entry.title: Research Summary: February 06, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by critical AI safety and security findings with significant implications for deployment and research integrity.

First Proof introduces a research-level math benchmark from Fields medalist Martin Hairer and colleagues with encrypted answers to prevent contamination. Meanwhile, analysis of NeurIPS 2025 reveals ~1% of accepted papers contain AI-generated fabricated citations, presenting a five-category hallucination taxonomy.

  • Chunky Post-Training from OpenAI (including John Schulman) identifies how discrete data curation creates spurious correlations causing generalization failures
  • Phantom Transfer demonstrates unfilterable data poisoning attacks effective on frontier models, challenging data-level defense assumptions
  • Steering Externalities reveals benign activation steering unexpectedly increases jailbreak vulnerability
  • Agent-as-a-Proxy and Among Us expose fundamental weaknesses in monitoring-based safety for agentic and multi-model systems

On the constructive side, Reducible Uncertainty Modeling (Dawn Song, Sharon Li) provides the first general framework for uncertainty quantification in LLM agents, while a position paper argues capability control should be architecturally separated from alignment.

entry.title: First Proof

author.name: Mohammed Abouzaid, Andrew J. Blumberg, Martin Hairer, Joe Kileel, Tamara G. Kolda, Paul D. Nelson, Daniel Spielman, Nikhil Srivastava, Rachel Ward, Shmuel Weinberger, Lauren Williams

entry.summary: Top mathematicians (including Fields medalist Hairer) share 10 research-level math problems with encrypted answers to evaluate AI mathematical reasoning. Problems arose naturally from their research.

entry.title: Compound Deception in Elite Peer Review: A Failure Mode Taxonomy of 100 Fabricated Citations at NeurIPS 2025

author.name: Samar Ansari

entry.summary: Analyzes 100 AI-generated hallucinated citations in 53 papers accepted at NeurIPS 2025 (~1% of accepted papers). Develops five-category taxonomy of hallucination failure modes including Total Fabrication (66%) and Partial Attribute Corruption (27%).

entry.title: Towards Reducible Uncertainty Modeling for Reliable Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Changdae Oh, Seongheon Park, To Eun Kim, Jiatong Li, Wendi Li, Samuel Yeh, Xuefeng Du, Hamed Hassani, Paul Bogdan, Dawn Song, Sharon Li

entry.summary: Presents first general framework for uncertainty quantification in LLM agents, arguing current UQ research incorrectly treats it as uncertainty accumulation. Proposes novel reducible uncertainty framework for interactive agents.

entry.title: Phantom Transfer: Data-level Defences are Insufficient Against Data Poisoning

author.name: Andrew Draganov, Tolga H. Dur, Anandmayi Bhongade, Mary Phuong

entry.summary: Introduces Phantom Transfer, a data poisoning attack that cannot be filtered even when the poisoning method is known. Demonstrates effectiveness across models including GPT-4.1, showing data-level defenses are fundamentally insufficient.

entry.title: PieArena: Frontier Language Agents Achieve MBA-Level Negotiation Performance and Reveal Novel Behavioral Differences

author.name: Chris Zhu (Department of Statistics, Data Science, Yale University), Sasha Cui (Department of Statistics, Data Science, Yale University), Will Sanok Dufallo (Department of Philosophy, Yale University), Runzhi Jin (School of Law, University of California, Berkeley), Zhen Xu (Bloomberg), Linjun Zhang (Department of Statistics, Rutgers University), Daylian Cain (Yale School of Management)

entry.summary: Introduces PieArena, a negotiation benchmark from MBA course scenarios, finding GPT-5 matches or outperforms trained business students. Studies joint-intentionality scaffolding effects.

entry.title: Position: Capability Control Should be a Separate Goal From Alignment

author.name: Shoaib Ahmed Siddiqui, Eleni Triantafillou, David Krueger, Adrian Weller

entry.summary: Position paper arguing capability control (hard operational limits) should be treated separately from alignment (preference-driven). Organizes control mechanisms across model lifecycle.

entry.title: Learning to Inject: Automated Prompt Injection via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xin Chen, Jie Zhang, Florian Tramer

entry.summary: Proposes AutoInject, an RL framework for generating universal, transferable adversarial suffixes for prompt injection attacks. Claims successful attacks on GPT-5 Nano, Claude Sonnet 3.5, and other frontier systems.

entry.title: Chunky Post-Training: Data Driven Failures of Generalization

author.name: Seoirse Murray, Allison Qi, Timothy Qian, John Schulman, Collin Burns, Sara Price

entry.summary: OpenAI researchers (including John Schulman) identify 'chunky post-training' - how discrete data curation creates spurious correlations that cause models to behave unexpectedly, like rejecting true facts in certain formats. They introduce SURF (runtime detection) and TURF (data refinement) to surface and mitigate these unintended behaviors.

entry.title: Democratic Preference Alignment via Sortition-Weighted RLHF

author.name: Suvadip Sana, Jinzhou Wu, Martin T. Wells

entry.summary: Introduces DemPO, applying democratic sortition (citizen assembly sampling) to RLHF to address demographic bias in preference data. Offers hard-panel (exclusive) and soft-panel (reweighted) training schemes.

entry.title: Steering Externalities: Benign Activation Steering Unintentionally Increases Jailbreak Risk for Large Language Models

author.name: Chen Xiong, Zhiyuan He, Pin-Yu Chen, Ching-Yun Ko, Tsung-Yi Ho

entry.summary: Identifies 'Steering Externalities' - an unexpected phenomenon where benign activation steering vectors (e.g., for compliance or JSON output) inadvertently erode safety guardrails and increase jailbreak susceptibility.

entry.title: Alignment Verifiability in Large Language Models: Normative Indistinguishability under Behavioral Evaluation

author.name: Igor Santos-Grueiro

entry.summary: Formally studies alignment verification under partial observability, introducing the concept of normative indistinguishability - when aligned and misaligned agents are behaviorally indistinguishable under finite evaluation. Shows this is a fundamental limitation.

entry.title: Among Us: Measuring and Mitigating Malicious Contributions in Model Collaboration Systems

author.name: Ziyuan Yang, Wenxuan Ding, Shangbin Feng, Yulia Tsvetkov

entry.summary: Studies safety risks in multi-LLM collaboration systems by engineering malicious models and measuring their impact. Finds severe degradation (7-8% average) especially in reasoning and safety domains, and proposes mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Bypassing AI Control Protocols via Agent-as-a-Proxy Attacks

author.name: Jafar Isbarov, Murat Kantarcioglu

entry.summary: Demonstrates Agent-as-a-Proxy attacks that bypass monitoring by treating the agent as a delivery mechanism, showing even frontier-scale monitors (Qwen2.5-72B) can be bypassed.

entry.title: Surgery: Mitigating Harmful Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models via Attention Sink

author.name: Guozhi Liu, Weiwei Lin, Tiansheng Huang, Ruichao Mo, Qi Mu, Xiumin Wang, Li Shen

entry.summary: Discovers that attention sinks can indicate harmful fine-tuning in LLMs, proposing 'Surgery' method to mitigate safety degradation by identifying and modifying attention heads with positive sink divergence.

entry.title: Split Personality Training: Revealing Latent Knowledge Through Alternate Personalities

author.name: Florian Dietz, William Wale, Oscar Gilg, Robert McCarthy, Felix Michalak, Gustavo Ewbank Rodrigues Danon, Miguelito de Guzman, Dietrich Klakow

entry.summary: Introduces Split Personality Training (SPT), fine-tuning an 'honest persona' into LoRA parameters to review and expose potentially misaligned responses while detecting concealed misbehavior.

entry.title: Dr. Kernel: Reinforcement Learning Done Right for Triton Kernel Generations

author.name: Wei Liu, Jiawei Xu, Yingru Li, Longtao Zheng, Tianjian Li, Qian Liu, Junxian He

entry.summary: Systematically studies RL for Triton kernel generation. Designs KernelGYM environment supporting reward hacking detection and multi-turn RL. Identifies bias toward trivial correctness over speedup.

entry.title: Inverse Depth Scaling From Most Layers Being Similar

author.name: Yizhou Liu, Sara Kangaslahti, Ziming Liu, Jeff Gore

entry.summary: Finds that loss scales inversely proportional to depth in LLMs, likely due to functionally similar layers reducing error through ensemble averaging rather than compositional learning. Suggests architectural innovations needed.

entry.title: Muon in Associative Memory Learning: Training Dynamics and Scaling Laws

author.name: Binghui Li, Kaifei Wang, Han Zhong, Pinyan Lu, Liwei Wang

entry.summary: Analyzes Muon optimizer dynamics in associative memory model, showing it mitigates learning rate imbalance across frequency components that slows GD. Proves exponential speedup in noiseless case.

entry.title: Stop Rewarding Hallucinated Steps: Faithfulness-Aware Step-Level Reinforcement Learning for Small Reasoning Models

author.name: Shuo Nie, Hexuan Deng, Chao Wang, Ruiyu Fang, Xuebo Liu, Shuangyong Song, Yu Li, Min Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes FaithRL for reducing faithfulness hallucinations in small reasoning models through step-level RL supervision with explicit faithfulness rewards and truncated resampling.

entry.title: Graph-based Agent Memory: Taxonomy, Techniques, and Applications

author.name: Chang Yang, Chuang Zhou, Yilin Xiao, Su Dong, Luyao Zhuang, Yujing Zhang, Zhu Wang, Zijin Hong, Zheng Yuan, Zhishang Xiang, Shengyuan Chen, Huachi Zhou, Qinggang Zhang, Ninghao Liu, Jinsong Su, Xinrun Wang, Yi Chang, Xiao Huang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of graph-based memory architectures for LLM agents, covering taxonomy of memory types, graph construction, retrieval mechanisms, and applications.

entry.title: Attack Selection Reduces Safety in Concentrated AI Control Settings against Trusted Monitoring

author.name: Joachim Schaeffer, Arjun Khandelwal, Tyler Tracy

entry.summary: Studies attack selection in AI control settings, showing how adversarial selection against monitors significantly reduces safety. Demonstrates safety is more sensitive to false positive rate than true positive rate.

entry.title: Structured Context Engineering for File-Native Agentic Systems: Evaluating Schema Accuracy, Format Effectiveness, and Multi-File Navigation at Scale

author.name: Damon McMillan

entry.summary: Presents a systematic 9,649-experiment study of context engineering for LLM agents across 11 models, 4 formats, and schemas up to 10,000 tables. Challenges common assumptions, finding that optimal architecture is model-dependent and file-based retrieval benefits frontier models differently than open-source ones.

entry.title: Transport and Merge: Cross-Architecture Merging for Large Language Models

author.name: Chenhang Cui, Binyun Yang, Fei Shen, Yuxin Chen, Jingnan Zheng, Xiang Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-architecture model merging framework using optimal transport to align activations and infer neuron correspondences between heterogeneous models. Enables knowledge transfer from large to small models without shared architecture.

entry.title: Back to Basics: Revisiting Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning via Generative Probabilities

author.name: Pengyi Li, Elizaveta Goncharova, Andrey Kuznetsov, Ivan Oseledets

entry.summary: Proposes Advantage Re-weighting Mechanism (ARM) to address mode collapse in GRPO-style LLM training by equilibrating confidence across correct responses, maintaining exploration.

entry.title: PACE: Defying the Scaling Hypothesis of Exploration in Iterative Alignment for Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Jun Rao, Zixiong Yu, Xuebo Liu, Guhan Chen, Jing Li, Jiansheng Wei, Xiaojun Meng, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Challenges the scaling hypothesis for exploration in iterative DPO, showing that aggressive Best-of-N sampling yields diminishing returns and can cause policy collapse. Proposes PACE for proximal alignment.

entry.title: Reinforcement World Model Learning for LLM-based Agents

author.name: Xiao Yu, Baolin Peng, Ruize Xu, Yelong Shen, Pengcheng He, Suman Nath, Nikhil Singh, Jiangfeng Gao, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes RWML for learning world models for LLM-based agents using sim-to-real gap rewards, aligning internal simulations with actual environment dynamics.

entry.title: The nature of LLM algorithmic progress

author.name: Steven Byrnes

entry.summary: Steven Byrnes argues that commonly cited ~3x/year algorithmic progress figures conflate different phenomena: training efficiency improvements are misleading, while inference efficiency gains largely come from distillation of frontier models.

entry.title: Towards a Science of Collective AI: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems Need a Transition from Blind Trial-and-Error to Rigorous Science

author.name: Jingru Fan, Dewen Liu, Yufan Dang, Huatao Li, Yuheng Wang, Wei Liu, Feiyu Duan, Xuanwen Ding, Shu Yao, Lin Wu, Ruijie Shi, Wai-Shing Leung, Yuan Cheng, Zhongyu Wei, Cheng Yang, Chen Qian, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Position paper advocating transition from trial-and-error to rigorous science for LLM-based multi-agent systems, proposing unified taxonomy and metrics for collaboration gain.

entry.title: When Shared Knowledge Hurts: Spectral Over-Accumulation in Model Merging

author.name: Yayuan Li, Ze Peng, Jian Zhang, Jintao Guo, Yue Duan, Yinghuan Shi

entry.summary: Identifies spectral over-accumulation as a failure mode in model merging - when tasks share aligned spectral directions, linear combination inflates singular values and biases toward shared subspaces. Proposes SVC to rescale inflated singular values.

entry.title: DLM-Scope: Mechanistic Interpretability of Diffusion Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Xu Wang, Bingqing Jiang, Yu Wan, Baosong Yang, Lingpeng Kong, Difan Zou

entry.summary: Introduces DLM-Scope, the first SAE-based interpretability framework for diffusion language models. Demonstrates that Top-K SAEs can extract interpretable features, with different effects than in autoregressive LLMs.

entry.title: Where Does Warm-Up Come From? Adaptive Scheduling for Norm-Constrained Optimizers

author.name: Artem Riabinin, Andrey Veprikov, Arman Bolatov, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Aleksandr Beznosikov

entry.summary: Studies adaptive learning rate scheduling for norm-constrained optimizers (Muon, Lion) under generalized smoothness. Shows warm-up arises naturally from theory rather than heuristics.

entry.title: SAIL: Self-Amplified Iterative Learning for Diffusion Model Alignment with Minimal Human Feedback

author.name: Xiaoxuan He, Siming Fu, Wanli Li, Zhiyuan Li, Dacheng Yin, Kang Rong, Fengyun Rao, Bo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SAIL for diffusion model alignment with minimal human feedback through iterative self-improvement, where models act as their own teachers.

entry.title: Learning Rate Matters: Vanilla LoRA May Suffice for LLM Fine-tuning

author.name: Yu-Ang Lee, Ching-Yun Ko, Pin-Yu Chen, Mi-Yen Yeh

entry.summary: Shows that vanilla LoRA performance matches or exceeds variants when learning rate is properly tuned. Different LoRA methods favor distinct learning rate ranges, explaining prior conflicting results.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Rethinking Policy Divergence Measures in GRPO

author.name: Qingyuan Wu, Yuhui Wang, Simon Sinong Zhan, Yanning Dai, Shilong Deng, Sarra Habchi, Qi Zhu, Matthias Gall\'e, Chao Huang

entry.summary: Introduces a unified clipping framework for GRPO that characterizes existing methods via general policy divergence measures, including likelihood ratios and KL divergences. Identifies the KL3 estimator as particularly effective.

entry.title: Mind the Performance Gap: Capability-Behavior Trade-offs in Feature Steering

author.name: Eitan Sprejer, Oscar Agust\'in Stanchi, Mar\'ia Victoria Carro, Denise Alejandra Mester, Iv\'an Arcuschin

entry.summary: Shows that feature steering methods substantially degrade model performance even when successfully controlling target behaviors. Evaluates Goodfire's Auto Steer against prompt engineering on MMLU.

entry.title: Rewards as Labels: Revisiting RLVR from a Classification Perspective

author.name: Zepeng Zhai, Meilin Chen, Jiaxuan Zhao, Junlang Qian, Lei Shen, Yuan Lu

entry.summary: REAL reformulates RLVR as classification with rewards as labels, addressing gradient misassignment and domination issues in GRPO. Introduces anchor logits for enhanced optimization.

entry.title: Bagpiper: Solving Open-Ended Audio Tasks via Rich Captions

author.name: Jinchuan Tian, Haoran Wang, Bo-Hao Su, Chien-yu Huang, Qingzheng Wang, Jiatong Shi, William Chen, Xun Gong, Siddhant Arora, Chin-Jou Li, Masao Someki, Takashi Maekaku, Yusuke Shinohara, Jin Sakuma, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Shinji Watanabe

entry.summary: Introduces Bagpiper, an 8B audio foundation model that interprets audio via rich natural language captions capturing transcription, events, and cognitive concepts. Pre-trained on 600B tokens.

entry.title: LongR: Unleashing Long-Context Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Dense Utility Rewards

author.name: Bowen Ping, Zijun Chen, Yiyao Yu, Tingfeng Hui, Junchi Yan, Baobao Chang

entry.summary: Proposes LongR for long-context reasoning via RL with dense utility rewards, integrating a dynamic Think-and-Read mechanism that interleaves reasoning with document consumption.

entry.title: GT-SVJ: Generative-Transformer-Based Self-Supervised Video Judge For Efficient Video Reward Modeling

author.name: Shivanshu Shekhar, Uttaran Bhattacharya, Raghavendra Addanki, Mehrab Tanjim, Somdeb Sarkhel, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GT-SVJ, repurposing video generation models as reward models by treating them as energy-based models that assign low energy to high-quality videos.

entry.title: Position: Universal Time Series Foundation Models Rest on a Category Error

author.name: Xilin Dai, Wanxu Cai, Zhijian Xu, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing universal time series foundation models are fundamentally flawed, mistaking structural container for semantic modality. Proposes 'Autoregressive Blindness Bound' showing history-only models cannot predict regime shifts.

entry.title: PATHWAYS: Evaluating Investigation and Context Discovery in AI Web Agents

author.name: Shifat E. Arman, Syed Nazmus Sakib, Tapodhir Karmakar Taton, Nafiul Haque, Shahrear Bin Amin

entry.summary: PATHWAYS benchmark tests whether web agents can discover and correctly use hidden contextual information. Finds agents navigate to relevant pages but retrieve decisive evidence rarely, often hallucinating investigative reasoning.

entry.title: RL-VLA$^3$: Reinforcement Learning VLA Accelerating via Full Asynchronism

author.name: Zhong Guan, Haoran Sun, Yongjian Guo, Shuai Di, Xiaodong Bai, Jing Long, Tianyun Zhao, Mingxi Luo, Chen Zhou, Yucheng Guo, Qiming Yang, Wanting Xu, Wen Huang, Yunxuan Ma, Hongke Zhao, Likang Wu, Xiaotie Deng, Xi Xiao, Sheng Wen, Yicheng Gong, Junwu Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes RL-VLA³, first fully-asynchronous training framework for Vision-Language-Action models spanning environment interaction, rollout generation, and policy updates.

entry.title: FlashBlock: Attention Caching for Efficient Long-Context Block Diffusion

author.name: Zhuokun Chen, Jianfei Cai, Bohan Zhuang

entry.summary: FlashBlock identifies cross-step attention redundancy in block diffusion and caches cross-block attention while updating block-internal attention for efficient long-context generation.

entry.title: Unveiling Implicit Advantage Symmetry: Why GRPO Struggles with Exploration and Difficulty Adaptation

author.name: Zhiqi Yu, Zhangquan Chen, Mengting Liu, Heye Zhang, Liangqiong Qu

entry.summary: Identifies implicit advantage symmetry in GRPO's Group Relative Advantage Estimation as causing exploration bottlenecks and difficulty adaptation issues. Shows symmetric weights leave unsampled action logits unchanged.

entry.title: Parity, Sensitivity, and Transformers

author.name: Alexander Kozachinskiy, Tomasz Steifer, Przemys{\l}aw Wa{\l}\c{e}ga

entry.summary: Provides new transformer construction for PARITY with softmax, length-independent positional encoding, and causal masking compatibility. Also gives first lower bound on transformer sensitivity.

entry.title: Transolver-3: Scaling Up Transformer Solvers to Industrial-Scale Geometries

author.name: Hang Zhou, Haixu Wu, Haonan Shangguan, Yuezhou Ma, Huikun Weng, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng Long

entry.summary: Transolver-3 scales neural PDE solvers to industrial geometries with 10^8+ cells through optimized tensor operations and geometry slicing. Achieves high-fidelity physics simulation at unprecedented scale.

entry.title: MentorCollab: Selective Large-to-Small Inference-Time Guidance for Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Haojin Wang, Yike Wang, Shangbin Feng, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Yulia Tsvetkov

entry.summary: Proposes MentorCollab where large reasoning models selectively and sparsely guide small models at inference time, avoiding verbose reasoning through divergence probing and lightweight verification.

entry.title: OPUS: Towards Efficient and Principled Data Selection in Large Language Model Pre-training in Every Iteration

author.name: Shaobo Wang, Xuan Ouyang, Tianyi Xu, Yuzheng Hu, Jialin Liu, Guo Chen, Tianyu Zhang, Junhao Zheng, Kexin Yang, Xingzhang Ren, Dayiheng Liu, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces OPUS for dynamic data selection during LLM pre-training, defining utility in optimizer-induced update space and using ghost technique with CountSketch for efficiency.

entry.title: OdysseyArena: Benchmarking Large Language Models For Long-Horizon, Active and Inductive Interactions

author.name: Fangzhi Xu, Hang Yan, Qiushi Sun, Jinyang Wu, Zixian Huang, Muye Huang, Jingyang Gong, Zichen Ding, Kanzhi Cheng, Yian Wang, Xinyu Che, Zeyi Sun, Jian Zhang, Zhangyue Yin, Haoran Luo, Xuanjing Huang, Ben Kao, Jun Liu, Qika Lin

entry.summary: Introduces OdysseyArena benchmark focusing on long-horizon, active, and inductive agent interactions, requiring agents to discover latent transition laws from experience.

entry.title: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding

author.name: Jian Chen, Yesheng Liang, Zhijian Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DFlash, using lightweight block diffusion models for parallel drafting in speculative decoding, combining diffusion's parallel generation with speculative decoding efficiency.

entry.title: AudioSAE: Towards Understanding of Audio-Processing Models with Sparse AutoEncoders

author.name: Georgii Aparin, Tasnima Sadekova, Alexey Rukhovich, Assel Yermekova, Laida Kushnareva, Vadim Popov, Kristian Kuznetsov, Irina Piontkovskaya

entry.summary: Trains sparse autoencoders on Whisper and HuBERT audio models, finding 50%+ feature stability across seeds. Features capture acoustic/semantic information and enable steering to reduce false speech detections by 70%.

entry.title: Capture the Flags: Family-Based Evaluation of Agentic LLMs via Semantics-Preserving Transformations

author.name: Shahin Honarvar, Amber Gorzynski, James Lee-Jones, Harry Coppock, Marek Rei, Joseph Ryan, Alastair F. Donaldson

entry.summary: Introduces CTF challenge families using semantics-preserving program transformations to evaluate agentic LLM robustness in cybersecurity. The Evolve-CTF tool generates equivalent challenges while keeping exploit strategy fixed.

entry.title: Diamond Maps: Efficient Reward Alignment via Stochastic Flow Maps

author.name: Peter Holderrieth, Douglas Chen, Luca Eyring, Ishin Shah, Giri Anantharaman, Yutong He, Zeynep Akata, Tommi Jaakkola, Nicholas Matthew Boffi, Max Simchowitz

entry.summary: Proposes Diamond Maps, stochastic flow map models enabling efficient reward alignment at inference time. Combines single-step sampling with preserved stochasticity for search and guidance scalability.

entry.title: The Single-Multi Evolution Loop for Self-Improving Model Collaboration Systems

author.name: Shangbin Feng, Kishan Panaganti, Yulia Tsvetkov, Wenhao Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a single-multi evolution loop where multi-model collaboration outputs are distilled into individual models, which then collaborate again in an iterative improvement cycle.

entry.title: Copyright Detective: A Forensic System to Evidence LLMs Flickering Copyright Leakage Risks

author.name: Guangwei Zhang, Jianing Zhu, Cheng Qian, Neil Gong, Rada Mihalcea, Zhaozhuo Xu, Jingrui He, Jiaqi Ma, Yun Huang, Chaowei Xiao, Bo Li, Ahmed Abbasi, Dongwon Lee, Heng Ji, Denghui Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Copyright Detective, an interactive forensic system for detecting copyright risks in LLM outputs through multiple detection paradigms including recall testing, paraphrase analysis, and jailbreak probing.

entry.title: MedErrBench: A Fine-Grained Multilingual Benchmark for Medical Error Detection and Correction with Clinical Expert Annotations

author.name: Congbo Ma, Yichun Zhang, Yousef Al-Jazzazi, Ahamed Foisal, Laasya Sharma, Yousra Sadqi, Khaled Saleh, Jihad Mallat, Farah E. Shamout

entry.summary: Introduces MedErrBench, the first multilingual benchmark for medical error detection, localization, and correction in English, Arabic, and Chinese with clinical expert annotations.

entry.title: Agent2Agent Threats in Safety-Critical LLM Assistants: A Human-Centric Taxonomy

author.name: Lukas Stappen, Ahmet Erkan Turan, Johann Hagerer, Georg Groh

entry.summary: Develops human-centric taxonomy for agent-to-agent security threats in LLM-based automotive assistants, addressing attack surfaces from inter-agent communication protocols like Google's A2A.

entry.title: Privileged Information Distillation for Language Models

author.name: Emiliano Penaloza, Dheeraj Vattikonda, Nicolas Gontier, Alexandre Lacoste, Laurent Charlin, Massimo Caccia

entry.summary: Introduces π-Distill for distilling frontier models in agentic environments where internal reasoning is hidden. Joint teacher-student objective enables transfer of capabilities learned with privileged information.

entry.title: CoPE: Clipped RoPE as A Scalable Free Lunch for Long Context LLMs

author.name: Haoran Li, Sucheng Ren, Alan Yuille, Feng Wang

entry.summary: CoPE clips low-frequency RoPE components as simple intervention for long context scaling, eliminating OOD outliers, refining semantic signals, and preventing spectral leakage.

entry.title: Multi-Task GRPO: Reliable LLM Reasoning Across Tasks

author.name: Shyam Sundhar Ramesh, Xiaotong Ji, Matthieu Zimmer, Sangwoong Yoon, Zhiyong Wang, Haitham Bou Ammar, Aurelien Lucchi, Ilija Bogunovic

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Task GRPO (MT-GRPO) that dynamically adapts task weights to optimize worst-task performance and addresses the zero-advantage problem where different tasks contribute unevenly to gradients.

entry.title: RISE-Video: Can Video Generators Decode Implicit World Rules?

author.name: Mingxin Liu, Shuran Ma, Shibei Meng, Xiangyu Zhao, Zicheng Zhang, Shaofeng Zhang, Zhihang Zhong, Peixian Chen, Haoyu Cao, Xing Sun, Haodong Duan, Xue Yang

entry.summary: Presents RISE-Video, a reasoning-oriented benchmark for text-image-to-video synthesis with 467 human-annotated samples spanning 8 categories. Evaluates model ability to reason about implicit world rules.

entry.title: Simulated Adoption: Decoupling Magnitude and Direction in LLM In-Context Conflict Resolution

author.name: Long Zhang, Fangwei Lin

entry.summary: Conducts layer-wise geometric analysis of LLM sycophancy across multiple models, decomposing residual stream updates into radial and angular components. Rejects universality of norm-based explanations.

entry.title: CASTLE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Student-Tailored Personalized Safety in Large Language Models

author.name: Rui Jia, Ruiyi Lan, Fengrui Liu, Zhongxiang Dai, Bo Jiang, Jing Shao, Jingyuan Chen, Guandong Xu, Fei Wu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CASTLE benchmark for evaluating student-tailored safety in LLMs, recognizing that identical responses may harm different students based on cognitive and psychological attributes.

entry.title: SAGE: Benchmarking and Improving Retrieval for Deep Research Agents

author.name: Tiansheng Hu, Yilun Zhao, Canyu Zhang, Arman Cohan, Chen Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE benchmark for evaluating retrieval in deep research agents with 1,200 queries across scientific domains and 200K paper corpus. Finds all systems struggle with reasoning-intensive retrieval.

entry.title: VERA-MH: Reliability and Validity of an Open-Source AI Safety Evaluation in Mental Health

author.name: Kate H. Bentley, Luca Belli, Adam M. Chekroud, Emily J. Ward, Emily R. Dworkin, Emily Van Ark, Kelly M. Johnston, Will Alexander, Millard Brown, Matt Hawrilenko

entry.summary: Validates VERA-MH, an open-source safety benchmark for AI chatbots in mental health contexts, focusing on suicide risk detection. Compares LLM evaluation against clinician grading.

entry.title: ProAct: Agentic Lookahead in Interactive Environments

author.name: Yangbin Yu, Mingyu Yang, Junyou Li, Yiming Gao, Feiyu Liu, Yijun Yang, Zichuan Lin, Jiafei Lyu, Yicheng Liu, Zhicong Lu, Deheng Ye, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes ProAct, enabling LLM agents to internalize lookahead reasoning through supervised training on search-derived trajectories (GLAD) and Monte-Carlo critic refinement for improved long-horizon planning.

entry.title: BABE: Biology Arena BEnchmark

author.name: Junting Zhou, Jin Chen, Linfeng Hao, Denghui Cao, Zheyu Wang, Qiguang Chen, Chaoyou Fu, Jiaze Chen, Yuchen Wu, Ge Zhang, Mingxuan Wang, Wenhao Huang, Tong Yang

entry.summary: Introduces BABE (Biology Arena Benchmark) evaluating AI experimental reasoning capabilities using peer-reviewed research papers requiring integration of experimental results with contextual knowledge.

entry.title: A Causal Perspective for Enhancing Jailbreak Attack and Defense

author.name: Licheng Pan, Yunsheng Lu, Jiexi Liu, Jialing Tao, Haozhe Feng, Hui Xue, Zhixuan Chu, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Proposes Causal Analyst, a framework using LLMs for data-driven causal discovery to identify direct causes of jailbreaks. Introduces a 35k jailbreak attempt dataset across seven LLMs for both attack and defense research.

entry.title: Data-Centric Interpretability for LLM-based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: John Yan, Michael Yu, Yuqi Sun, Alexander Duffy, Tyler Marques, Matthew Lyle Olson

entry.summary: Applies sparse autoencoders to analyze RL training in Full-Press Diplomacy, introducing Meta-Autointerp to group features into interpretable hypotheses about training dynamics.

entry.title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter

author.name: Xukun Li, Yu Sun, Lei Zhang, Bosheng Huang, Yibo Peng, Yuan Meng, Haojun Jiang, Shaoxuan Xie, Guacai Yao, Alois Knoll, Zhenshan Bing, Xinlong Wang, Zhenguo Sun

entry.summary: Introduces DECO, a DiT-based policy for bimanual dexterous manipulation that decouples multimodal conditioning. Includes DECO-50, a dataset with 50+ hours of bimanual manipulation data with tactile sensing across 28 sub-tasks.

entry.title: Steering Large Reasoning Models towards Concise Reasoning via Flow Matching

author.name: Yawei Li, Benjamin Bergner, Yinghan Zhao, Vihang Prakash Patil, Bei Chen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FlowSteer, a nonlinear steering method for reducing verbosity in Large Reasoning Models. Uses flow matching to learn transformations between verbose and concise reasoning distributions, enabling input-dependent control.

entry.title: EuroLLM-22B: Technical Report

author.name: Miguel Moura Ramos, Duarte M. Alves, Hippolyte Gisserot-Boukhlef, Jo\~ao Alves, Pedro Henrique Martins, Patrick Fernandes, Jos\'e Pombal, Nuno M. Guerreiro, Ricardo Rei, Nicolas Boizard, Amin Farajian, Mateusz Klimaszewski, Jos\'e G. C. de Souza, Barry Haddow, Fran\c{c}ois Yvon, Pierre Colombo, Alexandra Birch, Andr\'e F. T. Martins

entry.summary: Presents EuroLLM-22B, a multilingual LLM trained from scratch covering all 24 EU official languages plus 11 additional languages. Releases base model and provides comprehensive training details.

entry.title: Learning Where It Matters: Geometric Anchoring for Robust Preference Alignment

author.name: Youngjae Cho, Jongsuk Kim, Ji-Hoon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes GAPO (Geometric Anchor Preference Optimization) replacing fixed reference policies with dynamic geometry-aware anchors. Uses adversarial local perturbations as pessimistic baseline for adaptive reweighting.

entry.title: Does SGD Seek Flatness or Sharpness? An Exactly Solvable Model

author.name: Yizhou Xu, Pierfrancesco Beneventano, Isaac Chuang, Liu Ziyin

entry.summary: Provides analytically solvable model showing SGD has no intrinsic preference for flatness, only for minimal gradient fluctuations. Data distribution determines whether SGD seeks flat or sharp solutions.

entry.title: Logical Guidance for the Exact Composition of Diffusion Models

author.name: Francesco Alesiani, Jonathan Warrell, Tanja Bien, Henrik Christiansen, Matheus Ferraz, Mathias Niepert

entry.summary: LOGDIFF enables principled logical composition of diffusion models through exact Boolean calculus for conjunctions and disjunctions when subformulas satisfy conditional independence conditions.

entry.title: ContextBench: A Benchmark for Context Retrieval in Coding Agents

author.name: Han Li, Letian Zhu, Bohan Zhang, Rili Feng, Jiaming Wang, Yue Pan, Earl T. Barr, Sarro Federica, Zhaoyang Chu, He Ye

entry.summary: ContextBench provides a process-oriented benchmark for evaluating how coding agents retrieve and use code context during issue resolution. It covers 1,136 tasks across 66 repositories and 8 languages with human-annotated gold contexts, enabling measurement of context recall, precision, and efficiency throughout agent trajectories.

entry.title: FedMosaic: Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Parametric Adapters

author.name: Zhilin Liang, Yuxiang Wang, Zimu Zhou, Hainan Zhang, Boyi Liu, Yongxin Tong

entry.summary: Proposes FedMosaic for federated RAG using parametric adapters that encode documents into lightweight modules, avoiding raw document transmission for privacy preservation.

entry.title: Once Correct, Still Wrong: Counterfactual Hallucination in Multilingual Vision-Language Models

author.name: Basel Mousi, Fahim Dalvi, Shammur Chowdhury, Firoj Alam, Nadir Durrani

entry.summary: Introduces M2CQA benchmark for measuring counterfactual hallucination in VLMs across MENA cultural contexts. Proposes CounterFactual Hallucination Rate metric showing high acceptance of false culturally-plausible statements.

entry.title: Weaver: End-to-End Agentic System Training for Video Interleaved Reasoning

author.name: Yudi Shi, Shangzhe Di, Qirui Chen, Qinian Wang, Jiayin Cai, Xiaolong Jiang, Yao Hu, Weidi Xie

entry.summary: Introduces Weaver, an end-to-end trainable agentic system for video reasoning that enables policy models to dynamically invoke diverse tools during reasoning for progressive visual cue acquisition.

entry.title: Visuo-Tactile World Models

author.name: Carolina Higuera, Sergio Arnaud, Byron Boots, Mustafa Mukadam, Francois Robert Hogan, Franziska Meier

entry.summary: Introduces Visuo-Tactile World Models (VT-WM) that combine vision and touch sensing to improve physical reasoning in contact-rich manipulation tasks. Shows 33% better object permanence and 29% better physics compliance.

entry.title: Anchored Policy Optimization: Mitigating Exploration Collapse Via Support-Constrained Rectification

author.name: Tianyi Wang, Long Li, Hongcan Guo, Yibiao Chen, Yixia Li, Yong Wang, Yun Chen, Guanhua Chen

entry.summary: Identifies Recursive Space Contraction in RLVR and proposes Anchored Policy Optimization (APO), shifting from KL-based shape matching to support coverage via Safe Manifold constraint.

entry.title: AgenticPay: A Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation System for Buyer-Seller Transactions

author.name: Xianyang Liu, Shangding Gu, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticPay, a benchmark and simulation framework for multi-agent buyer-seller negotiation with 110+ tasks spanning bilateral to many-to-many markets with private constraints.

entry.title: Momentum Attention: The Physics of In-Context Learning and Spectral Forensics for Mechanistic Interpretability

author.name: Kingsuk Maitra

entry.summary: Introduces Momentum Attention with a symplectic augmentation embedding physical priors. Discovers fundamental Symplectic-Filter Duality showing physical shear equals high-pass filtering, bypassing depth constraints for induction heads.

entry.title: Double-P: Hierarchical Top-P Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLMs

author.name: Wentao Ni, Kangqi Zhang, Zhongming Yu, Oren Nelson, Mingu Lee, Hong Cai, Fatih Porikli, Jongryool Kim, Zhijian Liu, Jishen Zhao

entry.summary: Double-P proposes hierarchical top-p sparse attention with coarse-grained estimation and block-level refinement, optimizing selection overhead and sparse attention cost jointly.

entry.title: Better Source, Better Flow: Learning Condition-Dependent Source Distribution for Flow Matching

author.name: Junwan Kim, Jiho Park, Seonghu Jeon, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes learning condition-dependent source distributions for flow matching in text-to-image generation. Shows principled source distribution design is beneficial at scale of modern systems.

entry.title: BioACE: An Automated Framework for Biomedical Answer and Citation Evaluations

author.name: Deepak Gupta, Davis Bartels, Dina Demner-Fuhsman

entry.summary: Introduces BioACE, an automated framework for evaluating biomedical QA answers and their citations without requiring expert assessment. Addresses the challenge of evaluating LLM-generated medical content.

entry.title: RRAttention: Dynamic Block Sparse Attention via Per-Head Round-Robin Shifts for Long-Context Inference

author.name: Siran Liu, Guoxia Wang, Sa Wang, Jinle Zeng, HaoYang Xie, Siyu Lou, JiaBin Yang, DianHai Yu, Haifeng Wang, Chao Yang

entry.summary: Presents RRAttention, dynamic sparse attention using head round-robin sampling strategy for efficient long-context inference while maintaining query independence.

entry.title: AgentXRay: White-Boxing Agentic Systems via Workflow Reconstruction

author.name: Ruijie Shi, Houbin Zhang, Yuecheng Han, Yuheng Wang, Jingru Fan, Runde Yang, Yufan Dang, Huatao Li, Dewen Liu, Yuan Cheng, Chen Qian

entry.summary: Introduces AgentXRay for reconstructing interpretable workflows from black-box agentic systems using only input-output access. Formulates as combinatorial optimization over agent roles and tool invocations.

entry.title: SDFP: Speculative Decoding with FIT-Pruned Models for Training-Free and Plug-and-Play LLM Acceleration

author.name: Hanyu Wei, Zunhai Su, Peng Lu, Chao Li, Spandan Tiwari, Ashish Sirasao, Yuhan Dong

entry.summary: Proposes SDFP, a training-free speculative decoding framework using Fisher Information Trace-based layer pruning to create draft models, achieving plug-and-play acceleration.

entry.title: Depth-Wise Emergence of Prediction-Centric Geometry in Large Language Models

author.name: Shahar Haim, Daniel C McNamee

entry.summary: Demonstrates depth-wise transition in decoder LLMs from context-processing to prediction-forming phases, with geometric reorganization enabling selective causal control over predictions via angular organization.

entry.title: ZeroS: Zero-Sum Linear Attention for Efficient Transformers

author.name: Jiecheng Lu, Xu Han, Yan Sun, Viresh Pati, Yubin Kim, Siddhartha Somani, Shihao Yang

entry.summary: ZeroS proposes zero-sum linear attention removing constant term and reweighting residuals, enabling negative attention weights and contrastive operations with O(N) complexity.

entry.title: Spider-Sense: Intrinsic Risk Sensing for Efficient Agent Defense with Hierarchical Adaptive Screening

author.name: Zhenxiong Yu, Zhi Yang, Zhiheng Jin, Shuhe Wang, Heng Zhang, Yanlin Fei, Lingfeng Zeng, Fangqi Lou, Shuo Zhang, Tu Hu, Jingping Liu, Rongze Chen, Xingyu Zhu, Kunyi Wang, Chaofa Yuan, Xin Guo, Zhaowei Liu, Feipeng Zhang, Jie Huang, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen, Liwen Zhang

entry.summary: Spider-Sense proposes event-driven defense framework with Intrinsic Risk Sensing allowing agents to maintain latent vigilance and trigger hierarchical defenses only upon risk perception.

entry.title: Stable but Wrong: When More Data Degrades Scientific Conclusions

author.name: Zhipeng Zhang, Kai Li

entry.summary: Demonstrates that standard inference procedures can converge to incorrect conclusions when observation reliability degrades in unobservable ways, even while passing diagnostic checks. Additional data worsens rather than corrects errors.

entry.title: OmniMoE: An Efficient MoE by Orchestrating Atomic Experts at Scale

author.name: Jingze Shi, Zhangyang Peng, Yizhang Zhu, Yifan Wu, Guang Liu, Yuyu Luo

entry.summary: Proposes OmniMoE with vector-level Atomic Experts enabling fine-grained routing within single MoE layers. Uses Cartesian product routing and fused kernels to address efficiency challenges of atomic granularity.

entry.title: Verification of the Implicit World Model in a Generative Model via Adversarial Sequences

author.name: Andr\'as Balogh, M\'ark Jelasity

entry.summary: Proposes adversarial sequence generation for verifying soundness of generative models' implicit world models. Uses chess as testbed where rule-based world model enables precise verification.

entry.title: GenArena: How Can We Achieve Human-Aligned Evaluation for Visual Generation Tasks?

author.name: Ruihang Li, Leigang Qu, Jingxu Zhang, Dongnan Gui, Mengde Xu, Xiaosong Zhang, Han Hu, Wenjie Wang, Jiaqi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces GenArena, a unified pairwise comparison framework for evaluating visual generation. Shows pairwise paradigm enables stable and human-aligned evaluation, unlike absolute pointwise scoring.

entry.title: Position: Machine Learning for Heart Transplant Allocation Policy Optimization Should Account for Incentives

author.name: Ioannis Anagnostides, Itai Zilberstein, Zachary W. Sollie, Arman Kilic, Tuomas Sandholm

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that ML for organ allocation must account for game-theoretic incentives among transplant centers and clinicians. Presents data showing current adverse consequences from ignoring incentives.

entry.title: Multi-Token Prediction via Self-Distillation

author.name: John Kirchenbauer, Abhimanyu Hans, Brian Bartoldson, Micah Goldblum, Ashwinee Panda, Tom Goldstein

entry.summary: Presents a self-distillation approach to convert pretrained autoregressive LLMs into multi-token prediction models without auxiliary speculator networks. Achieves 3x faster decoding on GSM8K with less than 5% accuracy drop while maintaining the exact same model architecture.

entry.title: Locas: Your Models are Principled Initializers of Locally-Supported Parametric Memories

author.name: Sidi Lu, Zhenwen Liang, Dongyang Ma, Yan Wang, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu

entry.summary: Presents Locas, a parametric memory system for transformers that enables flexible test-time training and continual learning. Memory can be offloaded or merged with model parameters.

entry.title: Causal Front-Door Adjustment for Robust Jailbreak Attacks on LLMs

author.name: Yao Zhou, Zeen Song, Wenwen Qiang, Fengge Wu, Shuyi Zhou, Changwen Zheng, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes CFA², a jailbreak attack framework using Pearl's Front-Door Criterion to bypass safety mechanisms by modeling them as unobserved confounders, using sparse autoencoders.

entry.title: Multimodal Latent Reasoning via Hierarchical Visual Cues Injection

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Qiangyu Yan, Borui Jiang, Kai Han

entry.summary: Proposes HIVE for multimodal latent reasoning by recursively extending transformer blocks for iterative refinement, enabling slow thinking without explicit chain-of-thought.

entry.title: UI-Mem: Self-Evolving Experience Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning in Mobile GUI Agents

author.name: Han Xiao, Guozhi Wang, Hao Wang, Shilong Liu, Yuxiang Chai, Yue Pan, Yufeng Zhou, Xiaoxin Chen, Yafei Wen, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes UI-Mem, enhancing GUI agent online RL with hierarchical experience memory storing workflows, subtask skills, and failure patterns as parameterized templates for cross-task transfer.

entry.title: Context Forcing: Consistent Autoregressive Video Generation with Long Context

author.name: Shuo Chen, Cong Wei, Sun Sun, Ping Nie, Kai Zhou, Ge Zhang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Wenhu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Context Forcing for consistent autoregressive video generation, training long-context student via long-context teacher to resolve student-teacher mismatch in streaming approaches.

entry.title: The Simplest Case for AI Catastrophe

author.name: Linch

entry.summary: Linch presents a streamlined argument for AI catastrophe risk: tech companies are building superhuman AI, these will be goal-seeking agents, we cannot reliably specify or verify their goals, leading to potential catastrophic outcomes.

entry.title: How to train any multiagent systems end-to-end from AI feedback

author.name: Ed Li

entry.summary: Presents MAPPA method for training multi-agent systems end-to-end using AI feedback as per-action process rewards, addressing credit assignment through coach LLM observation. Shows improvements on coding tasks.

entry.title: NEX: Neuron Explore-Exploit Scoring for Label-Free Chain-of-Thought Selection and Model Ranking

author.name: Kang Chen, Zhuoka Feng, Sihan Zhao, Kai Xiong, Junjie Nian, Yaoning Wang, Changyi Xiao, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: Proposes NEX, a white-box label-free framework scoring chain-of-thought traces by detecting exploration-exploitation phases via MLP neuron activation spikes with sticky HMM inference.

entry.title: Internalizing LLM Reasoning via Discovery and Replay of Latent Actions

author.name: Zhenning Shi, Yijia Zhu, Junhan Shi, Xun Zhang, Lei Wang, Congcong Miao

entry.summary: STIR reformulates reasoning enhancement as dynamic latent trajectory control, using differential intrinsic action induction and sparse control basis construction for adaptive steering.

entry.title: Towards Worst-Case Guarantees with Scale-Aware Interpretability

author.name: Lauren Greenspan, David Berman, Aryeh Brill, Ro Jefferson, Artemy Kolchinsky, Jennifer Lin, Andrew Mack, Anindita Maiti, Fernando E. Rosas, Alexander Stapleton, Lucas Teixeira, Dmitry Vaintrob

entry.summary: Proposes research agenda combining renormalization from physics with interpretability, arguing scale-aware methods can provide worst-case guarantees by tracking feature composition across resolutions.

entry.title: Variational Speculative Decoding: Rethinking Draft Training from Token Likelihood to Sequence Acceptance

author.name: Xiandong Zou, Jianshu Li, Jing Huang, Pan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Variational Speculative Decoding (VSD) that formulates draft training as variational inference over latent proposals. Uses ELBO optimization and EM procedure for higher quality draft paths.

entry.title: Correctness-Optimized Residual Activation Lens (CORAL): Transferrable and Calibration-Aware Inference-Time Steering

author.name: Miranda Muqing Miao, Young-Min Cho, Lyle Ungar

entry.summary: Proposes CORAL, a regularized inference-time steering method capturing correctness signals from model activations using weight-decay MLP probes. Improves accuracy by 10% and calibration by 50% on average.

entry.title: Private PoEtry: Private In-Context Learning via Product of Experts

author.name: Rob Romijnders, Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani, Jonathan Petit, Max Welling, Christos Louizos, Yuki M. Asano

entry.summary: Proposes Private PoEtry for differentially private in-context learning using Product of Experts formulation. Provides theoretical grounding and parallelization for privacy-preserving ICL.

entry.title: Length-Unbiased Sequence Policy Optimization: Revealing and Controlling Response Length Variation in RLVR

author.name: Fanfan Liu, Youyang Yin, Peng Shi, Siqi Yang, Zhixiong Zeng, Haibo Qiu

entry.summary: Analyzes response length variation in RLVR training, providing theoretical explanation for why different algorithms produce different length patterns. Proposes methods for controlling length.

entry.title: Self-Improving Multilingual Long Reasoning via Translation-Reasoning Integrated Training

author.name: Junxiao Liu, Zhijun Wang, Yixiao Li, Zhejian Lai, Liqian Huang, Xin Huang, Xue Han, Junlan Feng, Shujian Huang

entry.summary: Proposes TRIT for self-improving multilingual reasoning by integrating translation training with reasoning, improving both question understanding and response generation without external feedback.

entry.title: Magic-MM-Embedding: Towards Visual-Token-Efficient Universal Multimodal Embedding with MLLMs

author.name: Qi Li, Yanzhe Zhao, Yongxin Zhou, Yameng Wang, Yandong Yang, Yuanjia Zhou, Jue Wang, Zuojian Wang, Jinxiang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Magic-MM-Embedding for efficient universal multimodal embedding using visual token compression and multi-stage progressive training.

entry.title: SocialVeil: Probing Social Intelligence of Language Agents under Communication Barriers

author.name: Keyang Xuan, Pengda Wang, Chongrui Ye, Haofei Yu, Tal August, Jiaxuan You

entry.summary: Presents SocialVeil, a benchmark testing LLM social intelligence under realistic communication barriers including semantic vagueness, sociocultural mismatch, and emotional interference.

entry.title: RaBiT: Residual-Aware Binarization Training for Accurate and Efficient LLMs

author.name: Youngcheon You, Banseok Lee, Minseop Choi, Seonyoung Kim, Hyochan Chong, Changdong Kim, Youngmin Kim, Dongkyu Kim

entry.summary: Proposes RaBiT for extreme LLM quantization using residual binarization, identifying and solving inter-path adaptation problem where parallel binary paths learn redundant features.

entry.title: Determining Energy Efficiency Sweet Spots in Production LLM Inference

author.name: Hiari Pizzini Cavagna, Andrea Proia, Giacomo Madella, Giovanni B. Esposito, Francesco Antici, Daniele Cesarini, Zeynep Kiziltan, Andrea Bartolini

entry.summary: Discovers non-linear energy efficiency regimes in LLM inference, finding peak efficiency at short-to-moderate inputs with medium outputs. Proposes analytical model based on transformer architecture complexity.

entry.title: Extracting Recurring Vulnerabilities from Black-Box LLM-Generated Software

author.name: Tomer Kordonsky, Maayan Yamin, Noam Benzimra, Amit LeVi, Avi Mendelson

entry.summary: Studies vulnerability persistence in LLM-generated code and introduces Feature-Security Table (FSTab) enabling black-box attacks that predict backend vulnerabilities from frontend features without code access.

entry.title: TIDE: Temporal Incremental Draft Engine for Self-Improving LLM Inference

author.name: Jiyoung Park, Hankyu Jang, Changseok Song, Wookeun Jung

entry.summary: TIDE integrates online draft adaptation into LLM inference engines, reusing hidden states for training signals and employing adaptive runtime control for speculative decoding.

entry.title: Attention Retention for Continual Learning with Vision Transformers

author.name: Yue Lu, Xiangyu Zhou, Shizhou Zhang, Yinghui Xing, Guoqiang Liang, Wencong Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies attention drift in Vision Transformers as a primary source of catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. Proposes an attention-retaining framework that constrains drift by modifying gradients during backpropagation.

entry.title: Path-Guided Flow Matching for Dataset Distillation

author.name: Xuhui Li, Zhengquan Luo, Xiwei Liu, Yongqiang Yu, Zhiqiang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Path-Guided Flow Matching (PGFM), the first flow matching-based framework for dataset distillation. Enables fast deterministic synthesis via ODE solving in VAE latent space.

entry.title: Mining Generalizable Activation Functions

author.name: Alex Vitvitskyi, Michael Boratko, Matej Grcic, Razvan Pascanu, Deep Shah, Petar Veli\v{c}kovi\'c

entry.summary: Uses evolutionary search with frontier LLMs (citing AlphaEvolve approach) as mutation operators to discover new activation functions. Shows modern pipelines enable broader search across all Python functions within FLOP budgets.

entry.title: Learning to Share: Selective Memory for Efficient Parallel Agentic Systems

author.name: Joseph Fioresi, Parth Parag Kulkarni, Ashmal Vayani, Song Wang, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes Learning to Share (LTS), a learned shared-memory mechanism for parallel agentic systems enabling selective cross-team information reuse while controlling context growth.

entry.title: Gradually Compacting Large Language Models for Reasoning Like a Boiling Frog

author.name: Yiran Zhao, Shengyang Zhou, Zijian Wu, Tongyan Hu, Yuhui Xu, Rengan Dou, Kenji Kawaguchi, Shafiq Joty, Junnan Li, Michael Qizhe Shieh

entry.summary: Proposes a gradual model compression method for LLMs using iterative Prune-Tune Loops, avoiding the dramatic performance drops seen with conventional pruning. The 'boiling frog' approach incrementally reduces model size while maintaining reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Erase at the Core: Representation Unlearning for Machine Unlearning

author.name: Jaewon Lee, Yongwoo Kim, Donghyun Kim

entry.summary: Identifies 'superficial forgetting' where unlearning methods only alter final classifiers while preserving information in features. Proposes Erase at the Core with multi-layer contrastive unlearning.

entry.title: Transformers Are Born Biased: Structural Inductive Biases at Random Initialization and Their Practical Consequences

author.name: Siquan Li, Yao Tong, Haonan Wang, Tianyang Hu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that randomly initialized transformers exhibit strong structural biases - certain tokens are predicted with probabilities orders of magnitude higher than others before any training. Provides mechanistic explanation: token representations contract along random directions that correlate with common tokens.

entry.title: Diffusion Model's Generalization Can Be Characterized by Inductive Biases toward a Data-Dependent Ridge Manifold

author.name: Ye He, Yitong Qiu, Molei Tao

entry.summary: Provides theoretical characterization of how diffusion models generalize by proposing a 'ridge manifold' concept. The inference process follows a reach-align-slide trajectory around this manifold, offering quantitative understanding of generation dynamics.

entry.title: KV-CoRE: Benchmarking Data-Dependent Low-Rank Compressibility of KV-Caches in LLMs

author.name: Jian Chen, Zhuoran Wang, Jiayu Qin, Ming Li, Meng Wang, Changyou Chen, Yin Chen, Qizhen Weng, Yirui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes KV-CoRE, an SVD-based method for evaluating data-dependent low-rank compressibility of KV-caches across models and datasets, enabling systematic compression analysis.

entry.title: ReGLA: Efficient Receptive-Field Modeling with Gated Linear Attention Network

author.name: Junzhou Li, Manqi Zhao, Yilin Gao, Zhiheng Yu, Yin Li, Dongsheng Jiang, Li Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces ReGLA, lightweight hybrid networks combining efficient convolutions with ReLU-based gated linear attention for high-resolution image processing.

entry.title: Dolphin-v2: Universal Document Parsing via Scalable Anchor Prompting

author.name: Hao Feng, Wei Shi, Ke Zhang, Xiang Fei, Lei Liao, Dingkang Yang, Yongkun Du, Xuecheng Wu, Jingqun Tang, Yang Liu, Hong Chen, Can Huang

entry.summary: Presents Dolphin-v2 for universal document parsing with anchor prompting, handling both digital-born and photographed documents with joint type classification and layout analysis.

entry.title: Stable Velocity: A Variance Perspective on Flow Matching

author.name: Donglin Yang, Yongxing Zhang, Xin Yu, Liang Hou, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Xiaojuan Qi, Renjie Liao

entry.summary: Provides variance analysis of flow matching training, identifying high-variance regimes near the prior that destabilize optimization. Proposes Stable Velocity framework with unbiased variance reduction and adaptive representation alignment.

entry.title: UniSurg: A Video-Native Foundation Model for Universal Understanding of Surgical Videos

author.name: Jinlin Wu, Felix Holm, Chuxi Chen, An Wang, Yaxin Hu, Xiaofan Ye, Zelin Zang, Miao Xu, Lihua Zhou, Huai Liao, Danny T. M. Chan, Ming Feng, Wai S. Poon, Hongliang Ren, Dong Yi, Nassir Navab, Gaofeng Meng, Jiebo Luo, Hongbin Liu, Zhen Lei

entry.summary: Introduces UniSurg, a video-native foundation model for surgical video understanding built on V-JEPA. Shifts from pixel reconstruction to latent motion prediction with motion-guided learning and spatiotemporal self-distillation.

entry.title: Thinking with Geometry: Active Geometry Integration for Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Haoyuan Li, Qihang Cao, Tao Tang, Kun Xiang, Zihan Guo, Jianhua Han, Hang Xu, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoThinker, shifting from passive geometry fusion to active perception where models selectively retrieve geometric evidence conditioned on reasoning demands.

entry.title: Scalable and General Whole-Body Control for Cross-Humanoid Locomotion

author.name: Yufei Xue, YunFeng Lin, Wentao Dong, Yang Tang, Jingbo Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Ming Zhou, Minghuan Liu, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: XHugWBC presents a cross-embodiment training framework enabling a single policy to control diverse humanoid robot designs through morphological randomization and semantically aligned observation/action spaces.

entry.title: Episodic memory in AI agents poses new safety risks

author.name: Chad DeChant

entry.summary: Argues episodic memory in AI agents will enable deception, improved situational awareness, and unpredictable behavior, proposing safety principles: memories should be interpretable, user-controlled, and time-limited.

entry.title: ALIVE: Awakening LLM Reasoning via Adversarial Learning and Instructive Verbal Evaluation

author.name: Yiwen Duan, Jing Ye, Xinpei Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces ALIVE, an adversarial learning framework for LLM reasoning that replaces scalar rewards with verbal evaluation, aiming for 'hands-free' alignment without external supervision.

entry.title: TangramSR: Can Vision-Language Models Reason in Continuous Geometric Space?

author.name: Yikun Zong, Cheston Tan

entry.summary: Introduces TangramSR benchmark testing VLM spatial reasoning on Tangram puzzles. Finds systematic failures: 0.41 average IoU on single pieces dropping to 0.23 on composition, with frequent hallucinated reasoning.

entry.title: SLAY: Geometry-Aware Spherical Linearized Attention with Yat-Kernel

author.name: Jose Miguel Luna, Taha Bouhsine, Krzysztof Choromanski

entry.summary: SLAY proposes linear-time attention using a relaxed Yat-kernel formulation with spherical constraints. Derives strictly positive random-feature approximation enabling O(L) complexity.

entry.title: Do Vision-Language Models Respect Contextual Integrity in Location Disclosure?

author.name: Ruixin Yang, Ethan Mendes, Arthur Wang, James Hays, Sauvik Das, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: Studies whether VLMs respect contextual integrity when performing geolocation, finding they can infer sensitive locations from casual photos at street-level precision without appropriate reasoning.

entry.title: Formal Synthesis of Certifiably Robust Neural Lyapunov-Barrier Certificates

author.name: Chengxiao Wang, Haoze Wu, Gagandeep Singh

entry.summary: Proposes formal synthesis of robust neural Lyapunov-barrier certificates that maintain guarantees under dynamics perturbations, with Lipschitz-based conditions and practical training.

entry.title: AI chatbots versus human healthcare professionals: a systematic review and meta-analysis of empathy in patient care

author.name: Alastair Howcroft, Amber Bennett-Weston, Ahmad Khan, Joseff Griffiths, Simon Gay, Jeremy Howick

entry.summary: Systematic review and meta-analysis comparing AI chatbot empathy versus human healthcare professionals. Finds mixed results with studies suggesting chatbots may sometimes match or exceed human empathy in patient care.

entry.title: CompactRAG: Reducing LLM Calls and Token Overhead in Multi-Hop Question Answering

author.name: Hao Yang, Zhiyu Yang, Xupeng Zhang, Wei Wei, Yunjie Zhang, Lin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CompactRAG that decouples offline corpus restructuring from online reasoning for multi-hop QA. Converts corpus into atomic QA pairs offline, enabling efficient retrieval with entity-consistent query decomposition.

entry.title: Learning Query-Aware Budget-Tier Routing for Runtime Agent Memory

author.name: Haozhen Zhang, Haodong Yue, Tao Feng, Quanyu Long, Jianzhu Bao, Bowen Jin, Weizhi Zhang, Xiao Li, Jiaxuan You, Chengwei Qin, Wenya Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BudgetMem, a runtime agent memory framework with explicit query-aware performance-cost control. Uses budget tiers (Low/Mid/High) with lightweight router for memory module selection.

entry.title: TurboBoA: Faster and Exact Attention-aware Quantization without Backpropagation

author.name: Junhan Kim, Yeo Jeong Park, Seungwoo Son, Chungman Lee, Ho-young Kim, Joonyoung Kim, Yongkweon Jeon

entry.summary: TurboBoA improves upon BoA quantization by preserving inter-layer attention dependencies while achieving efficiency comparable to GPTQ. Enables accurate low-bit quantization without backpropagation.

entry.title: Detecting Misbehaviors of Large Vision-Language Models by Evidential Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Tao Huang, Rui Wang, Xiaofei Liu, Yi Qin, Li Duan, Liping Jing

entry.summary: Proposes evidential uncertainty quantification to detect LVLMs misbehaviors like hallucinations by separating epistemic uncertainty from conflicting knowledge vs. missing information.

entry.title: Polyglots or Multitudes? Multilingual LLM Answers to Value-laden Multiple-Choice Questions

author.name: L\'eo Labat, Etienne Ollion, Fran\c{c}ois Yvon

entry.summary: Introduces MEVS (Multilingual European Value Survey) to study whether multilingual LLMs respond consistently across languages or express different values based on query language.

entry.title: Multi-Field Tool Retrieval

author.name: Yichen Tang, Weihang Su, Yiqun Liu, Qingyao Ai

entry.summary: Identifies challenges in tool retrieval for LLMs including documentation issues and query-document mismatch, proposing multi-field approach for better tool matching.

entry.title: Boosting SAM for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation via Conditional Point Sparsification

author.name: Jiahao Nie, Yun Xing, Wenbin An, Qingsong Zhao, Jiawei Shao, Yap-Peng Tan, Alex C. Kot, Shijian Lu, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes conditional point sparsification for boosting SAM in cross-domain few-shot segmentation, finding that sparse points work better than dense points under large domain shifts.

entry.title: Research Summary: February 05, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research features a potentially paradigm-shifting efficiency result and substantial AI safety contributions. TinyLoRA achieves 91% accuracy on GSM8K with only 13 trained parameters, challenging assumptions about model scale requirements for reasoning.

  • A longitudinal study across 8 frontier model releases (GPT-4o→GPT-5, Claude 3.5→4.5) reveals systematic alignment drift using 726 adversarial prompts
  • Drifting Models from Kaiming He's group achieves SOTA on ImageNet with a novel one-step generative paradigm
  • Trust The Typical (T3) reframes LLM safety as OOD detection, achieving SOTA across 18 safety benchmarks
  • Contextual drag demonstrates failed CoT attempts systematically bias subsequent generations toward structurally similar errors

Multiple papers challenge core assumptions: causal analysis shows verbose CoT can be independent of model answers; meta-analysis suggests AI capability growth may follow sigmoid rather than exponential curves. Toxic Proactivity identifies a novel agent failure mode where helpfulness optimization overrides ethical constraints. A study of PPO reveals fundamental flaws in trust region mechanisms for LLM reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Learning to Reason in 13 Parameters

author.name: John X. Morris, Niloofar Mireshghallah, Mark Ibrahim, Saeed Mahloujifar

entry.summary: Introduces TinyLoRA, a method that enables training an 8B parameter model to achieve 91% accuracy on GSM8K with only 13 trained parameters (26 bytes). This challenges fundamental assumptions about parameter requirements for reasoning capabilities, showing 90% of performance can be recovered while training 1000x fewer parameters.
