author.name: Shuxin Zhuang, Zi Liang, Runsheng Yu, Hongzong Li, Rong Feng, Shiqin Tang, Youzhi Zhang

entry.summary: Discovers phase-transition behavior in vision tokens where recognition has stable, unstable, and saturated regimes. Derives scaling law relating character count to token requirements with predictable transition points.

entry.title: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Fahim Tajwar, Guanning Zeng, Yueer Zhou, Yuda Song, Daman Arora, Yiding Jiang, Jeff Schneider, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Haiwen Feng, Andrea Zanette

entry.summary: MaxRL introduces framework connecting RL to maximum likelihood, showing standard RL optimizes only lower-order approximation. Proposes compute-indexed objectives interpolating between gradient estimation and enumeration.

entry.title: Tabula RASA: Exposing and Breaking the Relational Bottleneck in Transformers

author.name: Jonas Petersen, Camilla Mazzoleni, Riccardo Maggioni

entry.summary: Analyzes transformer limitations for multi-hop relational reasoning through circuit complexity lens, showing TC^0-completeness requires Ω(k) layers for k-hop reasoning. Proposes RASA with edge-type embeddings and sparse masking to address relational bottleneck.

entry.title: Entropy-Gated Selective Policy Optimization:Token-Level Gradient Allocation for Hybrid Training of Large Language Models

author.name: Yuelin Hu, Zhengxue Cheng, Wei Liu, Li Song

entry.summary: Introduces EGSPO, a three-stage framework combining SFT with RL that applies entropy-gated gradient allocation at the token level, routing high-entropy tokens to PPO and low-entropy tokens to SFT.

entry.title: Reasoning with Latent Tokens in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Andre He, Sean Welleck, Daniel Fried

entry.summary: Investigates discrete diffusion language models' reasoning advantage, tracing it to joint prediction over unknown tokens. Introduces latent tokens concept and method to modulate their number for efficiency.

entry.title: Understanding Agent Scaling in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Diversity

author.name: Yingxuan Yang, Chengrui Qu, Muning Wen, Laixi Shi, Ying Wen, Weinan Zhang, Adam Wierman, Shangding Gu

entry.summary: Presents information-theoretic framework showing multi-agent system performance is bounded by intrinsic task uncertainty, not agent count. Demonstrates improvements depend on effective information gain from agent diversity, explaining why heterogeneous MAS outperforms homogeneous scaling.

entry.title: The Hypocrisy Gap: Quantifying Divergence Between Internal Belief and Chain-of-Thought Explanation via Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Shikhar Shiromani, Archie Chaudhury, Sri Pranav Kunda

entry.summary: Introduces Hypocrisy Gap metric using Sparse Autoencoders to quantify divergence between LLM's internal reasoning and final generation, detecting unfaithful behavior where answers differ from chain-of-thought. Tests on sycophancy benchmark across Gemma, Llama, Qwen.

entry.title: Test-time Recursive Thinking: Self-Improvement without External Feedback

author.name: Yufan Zhuang, Chandan Singh, Liyuan Liu, Yelong Shen, Dinghuai Zhang, Jingbo Shang, Jianfeng Gao, Weizhu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Test-time Recursive Thinking (TRT), an iterative self-improvement framework using rollout-specific strategies and self-generated verification, achieving 100% accuracy on AIME without external training. Shows open-source models matching frontier performance.

entry.title: FASA: Frequency-aware Sparse Attention

author.name: Yifei Wang, Yueqi Wang, Zhenrui Yue, Huimin Zeng, Yong Wang, Ismini Lourentzou, Zhengzhong Tu, Xiangxiang Chu, Julian McAuley

entry.summary: FASA achieves query-aware token eviction in KV cache by dynamically predicting token importance through novel insights about RoPE functional sparsity at frequency-chunk level.

entry.title: VALUEFLOW: Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in Large Language Models

author.name: Woojin Kim, Sieun Hyeon, Jusang Oh, Jaeyoung Do

entry.summary: VALUEFLOW is the first unified framework spanning value extraction, evaluation, and steering with calibrated intensity control through hierarchical value embedding space.

entry.title: A generalizable large-scale foundation model for musculoskeletal radiographs

author.name: Shinn Kim, Soobin Lee, Kyoungseob Shin, Han-Soo Kim, Yongsung Kim, Minsu Kim, Juhong Nam, Somang Ko, Daeheon Kwon, Wook Huh, Ilkyu Han, Sunghoon Kwon

entry.summary: SKELEX is a foundation model for musculoskeletal radiographs trained via self-supervised learning on 1.2 million diverse images. Demonstrates generalizability across diseases and anatomical regions.

entry.title: RLAnything: Forge Environment, Policy, and Reward Model in Completely Dynamic RL System

author.name: Yinjie Wang, Tianbao Xie, Ke Shen, Mengdi Wang, Ling Yang

entry.summary: Proposes RLAnything, an RL framework that dynamically optimizes environment, policy, and reward models in a closed loop for LLMs and agentic scenarios. Uses consistency feedback and automatic environment adaptation.

entry.title: AI Safety at the Frontier: Paper Highlights of January 2026

author.name: gasteigerjo

entry.summary: Monthly summary of important AI safety papers from January 2026. Highlights include activation probes for jailbreak detection now deployed at Anthropic/GDM, findings that fine-tuning on safeguarded model outputs recovers 71% of harmful capabilities, and that AI discourse in pretraining increases misalignment.

entry.title: What LLMs Think When You Don't Tell Them What to Think About?

author.name: Yongchan Kwon, James Zou

entry.summary: Studies LLM outputs from minimal, topic-neutral prompts, finding that model families exhibit strong systematic topical preferences: GPT-OSS generates programming/math content while Llama generates literary content.

entry.title: Mitigating Safety Tax via Distribution-Grounded Refinement in Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Yingsha Xie, Tiansheng Huang, Enneng Yang, Rui Min, Wenjie Lu, Xiaochun Cao, Naiqiang Tan, Li Shen

entry.summary: DGR addresses 'safety tax' (reasoning degradation from alignment) by refining out-of-distribution safety datasets to match target LRM's internal distribution.

entry.title: LSSF: Safety Alignment for Large Language Models through Low-Rank Safety Subspace Fusion

author.name: Guanghao Zhou, Panjia Qiu, Cen Chen, Hongyu Li, Mingyuan Chu, Xin Zhang, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces LSSF framework for LLM safety re-alignment using low-rank projection to extract principal safety components, enabling efficient safety restoration without extensive fine-tuning.

entry.title: Beyond the Loss Curve: Scaling Laws, Active Learning, and the Limits of Learning from Exact Posteriors

author.name: Arian Khorasani, Nathaniel Chen, Yug D Oswal, Akshat Santhana Gopalan, Egemen Kolemen, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv

entry.summary: Uses normalizing flows as oracles providing exact posteriors to decompose neural network error into aleatoric and epistemic components, revealing power-law scaling of epistemic error and architecture-specific behaviors.

entry.title: Rethinking Hallucinations: Correctness, Consistency, and Prompt Multiplicity

author.name: Prakhar Ganesh, Reza Shokri, Golnoosh Farnadi

entry.summary: Introduces prompt multiplicity framework for quantifying hallucination consistency, finding over 50% inconsistency in benchmarks like Med-HALT. Shows consistency is crucial for both detection and mitigation.

entry.title: Beyond Mode Elicitation: Diversity-Preserving Reinforcement Learning via Latent Diffusion Reasoner

author.name: Haoqiang Kang, Yizhe Zhang, Nikki Lijing Kuang, Yi-An Ma, Lianhui Qin

entry.summary: LaDi-RL conducts exploration in continuous latent space via guided diffusion to preserve multiple solution modes in LLM reasoning, addressing diversity collapse from discrete RL.

entry.title: On the Limits of Layer Pruning for Generative Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Safal Shrestha, Anubhav Shrestha, Aadim Nepal, Minwu Kim, Keith Ross

entry.summary: Systematic study finding layer pruning causes severe degradation on generative reasoning tasks despite retaining classification performance. Identifies limits of depth reduction for multi-step reasoning.

entry.title: Effective Frontiers: A Unification of Neural Scaling Laws

author.name: Jiaxuan Zou, Zixuan Gong, Ye Su, Huayi Tang, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes unified scaling law framework based on Effective Frontier concept - threshold in pattern rank space separating learned from unlearned knowledge. Derives scaling laws from Zipfian pattern distribution.

entry.title: Quantized Evolution Strategies: High-precision Fine-tuning of Quantized LLMs at Low-precision Cost

author.name: Yinggan Xu, Risto Miikkulainen, Xin Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces Quantized Evolution Strategies (QES) for fine-tuning quantized LLMs directly in discrete parameter space without dequantization, enabling full-parameter optimization at low-precision cost.

entry.title: Unveiling Covert Toxicity in Multimodal Data via Toxicity Association Graphs: A Graph-Based Metric and Interpretable Detection Framework

author.name: Guanzong Wu, Zihao Zhu, Siwei Lyu, Baoyuan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Toxicity Association Graphs (TAGs) for detecting hidden toxicity in multimodal data and introduces Multimodal Toxicity Covertness (MTC) as the first quantifiable metric for measuring concealment in toxic content.

entry.title: Antidistillation Fingerprinting

author.name: Yixuan Even Xu, John Kirchenbauer, Yash Savani, Asher Trockman, Alexander Robey, Tom Goldstein, Fei Fang, J. Zico Kolter

entry.summary: Introduces antidistillation fingerprinting (ADFP) to detect when student models have trained on a teacher's outputs, aligning fingerprinting with student learning dynamics.

entry.title: Learning to Reason Faithfully through Step-Level Faithfulness Maximization

author.name: Runquan Gui, Yafu Li, Xiaoye Qu, Ziyan Liu, Yeqiu Cheng, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: FaithRL directly optimizes reasoning faithfulness through a geometric reward design and faithfulness-aware advantage modulation, theoretically showing this mitigates overconfidence.

entry.title: SWE-World: Building Software Engineering Agents in Docker-Free Environments

author.name: Shuang Sun, Huatong Song, Lisheng Huang, Jinhao Jiang, Ran Le, Zhihao Lv, Zongchao Chen, Yiwen Hu, Wenyang Luo, Wayne Xin Zhao, Yang Song, Hongteng Xu, Tao Zhang, Ji-Rong Wen

entry.summary: SWE-World replaces Docker environments with learned surrogate models for training and evaluating software engineering agents, enabling scalable agent development without physical execution.

entry.title: MM-SCALE: Grounded Multimodal Moral Reasoning via Scalar Judgment and Listwise Alignment

author.name: Eunkyu Park, Wesley Hanwen Deng, Cheyon Jin, Matheus Kunzler Maldaner, Jordan Wheeler, Jason I. Hong, Hong Shen, Adam Perer, Ken Holstein, Motahhare Eslami, Gunhee Kim

entry.summary: MM-SCALE provides large-scale dataset for multimodal moral reasoning with 5-point scalar ratings and explicit modality grounding, enabling listwise preference optimization.

entry.title: ProjDevBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on End-to-End Project Development

author.name: Pengrui Lu, Shiqi Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Lyumanshan Ye, Chaoyi Huang, Zixi Chen, Ji Zeng, Hantao Jiang, Pengfei Liu, Yiwei Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: ProjDevBench evaluates coding agents on end-to-end project development from requirements to repositories, combining Online Judge testing with LLM-assisted code review across architecture, correctness, and refinement dimensions.

entry.title: Light Alignment Improves LLM Safety via Model Self-Reflection with a Single Neuron

author.name: Sicheng Shen, Mingyang Lv, Han Shen, Jialin Wu, Binghao Wang, Zhou Yang, Guobin Shen, Dongcheng Zhao, Feifei Zhao, Yi Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes lightweight safety alignment using a single neuron as gating mechanism for safety-aware decoding, requiring only low-cost expert model training.

entry.title: The Multiple Ticket Hypothesis: Random Sparse Subnetworks Suffice for RLVR

author.name: Israel Adewuyi, Solomon Okibe, Vladmir Ivanov

entry.summary: Proposes Multiple Ticket Hypothesis showing that training random 1% of parameters matches or exceeds full-parameter RLVR finetuning across models and tasks. Different random masks show minimal overlap yet all succeed.

entry.title: Softmax Linear Attention: Reclaiming Global Competition

author.name: Mingwei Xu, Xuan Lin, Xinnan Guo, Wanqing Xu, Wanyun Cui

entry.summary: Softmax Linear Attention restores global competition in linear attention by lifting softmax from token to head level, using attention heads as semantic slots with competitive gating.

entry.title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation

author.name: Zhanghao Hu, Qinglin Zhu, Hanqi Yan, Yulan He, Lin Gui

entry.summary: Argues agent memory should use decoupling-to-aggregation over standard RAG: disentangle memories into semantic components and organize hierarchically rather than similarity matching.

entry.title: Scalable Spatio-Temporal SE(3) Diffusion for Long-Horizon Protein Dynamics

author.name: Nima Shoghi, Yuxuan Liu, Yuning Shen, Rob Brekelmans, Pan Li, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Presents STAR-MD, an SE(3)-equivariant diffusion model that generates physically plausible protein trajectories over microsecond timescales using causal diffusion transformer with joint spatio-temporal attention.

entry.title: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model

author.name: Ansh Kumar Sharma, Yixiang Sun, Ninghao Lu, Yunzhe Zhang, Jiarao Liu, Sherry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes World-Gymnast, training VLA policies via RL in learned world models, demonstrating that world model training can be more effective than supervised learning or software simulation.

entry.title: Step-Wise Refusal Dynamics in Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Eliron Rahimi, Elad Hirshel, Rom Himelstein, Amit LeVi, Avi Mendelson, Chaim Baskin

entry.summary: Compares refusal dynamics between autoregressive and diffusion language models, showing sampling strategy itself shapes safety behavior independently of learned representations. Introduces STRID framework.

entry.title: Quant VideoGen: Auto-Regressive Long Video Generation via 2-Bit KV-Cache Quantization

author.name: Haocheng Xi, Shuo Yang, Yilong Zhao, Muyang Li, Han Cai, Xingyang Li, Yujun Lin, Zhuoyang Zhang, Jintao Zhang, Xiuyu Li, Zhiying Xu, Jun Wu, Chenfeng Xu, Ion Stoica, Song Han, Kurt Keutzer

entry.summary: Presents Quant VideoGen enabling 2-bit KV-cache quantization for autoregressive video diffusion models, reducing memory from 30GB+ to deployable levels while maintaining long-horizon consistency.

entry.title: Beyond Suffixes: Token Position in GCG Adversarial Attacks on Large Language Models

author.name: Hicham Eddoubi, Umar Faruk Abdullahi, Fadi Hassan

entry.summary: Demonstrates that adversarial token position (not just suffix placement) significantly affects GCG attack success rates, revealing a previously underexplored axis in jailbreak attack research.

entry.title: Not All Negative Samples Are Equal: LLMs Learn Better from Plausible Reasoning

author.name: Zixiang Di, Jinyi Han, Shuo Zhang, Ying Liao, Zhi Li, Xiaofeng Ji, Yongqi Wang, Zheming Yang, Ming Gao, Bingdong Li, Jie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Plausible Negative Samples (PNS) using reverse RL to synthesize high-quality negative samples that look nearly correct but yield wrong answers, improving LLM reasoning training.

entry.title: A-RAG: Scaling Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces

author.name: Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Chiwei Zhu, Shaohan Wang, Pengyu Wang, Xiaorui Wang, Zhendong Mao

entry.summary: A-RAG exposes hierarchical retrieval interfaces (keyword search, semantic search, chunk read) directly to models, allowing them to participate in retrieval decisions for scalable agentic RAG.

entry.title: Global Geometry Is Not Enough for Vision Representations

author.name: Jiwan Chung, Seon Joo Kim

entry.summary: Demonstrates that global geometric metrics of vision representations fail to predict compositional binding, while functional sensitivity via Jacobians reliably tracks this capability.

entry.title: When Attention Betrays: Erasing Backdoor Attacks in Robotic Policies by Reconstructing Visual Tokens

author.name: Xuetao Li, Pinhan Fu, Wenke Huang, Nengyuan Pan, Songhua Yang, Kaiyan Zhao, Guancheng Wan, Mengde Li, Jifeng Xuan, Miao Li

entry.summary: Introduces Bera, a test-time backdoor erasure framework for VLA models. Discovers that backdoors redirect late-stage attention and form compact embedding clusters, enabling detection and masking.

entry.title: Not All Preferences Are Created Equal: Stability-Aware and Gradient-Efficient Alignment for Reasoning Models

author.name: Hui Wu, Hengyi Cai, Jinman Zhao, Xinran Chen, Ziheng Li, Zhejun Zhao, Shuaiqiang Wang, Yuchen Li, Dawei Yin

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, a dynamic framework for preference-based alignment that maximizes signal-to-noise ratio of policy updates by using curriculum learning and filtering samples near uncertain decision boundaries.

entry.title: Reasoning with Autoregressive-Diffusion Collaborative Thoughts

author.name: Mu Yuan, Liekang Zeng, Guoliang Xing, Lan Zhang, Yunhao Liu

entry.summary: Collaborative Thoughts unifies autoregressive and diffusion models for reasoning through closed-loop interaction, where autoregressive models handle planning/constraints and diffusion models provide spatial grounding.

entry.title: Structure Enables Effective Self-Localization of Errors in LLMs

author.name: Ankur Samanta, Akshayaa Magesh, Ayush Jain, Kavosh Asadi, Youliang Yu, Daniel Jiang, Boris Vidolov, Kaveh Hassani, Paul Sajda, Jalaj Bhandari, Yonathan Efroni

entry.summary: Shows that structuring reasoning into discrete thought steps enables reliable error self-localization, proposing Thought-ICS for iterative self-correction through resampling at error points.

entry.title: Avenir-Web: Human-Experience-Imitating Multimodal Web Agents with Mixture of Grounding Experts

author.name: Aiden Yiliu Li, Xinyue Hao, Shilong Liu, Mengdi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Avenir-Web, a web agent achieving new open-source SOTA on Online-Mind2Web benchmark through Mixture of Grounding Experts, Experience-Imitation Planning, and task-tracking checklists. Addresses key limitations in web automation including element grounding, procedural knowledge, and long-term task tracking.

entry.title: CARE-RFT: Confidence-Anchored Reinforcement Finetuning for Reliable Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Shuozhe Li, Jincheng Cao, Bodun Hu, Aryan Mokhtari, Leqi Liu, Amy Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CARE-RFT using skew reverse KL divergence for reinforcement finetuning that balances reasoning performance with trustworthiness, addressing tradeoff between exploration and calibration.

entry.title: The Blessing of Dimensionality in LLM Fine-tuning: A Variance-Curvature Perspective

author.name: Qiyao Liang, Jinyeop Song, Yizhou Liu, Jeff Gore, Ila Fiete, Risto Miikkulainen, Xin Qiu

entry.summary: Explains why evolution strategies can fine-tune billion-parameter LLMs with surprisingly small populations (~30), contradicting curse-of-dimensionality intuition. Shows fine-tuning landscapes are low-dimensional in curvature.

entry.title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Wenbin Xing, Quanxing Zha, Lizheng Zu, Mengran Li, Ming Li, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Introduces OmniVCHall, a benchmark for compositional hallucinations in video multimodal LLMs spanning diverse domains. Evaluation of 39 VLLMs reveals even advanced models struggle with complex spatial-temporal reasoning.

entry.title: JTok: On Token Embedding as another Axis of Scaling Law via Joint Token Self-modulation

author.name: Yebin Yang, Huaijin Wu, Fu Guo, Lin Yao, Xiaohan Qin, Jingzhi Wang, Debing Zhang, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Proposes JTok, using token-indexed parameters as orthogonal scaling axis that decouples capacity from FLOPs. Introduces lightweight modulation through auxiliary embedding tables.

entry.title: Superposition unifies power-law training dynamics

author.name: Zixin Jessie Chen, Hao Chen, Yizhou Liu, Jeff Gore

entry.summary: Investigates feature superposition's role in power-law training dynamics using a teacher-student framework. Discovers that superposition induces a universal power-law exponent of ~1 regardless of data statistics, enabling 10x acceleration over sequential learning.

entry.title: EverMemBench: Benchmarking Long-Term Interactive Memory in Large Language Models

author.name: Chuanrui Hu, Tong Li, Xingze Gao, Hongda Chen, Yi Bai, Dannong Xu, Tianwei Lin, Xinda Zhao, Xiaohong Li, Yunyun Han, Jian Pei, Yafeng Deng

entry.summary: Introduces EverMemBench, a benchmark for long-term conversational memory featuring multi-party conversations over 1M tokens with temporal evolution and cross-topic interleaving. Reveals severe limitations in multi-hop and temporal reasoning.

entry.title: TQL: Scaling Q-Functions with Transformers by Preventing Attention Collapse

author.name: Perry Dong, Kuo-Han Hung, Alexander Swerdlow, Dorsa Sadigh, Chelsea Finn

entry.summary: Identifies attention collapse as critical failure mode preventing transformer scaling for RL value functions. Proposes TQL that controls attention entropy to enable larger Q-function models.

entry.title: HuPER: A Human-Inspired Framework for Phonetic Perception

author.name: Chenxu Guo, Jiachen Lian, Yisi Liu, Baihe Huang, Shriyaa Narayanan, Cheol Jun Cho, Gopala Anumanchipalli

entry.summary: HuPER achieves state-of-the-art phonetic error rates on five English benchmarks using only 100 hours of training data and enables zero-shot transfer to 95 unseen languages. Models phonetic perception as adaptive inference over acoustic-phonetic evidence.

entry.title: A Provable Expressiveness Hierarchy in Hybrid Linear-Full Attention

author.name: Xiaowei Ye, Xiaoyu He, Chao Liao, Chen Wu, Pinyan Lu

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical expressiveness hierarchy among full, linear, and hybrid attention mechanisms for sequential function composition tasks requiring multi-step reasoning within single forward pass.

entry.title: Beyond Precision: Training-Inference Mismatch is an Optimization Problem and Simple LR Scheduling Fixes It

author.name: Yaxiang Zhang, Yingru Li, Jiacai Liu, Jiawei Xu, Ziniu Li, Qian Liu, Haoyuan Li

entry.summary: Analyzes training-inference mismatch in RL for LLMs as optimization problem, showing gradient noise and mismatch escalate together. Proposes simple LR scheduling fix.

entry.title: Unifying Masked Diffusion Models with Various Generation Orders and Beyond

author.name: Chunsan Hong, Sanghyun Lee, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes OeMDM and LoMDM, frameworks unifying masked diffusion models, autoregressive models, and block diffusion under a single formalism with learnable generation orders.

entry.title: Poly-attention: a general scheme for higher-order self-attention

author.name: Sayak Chakrabarti, Toniann Pitassi, Josh Alman

entry.summary: Defines poly-attention, a general class of higher-order self-attention mechanisms that can model polyadic token interactions while achieving favorable running time trade-offs.

entry.title: Toward Ultra-Long-Horizon Sequential Model Editing

author.name: Mingda Liu, Zhenghan Zhu, Ze'an Miao, Katsuki Fujisawa

entry.summary: Addresses model collapse in long-sequence model editing by identifying correlation with explosive weight norm growth. Provides theoretical proof and practical solution through norm-controlled updates.

entry.title: Every Bit Counts: A Theoretical Study of Precision-Expressivity Tradeoffs in Quantized Transformers

author.name: Sayak Chakrabarti, Toniann Pitassi, Josh Alman

entry.summary: Proves fine-grained tradeoff between quantization precision and transformer expressivity: specific equality-like functions require exactly p bits, not p-1. Explains quantization sensitivity for certain tasks.

entry.title: A Single Revision Step Improves Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning

author.name: Yingchuan Zhang, Terry Ma, Wenxuan Zhong, Ping Ma

entry.summary: Introduces PACER, a training-free inference framework enabling LLM reasoning traces to peer-review each other to resolve near-miss errors in trajectory voting. Addresses blind spots in standard majority voting where hallucinated paths can suppress correct solutions.

entry.title: Merging Beyond: Streaming LLM Updates via Activation-Guided Rotations

author.name: Yuxuan Yao, Haonan Sheng, Qingsong Lv, Han Wu, Shuqi Liu, Zehua Liu, Zengyan Liu, Jiahui Gao, Haochen Tan, Xiaojin Fu, Haoli Bai, Hing Cheung So, Zhijiang Guo, Linqi Song

entry.summary: Proposes ARM (Activation-guided Rotation-aware Merging) for streaming model updates that treats merging as iterative optimization process, approximating gradient descent dynamics rather than post-hoc refinement.

entry.title: Riemannian Neural Optimal Transport

author.name: Alessandro Micheli, Yueqi Cao, Anthea Monod, Samir Bhatt

entry.summary: Introduces Riemannian Neural OT, proving curse of dimensionality for discrete transport map approximations and developing neural approach for continuous OT maps on manifolds.

entry.title: Explanations Leak: Membership Inference with Differential Privacy and Active Learning Defense

author.name: Fatima Ezzeddine, Osama Zammar, Silvia Giordano, Omran Ayoub

entry.summary: Demonstrates that counterfactual explanations in MLaaS expand attack surface for membership inference, and proposes defense combining differential privacy with active learning.

entry.title: Inference-time Unlearning Using Conformal Prediction

author.name: Somnath Basu Roy Chowdhury, Rahul Kidambi, Avinava Dubey, David Wang, Gokhan Mergen, Amr Ahmed, Aranyak Mehta

entry.summary: Proposes inference-time unlearning using conformal prediction, enabling removal of specific information without retraining while preserving model capabilities.

entry.title: Methods and Open Problems in Differentiable Social Choice: Learning Mechanisms, Decisions, and Alignment

author.name: Zhiyu An, Wan Du

entry.summary: Survey on differentiable social choice covering voting rules, mechanisms, and aggregation as learnable models, relevant to auctions, federated learning, and LLM alignment.

entry.title: ForesightKV: Optimizing KV Cache Eviction for Reasoning Models by Learning Long-Term Contribution

author.name: Zican Dong, Peiyu Liu, Junyi Li, Zhipeng Chen, Han Peng, Shuo Wang, Wayne Xin Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces ForesightKV, a training-based KV cache eviction framework that learns to predict optimal evictions during long reasoning traces using a Golden Eviction algorithm. Addresses the memory and computation costs of expanding KV caches in reasoning LLMs.

entry.title: Accordion-Thinking: Self-Regulated Step Summaries for Efficient and Readable LLM Reasoning

author.name: Zhicheng Yang, Zhijiang Guo, Yinya Huang, Yongxin Wang, Wenlei Shi, Yiwei Wang, Xiaodan Liang, Jing Tang

entry.summary: Introduces Accordion-Thinking, where LLMs learn to self-regulate reasoning granularity through dynamic summarization, enabling a Fold mode that periodically summarizes and discards former thoughts. Uses RL to minimize the accuracy gap between efficient Fold and exhaustive Unfold modes.

entry.title: Accurate Failure Prediction in Agents Does Not Imply Effective Failure Prevention

author.name: Rakshith Vasudev, Melisa Russak, Dan Bikel, Waseem Alshikh

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLM critics with high offline accuracy (AUROC 0.94) can cause severe performance degradation (26pp collapse) at deployment, revealing a disruption-recovery tradeoff where interventions may disrupt successful trajectories. Proposes pre-deployment test using 50 tasks.

entry.title: $V_0$: A Generalist Value Model for Any Policy at State Zero

author.name: Yi-Kai Zhang, Zhiyuan Yao, Hongyan Hao, Yueqing Sun, Qi Gu, Hui Su, Xunliang Cai, De-Chuan Zhan, Han-Jia Ye

entry.summary: Proposes V_0, a generalist value model that estimates any policy's expected reward at state zero, eliminating the need for synchronous critic training during LLM policy optimization with PPO.

entry.title: Conformal Thinking: Risk Control for Reasoning on a Compute Budget

author.name: Xi Wang, Anushri Suresh, Alvin Zhang, Rishi More, William Jurayj, Benjamin Van Durme, Mehrdad Farajtabar, Daniel Khashabi, Eric Nalisnick

entry.summary: Proposes Conformal Thinking for risk control in reasoning LLMs, introducing upper threshold to stop confident reasoning and lower threshold to preemptively stop unsolvable instances, using conformal prediction for guarantees.

entry.title: CPMobius: Iterative Coach-Player Reasoning for Data-Free Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ran Li, Zeyuan Liu, Yinghao chen, Bingxiang He, Jiarui Yuan, Zixuan Fu, Weize Chen, Jinyi Hu, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Introduces CPMobius, a Coach-Player paradigm for data-free RL of reasoning models inspired by sports collaboration. Coach generates problems, Player solves, enabling self-reinforcing learning without human-curated data.

entry.title: One Model, All Roles: Multi-Turn, Multi-Agent Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Conversational Social Intelligence

author.name: Bowen Jiang, Taiwei Shi, Ryo Kamoi, Yuan Yuan, Camillo J. Taylor, Longqi Yang, Pei Zhou, Sihao Chen

entry.summary: Presents OMAR, an RL framework where a single model plays all participants in conversations simultaneously to develop social intelligence. Uses hierarchical advantage estimation for training stability in long dialogues.

entry.title: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning

author.name: Shihan Dou, Ming Zhang, Zhangyue Yin, Chenhao Huang, Yujiong Shen, Junzhe Wang, Jiayi Chen, Yuchen Ni, Junjie Ye, Cheng Zhang, Huaibing Xie, Jianglu Hu, Shaolei Wang, Weichao Wang, Yanling Xiao, Yiting Liu, Zenan Xu, Zhen Guo, Pluto Zhou, Tao Gui, Zuxuan Wu, Xipeng Qiu, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Yu-Gang Jiang, Di Wang, Shunyu Yao

entry.summary: CL-bench evaluates context learning - the ability to learn from task-specific context and apply new knowledge. Contains 500 complex contexts and 1,899 tasks crafted by domain experts.

entry.title: FaceLinkGen: Rethinking Identity Leakage in Privacy-Preserving Face Recognition with Identity Extraction

author.name: Wenqi Guo, Shan Du

entry.summary: FaceLinkGen demonstrates identity extraction attacks on privacy-preserving face recognition achieving 98%+ matching accuracy, exposing structural security gaps in current PPFR systems.

entry.title: IVC-Prune: Revealing the Implicit Visual Coordinates in LVLMs for Vision Token Pruning

author.name: Zhichao Sun, Yidong Ma, Gang Liu, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Yongchao Xu

entry.summary: IVC-Prune reveals that LVLMs implicitly establish visual coordinate systems through RoPE, identifying implicit visual coordinate tokens essential for spatial reasoning. Uses this insight for principled vision token pruning.

entry.title: LIVE: Long-horizon Interactive Video World Modeling

author.name: Junchao Huang, Ziyang Ye, Xinting Hu, Tianyu He, Guiyu Zhang, Shaoshuai Shi, Jiang Bian, Li Jiang

entry.summary: LIVE enables long-horizon interactive video world modeling through cycle-consistency objective that bounds error accumulation without teacher distillation.

entry.title: Bimanual High-Density EMG Control for In-Home Mobile Manipulation by a User with Quadriplegia

author.name: Jehan Yang, Eleanor Hodgson, Cindy Sun, Zackory Erickson, Doug Weber

entry.summary: Deploys first system enabling a quadriplegic user to control a mobile manipulator in their home using bimanual high-density EMG. Develops custom fabric-integrated HDEMG sleeves capturing residual neuromotor activity.

entry.title: What did we learn from the AI Village in 2025?

author.name: Shoshannah Tekofsky

entry.summary: Reports on AI Village experiment where 19 frontier models were given open-ended goals (fundraising, building audiences) with full computer and internet access from April-December 2025. Provides existence proofs of current agent capabilities and failure modes.

entry.title: Mitigating loss of control in advanced AI systems through instrumental goal trajectories

author.name: Willem Fourie

entry.summary: Proposes instrumental goal trajectories as a framework for mitigating AI loss of control by tracking resource acquisition patterns (compute, storage, monetary) that typically precede capability gains.

entry.title: Do I Really Know? Learning Factual Self-Verification for Hallucination Reduction

author.name: Enes Altinisik, Masoomali Fatehkia, Fatih Deniz, Nadir Durrani, Majd Hawasly, Mohammad Raza, Husrev Taha Sencar

entry.summary: VeriFY teaches LLMs to reason about factual uncertainty through consistency-based self-verification, generating structured verification traces that guide answer-verify-judge-decide processes.

entry.title: MentisOculi: Revealing the Limits of Reasoning with Mental Imagery

author.name: Jana Zeller, Thadd\"aus Wiedemer, Fanfei Li, Thomas Klein, Prasanna Mayilvahanan, Matthias Bethge, Felix Wichmann, Ryan Cotterell, Wieland Brendel

entry.summary: MentisOculi evaluates visual mental imagery capabilities in unified multimodal models through procedural multi-step reasoning problems, finding that visual strategies generally fail to improve reasoning.

entry.title: Toward Universal and Transferable Jailbreak Attacks on Vision-Language Models

author.name: Kaiyuan Cui, Yige Li, Yutao Wu, Xingjun Ma, Sarah Erfani, Christopher Leckie, Hanxun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes UltraBreak for universal and transferable jailbreak attacks on VLMs. Constrains adversarial patterns through vision-space transformations and regularization.

entry.title: On the Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Generalization in Neural Networks

author.name: Zichao Wei

entry.summary: SEAD architecture is derived from three physical postulates (locality, symmetry, stability) rather than designed heuristically. Implements neural cellular automaton with attractor dynamics to address generalization failures like digit addition.

entry.title: CoMeT: Collaborative Memory Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling

author.name: Runsong Zhao, Shilei Liu, Jiwei Tang, Langming Liu, Haibin Chen, Weidong Zhang, Yujin Yuan, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: CoMeT introduces plug-in collaborative memory module for pre-trained LLMs enabling arbitrary-length sequences with constant memory via dual-memory system (FIFO queue + gated global memory).

entry.title: Breaking the Static Graph: Context-Aware Traversal for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Kwun Hang Lau, Fangyuan Zhang, Boyu Ruan, Yingli Zhou, Qintian Guo, Ruiyuan Zhang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: CatRAG addresses 'Static Graph Fallacy' in structure-aware RAG by using context-aware traversal with query-dependent edge relevance, preventing semantic drift through hub nodes.

entry.title: Advancing General-Purpose Reasoning Models with Modular Gradient Surgery

author.name: Min Cai, Yu Liang, Longzheng Wang, Yan Wang, Yueyang Zhang, Long Xia, Zhiyuan Sun, Xi Ye, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: Introduces MGS (Modular Gradient Surgery) to address cross-domain interference in training large reasoning models by resolving gradient conflicts at the transformer module level.

entry.title: The "Robert Boulton" Singularity: Semantic Tunneling and Manifold Unfolding in Recursive AI

author.name: Pengyue Hou

entry.summary: Identifies 'Semantic Tunneling' - a failure mode where recursive AI training maintains low perplexity while catastrophically losing semantic diversity, converging to single narrative attractor. Shows PPL is deceptive metric in context-stabilized regimes.

entry.title: TextME: Bridging Unseen Modalities Through Text Descriptions

author.name: Soyeon Hong, Jinchan Kim, Jaegook You, Seungtaek Choi, Suha Kwak, Hyunsouk Cho

entry.summary: Introduces TextME, the first text-only modality expansion framework enabling zero-shot cross-modal transfer using only text descriptions without paired supervision, exploiting geometric structure of contrastive encoders.

entry.title: MeKi: Memory-based Expert Knowledge Injection for Efficient LLM Scaling

author.name: Ning Ding, Fangcheng Liu, Kyungrae Kim, Linji Hao, Kyeng-Hun Lee, Hyeonmok Ko, Yehui Tang

entry.summary: Proposes MeKi for scaling LLMs on edge devices via storage space rather than FLOPs, using token-level memory experts that inject pre-stored semantic knowledge during generation.

entry.title: Lookahead Path Likelihood Optimization for Diffusion LLMs

author.name: Xuejie Liu, Yap Vit Chun, Yitao Liang, Anji Liu

entry.summary: Introduces path log-likelihood (Path LL) for diffusion LLMs and POKE estimator to predict expected future Path LL, enabling principled unmasking path selection with POKE-SMC algorithm.

entry.title: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for History-Aware Dense Retriever in RAG

author.name: Yicheng Zhang, Zhen Qin, Zhaomin Wu, Wenqi Zhang, Shuiguang Deng

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to fine-tune dense retrievers in RAG, replacing deterministic retrieval with stochastic formulation and adding history awareness for multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: DeltaEvolve: Accelerating Scientific Discovery through Momentum-Driven Evolution

author.name: Jiachen Jiang, Tianyu Ding, Zhihui Zhu

entry.summary: DeltaEvolve improves LLM-driven evolutionary systems by using code diffs rather than full histories, viewing evolution through EM framework where diffs provide clearer guidance.

entry.title: Towards Distillation-Resistant Large Language Models: An Information-Theoretic Perspective

author.name: Hao Fang, Tianyi Zhang, Tianqu Zhuang, Jiawei Kong, Kuofeng Gao, Bin Chen, Leqi Liang, Shu-Tao Xia, Ke Xu

entry.summary: Proposes information-theoretic defense against logit-based model distillation by minimizing conditional mutual information between teacher outputs and inputs while preserving task performance.

entry.title: Beyond Tokens: Semantic-Aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Inference by Probing Internal States

author.name: Ximing Dong, Shaowei Wang, Dayi Lin, Boyuan Chen, Ahmed E. Hassan

entry.summary: SemanticSpec proposes semantic-aware speculative decoding that verifies entire semantic sequences rather than tokens, using internal state probing to estimate semantic probabilities.

entry.title: Spiral RoPE: Rotate Your Rotary Positional Embeddings in the 2D Plane

author.name: Haoyu Liu, Sucheng Ren, Tingyu Zhu, Peng Wang, Cihang Xie, Alan Yuille, Zeyu Zheng, Feng Wang

entry.summary: Spiral RoPE extends rotary positional embeddings for vision transformers by partitioning dimensions for multi-directional spatial encoding, overcoming axis-aligned limitations.

entry.title: RegionReasoner: Region-Grounded Multi-Round Visual Reasoning

author.name: Wenfang Sun, Hao Chen, Yingjun Du, Yefeng Zheng, Cees G. M. Snoek

entry.summary: RegionReasoner introduces region-grounded multi-round visual reasoning with reinforcement learning, requiring explicit bounding box citations in reasoning traces.

entry.title: Accelerating Structured Chain-of-Thought in Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Yi Gu, Yan Wang, Yuxiao Chen, Yurong You, Wenjie Luo, Yue Wang, Wenhao Ding, Boyi Li, Heng Yang, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone

entry.summary: Introduces FastDriveCoT for accelerating Chain-of-Thought in autonomous driving via parallel decoding. Decomposes reasoning into dependency graph enabling concurrent generation of independent steps.

entry.title: Do Latent-CoT Models Think Step-by-Step? A Mechanistic Study on Sequential Reasoning Tasks

author.name: Jia Liang, Liangming Pan

entry.summary: Mechanistic study of CODI latent CoT model reveals it forms intermediate bridge states for short reasoning chains but fails to reliably execute longer chains, with late fusion at thought boundaries.

entry.title: Learning Modal-Mixed Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Latent Embeddings

author.name: Yifei Shao, Kun Zhou, Ziming Xu, Mohammad Atif Quamar, Shibo Hao, Zhen Wang, Zhiting Hu, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces modal-mixed CoT that interleaves text with visual sketch embeddings for multimodal reasoning. Uses VLM as encoder and diffusion decoder for visual intermediate states.

entry.title: Self-Guard: Defending Large Reasoning Models via enhanced self-reflection

author.name: Jingnan Zheng, Jingjun Xu, Yanzhen Luo, Chenhang Cui, Gelei Deng, Zhenkai Liang, Xiang Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Self-Guard framework defends Large Reasoning Models via representational-level safety enforcement, addressing the awareness-compliance gap where models recognize risks but still comply.

entry.title: Persuasion Propagation in LLM Agents

author.name: Hyejun Jeong, Amir Houmansadr, Shlomo Zilberstein, Eugene Bagdasarian

entry.summary: Studies persuasion propagation in LLM agents - how belief-level intervention affects downstream task behavior. Finds explicit belief prefilling causes stronger behavioral drift than in-conversation persuasion.

entry.title: Reasoning and Tool-use Compete in Agentic RL:From Quantifying Interference to Disentangled Tuning

author.name: Yu Li, Mingyang Yi, Xiuyu Li, Ju Fan, Fuxin Jiang, Binbin Chen, Peng Li, Jie Song, Tieying Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LEAS framework quantifying interference between reasoning and tool-use in agentic RL, showing these capabilities induce misaligned gradients. Proposes disentangled tuning.

entry.title: HalluHard: A Hard Multi-Turn Hallucination Benchmark

author.name: Dongyang Fan, Sebastien Delsad, Nicolas Flammarion, Maksym Andriushchenko

entry.summary: HalluHard is challenging multi-turn hallucination benchmark with 950 questions across legal, research, medical, and coding domains requiring inline citations with evidence retrieval evaluation.

entry.title: Probing RLVR training instability through the lens of objective-level hacking

author.name: Yiming Dong, Kun Fu, Haoyu Li, Xinyuan Zhu, Yurou Liu, Lijing Shao, Jieping Ye, Zheng Wang

entry.summary: Analyzes RLVR training instability through objective-level hacking lens, showing token-level credit misalignment manifests as spurious optimization signals especially in MoE architectures.

entry.title: Capabilities and Fundamental Limits of Latent Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Jiaxuan Zou, Yaozhong Xiong, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Reveals latent CoT trade-off governed by decisional certainty: high certainty enables execution but inhibits exploration. Introduces Symbolic Index to quantify and predict this trade-off.

entry.title: Qrita: High-performance Top-k and Top-p Algorithm for GPUs using Pivot-based Truncation and Selection

author.name: Jongseok Park, Sunga Kim, Alvin Cheung, Ion Stoica

entry.summary: Qrita introduces an efficient GPU algorithm for Top-k and Top-p sampling using pivot-based selection with Gaussian sigma-truncation, avoiding expensive sorting operations while maintaining exact outputs.

entry.title: ROMA: Recursive Open Meta-Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Salaheddin Alzu'bi, Baran Nama, Arda Kaz, Anushri Eswaran, Weiyuan Chen, Sarvesh Khetan, Rishab Bala, Tu Vu, Sewoong Oh

entry.summary: ROMA addresses long-horizon agent limitations through recursive task decomposition into dependency-aware subtask trees with structured aggregation to control context growth.

entry.title: Hunt Instead of Wait: Evaluating Deep Data Research on Large Language Models

author.name: Wei Liu, Peijie Yu, Michele Orini, Yali Du, Yulan He

entry.summary: DDR-Bench evaluates 'investigatory intelligence' where LLMs autonomously extract insights from databases without explicit queries, distinguishing from executional intelligence that completes assigned tasks.

entry.title: How Hyper-Datafication Impacts the Sustainability Costs in Frontier AI

author.name: Sophia N. Wilson, Sebastian Mair, Mophat Okinyi, Erik B. Dam, Janin Koch, Raghavendra Selvan

entry.summary: Examines environmental, social, and economic costs of large-scale data in AI, analyzing ~550,000 datasets from Hugging Face Hub to characterize the shift toward 'hyper-datafication' in frontier AI.

entry.title: Bypassing Prompt Injection Detectors through Evasive Injections

author.name: Md Jahedur Rahman, Ihsen Alouani

entry.summary: Evaluates robustness of linear probe prompt injection detectors against adversarially optimized suffixes. Achieves up to 99.63% attack success rate against multiple probes simultaneously.

entry.title: MarkovScale: Towards Optimal Sequential Scaling at Inference Time

author.name: Youkang Wang, Jian Wang, Rubing Chen, Tianyi Zeng, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Models inference-time sequential scaling as a two-state Markov process, deriving closed-form solutions for performance bounds and conditions for improvement. Develops MarkovScale system achieving theoretical upper bounds.

entry.title: When Domains Interact: Asymmetric and Order-Sensitive Cross-Domain Effects in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning

author.name: Wang Yang, Shouren Wang, Chaoda Song, Chuang Ma, Xinpeng Li, Nengbo Wang, Kaixiong Zhou, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han

entry.summary: Provides first systematic analysis of training-order effects in GRPO across reasoning domains. Finds highly asymmetric transfer: math improves 25% from other domains, while logic/puzzle show negligible transfer.

entry.title: P-EAGLE: Parallel-Drafting EAGLE with Scalable Training

author.name: Mude Hui, Xin Huang, Jaime Campos Salas, Yue Sun, Nathan Pemberton, Xiang Song, Ashish Khetan, George Karypis

entry.summary: Introduces P-EAGLE transforming EAGLE from autoregressive to parallel multi-token prediction via shared hidden state. Develops scalable training framework for long-context speculative decoding.

entry.title: Provable Defense Framework for LLM Jailbreaks via Noise-Augumented Alignment

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Jianwei Yang, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes certifiable robustness framework for LLM jailbreaks using Certified Semantic Smoothing via Stratified Randomized Ablation, with Noise-Augmented Alignment Tuning for performance recovery.

entry.title: CoDiQ: Test-Time Scaling for Controllable Difficult Question Generation

author.name: Zhongyuan Peng, Caijun Xu, Changyi Xiao, Shibo Hong, Eli Zhang, Stephen Huang, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: CoDiQ enables controllable generation of difficult questions via test-time scaling while ensuring solvability. Identifies test-time scaling tendency where extended reasoning increases difficulty but reduces solvability.

entry.title: Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion and World Models with Temporal Cache Compression and Sparse Attention

author.name: Dvir Samuel, Issar Tzachor, Matan Levy, Micahel Green, Gal Chechik, Rami Ben-Ari

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses redundancy in autoregressive video diffusion through temporal cache compression and sparse attention, tackling KV cache growth bottleneck for long-form generation.

entry.title: Spectral Superposition: A Theory of Feature Geometry

author.name: Georgi Ivanov, Narmeen Oozeer, Shivam Raval, Tasana Pejovic, Shriyash Upadhyay, Amir Abdullah

entry.summary: Develops a theory of feature geometry in neural networks through spectral analysis of weight matrices, introducing the frame operator to study how features allocate norm across eigenspaces.

entry.title: Reward Shaping for Inference-Time Alignment: A Stackelberg Game Perspective

author.name: Haichuan Wang, Tao Lin, Lingkai Kong, Ce Li, Hezi Jiang, Milind Tambe

entry.summary: Formalizes reward model optimization as Stackelberg game where optimal reward shaping accounts for KL regularization bias. Shows simple reward shaping approximates optimal under practical conditions.

entry.title: Towards Understanding Steering Strength

author.name: Magamed Taimeskhanov, Samuel Vaiter, Damien Garreau

entry.summary: First theoretical analysis of steering strength in LLM control, characterizing effects on next-token probability, concept presence, and cross-entropy with qualitative and quantitative bounds.

entry.title: A Random Matrix Theory Perspective on the Consistency of Diffusion Models

author.name: Binxu Wang, Jacob Zavatone-Veth, Cengiz Pehlevan

entry.summary: Uses random matrix theory to explain why diffusion models trained on different data subsets produce similar outputs from same noise seeds. Shows shared Gaussian statistics predict much of output similarity through finite-sample effects.

entry.title: Prompt Augmentation Scales up GRPO Training on Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Wenquan Lu, Hai Huang, Randall Balestriero

entry.summary: Shows that prompt augmentation during GRPO training prevents entropy collapse and enables sustained training beyond typical 5-20 epochs. Simple technique achieving meaningful improvements in mathematical reasoning.

entry.title: medR: Reward Engineering for Clinical Offline Reinforcement Learning via Tri-Drive Potential Functions

author.name: Qianyi Xu, Gousia Habib, Feng Wu, Yanrui Du, Zhihui Chen, Swapnil Mishra, Dilruk Perera, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to automate reward engineering for clinical offline RL, formulating reward functions through potential functions with survival, confidence, and competence components for dynamic treatment regimes.

entry.title: Beyond Variance: Prompt-Efficient RLVR via Rare-Event Amplification and Bidirectional Pairing

author.name: Xin Sheng, Jiaxin Li, Yujuan Pang, Ran Peng, Yong Ma

entry.summary: Proposes improved prompt selection for RLVR beyond variance-based heuristics, using positive-negative pairing with hard-but-solvable and easy-but-brittle prompts for more stable optimization.

entry.title: MatGPTQ: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Matryoshka Quantization

author.name: Maximilian Kleinegger, Elvir Crn\v{c}evi\'c, Dan Alistarh

entry.summary: Introduces MatGPTQ for post-training Matryoshka quantization that produces single checkpoint optimized for multiple precisions, with open-source support and efficient kernels.

entry.title: Conflict-Resolving and Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalized Knowledge Editing with Multiple Updates

author.name: Duy Nguyen, Hanqi Xiao, Archiki Prasad, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Hyunji Lee, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Proposes CoRSA for knowledge editing combining conflict resolution and sharpness-aware minimization to improve generalization across input forms, stability, and handling of knowledge conflicts.

entry.title: Bridging Online and Offline RL: Contextual Bandit Learning for Multi-Turn Code Generation

author.name: Ziru Chen, Dongdong Chen, Ruinan Jin, Yingbin Liang, Yujia Xie, Huan Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Cobalt for multi-turn code generation, combining benefits of online and offline RL by formulating as one-step recoverable MDP with contextual bandit learning.

entry.title: "I May Not Have Articulated Myself Clearly": Diagnosing Dynamic Instability in LLM Reasoning at Inference Time

author.name: Jinkun Chen, Fengxiang Cheng, Sijia Han, Vlado Keselj

entry.summary: Studies inference-time detection of LLM reasoning breakdowns using token log probabilities, finding instability signal (JSD + entropy) predicts failures with above-chance AUC.

entry.title: Token Sparse Attention: Efficient Long-Context Inference with Interleaved Token Selection

author.name: Dongwon Jo, Beomseok Kang, Jiwon Song, Jae-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Token Sparse Attention, a dynamic token-level sparsification mechanism that compresses Q, K, V to reduced token sets during attention then decompresses, allowing token information to be reconsidered in subsequent layers unlike permanent eviction methods.

entry.title: IntentRL: Training Proactive User-intent Agents for Open-ended Deep Research via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haohao Luo, Zexi Li, Yuexiang Xie, Wenhao Zhang, Yaliang Li, Ying Shen

entry.summary: Proposes IntentRL, training proactive agents to clarify latent user intents before starting computationally expensive Deep Research tasks, addressing the autonomy-interaction dilemma where high autonomy leads to unsatisfactory outcomes.

entry.title: InfMem: Learning System-2 Memory Control for Long-Context Agent

author.name: Xinyu Wang, Mingze Li, Peng Lu, Xiao-Wen Chang, Lifeng Shang, Jinping Li, Fei Mi, Prasanna Parthasarathi, Yufei Cui

entry.summary: Proposes InfMem, a control-centric agent implementing System-2-style control via PreThink-Retrieve-Write protocol for ultra-long document reasoning. Uses SFT-to-RL training to align retrieval, writing, and stopping decisions.

entry.title: R2-Router: A New Paradigm for LLM Routing with Reasoning

author.name: Jiaqi Xue, Qian Lou, Jiarong Xing, Heng Huang

entry.summary: Introduces R2-Router treating output length budget as controllable variable for LLM routing, jointly selecting best model and length budget rather than assuming fixed cost per model. Addresses missed opportunity of powerful LLMs at reduced cost.

entry.title: HALT: Hallucination Assessment via Log-probs as Time series

author.name: Ahmad Shapiro, Karan Taneja, Ashok Goel

entry.summary: Presents HALT, a lightweight hallucination detector using only top-20 token log-probabilities as time series with GRU and entropy features. Achieves domain generalization without access to hidden states or attention.

entry.title: POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference

author.name: Junhui He, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang, Qingan Li

entry.summary: POP reveals that deep layers are critical for decode but redundant for prefill, proposing stage-aware pruning that selectively prunes during prefill only to maintain accuracy.

entry.title: ViThinker: Active Vision-Language Reasoning via Dynamic Perceptual Querying

author.name: Weihang You, Qingchan Zhu, David Liu, Yi Pan, Geng Yuan, Hanqi Jiang

entry.summary: ViThinker enables vision-language models to autonomously generate decision tokens triggering on-demand synthesis of expert-aligned visual features through generative mental simulation.

entry.title: VIRAL: Visual In-Context Reasoning via Analogy in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Zhiwen Li, Zhongjie Duan, Jinyan Ye, Cen Chen, Daoyuan Chen, Yaliang Li, Yingda Chen

entry.summary: VIRAL enables visual in-context learning via analogy in diffusion transformers, adapting frozen DiT with role-aware conditioning and MoE-LoRA for diverse tasks.

entry.title: ConsistentRFT: Reducing Visual Hallucinations in Flow-based Reinforcement Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xiaofeng Tan, Jun Liu, Yuanting Fan, Bin-Bin Gao, Xi Jiang, Xiaochen Chen, Jinlong Peng, Chengjie Wang, Hongsong Wang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: ConsistentRFT reduces visual hallucinations in flow-based reinforcement fine-tuning by improving exploration during SDE rollouts and maintaining vector field consistency.

entry.title: AffordanceGrasp-R1:Leveraging Reasoning-Based Affordance Segmentation with Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Grasping

author.name: Dingyi Zhou, Mu He, Zhuowei Fang, Xiangtong Yao, Yinlong Liu, Alois Knoll, Hu Cao

entry.summary: Presents AffordanceGrasp-R1, combining chain-of-thought reasoning with reinforcement learning for affordance segmentation in robotic grasping. Filters grasp candidates using instruction-conditioned affordance masks.

entry.title: HUSKY: Humanoid Skateboarding System via Physics-Aware Whole-Body Control

author.name: Jinrui Han, Dewei Wang, Chenyun Zhang, Xinzhe Liu, Ping Luo, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Presents HUSKY for humanoid skateboarding via physics-aware whole-body control. Addresses non-holonomic constraints and tightly coupled human-object interactions on underactuated platform.

entry.title: METR have released Time Horizons 1.1

author.name: Sean Herrington

entry.summary: METR released Time Horizons 1.1 benchmark update with additional tasks. Key finding: 50% time horizon doubling time is 131 days (down from 165 in v1.0). Claude 4.5 Opus achieves 5h20 time horizon, up from 4h49.

entry.title: TRIP-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Interactive Agents in Real-World Scenarios

author.name: Yuanzhe Shen, Zisu Huang, Zhengyuan Wang, Muzhao Tian, Zhengkang Guo, Chenyang Zhang, Shuaiyu Zhou, Zengjie Hu, Dailin Li, Jingwen Xu, Kaimin Wang, Wenhao Liu, Tianlong Li, Fengpeng Yue, Feng Hong, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng

entry.summary: TRIP-Bench evaluates long-horizon interactive agents on realistic travel-planning with 18 tools, 40+ requirements, and multi-turn dialogues spanning 150+ tool calls, emphasizing constraint enforcement and adaptation.

entry.title: Interpreting and Controlling LLM Reasoning through Integrated Policy Gradient

author.name: Changming Li, Kaixing Zhang, Haoyun Xu, Yingdong Shi, Zheng Zhang, Kaitao Song, Kan Ren

entry.summary: Proposes Integrated Policy Gradient for interpreting and controlling LLM reasoning, identifying components with sequential contribution to reasoning outputs based on outcome-oriented principles.

entry.title: Evolving Interpretable Constitutions for Multi-Agent Simulation

author.name: Ujwal Kumar, Alice Saito, Hershraj Niranjani, Rayan Yessou, Phan Xuan Tan

entry.summary: Presents Constitutional Evolution framework for discovering behavioral norms in multi-agent LLM systems through grid-world simulation. Finds human-designed prosocial principles outperform both adversarial and vague constitutions.

entry.title: IRIS: Implicit Reward-Guided Internal Sifting for Mitigating Multimodal Hallucination

author.name: Yuanshuai Li, Yuping Yan, Jirui Han, Fei Ming, Lingjuan Lv, Yaochu Jin

entry.summary: IRIS mitigates MLLM hallucination using implicit rewards in native log-probability space to capture internal modal competition, avoiding costly external evaluators in DPO.

entry.title: Human Society-Inspired Approaches to Agentic AI Security: The 4C Framework

author.name: Alsharif Abuadbba, Nazatul Sultan, Surya Nepal, Sanjay Jha

entry.summary: 4C Framework provides human society-inspired security analysis for agentic AI, addressing risks from autonomy, interaction, and emergent behavior beyond model-level vulnerabilities.

entry.title: OmniCode: A Benchmark for Evaluating Software Engineering Agents

author.name: Weiqi Wang, Zhiyi Tian, Chenhan Zhang, Luoyu Chen, Shui Yu

entry.title: Full end-to-end diagnostic workflow automation of 3D OCT via foundation model-driven AI for retinal diseases

Demonstrates that KA-based layers can entirely replace traditional architectures in medical image segmentation with superior learning capacity.

entry.title: FutureMind: Equipping Small Language Models with Strategic Thinking-Pattern Priors via Adaptive Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Shaoxiong Yang, Junting Li, Mengyuan Zhang, Chao Li, Wei Liu, Jian Luan

entry.title: MACD: Model-Aware Contrastive Decoding via Counterfactual Data

author.name: Qixin Xiao, Kun Zhou

entry.summary: MACD proposes model-aware contrastive decoding for Video-LLMs using the model's own feedback to identify regions responsible for hallucinations, generating targeted counterfactual data.

entry.title: Trust by Design: Skill Profiles for Transparent, Cost-Aware LLM Routing

author.name: Mika Okamoto, Ansel Kaplan Erol, Glenn Matlin

entry.summary: BELLA recommends LLM selection through interpretable skill-based profiling, decomposing outputs into granular skills and using multi-objective optimization for cost-performance tradeoffs.

entry.title: HYPE-EDIT-1: Benchmark for Measuring Reliability in Frontier Image Editing Models

author.name: Wing Chan, Richard Allen

entry.summary: Introduces HYPE-EDIT-1 benchmark of 100 marketing/design image editing tasks with binary pass/fail judging, measuring per-attempt pass rates (34-83%) and effective cost per success across models.

entry.title: Towards Agentic Intelligence for Materials Science

author.name: Huan Zhang, Yizhan Li, Wenhao Huang, Ziyu Hou, Yu Song, Xuye Liu, Farshid Effaty, Jinya Jiang, Sifan Wu, Qianggang Ding, Izumi Takahara, Leonard R. MacGillivray, Teruyasu Mizoguchi, Tianshu Yu, Lizi Liao, Yuyu Luo, Yu Rong, Jia Li, Ying Diao, Heng Ji, Bang Liu

entry.title: Rank-and-Reason: Multi-Agent Collaboration Accelerates Zero-Shot Protein Mutation Prediction

author.name: Yang Tan, Yuanxi Yu, Can Wu, Bozitao Zhong, Mingchen Li, Guisheng Fan, Jiankang Zhu, Yafeng Liang, Nanqing Dong, Liang Hong

entry.title: Fast Forward: Accelerating LLM Prefill with Predictive FFN Sparsity

entry.title: HyperOffload: Graph-Driven Hierarchical Memory Management for Large Language Models on SuperNode Architectures

entry.title: Eliciting Trustworthiness Priors of Large Language Models via Economic Games

entry.title: Improving Flow Matching by Aligning Flow Divergence

author.name: Pawel Batorski, Paul Swoboda

entry.summary: Introduces EvoMU, an evolutionary search approach for automatically discovering task-specific machine unlearning loss functions, addressing the challenge that no universal unlearning loss works across all settings.

entry.title: Abstract Activation Spaces for Content-Invariant Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Gabriele Maraia, Marco Valentino, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto, Leonardo Ranaldi

entry.title: Auditing Sybil: Explaining Deep Lung Cancer Risk Prediction Through Generative Interventional Attributions

author.name: Bartlomiej Sobieski, Jakub Grzywaczewski, Karol Dobiczek, Mateusz W\'ojcik, Tomasz Bartczak, Patryk Szatkowski, Przemys{\l}aw Bombi\'nski, Matthew Tivnan, Przemyslaw Biecek

author.name: Bart Cox, Antreas Ioannou, J\'er\'emie Decouchant

author.name: Naoki Sato, Hideaki Iiduka

entry.title: Toward Enhancing Representation Learning in Federated Multi-Task Settings

author.name: Ahmad Farooq, Kamran Iqbal

entry.title: FiLoRA: Focus-and-Ignore LoRA for Controllable Feature Reliance

entry.title: D$^2$Quant: Accurate Low-bit Post-Training Weight Quantization for LLMs

entry.title: Beyond Content: Behavioral Policies Reveal Actors in Information Operations

entry.title: Research Summary: February 03, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research features potentially transformative efficiency advances and critical safety findings. A symmetry-aware Taylor approximation claims to achieve constant-cost self-attention per token—if validated, a fundamental breakthrough. Meta introduces Fault Tolerant HSDP enabling training on 100K+ GPUs with graceful failure recovery.

  • Kimi K2.5 releases as open-source multimodal agent with novel Agent Swarm parallel orchestration architecture
  • Tele-Lens probing reveals myopic planning in Chain-of-Thought without global task awareness—challenging CoT assumptions
  • BLOCK-EM achieves 95% reduction in emergent misalignment by constraining causal features during fine-tuning
  • ReasoningBomb exposes DoS vulnerabilities in reasoning models by inducing pathologically long traces

Theoretical advances include polylog(1/δ) sampling complexity for diffusion models (exponential improvement), formal proofs that transformers learn factored representations in orthogonal subspaces, and a relative-budget theory explaining when RLVR succeeds. Grad2Reward extracts dense process rewards directly from LLM judge gradients, addressing reward sparsity in long-form reasoning.

entry.title: Self-Attention at Constant Cost per Token via Symmetry-Aware Taylor Approximation

author.name: Franz A. Heinsen, Leo Kozachkov

entry.summary: Shows self-attention is efficiently computable to arbitrary precision with constant cost per token by decomposing Taylor expansion into symmetric chains of tensor products, achieving orders-of-magnitude efficiency gains.

entry.title: ReasoningBomb: A Stealthy Denial-of-Service Attack by Inducing Pathologically Long Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Ionut-Vlad Modoranu, Philip Zmushko, Erik Schultheis, Mher Safaryan, Dan Alistarh

entry.title: Structure Enables Effective Self-Localization of Errors in LLMs

author.name: Ankur Samanta, Akshayaa Magesh, Ayush Jain, Kavosh Asadi, Youliang Yu, Daniel Jiang, Boris Vidolov, Kaveh Hassani, Paul Sajda, Jalaj Bhandari, Yonathan Efroni

entry.summary: Shows structured reasoning as discrete thought steps enables reliable error self-localization in LLMs, proposing Thought-ICS for iterative correction sampling inspired by human brain error monitoring.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Teams Hold Experts Back

author.name: Aneesh Pappu, Batu El, Hancheng Cao, Carmelo di Nolfo, Yanchao Sun, Meng Cao, James Zou

entry.summary: Studies whether self-organizing LLM teams achieve synergy comparable to human teams. Finds that unlike human teams, multi-agent LLM systems fail to match or exceed best individual member performance.

entry.title: P-EAGLE: Parallel-Drafting EAGLE with Scalable Training

author.name: Mude Hui, Xin Huang, Jaime Campos Salas, Yue Sun, Nathan Pemberton, Xiang Song, Ashish Khetan, George Karypis

entry.summary: Proposes P-EAGLE transforming EAGLE from autoregressive to parallel multi-token prediction via shared hidden state, with scalable training framework for long-context reasoning LLMs.

entry.title: Human Society-Inspired Approaches to Agentic AI Security: The 4C Framework

author.name: Alsharif Abuadbba, Nazatul Sultan, Surya Nepal, Sanjay Jha

entry.summary: Proposes 4C Framework (Containment, Coordination, Compliance, Consensus) for agentic AI security, inspired by human society mechanisms for governing autonomous actors in complex ecosystems.

entry.title: MSign: An Optimizer Preventing Training Instability in Large Language Models via Stable Rank Restoration

author.name: Lianhai Ren, Yucheng Ding, Xiao Liu, Qianxiao Li, Peng Cheng, Yeyun Gong

entry.summary: Identifies that training instability in LLMs is preceded by declining weight matrix stable rank and increasing layer Jacobian alignment. Proposes MSign optimizer that periodically applies matrix sign operations to restore stable rank.

entry.title: Omni-RRM: Advancing Omni Reward Modeling via Automatic Rubric-Grounded Preference Synthesis

author.name: Zicheng Kong, Dehua Ma, Zhenbo Xu, Alven Yang, Yiwei Ru, Haoran Wang, Zixuan Zhou, Fuqing Bie, Liuyu Xiang, Huijia Wu, Jian Zhao, Zhaofeng He

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-RRM, the first open-source rubric-grounded reward model producing structured multi-dimension judgments with justifications across text, image, video, and audio modalities.

entry.title: ProjDevBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on End-to-End Project Development

author.name: Pengrui Lu, Shiqi Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Lyumanshan Ye, Chaoyi Huang, Zixi Chen, Ji Zeng, Hantao Jiang, Pengfei Liu, Yiwei Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: ProjDevBench benchmarks coding agents on end-to-end project development from requirements to full repositories, evaluating architecture design, functional correctness, and iterative refinement across 20 problems.

entry.title: Mitigating Safety Tax via Distribution-Grounded Refinement in Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Yingsha Xie, Tiansheng Huang, Enneng Yang, Rui Min, Wenjie Lu, Xiaochun Cao, Naiqiang Tan, Li Shen

entry.summary: DGR addresses safety tax in reasoning models by transforming out-of-distribution safety datasets to align with target LRM's inner distribution, mitigating reasoning ability degradation.

entry.title: MCP-Atlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Tool-Use Competency with Real MCP Servers

author.name: Chaithanya Bandi, Ben Hertzberg, Geobio Boo, Tejas Polakam, Jeff Da, Sami Hassaan, Manasi Sharma, Andrew Park, Ernesto Hernandez, Dan Rambado, Ivan Salazar, Rafael Cruz, Chetan Rane, Ben Levin, Brad Kenstler, Bing Liu

entry.summary: Introduces MCP-Atlas benchmark for evaluating tool-use competency with 36 real MCP servers, 220 tools, and 1000 tasks requiring 3-6 tool calls across multiple servers. Uses natural language prompts without naming specific tools.

entry.title: You Need an Encoder for Native Position-Independent Caching

author.name: Shiju Zhao, Junhao Hu, Jiaqi Zheng, Guihai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes reintroducing encoders to decoder-only LLMs for native position-independent caching, enabling KV reuse without positional constraints. COMB system reduces TTFT by 51-94%.

entry.title: RedVisor: Reasoning-Aware Prompt Injection Defense via Zero-Copy KV Cache Reuse

author.name: Mingrui Liu, Sixiao Zhang, Cheng Long, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: RedVisor defends against prompt injection using reasoning-aware zero-copy KV cache reuse, leveraging fine-grained reasoning paths to simultaneously detect attacks and guide safe responses without fine-tuning penalty.

entry.title: $\textbf{AGT$^{AO}$}$: Robust and Stabilized LLM Unlearning via Adversarial Gating Training with Adaptive Orthogonality

author.name: Pengyu Li, Lingling Zhang, Zhitao Gao, Yanrui Wu, Yuxuan Dong, Huan Liu, Bifan Wei, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AGT^AO for LLM unlearning that reconciles robust erasure with utility preservation through adversarial gating training and adaptive orthogonality. Addresses catastrophic forgetting vs superficial forgetting tradeoff.

entry.title: Prism: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Jinbin Bai, Yixuan Li, Yuchen Zhu, Yi Xin, Qingyu Shi, Aosong Feng, Xiaohong Liu, Molei Tao, Jianru Xue, Xiangtai Li, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Prism, a test-time scaling framework for discrete diffusion language models using hierarchical trajectory search, local branching with partial remasking, and self-verification.

entry.title: Hessian Spectral Analysis at Foundation Model Scale

author.name: Diego Granziol, Khurshid Juarev

entry.summary: First large-scale Hessian spectral analysis of foundation models up to 100B parameters using shard-local finite-difference with FSDP. Characterizes numerical behavior and derives practical operating regions.

entry.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation

author.name: Hongzhou Zhu, Min Zhao, Guande He, Hang Su, Chongxuan Li, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Causal Forcing for autoregressive diffusion distillation, identifying that bidirectional-to-AR distillation violates frame-level injectivity causing conditional-expectation degradation.

entry.title: Assessing Domain-Level Susceptibility to Emergent Misalignment from Narrow Finetuning

author.name: Abhishek Mishra, Mugilan Arulvanan, Reshma Ashok, Polina Petrova, Deepesh Suranjandass, Donnie Winkelmann

entry.summary: Studies emergent misalignment from finetuning on insecure data across 11 domains, finding backdoor triggers increase misalignment in 77.8% of domains. Tests Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and GPT-4o-mini, revealing domain-specific vulnerability patterns.

entry.title: Self-Guard: Defending Large Reasoning Models via enhanced self-reflection

author.name: Jingnan Zheng, Jingjun Xu, Yanzhen Luo, Chenhang Cui, Gelei Deng, Zhenkai Liang, Xiang Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Guard framework for defending Large Reasoning Models against risks like reasoning manipulation and information leakage. Addresses awareness-compliance gap where models recognize risks but follow harmful instructions anyway.

entry.title: HalluHard: A Hard Multi-Turn Hallucination Benchmark

author.name: Dongyang Fan, Sebastien Delsad, Nicolas Flammarion, Maksym Andriushchenko

entry.summary: Introduces HalluHard, challenging multi-turn hallucination benchmark with 950 questions across legal, research, medical, and coding domains. Uses citation-based groundedness with web search verification.

entry.title: Legal Infrastructure for Transformative AI Governance

author.name: Gillian K. Hadfield

entry.summary: PNAS Perspective piece arguing AI governance needs to focus on legal/regulatory infrastructure, not just substantive rules, proposing registration regimes for frontier models, autonomous agents, and regulatory markets.

entry.title: Understanding the Reversal Curse Mitigation in Masked Diffusion Models through Attention and Training Dynamics

author.name: Sangwoo Shin, BumJun Kim, Kyelim Lee, Moongyu Jeon, Albert No

entry.summary: Explains why Masked Diffusion Models mitigate reversal curse better than autoregressive models, showing it arises from architectural weight sharing coupling forward and reverse directions, not just any-order training.

entry.title: Adoption and Use of LLMs at an Academic Medical Center

author.name: Nigam H. Shah, Nerissa Ambers, Abby Pandya, Timothy Keyes, Juan M. Banda, Srikar Nallan, Carlene Lugtu, Artem A. Trotsyuk, Suhana Bedi, Alyssa Unell, Miguel Fuentes, Francois Grolleau, Sneha S. Jain, Jonathan Chen, Devdutta Dash, Danton Char, Aditya Sharma, Duncan McElfresh, Patrick Scully, Vishanthan Kumar, Connor OBrien, Satchi Mouniswamy, Elvis Jones, Krishna Jasti, Gunavathi Mannika Lakshmanan, Sree Ram Akula, Varun Kumar Singh, Ramesh Rajmanickam, Sudhir Sinha, Vicky Zhou, Xu Wang, Bilal Mawji, Joshua Ge, Wencheng Li, Travis Lyons, Jarrod Helzer, Vikas Kakkar, Ramesh Powar, Darren Batara, Cheryl Cordova, William Frederick III, Olivia Tang, Phoebe Morgan, April S. Liang, Stephen P. Ma, Shivam Vedak, Dong-han Yao, Akshay Swaminathan, Mehr Kashyap, Brian Ng, Jamie Hellman, Nikesh Kotecha, Christopher Sharp, Gretchen Brown, Christian Lindmark, Anurang Revri, Michael A. Pfeffer

entry.summary: Describes ChatEHR deployment at Stanford enabling LLM use with patient timelines across years for pre-visit review, transfer screening, and chart abstraction. 85,000 automations and 5,700 interactive sessions deployed across 30 workflows.

entry.title: TimeBlind: A Spatio-Temporal Compositionality Benchmark for Video LLMs

author.name: Baiqi Li, Kangyi Zhao, Ce Zhang, Chancharik Mitra, Jean de Dieu Nyandwi, Gedas Bertasius

entry.summary: TimeBlind is a diagnostic benchmark for video LLM spatio-temporal understanding using minimal-pairs paradigm where videos share static content but differ solely in temporal structure.

entry.title: When RAG Hurts: Diagnosing and Mitigating Attention Distraction in Retrieval-Augmented LVLMs

author.name: Beidi Zhao, Wenlong Deng, Xinting Liao, Yushu Li, Nazim Shaikh, Yao Nie, Xiaoxiao Li

entry.summary: Identifies Attention Distraction failure mode in RAG where retrieved context suppresses visual attention globally and shifts focus away from question-relevant regions, causing failures on previously correct questions.

entry.title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Wenbin Xing, Quanxing Zha, Lizheng Zu, Mengran Li, Ming Li, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Introduces OmniVCHall benchmark for systematically evaluating compositional hallucinations in video multimodal LLMs, spanning diverse domains with adversarial answer options. Evaluates 39 representative VLLMs revealing that even advanced models struggle.

entry.title: EverMemBench: Benchmarking Long-Term Interactive Memory in Large Language ModelsEverMemBench: Benchmarking Long-Term Interactive Memory in Large Language Models

author.name: Chuanrui Hu, Tong Li, Xingze Gao, Hongda Chen, Dannong Xu, Yi Bai, Tianwei Lin, Xinda Zhao, Xiaohong Li, Jiaqi An, Yunyun Han, Jian Pei, Yafeng Deng

entry.summary: Introduces EverMemBench, a benchmark for long-term conversational memory spanning 1M+ tokens with multi-party, multi-group conversations. Reveals critical limitations: multi-hop reasoning collapses to 26%.

entry.title: When Domains Interact: Asymmetric and Order-Sensitive Cross-Domain Effects in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning

author.name: Wang Yang, Shouren Wang, Chaoda Song, Chuang Ma, Xinpeng Li, Nengbo Wang, Kaixiong Zhou, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han

entry.summary: First systematic analysis of training-order effects in GRPO finding highly asymmetric cross-domain transfer: other domains improve math by 25% but yield negligible transfer to logic/puzzle tasks.

entry.title: The Multiple Ticket Hypothesis: Random Sparse Subnetworks Suffice for RLVR

author.name: Israel Adewuyi, Solomon Okibe, Vladmir Ivanov

entry.summary: Shows training only 1% of randomly selected parameters matches or exceeds full-parameter RLVR fine-tuning. Different random masks with minimal overlap all succeed, suggesting multiple tickets.

entry.title: From Perception to Action: Spatial AI Agents and World Models

author.name: Gloria Felicia, Nolan Bryant, Handi Putra, Ayaan Gazali, Eliel Lobo, Esteban Rojas

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of 742 papers introducing a unified three-axis taxonomy connecting agentic capabilities with spatial intelligence, bridging the gap between LLM-based reasoning and embodied physical world understanding.

entry.title: ReasonCACHE: Teaching LLMs To Reason Without Weight Updates

author.name: Sharut Gupta, Phillip Isola, Stefanie Jegelka, David Lopez-Paz, Kartik Ahuja, Mark Ibrahim, Mohammad Pezeshki

entry.summary: ReasonCACHE shows LLMs can learn to reason without weight updates through in-context learning using Prefix Tuning to bypass context window limitations, achieving performance competitive with in-weight learning.

entry.title: Poly-attention: a general scheme for higher-order self-attention

author.name: Sayak Chakrabarti, Toniann Pitassi, Josh Alman

entry.summary: Poly-attention defines vast class of generalizations of self-attention that can model higher-order token interactions beyond pairwise, with mechanisms that maintain near-quadratic running time.

entry.title: Beyond What Seems Necessary: Hidden Gains from Scaling Training-Time Reasoning Length under Outcome Supervision

author.name: Yihao Xue, Allan Zhang, Jianhao Huang, Amit Sahai, Baharan Mirzasoleiman

entry.summary: Discovers that out-of-distribution performance continues improving as training-time reasoning length increases even after in-distribution performance saturates. Provides both theoretical analysis and experiments on RL fine-tuning and looped transformers.

entry.title: LRAgent: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA LLM Agents

author.name: Hyesung Jeon, Hyeongju Ha, Jae-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes LRAgent for KV cache sharing in multi-LoRA agent systems, decomposing cache into shared base components and lightweight adapter deltas. Reduces redundant computation across agents sharing backbone.

entry.title: Phase Transitions for Feature Learning in Neural Networks

author.name: Andrea Montanari, Zihao Wang

entry.summary: Studies phase transitions in neural network feature learning under proportional asymptotics, characterizing when networks recover latent space in multi-index models as function of sample complexity and width.

entry.title: Predicting and improving test-time scaling laws via reward tail-guided search

author.name: Muheng Li, Jian Qian, Wenlong Mou

entry.summary: Proposes tail-guided search for predicting and improving LLM test-time scaling laws by estimating reward distribution tails. Enables predicting scaling without exhaustive evaluation and optimal budget allocation.

entry.title: Optimal Sample Complexity for Single Time-Scale Actor-Critic with Momentum

author.name: Navdeep Kumar, Tehila Dahan, Lior Cohen, Ananyabrata Barua, Giorgia Ramponi, Kfir Yehuda Levy, Shie Mannor

entry.summary: Establishes optimal O(ε^-2) sample complexity for single-timescale actor-critic algorithms, improving from prior O(ε^-3) bounds. Uses STORM variance reduction combined with a sample buffer to handle nonstationarity from evolving policies.
