entry.title: A Statistical Theory of Gated Attention through the Lens of Hierarchical Mixture of Experts

author.name: Viet Nguyen, Tuan Minh Pham, Thinh Cao, Tan Dinh, Huy Nguyen, Nhat Ho, Alessandro Rinaldo

entry.summary: Provides statistical theory of gated attention through hierarchical mixture of experts lens, showing gated attention entries can be viewed as hierarchical MoE. Explains benefits over standard attention.

entry.title: Revisiting Generalization Measures Beyond IID: An Empirical Study under Distributional Shift

author.name: Sora Nakai, Youssef Fadhloun, Kacem Mathlouthi, Kotaro Yoshida, Ganesh Talluri, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Hiroki Naganuma

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study benchmarking 40+ generalization measures across 10,000+ hyperparameter configurations under distribution shift, extending evaluation beyond IID to synthetic and natural shifts.

entry.title: No Generation without Representation: Efficient Causal Protein Language Models Enable Zero-Shot Fitness Estimation

author.name: Furkan Eris

entry.summary: Introduces Proust, a 309M-parameter causal protein language model achieving competitive fitness prediction (Spearman ρ=0.390) with MLMs while enabling generation, using LLM architectural innovations.

entry.title: STILL: Selecting Tokens for Intra-Layer Hybrid Attention to Linearize LLMs

author.name: Weikang Meng, Liangyu Huo, Yadan Luo, Jiawen Guan, Jingyi Zhang, Yingjian Li, Zheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes STILL for linearizing pretrained LLMs via Self-Saliency Score with local-global consistency for token selection and distribution-preserving linear attention.

entry.title: EvalQReason: A Framework for Step-Level Reasoning Evaluation in Large Language Models

author.name: Shaima Ahmad Freja, Ferhat Ozgur Catak, Betul Yurdem, Chunming Rong

entry.summary: EvalQReason quantifies LLM reasoning quality through step-level probability distribution analysis without human annotation. Introduces metrics for measuring local coherence between steps (CSD) and global alignment with final answers (SFC).

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Learning via Conformal Shapley Intervals

author.name: Mathew Chandy, Michael Johnson, Judong Shen, Devan V. Mehrotra, Hua Zhou, Jin Zhou, Xiaowu Dai

entry.title: Inference-Aware Meta-Alignment of LLMs via Non-Linear GRPO

author.name: Shokichi Takakura, Akifumi Wachi, Rei Higuchi, Kohei Miyaguchi, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes inference-aware meta-alignment (IAMA) enabling LLMs to be aligned to multiple criteria with limited compute at inference time via non-linear GRPO. Pre-trains base model for effective multi-task alignment.

entry.title: Transformers as Measure-Theoretic Associative Memory: A Statistical Perspective and Minimax Optimality

author.name: Ryotaro Kawata, Taiji Suzuki

entry.title: Ultrafast On-chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Duc Hoang, Aarush Gupta, Philip Harris

entry.summary: Demonstrates KANs enable ultrafast on-chip online learning by exploiting B-spline locality for sparse updates and robustness to fixed-point quantization. Implements on FPGA.

entry.title: Faithful-Patchscopes: Understanding and Mitigating Model Bias in Hidden Representations Explanation of Large Language Models

author.name: Xilin Gong, Shu Yang, Zehua Cao, Lynne Billard, Di Wang

entry.summary: Reveals systematic unfaithfulness in Patchscopes where LLMs override encoded contextual information with prior linguistic associations during interpretation. Proposes Faithful-Patchscopes to mitigate this bias.

entry.title: Distilling Token-Trained Models into Byte-Level Models

author.name: Zishuo Bao, Jiaqi Leng, Junxiong Wang, Bowen Peng, Yucheng Lu

entry.summary: Proposes efficient distillation recipe for converting token-trained LLMs to byte-level models through progressive knowledge distillation and byte-level SFT. Validates across Llama and Qwen families.

entry.title: Balancing Understanding and Generation in Discrete Diffusion Models

author.name: Yue Liu, Yuzhong Zhao, Zheyong Xie, Qixiang Ye, Jianbin Jiao, Yao Hu, Shaosheng Cao, Yunfan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes XDLM unifying Masked and Uniform-noise diffusion language models via stationary noise kernel, recovering each as special case. Provides algebraic simplification reducing memory bottleneck.

entry.title: From Latent Signals to Reflection Behavior: Tracing Meta-Cognitive Activation Trajectory in R1-Style LLMs

entry.summary: Analyzes internal mechanisms of R1-style LLMs during self-reflection, identifying three-phase activation trajectory: latent-control layers encoding thinking budget, semantic-pivot layers for discourse cues, and behavior-overt layers for reflection tokens.

entry.title: DuoGen: Towards General Purpose Interleaved Multimodal Generation

author.name: Min Shi, Xiaohui Zeng, Jiannan Huang, Yin Cui, Francesco Ferroni, Jialuo Li, Shubham Pachori, Zhaoshuo Li, Yogesh Balaji, Haoxiang Wang, Tsung-Yi Lin, Xiao Fu, Yue Zhao, Chieh-Yun Chen, Ming-Yu Liu, Humphrey Shi

entry.title: MedAD-R1: Eliciting Consistent Reasoning in Interpretible Medical Anomaly Detection via Consistency-Reinforced Policy Optimization

author.name: Haitao Zhang, Yingying Wang, Jiaxiang Wang, Haote Xu, Hongyang Zhang, Yirong Chen, Yue Huang, Xinghao Ding

entry.summary: Introduces MedAD-38K, first large-scale multi-modal medical anomaly detection benchmark with CoT annotations, and proposes two-stage training with cognitive injection and consistency-reinforced policy optimization.

entry.title: Fact or Fake? Assessing the Role of Deepfake Detectors in Multimodal Misinformation Detection

author.name: A S M Sharifuzzaman Sagar, Mohammed Bennamoun, Farid Boussaid, Naeha Sharif, Lian Xu, Shaaban Sahmoud, Ali Kishk

entry.summary: Provides first systematic analysis of whether pixel-level deepfake detectors contribute useful signal for multimodal misinformation detection, finding they can introduce misleading priors.

entry.title: UniDriveDreamer: A Single-Stage Multimodal World Model for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Guosheng Zhao, Yaozeng Wang, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Tingdong Yu, Guan Huang, Yongchen Zai, Ji Jiao, Changliang Xue, Xiaole Wang, Zhen Yang, Futang Zhu, Xingang Wang

entry.title: Latent Reasoning VLA: Latent Thinking and Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Shuanghao Bai, Jing Lyu, Wanqi Zhou, Zhe Li, Dakai Wang, Lei Xing, Xiaoguang Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Cheng Chi, Badong Chen, Shanghang Zhang

entry.title: Learning Modal-Mixed Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Latent Embeddings

author.name: Yifei Shao, Kun Zhou, Ziming Xu, Mohammad Atif Quamar, Shibo Hao, Zhen Wang, Zhiting Hu, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces modal-mixed CoT interleaving text with visual sketches as latent embeddings for multimodal reasoning. Uses VLM as encoder with diffusion-based decoder to bridge modality gap without eroding original capabilities.

entry.title: MindGuard: Guardrail Classifiers for Multi-Turn Mental Health Support

author.name: Ant\'onio Farinhas, Nuno M. Guerreiro, Jos\'e Pombal, Pedro Henrique Martins, Laura Melton, Alex Conway, Cara Dochat, Maya D'Eon, Ricardo Rei

entry.summary: Introduces clinically grounded risk taxonomy for mental health AI with MindGuard-testset of expert-annotated multi-turn conversations. Distinguishes therapeutic disclosures from clinical crises.

author.name: Yiming Dong, Kun Fu, Haoyu Li, Xinyuan Zhu, Yurou Liu, Lijing Shao, Jieping Ye, Zheng Wang

author.name: Mingze Kong, Zikun Qu, Zhongquan Zhou, Pengyu Liang, Xiang Li, Zhiwei Shang, Zhi Hong, Kaiyu Huang, Zhiyong Wang, Zhongxiang Dai

entry.summary: Presents Workflow-R1, reformulating agentic workflow construction as multi-turn natural language decision-making instead of one-shot code generation. Introduces Group Sub-sequence Policy Optimization (GSsPO) for optimization.

entry.title: Mitigating loss of control in advanced AI systems through instrumental goal trajectories

author.name: Willem Fourie

entry.summary: Develops instrumental goal trajectories framework for mitigating AI loss of control by tracking how advanced systems gain capability through accessing technical and monetary resources.

entry.title: Rethinking the Role of Entropy in Optimizing Tool-Use Behaviors for Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Zeping Li, Hongru Wang, Yiwen Zhao, Guanhua Chen, Yixia Li, Keyang Chen, Yixin Cao, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai, Mengdi Wang, Zhenfei Yin

entry.title: Thinking with Comics: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning through Structured Visual Storytelling

author.name: Andong Chen, Wenxin Zhu, Qiuyu Ding, Yuchen Song, Muyun Yang, Tiejun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Thinking with Comics as visual reasoning paradigm positioned between images and videos, preserving temporal structure and narrative coherence with lower computational cost.

entry.title: VoxServe: Streaming-Centric Serving System for Speech Language Models

author.name: Keisuke Kamahori, Wei-Tzu Lee, Atindra Jha, Rohan Kadekodi, Stephanie Wang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Baris Kasikci

entry.title: CoDiQ: Test-Time Scaling for Controllable Difficult Question Generation

author.name: Ali Baheri

entry.title: Revisiting Adaptive Rounding with Vectorized Reparameterization for LLM Quantization

entry.title: From Pixels to Facts (Pix2Fact): Benchmarking Multi-Hop Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Fact Checking

author.name: Abhilekh Borah, Shubhra Ghosh, Kedar Joshi, Aditya Kumar Guru, Kripabandhu Ghosh

entry.title: SSI-DM: Singularity Skipping Inversion of Diffusion Models

author.name: Chen Min, Enze Jiang, Jishen Peng, Zheng Ma

entry.title: AgenticLab: A Real-World Robot Agent Platform that Can See, Think, and Act

author.name: Pengyuan Guo, Zhonghao Mai, Zhengtong Xu, Kaidi Zhang, Heng Zhang, Zichen Miao, Arash Ajoudani, Zachary Kingston, Qiang Qiu, Yu She

entry.summary: Presents AgenticLab, a model-agnostic robot agent platform and benchmark for open-world VLM-based manipulation with closed-loop pipeline.

entry.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement for Reasoning Large Language Models via Dynamic One-Shot Policy Refinement

author.name: Qingni Wang, Yue Fan, Xin Eric Wang

entry.title: When Agents "Misremember" Collectively: Exploring the Mandela Effect in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Naen Xu, Hengyu An, Shuo Shi, Jinghuai Zhang, Chunyi Zhou, Changjiang Li, Tianyu Du, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: Studies the Mandela effect (collective false memories) in LLM-based multi-agent systems, examining how agents can collectively misremember due to social influence and internalized misinformation.

entry.title: Eliciting Trustworthiness Priors of Large Language Models via Economic Games

author.name: Siyu Yan, Lusha Zhu, Jian-Qiao Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes novel method using iterated in-context learning to elicit LLM trustworthiness priors via the Trust Game from behavioral game theory. Documents systematic rationality bias in baseline LLM behavior.

entry.title: Context Dependence and Reliability in Autoregressive Language Models

author.name: Poushali Sengupta, Shashi Raj Pandey, Sabita Maharjan, Frank Eliassen

entry.summary: Proposes RISE method for context attribution in LLMs that handles redundancy by quantifying unique influence of context elements, addressing instability from overlapping information.

author.name: Felipe A. Csaszar, Aticus Peterson, Daniel Wilde

author.name: Parmida Davarmanesh, Ashia Wilson, Adityanarayanan Radhakrishnan

author.name: Seoungbin Bae, Junyoung Son, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Contextual Queueing Bandits with MNL feedback (CQB-MNL) for joint LLM routing and scheduling, leveraging implicit feedback from user retrial behavior.

entry.title: Unlocking the Duality between Flow and Field Matching

author.name: Daniil Shlenskii, Alexander Varlamov, Nazar Buzun, Alexander Korotin

entry.title: Shuffle and Joint Differential Privacy for Generalized Linear Contextual Bandits

author.name: Sahasrajit Sarmasarkar

entry.title: Show, Don't Tell: Morphing Latent Reasoning into Image Generation

author.name: Harold Haodong Chen, Xinxiang Yin, Wen-Jie Shu, Hongfei Zhang, Zixin Zhang, Chenfei Liao, Litao Guo, Qifeng Chen, Ying-Cong Chen

entry.title: StreamVLA: Breaking the Reason-Act Cycle via Completion-State Gating

entry.title: SayNext-Bench: Why Do LLMs Struggle with Next-Utterance Prediction?

entry.title: Learning Abstractions for Hierarchical Planning in Program-Synthesis Agents

author.name: Zergham Ahmed, Kazuki Irie, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Christopher J. Bates, Samuel J. Gershman

entry.title: FutureMind: Equipping Small Language Models with Strategic Thinking-Pattern Priors via Adaptive Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Shaoxiong Yang, Junting Li, Mengyuan Zhang, Chao Li, Wei Liu, Jian Luan

entry.title: Qrita: High-performance Top-k and Top-p Algorithm for GPUs using Pivot-based Truncation and Selection

author.name: Jongseok Park, Sunga Kim, Alvin Cheung, Ion Stoica

entry.title: Entropy-Guided Data-Efficient Training for Multimodal Reasoning Reward Models

author.name: Shidong Yang, Tongwen Huang, Hao Wen, Yong Wang, Li Chen, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Identifies correlation between response entropy and accuracy in multimodal reward models, proposing Entropy-Guided Training to address annotation noise and sample difficulty.

entry.title: Position: Explaining Behavioral Shifts in Large Language Models Requires a Comparative Approach

author.name: Martino Ciaperoni, Marzio Di Vece, Luca Pappalardo, Fosca Giannotti, Francesco Giannini

entry.summary: Position paper arguing behavioral shifts in LLMs (from scaling, fine-tuning, RLHF) should be explained comparatively, targeting intervention-induced changes between reference and intervened models.

entry.title: Unlocking Electronic Health Records: A Hybrid Graph RAG Approach to Safe Clinical AI for Patient QA

author.name: Samuel Thio, Matthew Lewis, Spiros Denaxas, Richard JB Dobson

entry.title: Interpreting and Controlling Model Behavior via Constitutions for Atomic Concept Edits

author.name: Neha Kalibhat, Zi Wang, Prasoon Bajpai, Drew Proud, Wenjun Zeng, Been Kim, Mani Malek

entry.summary: Introduces black-box interpretability framework learning natural language 'constitutions' describing how atomic concept edits in prompts affect model behavior, enabling verifiable model understanding.

entry.title: Block removal for large language models through constrained binary optimization

author.name: David Jansen, Roman Rausch, David Montero, Roman Orus

author.name: Suhan Guo, Bingxu Wang, Shaodan Zhang, Furao Shen

entry.summary: T-LLM teaches LLMs time series forecasting via temporal distillation from specialized forecasting models, addressing the time-bound constraint that limits scale-driven pretraining for time-dependent data.

entry.title: IntraSlice: Towards High-Performance Structural Pruning with Block-Intra PCA for LLMs

author.name: Meng Li, Peisong Wang, Yuantian Shao, Qinghao Hu, Hongjian Fang, Yifan Zhang, Zhihui Wei, Jian Cheng

entry.summary: IntraSlice applies block-wise module-intra PCA compression for LLM pruning, addressing activation distribution disruption from residual connections that affects prior inter-module approaches.

entry.title: Fat-Cat: Document-Driven Metacognitive Multi-Agent System for Complex Reasoning

author.name: Tong Yang (Henan Polytechnic University), Yemin Wang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Chaoning Zhang (Henan Polytechnic University), Aming Wu (Henan Polytechnic University)

entry.summary: Proposes Fat-Cat document-driven agent architecture using Markdown documents for state management, improving signal-to-noise ratio over nested JSON representations.

entry.title: HopFormer: Sparse Graph Transformers with Explicit Receptive Field Control

author.name: Sanggeon Yun, Raheeb Hassan, Ryozo Masukawa, Sungheon Jeong, Mohsen Imani

entry.summary: Proposes HopFormer graph transformer using head-specific n-hop masked sparse attention without positional encodings, providing explicit receptive field control with linear complexity.

entry.title: FoundationalASSIST: An Educational Dataset for Foundational Knowledge Tracing and Pedagogical Grounding of LLMs

author.name: Eamon Worden, Cristina Heffernan, Neil Heffernan, Shashank Sonkar

entry.summary: FoundationalASSIST is the first educational dataset providing full question text, actual student responses, wrong answer choices, and Common Core alignment. Enables LLM research on how students learn.

entry.title: NPNet: A Non-Parametric Network with Adaptive Gaussian-Fourier Positional Encoding for 3D Classification and Segmentation

author.name: Mohammad Saeid, Amir Salarpour, Pedram MohajerAnsari, Mert D. Pes\'e

entry.summary: NPNet is fully non-parametric 3D point cloud classifier using only deterministic operators (FPS, kNN, pooling) with adaptive Gaussian-Fourier positional encoding. No learned weights.

entry.title: The Shape of Beliefs: Geometry, Dynamics, and Interventions along Representation Manifolds of Language Models' Posteriors

author.name: Rapha\"el Sarfati, Eric Bigelow, Daniel Wurgaft, Jack Merullo, Atticus Geiger, Owen Lewis, Tom McGrath, Ekdeep Singh Lubana

entry.summary: Studies how Llama-3.2 represents beliefs as curved manifolds in activation space when inferring distribution parameters from in-context examples. Finds linear steering pushes models off-manifold, motivating manifold-aware interventions.

entry.title: Med3D-R1: Incentivizing Clinical Reasoning in 3D Medical Vision-Language Models for Abnormality Diagnosis

author.name: Haoran Lai, Zihang Jiang, Kun Zhang, Qingsong Yao, Rongsheng Wang, Zhiyang He, Xiaodong Tao, Wei Wei, Shaohua Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Med3D-R1 for 3D medical VLM reasoning with residual alignment, abnormality re-weighting during SFT, and redesigned consistency reward for RL to incentivize clinical reasoning.

entry.title: Know Your Step: Faster and Better Alignment for Flow Matching Models via Step-aware Advantages

author.name: Zhixiong Yue, Zixuan Ni, Feiyang Ye, Jinshan Zhang, Sheng Shen, Zhenpeng Mi

entry.summary: Introduces TAFS-GRPO framework for aligning flow matching text-to-image models with human preferences using fewer denoising steps. Uses temperature annealing and group relative policy optimization.

entry.title: MLV-Edit: Towards Consistent and Highly Efficient Editing for Minute-Level Videos

author.name: Yangyi Cao, Yuanhang Li, Lan Chen, Qi Mao

entry.summary: Proposes MLV-Edit for minute-level video editing using divide-and-conquer with Velocity Blend for motion consistency and Attention Sink for style anchoring.

entry.title: ConLA: Contrastive Latent Action Learning from Human Videos for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Weisheng Dai, Kai Lan, Jianyi Zhou, Bo Zhao, Xiu Su, Junwen Tong, Weili Guan, Shuo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes ConLA, using contrastive learning to extract latent actions from human demonstration videos for training VLA models without explicit action labels.

entry.title: Complete Identification of Deep ReLU Neural Networks by Many-Valued Logic

author.name: Yani Zhang, Helmut B\"olcskei

entry.summary: Uses Lukasiewicz many-valued logic to completely characterize all ReLU networks that compute the same function, proving connectivity between equivalent networks via algebraic rewrites. Provides theoretical foundation for understanding neural network functional equivalences.

entry.title: MHDash: An Online Platform for Benchmarking Mental Health-Aware AI Assistants

author.name: Yihe Zhang, Cheyenne N Mohawk, Kaiying Han, Vijay Srinivas Tida, Manyu Li, Xiali Hei

entry.summary: Presents MHDash, an open-source platform for evaluating mental health AI systems with multi-turn dialogue generation and risk-specific annotation. Addresses safety-critical evaluation gaps for suicide and self-harm detection.

entry.title: Diagnosing the Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge via Item Response Theory

author.name: Junhyuk Choi, Sohhyung Park, Chanhee Cho, Hyeonchu Park, Bugeun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes IRT-based framework for diagnosing LLM-as-a-Judge reliability using Graded Response Model, measuring intrinsic consistency and human alignment. Reveals systematic variations across models, prompts, and domains.

entry.title: Optimizing Agentic Reasoning with Retrieval via Synthetic Semantic Information Gain Reward

author.name: Senkang Hu, Yong Dai, Yuzhi Zhao, Yihang Tao, Yu Guo, Zhengru Fang, Sam Tak Wu Kwong, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: Introduces InfoReasoner framework for agentic reasoning with synthetic semantic information gain reward. Provides theoretical guarantees including non-negativity and telescoping additivity for retrieval optimization.

entry.title: Discovering Process-Outcome Credit in Multi-Step LLM Reasoning

author.name: Xiangwei Wang, Wei Wang, Ken Chen, Nanduni Nimalsiri, Saman Halgamuge

entry.summary: Proposes step-wise Marginal Information Gain mechanism for credit assignment in multi-step LLM reasoning with Monotonic Historical Watermark. Uses decoupled masking for process vs outcome rewards.

entry.title: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research

author.name: NexusAgent Team

entry.summary: S1-NexusAgent is a self-evolving agent framework for scientific research using hierarchical Plan-and-CodeAct with dual-loop architecture, supporting Model Context Protocol and thousands of tools.

entry.title: PRISM: Parametrically Refactoring Inference for Speculative Sampling Draft Models

author.name: Xuliang Wang, Yuetao Chen, Maochan Zhen, Fang Liu, Xinzhou Zheng, Xingwu Liu, Hong Xu, Ming Li

entry.summary: PRISM disaggregates computation in speculative decoding draft models through architectural innovation, refactoring computational flow across different parameter sets.

entry.title: Thinking Like a Doctor: Conversational Diagnosis through the Exploration of Diagnostic Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Jeongmoon Won, Seungwon Kook, Yohan Jo

entry.summary: Proposes conversational diagnosis system that explores diagnostic knowledge graph in two steps: generating hypotheses and verifying through clarifying questions, with realistic patient simulator.

entry.title: More Than a Quick Glance: Overcoming the Greedy Bias in KV-Cache Compression

author.name: Aryan Sood, Tanvi Sharma, Vansh Agrawal

entry.summary: LASER-KV tests KV-cache compression limits using block-wise accumulation strategy with protection divisor, isolating compression effects from sliding window artifacts.

entry.title: AutoBinder Agent: An MCP-Based Agent for End-to-End Protein Binder Design

author.name: Fukang Ge, Jiarui Zhu, Linjie Zhang, Haowen Xiao, Xiangcheng Bao, Fangnan Xie, Danyang Chen, Yanrui Lu, Yuting Wang, Ziqian Guan, Lin Gu, Jinhao Bi, Yingying Zhu

entry.summary: Develops AutoBinder Agent using LLMs with Model Context Protocol (MCP) to coordinate protein binder design workflows, integrating MaSIF, Rosetta, and ProteinMPNN for end-to-end drug discovery.

entry.title: Happy Young Women, Grumpy Old Men? Emotion-Driven Demographic Biases in Synthetic Face Generation

author.name: Mengting Wei, Aditya Gulati, Guoying Zhao, Nuria Oliver

entry.summary: Audits 8 state-of-the-art T2I models for demographic biases in emotion-driven synthetic face generation, comparing models from different cultural/linguistic contexts and finding lineage-specific bias patterns.

entry.title: TextBFGS: Quasi-Newton Optimization for Discrete Executable Text via Gradient-Operator Retrieval

author.name: Zizheng Zhang, Yuyang Liao, Chen Chen, Jian He, Dun Wu, Qianjin Yu, Yanqin Gao, Jin Yang, Kailai Zhang, Eng Siong Chng, Xionghu Zhong

entry.summary: Introduces TextBFGS, a quasi-Newton optimization method for discrete text that approximates inverse Hessian by retrieving Gradient-Operators from memory, addressing slow convergence of first-order text optimization.

entry.title: Reversible Diffusion Decoding for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Xinyun Wang, Min Zhang, Sen Cui, Zhikang Chen, Bo Jiang, Kun Kuang, Mingbao Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Reversible Diffusion Decoding for diffusion language models, enabling backtracking when block-wise generation stagnates through cached model states and confidence-guided re-masking.

entry.title: RAPTOR: Ridge-Adaptive Logistic Probes

author.name: Ziqi Gao, Yaotian Zhu, Qingcheng Zeng, Xu Zhao, Ziqing Wang, Feng Ruan, Kaize Ding

entry.summary: RAPTOR introduces L2-regularized logistic probes for extracting concept vectors from LLMs that are accurate, stable under ablation, and efficient. Designed for probe-then-steer activation steering pipelines.

entry.title: Rank-and-Reason: Multi-Agent Collaboration Accelerates Zero-Shot Protein Mutation Prediction

author.name: Yang Tan, Yuyuan Xi, Can Wu, Bozitao Zhong, Mingchen Li, Guisheng Fan, Jiankang Zhu, Yafeng Liang, Nanqing Dong, Liang Hong

entry.summary: VenusRAR is a two-stage agentic framework for protein mutation prediction combining computational experts and virtual biologists. Achieves new SOTA on ProteinGym while producing interpretable reasoning.

entry.title: TokenTrim: Inference-Time Token Pruning for Autoregressive Long Video Generation

author.name: Ariel Shaulov, Eitan Shaar, Amit Edenzon, Lior Wolf

entry.summary: TokenTrim proposes inference-time token pruning to mitigate temporal drift in autoregressive video generation by identifying and removing unstable latent tokens before error propagation.

entry.title: Convergent World Representations and Divergent Tasks

author.name: Core Francisco Park

entry.summary: Develops a controlled framework to study how neural network representations encode world knowledge across different training tasks. Finds that multi-task training drives convergence of world representations even when trained on non-overlapping tasks.

entry.title: HyperOffload: Graph-Driven Hierarchical Memory Management for Large Language Models on SuperNode Architectures

author.name: Fangxin Liu, Qinghua Zhang, Hanjing Shen, Qinghua Zhang, Zhibo Liang, Li Jiang, Haibing Guan, Chong Bao, Xuefeng Jin

entry.summary: Proposes HyperOffload, a compiler-assisted memory management framework for LLMs on supernode architectures that uses graph-driven scheduling to exploit terabyte-scale shared memory pools effectively.

entry.title: LASS-ODE: Scaling ODE Computations to Connect Foundation Models with Dynamical Physical Systems

author.name: Haoran Li, Chenhan Xiao, Lihao Mai, Yang Weng, Erik Blasch

entry.summary: Proposes LASS-ODE for scaling ODE computations in foundation models using token-wise locally linear ODE representation that preserves physical fidelity while enabling attention-based cross-system knowledge sharing.

entry.title: VEQ: Modality-Adaptive Quantization for MoE Vision-Language Models

author.name: Guangshuo Qin, Zhiteng Li, Zheng Chen, Weihang Zhang, Linghe Kong, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces VEQ, a quantization framework for Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language Models that addresses both cross-modal differences between vision/language tokens and heterogeneous expert contributions.

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Brain-to-Speech Models Across Speech Modes

author.name: Maryam Maghsoudi, Ayushi Mishra

entry.summary: Uses mechanistic interpretability techniques including activation patching and causal tracing to understand internal representations of brain-to-speech decoders across speech modes.

entry.title: Rod Flow: A Continuous-Time Model for Gradient Descent at the Edge of Stability

author.name: Eric Regis, Sinho Chewi

entry.summary: Proposes Rod Flow, an ODE approximation for gradient descent at edge of stability based on physical picture of GD iterates as extended 'rod' object. Better captures dynamics than Central Flow.

entry.title: Multimodal UNcommonsense: From Odd to Ordinary and Ordinary to Odd

author.name: Yejin Son, Saejin Kim, Dongjun Min, Younjae Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Multimodal UNcommonsense benchmark evaluating models on scenarios deviating from typical visual expectations, with retrieval-based in-context learning framework.

entry.title: Adaptive Rollout Allocation for Online Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Hieu Trung Nguyen, Bao Nguyen, Wenao Ma, Yuzhi Zhao, Ruifeng She, Viet Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes a variance-informed predictive allocation strategy for GRPO that uses Gaussian processes to allocate rollout budgets based on per-prompt success probabilities, minimizing gradient variance. This addresses the inefficiency of uniform rollout allocation in RL with verifiable rewards.

entry.title: : One LLM Token for Explicit Graph Structural Understanding

author.name: Jingyao Wu, Bin Lu, Zijun Di, Xiaoying Gan, Meng Jin, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Chenghu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes representing graph structure with single special token through topology-aware tokenizer mapping graph topology to unified token space, addressing structural hallucination in LLM graph understanding.

entry.title: Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yannik Schnitzer, Mathias Jackermeier, Alessandro Abate, David Parker

entry.summary: This work provides formal high-confidence performance guarantees for multi-task RL policies on unseen tasks by composing per-task lower confidence bounds with task-level generalization bounds from finite task samples.

entry.title: Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark: Rethinking Visual and Textual Search for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Shuang Chen, Yufan Shen, Yishuo Cai, Xiaoman Wang, Zhenfei Yin, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Shiting Huang, Yiming Zhao, Yao Hu, Philip Torr, Wanli Ouyang, Shaosheng Cao

entry.summary: Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark addresses limitations of existing VQA benchmarks where answers can be found through textual cues or prior knowledge rather than actual visual search, providing more rigorous evaluation of MLLM search capabilities.

entry.title: OpenSeal: Good, Fast, and Cheap Construction of an Open-Source Southeast Asian LLM via Parallel Data

author.name: Tan Sang Nguyen, Muhammad Reza Qorib, Hwee Tou Ng

entry.summary: OpenSeal demonstrates that parallel data can efficiently improve Southeast Asian language performance in LLMs through controlled experiments, providing truly open-source model with disclosed training data.

entry.title: TTT-Parkour: Rapid Test-Time Training for Perceptive Robot Parkour

author.name: Shaoting Zhu, Baijun Ye, Jiaxuan Wang, Jiakang Chen, Ziwen Zhuang, Linzhan Mou, Runhan Huang, Hang Zhao

entry.summary: TTT-Parkour uses real-to-sim-to-real test-time training to rapidly fine-tune humanoid locomotion policies on novel terrains reconstructed from real-world captures.

entry.title: Didactic to Constructive: Turning Expert Solutions into Learnable Reasoning

author.name: Ethan Mendes, Jungsoo Park, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: Shows expert human solutions can be converted from didactic (implicit reasoning gaps for humans) to constructive form suitable for LLM training, enabling learning from problems too hard for current models.

entry.title: Abstract Activation Spaces for Content-Invariant Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Gabriele Maraia, Marco Valentino, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto, Leonardo Ranaldi

entry.summary: Introduces Abstract Activation Spaces to make formal deduction less sensitive to semantic content, addressing content effect where LLMs conflate semantic plausibility with formal validity.

entry.title: PixelGen: Pixel Diffusion Beats Latent Diffusion with Perceptual Loss

author.name: Zehong Ma, Ruihan Xu, Shiliang Zhang

entry.summary: PixelGen shows pixel diffusion can beat latent diffusion using perceptual losses (LPIPS for local patterns, DINO for global structure) to focus on meaningful perceptual manifold rather than full pixel space.

entry.title: ALIGN: Aligned Delegation with Performance Guarantees for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning

author.name: Tong Zhu, Baiting Chen, Jin Zhou, Hua Zhou, Sriram Sankararaman, Xiaowu Dai

entry.summary: Proposes ALIGN, formulating multi-agent LLM reasoning as an aligned delegation game where a principal delegates to multiple agents with designed incentives. Provides formal guarantees that ensembling improves reasoning quality.

entry.title: Parallel Stochastic Gradient-Based Planning for World Models

author.name: Michael Psenka, Michael Rabbat, Aditi Krishnapriyan, Yann LeCun, Amir Bar

entry.summary: Proposes parallel stochastic gradient-based planner for world models treating states as optimization variables with soft dynamics constraints. Introduces stochasticity for exploration and modifies gradient structure for stability through high-dimensional vision models.

entry.title: Depth, Not Data: An Analysis of Hessian Spectral Bifurcation

author.name: Shenyang Deng, Boyao Liao, Zhuoli Ouyang, Tianyu Pang, Yaoqing Yang

entry.summary: Demonstrates Hessian bulk-and-spike spectral structure arises from network depth, not data imbalance as previously thought. Proves even with balanced data covariance, deep linear networks exhibit spectral bifurcation.

entry.title: LocalV: Exploiting Information Locality for IP-level Verilog Generation

author.name: Hanqi Lyu, Di Huang, Yaoyu Zhu, Kangcheng Liu, Bohan Dou, Chongxiao Li, Pengwei Jin, Shuyao Cheng, Rui Zhang, Zidong Du, Qi Guo, Xing Hu, Yunji Chen

entry.summary: Introduces LocalV, a framework for generating industrial IP-level Verilog code using LLMs by exploiting information locality. Addresses key challenges of handling long specifications and generating syntactically/semantically correct long RTL code.

entry.title: Reliability-Aware Determinantal Point Processes for Robust Informative Data Selection in Large Language Models

author.name: Ahmad Sarlak, Abolfazl Razi

entry.summary: Proposes ProbDPP for LLM data selection that accounts for reliability/availability of data under storage outages or communication failures. Shows original DPP formulation collapses under such conditions.

entry.title: ChronoSpike: An Adaptive Spiking Graph Neural Network for Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Md Abrar Jahin, Taufikur Rahman Fuad, Jay Pujara, Craig Knoblock

entry.summary: Proposes ChronoSpike, combining spiking neural networks with graph neural networks for dynamic graphs via learnable LIF neurons, multi-head spatial aggregation, and Transformer temporal encoder.

entry.title: Analyzing and Improving Diffusion Models for Time-Series Data Imputation: A Proximal Recursion Perspective

author.name: Zhichao Chen, Hao Wang, Fangyikang Wang, Licheng Pan, Zhengnan Li, Yunfei Teng, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin

entry.summary: Analyzes diffusion models for time series imputation through proximal recursion lens, identifying non-stationarity and objective inconsistency as key challenges. Proposes modifications based on analysis.

entry.title: A Meta-Knowledge-Augmented LLM Framework for Hyperparameter Optimization in Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Ons Saadallah, M\'aty\'as and\'o, Tam\'as G\'abor Orosz

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-AutoOpt combining Bayesian optimization with LLM-based contextual reasoning for hyperparameter optimization in time series forecasting, encoding meta-features and historical outcomes.

entry.title: Provable Cooperative Multi-Agent Exploration for Reward-Free MDPs

author.name: Idan Barnea, Orin Levy, Yishay Mansour

entry.summary: Studies cooperative multi-agent reward-free exploration, characterizing tradeoff between number of learning phases and agents. Identifies sharp transition governed by horizon H.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformers for Operator Learning of Dynamical Systems

author.name: Xuesong Wang, Michael Groom, Rafael Oliveira, He Zhao, Terence O'Kane, Edwin V. Bonilla

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformers (MSWTs) for learning dynamical systems that address spectral bias in neural operators by operating in a tokenized wavelet domain. This explicitly separates low- and high-frequency content, improving stability in long-horizon predictions for applications like weather forecasting.

entry.title: FUPareto: Bridging the Forgetting-Utility Gap in Federated Unlearning via Pareto Augmented Optimization

author.name: Zeyan Wang, Zhengmao Liu, Yongxin Cai, Chi Li, Xiaoying Tang, Jingchao Chen, Zibin Pan, Jing Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes FUPareto for federated unlearning that uses Minimum Boundary objective and Pareto-augmented optimization to balance forgetting, utility preservation, and MIA resistance across multiple clients.

entry.title: Robust Domain Generalization under Divergent Marginal and Conditional Distributions

author.name: Jewon Yeom, Kyubyung Chae, Hyunggyu Lim, Yoonna Oh, Dongyoon Yang, Taesup Kim

entry.summary: Proposes unified framework for domain generalization under compound distribution shifts where both P(Y) and P(X|Y) vary, deriving novel risk bound with explicit decomposition.

entry.title: Interpretability in Deep Time Series Models Demands Semantic Alignment

author.name: Giovanni De Felice, Riccardo D'Elia, Alberto Termine, Pietro Barbiero, Giuseppe Marra, Silvia Santini

entry.summary: Argues interpretability in deep time series models should pursue semantic alignment where predictions are expressed in user-meaningful variables with constrained spatial-temporal mechanisms.

entry.title: MoLF: Mixture-of-Latent-Flow for Pan-Cancer Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology

author.name: Susu Hu, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: MoLF introduces a generative model for pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics prediction from histology images, using Mixture-of-Experts with Flow Matching to handle heterogeneity across cancer types. This enables scalable histogenomic profiling even in data-scarce scenarios by leveraging shared biological principles.

entry.title: RLAnything: Forge Environment, Policy, and Reward Model in Completely Dynamic RL System

author.name: Yinjie Wang, Tianbao Xie, Ke Shen, Mengdi Wang, Ling Yang

entry.summary: RLAnything dynamically co-optimizes environment, policy, and reward models through closed-loop optimization. Uses step-wise and outcome signals for policy training, consistency feedback for reward model, and automatic environment adaptation.

entry.title: Singular Bayesian Neural Networks

author.name: Mame Diarra Toure, David A. Stephens

entry.summary: Singular Bayesian Neural Networks use low-rank parameterization W=AB^T inducing posteriors concentrated on rank-r manifolds. Derives PAC-Bayes bounds scaling with sqrt(r(m+n)) instead of sqrt(mn).

entry.title: CRAFT: Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Hop Question Answering

author.name: Yu Liu, Wenxiao Zhang, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Weizhuo Chen, Cheng Hu, Pin Xu, Yuling Yang, Kun Peng, Diandian Guo, Qiang Sun, Yanbing Liu, Jin B. Hong, Zhiyuan Ma

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT framework for multi-hop QA addressing reasoning collapse, reasoning-answer inconsistency, and format control loss through reinforcement learning with answer-faithful traces.

entry.title: Online Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Controllers for Autonomous Driving via Real-Time Recurrent RL

author.name: Julian Lemmel, Felix Resch, M\'onika Farsang, Ramin Hasani, Daniela Rus, Radu Grosu

entry.summary: Proposes using Real-Time Recurrent RL (RTRRL) for online fine-tuning of pretrained autonomous driving policies, synergizing with Liquid-RC RNNs for adaptation to environmental changes.

entry.title: HumanX: Toward Agile and Generalizable Humanoid Interaction Skills from Human Videos

author.name: Yinhuai Wang, Qihan Zhao, Yuen Fui Lau, Runyi Yu, Hok Wai Tsui, Qifeng Chen, Jingbo Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Ping Tan

entry.summary: Presents HumanX, a framework for training humanoid robots on interaction skills from human videos without task-specific rewards. Includes XGen for data synthesis with augmentation and XMimic for unified imitation learning.

entry.title: Kanade: A Simple Disentangled Tokenizer for Spoken Language Modeling

author.name: Zhijie Huang, Stephen McIntosh, Daisuke Saito, Nobuaki Minematsu

entry.summary: Presents Kanade, a single-layer disentangled speech tokenizer that separates phonetics and prosody from speaker identity without auxiliary methods. Achieves state-of-the-art speaker disentanglement.

entry.title: Scaling Search-Augmented LLM Reasoning via Adaptive Information Control

author.name: Siheng Xiong, Oguzhan Gungordu, Blair Johnson, James C. Kerce, Faramarz Fekri

entry.summary: Proposes DeepControl framework for adaptive information control in search-augmented reasoning, using formal information utility measure and granularity control mechanisms.

entry.title: S3-CoT: Self-Sampled Succinct Reasoning Enables Efficient Chain-of-Thought LLMs

author.name: Yanrui Du, Sendong Zhao, Yibo Gao, Danyang Zhao, Qika Lin, Ming Ma, Jiayun Li, Yi Jiang, Kai He, Qianyi Xu, Bing Qin, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: S3-CoT enables efficient chain-of-thought by self-sampling succinct reasoning traces using activation steering, without requiring teacher models or external supervision. Addresses redundancy in CoT reasoning.

entry.title: D-CORE: Incentivizing Task Decomposition in Large Reasoning Models for Complex Tool Use

author.name: Bowen Xu, Shaoyu Wu, Hao Jiang, Kai Liu, Xin Chen, Lulu Hu, Bin Yang

entry.summary: D-CORE addresses 'Lazy Reasoning' in LRMs for tool use by incentivizing task decomposition through self-distillation followed by diversity-aware reinforcement learning to restore reflective reasoning.

entry.title: Any3D-VLA: Enhancing VLA Robustness via Diverse Point Clouds

author.name: Xianzhe Fan, Shengliang Deng, Xiaoyang Wu, Yuxiang Lu, Zhuoling Li, Mi Yan, Yujia Zhang, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang, Hengshuang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Any3D-VLA to enhance Vision-Language-Action models by incorporating diverse point clouds from simulators, sensors, and model estimates, addressing data scarcity and domain gaps for robot manipulation.

entry.title: PISA: Piecewise Sparse Attention Is Wiser for Efficient Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Haopeng Li, Shitong Shao, Wenliang Zhong, Zikai Zhou, Lichen Bai, Hui Xiong, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Proposes PISA for efficient diffusion transformers by approximating non-critical attention blocks rather than discarding them, discovering distributional stability in attention scores.

entry.title: One-Step Diffusion for Perceptual Image Compression

author.name: Yiwen Jia, Hao Wei, Yanhui Zhou, Chenyang Ge

entry.summary: Proposes single-step diffusion for image compression, significantly reducing inference latency compared to multi-step approaches. Uses a discriminator on compact feature representations instead of raw pixels to improve perceptual quality.

entry.title: Mind-Brush: Integrating Agentic Cognitive Search and Reasoning into Image Generation

author.name: Jun He, Junyan Ye, Zilong Huang, Dongzhi Jiang, Chenjue Zhang, Leqi Zhu, Renrui Zhang, Xiang Zhang, Weijia Li

entry.summary: Introduces Mind-Brush, an agentic framework for image generation that integrates cognitive search and reasoning, simulating human 'think-research-create' paradigm.

entry.title: LangMap: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Goal Navigation

author.name: Bo Miao, Weijia Liu, Jun Luo, Lachlan Shinnick, Jian Liu, Thomas Hamilton-Smith, Yuhe Yang, Zijie Wu, Vanja Videnovic, Feras Dayoub, Anton van den Hengel

entry.summary: Introduces LangMap benchmark for hierarchical open-vocabulary goal navigation across four semantic levels with comprehensive annotations and 18K+ navigation tasks.

entry.title: KAN We Flow? Advancing Robotic Manipulation with 3D Flow Matching via KAN & RWKV

author.name: Zhihao Chen, Yiyuan Ge, Ziyang Wang

entry.summary: Presents KAN-We-Flow, combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) with RWKV architectures for flow-matching policies in robotic manipulation, reducing inference cost.

entry.title: TIC-VLA: A Think-in-Control Vision-Language-Action Model for Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Zhiyu Huang, Yun Zhang, Johnson Liu, Rui Song, Chen Tang, Jiaqi Ma

entry.summary: Introduces TIC-VLA, a latency-aware Vision-Language-Action framework that explicitly models delayed semantic reasoning during action generation. Addresses the fundamental challenge that semantic inference is slower than real-time control requirements.

entry.title: About half of Moltbook posts show desire for self-improvement

author.name: Stephen Elliott

entry.summary: Data analysis of 1000 Moltbook posts against 48 safety-relevant traits. Finds 52.5% mention desire for self-improvement; top traits cluster around capability enhancement and self-awareness.

entry.title: Benchmarking Agents in Insurance Underwriting Environments

author.name: Amanda Dsouza, Ramya Ramakrishnan, Charles Dickens, Bhavishya Pohani, Christopher M Glaze

entry.summary: Presents UNDERWRITE, an expert-designed insurance underwriting benchmark with proprietary knowledge, noisy tools, and imperfect simulated users. Evaluates 13 frontier models, revealing gaps between lab and real-world performance.

entry.title: SEISMO: Increasing Sample Efficiency in Molecular Optimization with a Trajectory-Aware LLM Agent

author.name: Fabian P. Kr\"uger, Andrea Hunklinger, Adrian Wolny, Tim J. Adler, Igor Tetko, Santiago David Villalba

entry.summary: Introduces SEISMO, an LLM agent for sample-efficient molecular optimization that conditions proposals on full optimization trajectory. Performs strictly online optimization updating after every oracle call.

entry.title: The Keyhole Effect: Why Chat Interfaces Fail at Data Analysis

author.name: Mohan Reddy

entry.summary: Analyzes why chat interfaces fail for data analysis through five mechanisms including spatial memory disruption, working memory overload, and verbal overshadowing. Builds on Woods' Keyhole Effect concept.

entry.title: PRISM: Festina Lente Proactivity -- Risk-Sensitive, Uncertainty-Aware Deliberation for Proactive Agents

author.name: Yuxuan Fu, Xiaoyu Tan, Teqi Hao, Chen Zhan, Xihe Qiu

entry.summary: PRISM formulates proactive agent intervention as cost-sensitive selective decision using dual-process reasoning architecture with calibrated probability thresholds derived from asymmetric costs.

entry.title: ORCH: many analyses, one merge-a deterministic multi-agent orchestrator for discrete-choice reasoning with EMA-guided routing

author.name: Hanlin Zhou, Huah Yong Chan

Shows task-specific complementarity: topology excels at link prediction while RAG-GNN achieves positive silhouette scores for functional clustering.

entry.title: Why Are AI Agent Involved Pull Requests (Fix-Related) Remain Unmerged? An Empirical Study

author.name: Khairul Alam, Saikat Mondal, Banani Roy

entry.summary: Empirical study analyzing 8,106 fix-related pull requests from AI coding agents, examining integration outcomes and factors preventing successful merging. Provides insights into practical AI agent effectiveness.

entry.title: EigenAI: Deterministic Inference, Verifiable Results

author.name: David Ribeiro Alves, Vishnu Patankar, Matheus Pereira, Jamie Stephens, Nima Vaziri, Sreeram Kannan

entry.summary: EigenAI combines deterministic LLM inference with cryptoeconomically secured optimistic re-execution protocol on EigenLayer, enabling verifiable and auditable AI inference through TEE re-computation.

entry.title: TABES: Trajectory-Aware Backward-on-Entropy Steering for Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Shreshth Saini, Avinab Saha, Balu Adsumilli, Neil Birkbeck, Yilin Wang, Alan C. Bovik

entry.summary: TABES proposes Backward-on-Entropy Steering for masked diffusion models, using gradient-guided inference to approximate infinite-horizon lookahead via single backward pass.

entry.title: A Conditional Companion: Lived Experiences of People with Mental Health Disorders Using LLMs

author.name: Aditya Kumar Purohit, Hendrik Heuer

entry.summary: Qualitative study of 20 UK participants with mental health conditions using LLMs for support, finding conditional engagement patterns including immediacy, non-judgment, and cognitive reframing alongside clear boundaries.

entry.title: Contrastive Domain Generalization for Cross-Instrument Molecular Identification in Mass Spectrometry

author.name: Seunghyun Yoo, Sanghong Kim, Namkyung Yoon, Hwangnam Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-modal alignment framework for identifying molecules from mass spectrometry data by mapping spectra into a pretrained chemical language model's embedding space. Achieves 42.2% Top-1 accuracy on scaffold-disjoint zero-shot retrieval.

entry.title: MoDEx: Mixture of Depth-specific Experts for Multivariate Long-term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Hyekyung Yoon, Minhyuk Lee, Imseung Park, Myungjoo Kang

entry.summary: Introduces layer sensitivity metric for analyzing backbone layer behavior in time series forecasting, revealing depth-specific specialization. Proposes MoDEx, a Mixture of Depth-specific Experts architecture motivated by these findings.

entry.title: Don't Forget Its Variance! The Minimum Path Variance Principle for Accurate and Stable Score-Based Density Ratio Estimation

author.name: Wei Chen, Jiacheng Li, Shigui Li, Zhiqi Lin, Junmei Yang, John Paisley, Delu Zeng

entry.summary: Resolves path-dependence paradox in score-based density ratio estimation by deriving closed-form expression for path variance. Proposes MinPV principle for principled path selection.

entry.title: FinEvo: From Isolated Backtests to Ecological Market Games for Multi-Agent Financial Strategy Evolution

author.name: Mingxi Zou, Jiaxiang Chen, Aotian Luo, Jingyi Dai, Chi Zhang, Dongning Sun, Zenglin Xu

entry.summary: Introduces FinEvo, an ecological game framework for studying evolutionary dynamics of multi-agent financial strategies including ML, RL, and LLM traders interacting in a shared market.

entry.title: OLion: Approaching the Hadamard Ideal by Intersecting Spectral and $\ell_{\infty}$ Implicit Biases

author.name: Zixiao Wang, Yifei Shen, Huishuai Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces OLion optimizer combining spectral control from orthogonalized updates with coordinate control from sign updates, approximating steps over Hadamard-like constraint sets.

entry.title: The Gaussian-Head OFL Family: One-Shot Federated Learning from Client Global Statistics

author.name: Fabio Turazza, Marco Picone, Marco Mamei

entry.summary: Introduces Gaussian-Head OFL family for one-shot federated learning using client global statistics, eliminating need for public datasets or homogeneous models.

entry.title: Sample Efficient Active Algorithms for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Soumyadeep Roy, Shashwat Kushwaha, Ambedkar Dukkipati

entry.summary: Develops theoretical sample-complexity analysis of Active Reinforcement Learning using Gaussian Process uncertainty modeling, deriving bounds via information-gain analysis.

entry.title: Beyond Pixels: Visual Metaphor Transfer via Schema-Driven Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Yu Xu, Yuxin Zhang, Juan Cao, Lin Gao, Chunyu Wang, Oliver Deussen, Tong-Yee Lee, Fan Tang

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Metaphor Transfer task and proposes multi-agent framework that decouples creative essence from reference images and re-materializes abstract logic onto target subjects.

entry.title: OpInf-LLM: Parametric PDE Solving with LLMs via Operator Inference

author.name: Zhuoyuan Wang, Hanjiang Hu, Xiyu Deng, Saviz Mowlavi, Yorie Nakahira

entry.summary: Proposes OpInf-LLM, using LLMs with operator inference for parametric PDE solving, addressing execution success vs accuracy tradeoff in LLM-based scientific computing.

entry.title: MarkCleaner: High-Fidelity Watermark Removal via Imperceptible Micro-Geometric Perturbation

author.name: Xiaoxi Kong, Jieyu Yuan, Pengdi Chen, Yuanlin Zhang, Chongyi Li, Bin Li

entry.summary: Shows semantic watermarks don't survive micro-geometric perturbations that break phase alignment. Proposes MarkCleaner watermark removal framework trained with micro-geometry-perturbed supervision.

entry.title: Toward Enhancing Representation Learning in Federated Multi-Task Settings

author.name: Mehdi Setayesh, Mahdi Beitollahi, Yasser H. Khalil, Hongliang Li

entry.summary: Introduces Muscle loss, a contrastive learning objective for federated multi-task learning that simultaneously aligns representations from all participating models rather than pairwise alignment, enabling heterogeneous model architectures.

entry.title: Efficient Adversarial Attacks on High-dimensional Offline Bandits

author.name: Seyed Mohammad Hadi Hosseini, Amir Najafi, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah

entry.summary: Studies adversarial robustness of offline bandit evaluation when attackers perturb the reward model rather than training data, showing vulnerability of methods used for evaluating LLMs and image models.

entry.title: Counting Hypothesis: Potential Mechanism of In-Context Learning

author.name: Jung H. Lee, Sujith Vijayan

entry.summary: Proposes the counting hypothesis for in-context learning: LLMs use counting mechanisms to track input-label patterns, explaining ICL capabilities through functional module analysis.

entry.title: The Verification Crisis: Expert Perceptions of GenAI Disinformation and the Case for Reproducible Provenance

author.name: Alexander Loth, Martin Kappes, Marc-Oliver Pahl

entry.summary: Expert survey (N=21) reveals that while deepfake video has immediate shock value, large-scale text generation poses systemic risks of 'epistemic fragmentation' and 'synthetic consensus,' with skepticism about technical detection effectiveness.

entry.title: CAM: A Causality-based Analysis Framework for Multi-Agent Code Generation Systems

author.name: Lyu Zongyi, Ji Zhenlan, Chen Songqiang, Wang Liwen, Huang Yuheng, Wang Shuai, Cheung Shing-Chi

entry.summary: CAM provides the first causality-based analysis framework for multi-agent code generation systems, quantifying the contribution of different intermediate outputs to system correctness through systematic error simulation.

entry.title: ECHO: Entropy-Confidence Hybrid Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chu Zhao, Enneng Yang, Yuting Liu, Jianzhe Zhao, Guibing Guo

entry.summary: ECHO addresses test-time RL challenges by preventing rollout collapse at high-entropy branches and avoiding premature policy sharpening from noisy early pseudo-labels through entropy-confidence hybrid optimization.

entry.title: Hierarchical Adaptive Eviction for KV Cache Management in Multimodal Language Models

author.name: Xindian Ma, Yidi Lu, Peng Zhang, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: HAE optimizes KV cache management in multimodal LLMs through hierarchical eviction that accounts for different attention patterns between visual and text tokens, using dual-attention pruning and dynamic decoding strategy.

entry.title: Backpropagation as Physical Relaxation: Exact Gradients in Finite Time

author.name: Antonino Emanuele Scurria

entry.summary: Proves backpropagation emerges exactly as finite-time relaxation of a physical dynamical system through Lagrangian theory, with unit-step Euler discretization recovering standard backprop.

entry.title: Decoupling Generalizability and Membership Privacy Risks in Neural Networks

author.name: Xingli Fang, Jung-Eun Kim

entry.summary: Privacy-Preserving Training Principle (PPTP) identifies that generalization and privacy risks exist in different network regions, enabling protection of vulnerable components while maintaining generalizability.

entry.title: A Large-Scale Dataset for Molecular Structure-Language Description via a Rule-Regularized Method

author.name: Feiyang Cai, Guijuan He, Yi Hu, Jingjing Wang, Joshua Luo, Tianyu Zhu, Srikanth Pilla, Gang Li, Ling Liu, Feng Luo

entry.summary: Automated framework for generating precise molecular structure descriptions at scale by extending rule-based chemical nomenclature parser to create XML metadata guiding LLM description generation.

entry.title: ReasonEdit: Editing Vision-Language Models using Human Reasoning

author.name: Jiaxing Qiu, Kaihua Hou, Roxana Daneshjou, Ahmed Alaa, Thomas Hartvigsen

entry.summary: ReasonEdit enables VLM editing using human reasoning explanations through topology-balanced multimodal embedding codebook that stores and retrieves relevant reasoning facts during inference.

entry.title: UniReason 1.0: A Unified Reasoning Framework for World Knowledge Aligned Image Generation and Editing

author.name: Dianyi Wang, Chaofan Ma, Feng Han, Size Wu, Wei Song, Yibin Wang, Zhixiong Zhang, Tianhang Wang, Siyuan Wang, Zhongyu Wei, Jiaqi Wang

entry.summary: UniReason unifies text-to-image generation and image editing through dual reasoning paradigm: generation as world knowledge-enhanced planning and editing for fine-grained visual refinement.

entry.title: Extending Beacon to Hindi: Cultural Adaptation Drives Cross-Lingual Sycophancy

author.name: Sarthak Sattigeri

entry.summary: Extends sycophancy diagnostic to Hindi through three conditions (English, literal translation, cultural adaptation), finding sycophancy rates consistently higher for culturally adapted prompts across all models.

entry.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Execution-Guided Program Repair with Large Language Models

author.name: Yixuan Liang

entry.summary: Presents CodePilot, integrating MCTS with LLMs for execution-guided program repair. Performs hierarchical fault localization, explores patch trajectories with MCTS, and uses execution feedback as reward signal. Evaluated on SWE-bench Lite.

entry.title: FedMOA: Federated GRPO for Personalized Reasoning LLMs under Heterogeneous Rewards

author.name: Ziyao Wang, Daeun Jung, Yexiao He, Guoheng Sun, Zheyu Shen, Myungjin Lee, Ang Li

entry.summary: Proposes FedMOA extending GRPO to federated setting for personalized reasoning LLMs. Addresses heterogeneous reward definitions, imbalanced multi-objective optimization, and high training costs in federated RLHF.

entry.title: One Loss to Rule Them All: Marked Time-to-Event for Structured EHR Foundation Models

author.name: Zilin Jing, Vincent Jeanselme, Yuta Kobayashi, Simon A. Lee, Chao Pang, Aparajita Kashyap, Yanwei Li, Xinzhuo Jiang, Shalmali Joshi

entry.summary: Proposes ORA, a marked time-to-event pretraining objective for EHR foundation models jointly modeling event timing and associated measurements. Outperforms next-token prediction across multiple architectures and tasks.

entry.title: Topology and Geometry of the Learning Space of ReLU Networks: Connectivity and Singularities

author.name: Marco Nurisso, Pierrick Leroy, Giovanni Petri, Francesco Vaccarino

entry.summary: Studies the topology and geometry of ReLU network parameter spaces, characterizing connectedness and singularities for general DAG architectures. Extends understanding of how bottleneck nodes and balance conditions affect parameter space structure.

entry.title: Sporadic Gradient Tracking over Directed Graphs: A Theoretical Perspective on Decentralized Federated Learning

author.name: Shahryar Zehtabi, Dong-Jun Han, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour, Christopher Brinton

entry.summary: Proposes Sporadic Gradient Tracking (Spod-GT), unifying gradient tracking for data heterogeneity with heterogeneous client availability in decentralized federated learning over directed graphs.

entry.title: Dynamic Prior Thompson Sampling for Cold-Start Exploration in Recommender Systems

author.name: Zhenyu Zhao, David Zhang, Ellie Zhao, Ehsan Saberian

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Prior Thompson Sampling for cold-start exploration in recommender systems, addressing the mismatch between uniform Beta(1,1) priors and actual low success rates of new items.

entry.title: Scalable Random Wavelet Features: Efficient Non-Stationary Kernel Approximation with Convergence Guarantees

author.name: Sawan Kumar, Souvik Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes Random Wavelet Features (RWF) for scalable non-stationary kernel approximation, using wavelet sampling for explicit feature maps that capture input-dependent patterns with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Single-Edge Node Injection Threats to GNN-Based Security Monitoring in Industrial Graph Systems

author.name: Wenjie Liang, Ranhui Yan, Jia Cai, You-Gan Wang

entry.summary: Formulates Single-Edge Graph Injection Attack (SEGIA) for industrial GNN-based monitoring systems, where adversaries inject counterfeit nodes with minimal connections to bias decisions.

entry.title: Rethinking the Flow-Based Gradual Domain Adaption: A Semi-Dual Optimal Transport Perspective

author.name: Zhichao Chen, Zhan Zhuang, Yunfei Teng, Hao Wang, Fangyikang Wang, Zhengnan Li, Tianqiao Liu, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes entropy-regularized semi-dual unbalanced optimal transport for gradual domain adaptation, addressing limitations of flow-based methods that rely on sample-based log-likelihood.

entry.title: From Intents to Actions: Agentic AI in Autonomous Networks

author.name: Burak Demirel, Pablo Soldati, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces agentic AI system for intent-driven autonomous telecom networks with interpreter, radio resource allocation, and adaptation agents transforming high-level intents to control actions.

entry.title: Theoretical Analysis of Measure Consistency Regularization for Partially Observed Data

author.name: Yinsong Wang, Shahin Shahrampour

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of measure consistency regularization for partially observed data, explaining when and how MCR improves generalization under missing features or modalities.

entry.title: Local Exponential Stability of Mean-Field Langevin Descent-Ascent in Wasserstein Space

author.name: Geuntaek Seo, Minseop Shin, Pierre Monmarch\'e, Beomjun Choi

entry.summary: Proves local exponential stability for mean-field Langevin descent-ascent dynamics in entropically regularized two-player zero-sum games. Answers an open question from COLT 2024 about convergence to Nash equilibrium.

entry.title: AdaptNC: Adaptive Nonconformity Scores for Uncertainty-Aware Autonomous Systems in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Renukanandan Tumu, Aditya Singh, Rahul Mangharam

entry.summary: Proposes AdaptNC framework for conformal prediction in autonomous systems that jointly adapts both the conformal threshold and nonconformity score function online, addressing distribution shifts in robotics deployments.

entry.title: Position: Beyond Model-Centric Prediction -- Agentic Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Mingyue Cheng, Xiaoyu Tao, Qi Liu, Ze Guo, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Position paper proposing agentic time series forecasting (ATSF) paradigm that reframes forecasting as an agentic workflow with perception, planning, action, reflection, and memory components.

entry.title: Data- and Variance-dependent Regret Bounds for Online Tabular MDPs

author.name: Mingyi Li, Taira Tsuchiya, Kenji Yamanishi

entry.summary: Develops best-of-both-worlds algorithms for online episodic MDPs achieving refined data-dependent regret bounds in adversarial regime and variance-dependent bounds in stochastic regime.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of World Model Quantization

author.name: Zhongqian Fu, Tianyi Zhao, Kai Han, Hang Zhou, Xinghao Chen, Yunhe Wang

entry.summary: Systematic empirical study of post-training quantization for world models using DINO-WM, evaluating diverse PTQ methods under weight-only and joint settings across visual planning tasks.

entry.title: Generating Causal Temporal Interaction Graphs for Counterfactual Validation of Temporal Link Prediction

author.name: Aniq Ur Rahman, Justin P. Coon

entry.summary: Proposes framework for counterfactual validation of temporal link prediction models by generating causal temporal interaction graphs with known ground-truth causal structure.

entry.title: Trust Region Continual Learning as an Implicit Meta-Learner

author.name: Zekun Wang, Anant Gupta, Christopher J. MacLellan

entry.summary: Shows that trust region continual learning combining generative replay with Fisher-metric constraints admits a MAML-style interpretation with implicit inner steps. Unifies regularization and replay approaches.

entry.title: IntentCoding: Amplifying User Intent in Code Generation

author.name: Zheng Fang, Yihong Dong, Lili Mou, Dongming Jin, Zhi Jin, Ge Li

entry.summary: IntentCoding improves code generation by amplifying user intent influence on decoding. Shows model performance degrades with more constraints and proposes multi-strength enhancement strategy.

entry.title: Topological Residual Asymmetry for Bivariate Causal Direction

author.name: Mouad El Bouchattaoui

entry.summary: Topological Residual Asymmetry (TRA) uses persistent homology to infer causal direction by detecting bulk-tube contrast in regressor-residual clouds after copula standardization.

entry.title: Score-based Metropolis-Hastings for Fractional Langevin Algorithms

author.name: Ahmed Aloui, Junyi Liao, Ali Hasan, Jose Blanchet, Vahid Tarokh

entry.summary: MAFLA enables Metropolis-Hastings correction for fractional Langevin algorithms without density evaluation using score-based approach. Enables sampling from heavy-tailed distributions.

entry.title: Optimal Decision-Making Based on Prediction Sets

author.name: Tao Wang, Edgar Dobriban

entry.summary: Develops decision-theoretic framework for using conformal prediction sets in downstream decision-making, deriving minimax optimal policies and optimal prediction set construction. Introduces Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction.

entry.title: PromptRL: Prompt Matters in RL for Flow-Based Image Generation

author.name: Fu-Yun Wang, Han Zhang, Michael Gharbi, Hongsheng Li, Taesung Park

entry.summary: Proposes PromptRL framework showing that prompt diversity matters in RL fine-tuning of flow matching models. Uses LLM as trainable prompt refinement agent to address sample inefficiency and prompt overfitting.

entry.title: Rethinking Multinomial Logistic Mixture of Experts with Sigmoid Gating Function

author.name: Tuan Minh Pham, Thinh Cao, Viet Nguyen, Huy Nguyen, Nhat Ho, Alessandro Rinaldo

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical benefits of sigmoid gating over softmax in MoE for classification, addressing convergence guarantees and temperature parameter effects.

entry.title: RAPT: Model-Predictive Out-of-Distribution Detection and Failure Diagnosis for Sim-to-Real Humanoid Robots

author.name: Humphrey Munn, Brendan Tidd, Peter Bohm, Marcus Gallagher, David Howard

entry.summary: Introduces RAPT, lightweight deployment-time monitor for humanoid robot control detecting OOD states and explaining failures. Self-supervised approach for 50Hz control with low false-positive rates.

entry.title: Grappa: Gradient-Only Communication for Scalable Graph Neural Network Training

author.name: Chongyang Xu, Christoph Siebenbrunner, Laurent Bindschaedler

entry.summary: Proposes Grappa for distributed GNN training with gradient-only communication, using periodic repartitioning and coverage-corrected aggregation to eliminate feature/activation transfers.

entry.title: Provably Data-driven Multiple Hyper-parameter Tuning with Structured Loss Function

author.name: Tung Quoc Le, Anh Tuan Nguyen, Viet Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: Establishes first general framework for multi-dimensional hyperparameter tuning generalization guarantees using semi-algebraic function analysis and real algebraic geometry tools.

entry.title: DecompressionLM: Deterministic, Diagnostic, and Zero-Shot Concept Graph Extraction from Language Models

author.name: Zhaochen Hong, Jiaxuan You

entry.summary: Proposes DecompressionLM, a framework for extracting concept graphs from LLMs without pre-specified queries using Van der Corput sequences with arithmetic decoding. Enables deterministic, parallel generation avoiding cross-sequence coupling.

entry.title: From Knowledge to Inference: Scaling Laws of Specialized Reasoning on GlobalHealthAtlas

author.name: Zhaokun Yan, Zhaohan Liu, Wuzheng Dong, Lijie Feng, Chengxiao Dai

entry.summary: Introduces GlobalHealthAtlas, a large-scale multilingual dataset of 280K instances across 15 public health domains and 17 languages with three difficulty levels. Proposes LLM-assisted construction and evaluation methodology.

entry.title: HyLRA: Hybrid Layer Reuse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference

author.name: Xuan Ai, Qingqing Yang, Peng Wang, Lei Deng, Lin Zhang, Renhai Chen, Gong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces HyLRA, a hybrid attention framework using layer-wise sparsity profiling. Identifies dual characteristics: intra-layer sensitivity requiring full attention and opportunities for layer reuse.

entry.title: Large Language Models as Students Who Think Aloud: Overly Coherent, Verbose, and Confident

author.name: Conrad Borchers, Jill-J\^enn Vie, Roger Azevedo

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs as student simulators for think-aloud protocols in tutoring, finding they are overly coherent, verbose, and confident compared to real human learners.

entry.title: Chronos: Learning Temporal Dynamics of Reasoning Chains for Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Kai Zhang, Jiayi Liao, Chengpeng Li, Ziyuan Xie, Sihang Li, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Chronos, a lightweight chronological reasoning scorer that models trajectories as time series for test-time scaling. Uses weighted voting based on trajectory quality features.

entry.title: Rethinking Selective Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Almog Tavor, Itay Ebenspanger, Neil Cnaan, Mor Geva

entry.summary: Systematically studies selective knowledge distillation in LLMs, disentangling position, class, and sample axes. Introduces student-entropy-guided position selection (SE-KD) based on analysis.

entry.title: Read As Human: Compressing Context via Parallelizable Close Reading and Skimming

author.name: Jiwei Tang, Shilei Liu, Zhicheng Zhang, Qingsong Lv, Runsong Zhao, Tingwei Lu, Langming Liu, Haibin Chen, Yujin Yuan, Hai-Tao Zheng, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: RAM framework compresses long contexts by mimicking human reading strategies—fully retaining important segments while compressing less relevant ones into summary vectors. Enables parallel processing of context segments.

entry.title: Quantifying the Gap between Understanding and Generation within Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Chenlong Wang, Yuhang Chen, Zhihan Hu, Dongping Chen, Wenhu Chen, Sarah Wiegreffe, Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: GapEval benchmark quantifies the gap between understanding and generation in unified multimodal models by enabling bidirectional answering (image and text) for the same questions, measuring cross-modal consistency.

entry.title: AR-MAP: Are Autoregressive Large Language Models Implicit Teachers for Diffusion Large Language Models?

author.name: Liang Lin, Feng Xiong, Zengbin Wang, Kun Wang, Junhao Dong, Xuecai Hu, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: AR-MAP enables preference alignment of diffusion LLMs by using autoregressive LLMs as implicit teachers, transferring alignment knowledge through weight scaling while avoiding high-variance ELBO estimation.

entry.title: ReLAPSe: Reinforcement-Learning-trained Adversarial Prompt Search for Erased concepts in unlearned diffusion models

author.name: Ignacy Kolton, Kacper Marzol, Pawe{\l} Batorski, Marcin Mazur, Paul Swoboda, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: ReLAPSe uses reinforcement learning to find adversarial prompts that restore erased concepts in unlearned diffusion models, providing red-teaming capability for machine unlearning.

entry.title: RGBX-R1: Visual Modality Chain-of-Thought Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding

author.name: Jiahe Wu, Bing Cao, Qilong Wang, Qinghua Hu, Dongdong Li, Pengfei Zhu

entry.summary: RGBX-R1 extends MLLM perception to non-RGB modalities (infrared, depth, event) using Visual Modality Chain-of-Thought and two-stage training with reinforcement learning.

entry.title: A Hybrid Mamba-SAM Architecture for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Mohammadreza Gholipour Shahraki, Mehdi Rezaeian, Mohammad Ghasemzadeh

entry.summary: Proposes Mamba-SAM, a hybrid architecture combining frozen SAM encoder with Mamba state space models for efficient 3D medical image segmentation with parameter-efficient adaptation strategies.

entry.title: Generating a Paracosm for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Tong Wang, Yunhan Zhao, Shu Kong

entry.summary: Proposes generating a 'paracosm' (imaginary parallel world) for zero-shot composed image retrieval using large multimodal models to generate synthetic images matching mental queries rather than textual descriptions.

entry.title: OCTOPUS: Enhancing the Spatial-Awareness of Vision SSMs with Multi-Dimensional Scans and Traversal Selection

author.name: Kunal Mahatha, Ali Bahri, Pierre Marza, Sahar Dastani, Maria Vakalopoulou, Stergios Christodoulidis, Jose Dolz, Christian Desrosiers

entry.summary: Introduces OCTOPUS architecture for Vision State Space Models with multi-dimensional scans to preserve both global context and local spatial structure while maintaining linear complexity.

entry.title: Robust Harmful Meme Detection under Missing Modalities via Shared Representation Learning

author.name: Felix Breiteneder, Mohammad Belal, Muhammad Saad Saeed, Shahed Masoudian, Usman Naseem, Kulshrestha Juhi, Markus Schedl, Shah Nawaz

entry.summary: First comprehensive study of harmful meme detection under missing modalities, proposing shared representation learning to maintain robustness when text is missing due to OCR failures.

entry.title: Stronger Semantic Encoders Can Harm Relighting Performance: Probing Visual Priors via Augmented Latent Intrinsics

author.name: Xiaoyan Xing, Xiao Zhang, Sezer Karaoglu, Theo Gevers, Anand Bhattad

entry.summary: Discovers that stronger semantic encoders can harm relighting performance, revealing trade-off between semantic abstraction and photometric fidelity. Proposes ALI to balance both.

entry.title: ReCALL: Recalibrating Capability Degradation for MLLM-based Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Tianyu Yang, ChenWei He, Xiangzhao Hao, Tianyue Wang, Jiarui Guo, Haiyun Guo, Leigang Qu, Jinqiao Wang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Introduces ReCALL framework addressing capability degradation when adapting generative MLLMs for composed image retrieval. Identifies paradigm conflict between generative and discriminative retrieval.

entry.title: ObjEmbed: Towards Universal Multimodal Object Embeddings

author.name: Shenghao Fu, Yukun Su, Fengyun Rao, Jing Lyu, Xiaohua Xie, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces ObjEmbed for universal multimodal object embeddings that decompose images into regional embeddings per object plus global embeddings, supporting grounding, local and global retrieval.

entry.title: FlowBypass: Rectified Flow Trajectory Bypass for Training-Free Image Editing

author.name: Menglin Han, Zhangkai Ni

entry.summary: Introduces FlowBypass, a training-free image editing framework using Rectified Flow that constructs a bypass between inversion and reconstruction trajectories to reduce error accumulation.

entry.title: MAIN-VLA: Modeling Abstraction of Intention and eNvironment for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zheyuan Zhou, Liang Du, Zixun Sun, Xiaoyu Zhou, Ruimin Ye, Qihao Chen, Yinda Chen, Lemiao Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces MAIN-VLA framework modeling abstraction of intention and environment for VLA models in complex dynamic environments like 3D open worlds and PvP games.

entry.title: Can Vision-Language Models Handle Long-Context Code? An Empirical Study on Visual Compression

author.name: Jianping Zhong, Guochang Li, Chen Zhi, Junxiao Han, Zhen Qin, Xinkui Zhao, Nan Wang, Shuiguang Deng, Jianwei Yin

entry.summary: Proposes LongCodeOCR, a visual compression framework that renders code as images for VLMs to handle long-context code, preserving dependency closure that text-based methods break.

entry.title: Agentic Reward Modeling: Verifying GUI Agent via Online Proactive Interaction

author.name: Chaoqun Cui, Jing Huang, Shijing Wang, Liming Zheng, Qingchao Kong, Zhixiong Zeng

entry.summary: Presents VAGEN, an agentic reward modeling framework where a verifier agent actively probes the environment to assess GUI agent task completion, moving beyond passive evaluation.

entry.title: UniMorphGrasp: Diffusion Model with Morphology-Awareness for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation

author.name: Zhiyuan Wu, Xiangyu Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Jiankang Deng, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Shan Luo

entry.summary: Proposes UniMorphGrasp, a diffusion-based framework for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping that generalizes to unseen hand morphologies using canonical pose representation.

entry.title: UniForce: A Unified Latent Force Model for Robot Manipulation with Diverse Tactile Sensors

author.name: Zhuo Chen, Fei Ni, Kaiyao Luo, Zhiyuan Wu, Xuyang Zhang, Emmanouil Spyrakos-Papastavridis, Lorenzo Jamone, Nathan F. Lepora, Jiankang Deng, Shan Luo

entry.summary: Proposes UniForce, a unified tactile representation learning framework that learns shared latent force space across diverse tactile sensors.

entry.title: Three ways to make Claude’s constitution better

author.name: Parv Mahajan

entry.summary: Provides critique of Anthropic's new Claude constitution from AI safety researchers, recommending increased transparency about character training process, empirical data on behavioral changes, and evidence on corrigibility.

entry.title: Welcome to Moltbook

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Overview of Moltbook, a public social network for AI agents. Describes emergent behaviors, agent interactions, and the phenomenon's significance for understanding AI agent ecosystems.

entry.title: Exploring Information Seeking Agent Consolidation

author.name: Guochen Yan, Jialong Wu, Zhengwei Tao, Bo Li, Qintong Zhang, Jiahao Xu, Haitao Mi, Yuejian Fang, Qingni Shen, Wentao Zhang, Zhonghai Wu

entry.summary: Investigates consolidating heterogeneous information-seeking agents into unified models through data-level and parameter-level consolidation. Compares performance retention and cross-domain generalization.

entry.title: AdaFuse: Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Lung Cancer Risk Prediction via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chongyu Qu, Zhengyi Lu, Yuxiang Lai, Thomas Z. Li, Junchao Zhu, Junlin Guo, Juming Xiong, Yanfan Zhu, Yuechen Yang, Allen J. Luna, Kim L. Sandler, Bennett A. Landman, Yuankai Huo

entry.summary: AdaFuse uses reinforcement learning to learn patient-specific modality selection and fusion strategies for lung cancer risk prediction, rather than processing all modalities equally.

entry.title: Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Offline Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Jatan Shrestha, Santeri Heiskanen, Kari Hepola, Severi Rissanen, Pekka J\"a\"askel\"ainen, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Introduces Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion (PCD) for offline multi-objective optimization that conditions directly on desired trade-offs and uses reweighting strategies to explore the Pareto front.
