entry.summary: V-Loop proposes training-free Visual Logical Loop Verification for hallucination detection in medical VQA, verifying factual correctness of specific answers rather than estimating general uncertainty.

entry.title: Efficient Complex-Valued Vision Transformers for MRI Classification Directly from k-Space

author.name: Moritz Rempe, Lukas T. Rotkopf, Marco Schlimbach, Helmut Becker, Fabian H\"orst, Johannes Haubold, Philipp Dammann, Kevin Kr\"oninger, Jens Kleesiek

entry.summary: kViT proposes complex-valued Vision Transformer for MRI classification directly from k-space data with radial patching strategy that respects spectral energy distribution.

entry.title: Trustworthy Evaluation of Robotic Manipulation: A New Benchmark and AutoEval Methods

author.name: Mengyuan Liu, Juyi Sheng, Peiming Li, Ziyi Wang, Tianming Xu, Tiantian Xu, Hong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Eval-Actions benchmark and AutoEval architecture for trustworthy evaluation of robotic manipulation, distinguishing genuine policy behaviors from teleoperation and assessing execution quality.

entry.title: Dario Amodei – The Adolescence of Technology

author.name: habryka

entry.summary: Links to Dario Amodei's new essay 'Confronting and Overcoming the Risks of Powerful AI,' describing humanity's technological adolescence and the need to navigate AI development carefully. Important for understanding Anthropic's strategic thinking.

entry.title: DIML: Differentiable Inverse Mechanism Learning from Behaviors of Multi-Agent Learning Trajectories

author.name: Zhiyu An, Wan Du

entry.summary: Proposes DIML for inverse mechanism learning, recovering unknown incentive mechanisms from observed multi-agent learning trajectories by differentiating through learning dynamics models.

entry.title: Emergence of Phonemic, Syntactic, and Semantic Representations in Artificial Neural Networks

author.name: Pierre Orhan, Pablo Diego-Sim\'on, Emmnanuel Chemla, Yair Lakretz, Yves Boubenec, Jean-R\'emi King

entry.summary: Investigates whether phonemic, lexical, and syntactic representations emerge during neural network training, finding sequential learning stages in both speech and text models.

entry.title: TEA-Bench: A Systematic Benchmarking of Tool-enhanced Emotional Support Dialogue Agent

author.name: Xingyu Sui, Yanyan Zhao, Yulin Hu, Jiahe Guo, Weixiang Zhao, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Introduces TEA-Bench, first interactive benchmark for tool-augmented agents in emotional support conversations with MCP-style tool environment and process-level metrics.

entry.title: Bridging Expectation Signals: LLM-Based Experiments and a Behavioral Kalman Filter Framework

author.name: Yu Wang, Xiangchen Liu

entry.summary: Develops Behavioral Kalman Filter framework to quantify how LLM agents update beliefs when presented with individual vs aggregate signals, finding consistent behavioral patterns.

entry.title: ShapLoRA: Allocation of Low-rank Adaption on Large Language Models via Shapley Value Inspired Importance Estimation

author.name: Yi Zhao, Qinghua Yao, Xinyuan song, Wei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes ShapLoRA for LoRA rank allocation using Shapley value-inspired importance estimation. Combines sensitivity measures with coalition game theory for explainable rank importance.

entry.title: Reflecting Twice before Speaking with Empathy: Self-Reflective Alternating Inference for Empathy-Aware End-to-End Spoken Dialogue

author.name: Yuhang Jia, Pei Liu, Haoqin Sun, Jiaming Zhou, Xuxin Cheng, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai, Yong Qin

entry.summary: Proposes self-reflective alternating inference framework for empathetic spoken dialogue using natural language evaluation model EmpathyEval instead of rigid supervised signals.

entry.title: Are Video Generation Models Geographically Fair? An Attraction-Centric Evaluation of Global Visual Knowledge

author.name: Xiao Liu, Jiawei Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates geographic fairness in text-to-video models by introducing GAP framework and GEOATTRACTION-500 benchmark with 500 globally distributed tourist attractions to assess regional bias.

entry.title: EquiForm: Noise-Robust SE(3)-Equivariant Policy Learning from 3D Point Clouds

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Yu She

entry.summary: Introduces EquiForm, a noise-robust SE(3)-equivariant policy learning framework for point cloud-based manipulation that explicitly corrects geometric deviations.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Self-Driving Laboratories in Soft Matter: Taxonomy, Benchmarks,and Open Challenges

author.name: Xuanzhou Chen, Audrey Wang, Stanley Yin, Hanyang Jiang, Dong Zhang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey framing self-driving laboratories as agent-environment interaction problems, reviewing Bayesian optimization and other AI methods for closed-loop experimentation with soft matter as representative setting.

entry.title: A Balanced Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Commonsense Abductive Logic

author.name: Joseph Cotnareanu, Didier Chetelat, Yingxue Zhang, Mark Coates

entry.summary: Proposes neuro-symbolic approach using logic solver feedback to iteratively augment problems with commonsense relations from LLMs, improving complex proof planning.

entry.title: Failing on Bias Mitigation: Investigating Why Predictive Models Struggle with Government Data

author.name: Hongbo Bo, Jingyu Hu, Debbie Watson, Weiru Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes why bias mitigation techniques fail on government data using crime rate prediction as case study. Finds data properties, not model architectures, cause mitigation failures.

entry.title: TrojanGYM: A Detector-in-the-Loop LLM for Adaptive RTL Hardware Trojan Insertion

author.name: Saideep Sreekumar, Zeng Wang, Akashdeep Saha, Weihua Xiao, Minghao Shao, Muhammad Shafique, Ozgur Sinanoglu, Ramesh Karri, Johann Knechtel

entry.summary: Introduces TrojanGYM, an agentic LLM framework using GPT-4, LLaMA-3.3-70B, and Gemini-2.5Pro for adaptive hardware trojan insertion to expose detector blind spots.

entry.title: Meta-Judging with Large Language Models: Concepts, Methods, and Challenges

author.name: Hugo Silva, Mateus Mendes, Hugo Gon\c{c}alo Oliveira

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on LLM-as-Meta-Judge paradigm covering conceptual foundations, mechanisms, alignment training, evaluation, and emerging applications.

entry.title: Linguistic and Argument Diversity in Synthetic Data for Function-Calling Agents

author.name: Dan Greenstein, Zohar Karnin, Chen Amiraz, Oren Somekh

entry.summary: Proposes method for generating synthetic training data for function-calling agents by optimizing linguistic and argument diversity without hand-crafted rules.

entry.title: \textsc{NaVIDA}: Vision-Language Navigation with Inverse Dynamics Augmentation

author.name: Weiye Zhu, Zekai Zhang, Xiangchen Wang, Hewei Pan, Teng Wang, Tiantian Geng, Rongtao Xu, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces NaVIDA framework for vision-language navigation that explicitly models how actions causally transform visual observations, using inverse dynamics to address unstable behaviors and weak generalization in VLN agents.

entry.title: Temp-R1: A Unified Autonomous Agent for Complex Temporal KGQA via Reverse Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhaoyan Gong, Zhiqiang Liu, Songze Li, Xiaoke Guo, Yuanxiang Liu, Xinle Deng, Zhizhen Liu, Lei Liang, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Temp-R1, first autonomous end-to-end agent for temporal knowledge graph QA via reinforcement learning. Uses reverse curriculum learning and specialized internal actions to handle cognitive overload.

entry.title: Dep-Search: Learning Dependency-Aware Reasoning Traces with Persistent Memory

author.name: Yanming Liu, Xinyue Peng, Zixuan Yan, Yanxin Shen, Wenjie Xu, Yuefeng Huang, Xinyi Wang, Jiannan Cao, Jianwei Yin, Xuhong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Dep-Search framework learning dependency-aware reasoning traces with persistent memory for RAG systems, addressing implicit reasoning limitations for managing cross-step dependencies.

entry.title: Beyond Superficial Unlearning: Sharpness-Aware Robust Erasure of Hallucinations in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Xianya Fang, Feiyang Ren, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian, Zhen Bi, Haiyang Yu, Sheng-Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SARE for robust hallucination unlearning in multimodal LLMs. Shows standard unlearning achieves only superficial suppression; uses Targeted-SAM to flatten loss landscape and prevent hallucination resurgence.

entry.title: GRIP: Algorithm-Agnostic Machine Unlearning for Mixture-of-Experts via Geometric Router Constraints

author.name: Andy Zhu, Rongzhe Wei, Yupu Gu, Pan Li

entry.summary: Proposes GRIP for machine unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts models. Identifies that traditional methods manipulate routers rather than erasing knowledge; uses geometric constraint to preserve routing stability.

entry.title: Auto-Regressive Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Mahdi Karami, Ali Ghodsi

entry.summary: Proposes Auto-Regressive Masked Diffusion (ARMD) that reframes masked diffusion as block-wise causal model. Enables computing all conditional probabilities in single parallel forward pass.

entry.title: White-Box Sensitivity Auditing with Steering Vectors

author.name: Hannah Cyberey, Yangfeng Ji, David Evans

entry.summary: Proposes white-box sensitivity auditing using activation steering vectors for LLMs. Enables more rigorous assessment of model properties like bias through internal perturbations rather than just input testing.

entry.title: Sequence Repetition Enhances Token Embeddings and Improves Sequence Labeling with Decoder-only Language Models

author.name: Matija Luka Kuki\'c, Marko \v{C}uljak, David Duki\'c, Martin Tutek, Jan \v{S}najder

entry.summary: Explores sequence repetition as a technique to enable decoder-only models to leverage full context for sequence labeling tasks without removing causal masks. Less invasive alternative to architectural modifications.

entry.title: PEAR: Pairwise Evaluation for Automatic Relative Scoring in Machine Translation

author.name: Lorenzo Proietti, Roman Grundkiewicz, Matt Post

entry.summary: Introduces PEAR, a pairwise QE metric for MT evaluation that predicts direction and magnitude of quality differences between translation candidates. Outperforms single-candidate baselines with same training data.

entry.title: A Contrastive Pre-trained Foundation Model for Deciphering Imaging Noisomics across Modalities

author.name: Yuanjie Gu, Yiqun Wang, Chaohui Yu, Ang Xuan, Fan Wang, Zhi Lu, Biqin Dong

entry.summary: Introduces 'Noisomics' framework shifting from noise suppression to systematic noise decoding via Contrastive Pre-trained Foundation Model, breaking traditional deep learning scaling laws for noise characterization.

entry.title: C-RADIOv4 (Tech Report)

author.name: Mike Ranzinger, Greg Heinrich, Collin McCarthy, Jan Kautz, Andrew Tao, Bryan Catanzaro, Pavlo Molchanov

entry.summary: Technical report on C-RADIOv4, multi-teacher distilled vision backbone with updated teachers (SigLIP2, DINOv3, SAM3), improved any-resolution support, and ViTDet option.

entry.title: FMIR, a foundation model-based Image Registration Framework for Robust Image Registration

author.name: Fengting Zhang, Yue He, Qinghao Liu, Yaonan Wang, Xiang Chen, Hang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FMIR, foundation model-based medical image registration framework achieving strong out-of-domain generalization when trained on single dataset, addressing key limitation of deep learning registration.

entry.title: VAE-REPA: Variational Autoencoder Representation Alignment for Efficient Diffusion Training

author.name: Mengmeng Wang, Dengyang Jiang, Liuzhuozheng Li, Yucheng Lin, Guojiang Shen, Xiangjie Kong, Yong Liu, Guang Dai, Jingdong Wang

entry.summary: VAE-REPA leverages off-the-shelf VAE features as intrinsic guidance for efficient diffusion transformer training, exploiting VAE's rich texture and structural priors without requiring external representation encoders.

entry.title: ARMOR: Agentic Reasoning for Methods Orchestration and Reparameterization for Robust Adversarial Attacks

author.name: Gabriel Lee Jun Rong, Christos Korgialas, Dion Jia Xu Ho, Pai Chet Ng, Xiaoxiao Miao, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis

entry.title: MetaWorld: Skill Transfer and Composition in a Hierarchical World Model for Grounding High-Level Instructions

author.name: Yutong Shen, Hangxu Liu, Kailin Pei, Ruizhe Xia, Tongtong Feng

entry.summary: Proposes MetaWorld, a hierarchical world model integrating VLM-driven semantic planning with latent dynamics model for humanoid loco-manipulation with expert policy transfer.

entry.title: MMR-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal LLM Routing

author.name: Haoxuan Ma, Guannan Lai, Han-Jia Ye

entry.summary: Presents MMR-Bench, a unified benchmark for multimodal LLM routing that addresses modality fusion challenges and budget-aware evaluation for query-level model selection.

entry.title: FadeMem: Biologically-Inspired Forgetting for Efficient Agent Memory

author.name: Lei Wei, Xu Dong, Xiao Peng, Niantao Xie, Bin Wang

entry.title: MergeMix: Optimizing Mid-Training Data Mixtures via Learnable Model Merging

author.name: Jiapeng Wang, Changxin Tian, Kunlong Chen, Ziqi Liu, Jiaxin Mao, Wayne Xin Zhao, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou

entry.title: GenAI for Social Work Field Education: Client Simulation with Real-Time Feedback

author.name: James Sungarda, Hongkai Liu, Zilong Zhou, Tien-Hsuan Wu, Johnson Chun-Sing Cheung, Ben Kao

entry.summary: Presents SWITCH, a social work training chatbot integrating client simulation with cognitively grounded profiles, real-time counseling skill classification, and Motivational Interviewing progression.

entry.title: Closing the Modality Gap Aligns Group-Wise Semantics

author.name: Eleonora Grassucci, Giordano Cicchetti, Emanuele Frasca, Aurelio Uncini, Danilo Comminiello

entry.summary: Analyzes and addresses the modality gap in CLIP-like models, showing its pronounced effect on group-level tasks like clustering and proposing method to close this gap.

entry.title: DV-VLN: Dual Verification for Reliable LLM-Based Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Zijun Li, Shijie Li, Zhenxi Zhang, Bin Li, Shoujun Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DV-VLN, a generate-then-verify framework for LLM-based vision-and-language navigation that reduces error accumulation through dual verification.

entry.title: Implementing Tensor Logic: Unifying Datalog and Neural Reasoning via Tensor Contraction

author.name: Swapn Shah (School of Data Science, University of North Carolina at Charlotte), Wlodek Zadrozny (Department of Computer Science, University of North Carolina at Charlotte)

entry.title: Sentipolis: Emotion-Aware Agents for Social Simulations

author.name: Chiyuan Fu, Lyuhao Chen, Yunze Xiao, Weihao Xuan, Carlos Busso, Mona Diab

entry.summary: Introduces Sentipolis framework for emotionally stateful LLM agents using continuous PAD representation, dual-speed emotion dynamics, and emotion-memory coupling for social simulation.

entry.title: Think-Augmented Function Calling: Improving LLM Parameter Accuracy Through Embedded Reasoning

author.name: Lei Wei, Jinpeng Ou, Xiao Peng, Bin Wang

entry.title: Interpretable and Sparse Linear Attention with Decoupled Membership-Subspace Modeling via MCR2 Objective

entry.title: A Mechanistic View on Video Generation as World Models: State and Dynamics

author.name: Luozhou Wang, Zhifei Chen, Yihua Du, Dongyu Yan, Wenhang Ge, Guibao Shen, Xinli Xu, Leyi Wu, Man Chen, Tianshuo Xu, Peiran Ren, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Ying-Cong Chen

entry.title: Beyond Instrumental and Substitutive Paradigms: Introducing Machine Culture as an Emergent Phenomenon in Large Language Models

author.name: Yueqing Hu, Xinyang Peng, Yukun Zhao, Lin Qiu, Ka-lai Hung, Kaiping Peng

entry.title: Learning to Collaborate: An Orchestrated-Decentralized Framework for Peer-to-Peer LLM Federation

author.name: Inderjeet Singh, Eleonore Vissol-Gaudin, Andikan Otung, Motoyoshi Sekiya

entry.title: Data-Driven Information-Theoretic Causal Bounds under Unmeasured Confounding

author.name: Yonghan Jung, Bogyeong Kang

entry.summary: Develops data-driven information-theoretic framework for causal effect bounds under unmeasured confounding. Overcomes limitations of existing approaches without requiring external inputs.

entry.title: Typhoon-S: Minimal Open Post-Training for Sovereign Large Language Models

author.name: Kunat Pipatanakul, Pittawat Taveekitworachai

entry.title: SMART: Scalable Mesh-free Aerodynamic Simulations from Raw Geometries using a Transformer-based Surrogate Model

author.name: Jan Hagnberger, Mathias Niepert

entry.title: $\alpha^3$-SecBench: A Large-Scale Evaluation Suite of Security, Resilience, and Trust for LLM-based UAV Agents over 6G Networks

author.name: Mohamed Amine Ferrag, Abderrahmane Lakas, Merouane Debbah

entry.title: Ordering-based Causal Discovery via Generalized Score Matching

author.name: Vy Vo, He Zhao, Trung Le, Edwin V. Bonilla, Dinh Phung

entry.title: Mixture-of-Models: Unifying Heterogeneous Agents via N-Way Self-Evaluating Deliberation

entry.title: Revisiting Modality Invariance in a Multilingual Speech-Text Model via Neuron-Level Analysis

entry.title: EFT-CoT: A Multi-Agent Chain-of-Thought Framework for Emotion-Focused Therapy

author.name: Lanqing Du, Yunong Li, YuJie Long, Shihong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EFT-CoT, an Emotion-Focused Therapy multi-agent chain-of-thought framework for mental health QA using eight specialized agents following bottom-up emotional processing trajectory.

entry.title: TechING: Towards Real World Technical Image Understanding via VLMs

author.name: Tafazzul Nadeem, Bhavik Shangari, Manish Rai, Gagan Raj Gupta, Ashutosh Modi

entry.summary: Introduces TechING, a synthetically generated corpus for training VLMs on technical diagram understanding (flowcharts, block diagrams) with evaluation on real hand-drawn images.

entry.title: Evaluating Morphological Plausibility of Subword Tokenization via Statistical Alignment with Morpho-Syntactic Features

author.name: Abishek Stephen, Jind\v{r}ich Libovick\'y

entry.title: The Voice of Equity: A Systematic Evaluation of Bias Mitigation Techniques for Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection Across Architectures and Demographics

author.name: Yasaman Haghbin, Sina Rashidi, Ali Zolnour, Maryam Zolnoori

entry.summary: Presents first comprehensive fairness analysis framework for speech-based cognitive impairment detection, systematically evaluating bias mitigation across transformer architectures and demographic subgroups on multilingual data.

entry.title: SpatialMath: Spatial Comprehension-Infused Symbolic Reasoning for Mathematical Problem-Solving

author.name: Ashutosh Bajpai, Akshat Bhandari, Akshay Nambi, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: Introduces SpatialMath framework integrating spatial comprehension with symbolic reasoning for mathematical problem-solving, using specialized perception module to extract spatially-grounded representations for geometric problems.

entry.title: Ego4OOD: Rethinking Egocentric Video Domain Generalization via Covariate Shift Scoring

author.name: Zahra Vaseqi, James Clark

entry.title: SkyReels-V3 Technique Report

author.name: Debang Li, Zhengcong Fei, Tuanhui Li, Yikun Dou, Zheng Chen, Jiangping Yang, Mingyuan Fan, Jingtao Xu, Jiahua Wang, Baoxuan Gu, Mingshan Chang, Yuqiang Xie, Binjie Mao, Youqiang Zhang, Nuo Pang, Hao Zhang, Yuzhe Jin, Zhiheng Xu, Dixuan Lin, Guibin Chen, Yahui Zhou

entry.title: HAAF: Hierarchical Adaptation and Alignment of Foundation Models for Few-Shot Pathology Anomaly Detection

author.name: Chunze Yang, Wenjie Zhao, Yue Tang, Junbo Lu, Jiusong Ge, Qidong Liu, Zeyu Gao, Chen Li

entry.summary: Proposes HAAF framework adapting vision-language models for few-shot pathology anomaly detection using Cross-Level Scaled Alignment to ground semantic prompts in ROI-specific visual contexts.

entry.title: SPACE-CLIP: Spatial Perception via Adaptive CLIP Embeddings for Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Taewan Cho, Taeryang Kim, Andrew Jaeyong Choi

entry.summary: SPACE-CLIP extracts latent geometric knowledge directly from frozen CLIP vision encoders for monocular depth estimation, bypassing the text encoder entirely through a dual-pathway decoder architecture using FiLM conditioning.

entry.title: ViTCoP: Accelerating Large Vision-Language Models via Visual and Textual Semantic Collaborative Pruning

author.name: Wen Luo, Peng Chen, Xiaotao Huang, LiQun Huang

entry.summary: ViTCoP introduces visual and textual semantic collaborative pruning for LVLMs, combining redundancy filtering in the vision encoder with step-wise co-pruning within the LLM to efficiently preserve critical information.

entry.title: MV-SAM: Multi-view Promptable Segmentation using Pointmap Guidance

author.name: Yoonwoo Jeong, Cheng Sun, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Minsu Cho, Jaesung Choe

entry.summary: MV-SAM achieves 3D-consistent multi-view segmentation using pointmaps from visual geometry models, enabling pixel-point correspondence lifting without costly per-scene optimization.

entry.title: FlowMorph: Physics-Consistent Self-Supervision for Label-Free Single-Cell Mechanics in Microfluidic Videos

author.name: Bora Yimenicioglu, Vishal Manikanden

entry.summary: FlowMorph introduces physics-consistent self-supervised learning for red blood cell mechanics in microfluidics, combining differentiable capsule-in-flow modeling with laminar Stokes-flow physics.

entry.title: MindCine: Multimodal EEG-to-Video Reconstruction with Large-Scale Pretrained Models

author.name: Tian-Yi Zhou, Xuan-Hao Liu, Bao-Liang Lu, Wei-Long Zheng

entry.summary: MindCine achieves EEG-to-video reconstruction using multimodal joint learning beyond text alignment, incorporating visual modalities to address data scarcity and overfitting in brain decoding.

entry.title: On Procrustes Contamination in Machine Learning Applications of Geometric Morphometrics

author.name: Lloyd Austin Courtenay

entry.summary: Identifies Procrustes contamination in machine learning applications of geometric morphometrics where GPA before train/test split introduces statistical dependence, and proposes realignment procedure.

entry.title: DisasterInsight: A Multimodal Benchmark for Function-Aware and Grounded Disaster Assessment

author.name: Sara Tehrani, Yonghao Xu, Leif Haglund, Amanda Berg, Michael Felsberg

entry.title: Grasp-and-Lift: Executable 3D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction via Physics-in-the-Loop Optimization

author.name: Byeonggyeol Choi, Woojin Oh, Jongwoo Lim

entry.summary: Introduces simulation-in-the-loop refinement framework to convert visually aligned hand-object trajectories into physically executable ones using black-box optimization with spline-based parameterization.

entry.title: EMPM: Embodied MPM for Modeling and Simulation of Deformable Objects

author.name: Yunuo Chen, Yafei Hu, Lingfeng Sun, Tushar Kusnur, Laura Herlant, Chenfanfu Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces EMPM, a differentiable MPM-based framework for modeling deformable objects from multi-view RGB-D videos with physics simulation for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: SG-CADVLM: A Context-Aware Decoding Powered Vision Language Model for Safety-Critical Scenario Generation

author.name: Hongyi Zhao, Shuo Wang, Qijie He, Ziyuan Pu

entry.summary: Proposes SG-CADVLM using context-aware decoding with VLMs for generating realistic safety-critical scenarios for autonomous vehicle validation from crash reports.

entry.title: EvolVE: Evolutionary Search for LLM-based Verilog Generation and Optimization

author.name: Wei-Po Hsin, Ren-Hao Deng, Yao-Ting Hsieh, En-Ming Huang, Shih-Hao Hung

entry.title: PolySHAP: Extending KernelSHAP with Interaction-Informed Polynomial Regression

author.name: Fabian Fumagalli, R. Teal Witter, Christopher Musco

entry.title: A Model-Driven Lossless Compression Algorithm Resistant to Mismatch

author.name: Cordelia Hu, Jennifer Tang

entry.summary: Proposes compression algorithm using next-token prediction that is robust to arbitrarily large model output mismatches between encoder and decoder, addressing non-determinism.

entry.title: Assessment of Generative Named Entity Recognition in the Era of Large Language Models

author.name: Qi Zhan, Yile Wang, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of open-source LLMs on flat and nested NER tasks across eight models and four datasets. Finds PEFT fine-tuned LLMs achieve competitive performance with traditional NER models.

entry.title: BMDS-Net: A Bayesian Multi-Modal Deep Supervision Network for Robust Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Yan Zhou, Zhen Huang, Yingqiu Li, Yue Ouyang, Suncheng Xiang, Zehua Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BMDS-Net for brain tumor segmentation prioritizing robustness to missing modalities and confidence calibration over simple metric maximization, using Bayesian deep supervision.

entry.title: Evolving Interdependent Operators with Large Language Models for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Junhao Qiu, Xin Chen, Liang Ge, Liyong Lin, Zhichao Lu, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes E2OC framework using LLMs to evolve interdependent operators for multi-objective evolutionary algorithms through sequential decision-making formulation.

entry.title: Less Is More: Scalable Visual Navigation from Limited Data

author.name: Yves Inglin, Jonas Frey, Changan Chen, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Introduces LiMo, showing that augmenting limited expert demonstrations with geometric planner-generated synthetic trajectories yields substantial performance gains for visual navigation.

entry.title: The LLM Data Auditor: A Metric-oriented Survey on Quality and Trustworthiness in Evaluating Synthetic Data

entry.title: Research Summary: January 26, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research features a major open-source release and critical safety findings. LongCat-Flash-Thinking-2601, a 560B MoE reasoning model, achieves SOTA among open-source models for agentic tasks. VibeTensor demonstrates LLM agents can generate complete deep learning system software stacks including CUDA runtime.

  • Endless Terminals (Stanford/UW) introduces autonomous pipeline for generating terminal RL environments, addressing a key bottleneck for self-improving agents
  • PHISH framework reveals persona jailbreaking via adversarial conversation history, bypassing input-only safety filters
  • Timely Machine reframes test-time scaling as wall-clock time, finding smaller models often outperform larger ones under time constraints

Theoretical and interpretability advances include floating-point transformer expressivity analysis proving non-equivariant function representation without positional encoding. Sycophancy signals are shown to be linearly separable in middle-layer attention heads, enabling targeted steering. A conceptual critique of machine unlearning argues dual-use capabilities and compositional generalization fundamentally prevent knowledge removal—an important insight for AI safety policy.

entry.title: DeMark: A Query-Free Black-Box Attack on Deepfake Watermarking Defenses

author.name: Wei Song, Zhenchang Xing, Liming Zhu, Yulei Sui, Jingling Xue

entry.summary: Introduces DeMark, a query-free black-box attack that removes defensive watermarks from deepfakes using latent-space sparsification, reducing detection accuracy from 100% to near random across 8 watermarking schemes.

entry.title: SALAD: Achieve High-Sparsity Attention via Efficient Linear Attention Tuning for Video Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Tongcheng Fang, Hanling Zhang, Ruiqi Xie, Zhuo Han, Xin Tao, Tianchen Zhao, Pengfei Wan, Wenbo Ding, Wanli Ouyang, Xuefei Ning, Yu Wang

entry.title: A tale of three theories: sparsity, frustration, and statistical field theory

author.name: Dmitry Vaintrob

entry.summary: Technical interpretability research connecting superposition, statistical field theory, and frustration in neural networks. Develops theoretical framework with Zohar Ringel for understanding computation in superposition.

entry.title: A Scalable Measure of Loss Landscape Curvature for Analyzing the Training Dynamics of LLMs

author.name: Dayal Singh Kalra, Jean-Christophe Gagnon-Audet, Andrey Gromov, Ishita Mediratta, Kelvin Niu, Alexander H Miller, Michael Shvartsman

entry.summary: Introduces 'critical sharpness' as a computationally efficient proxy for Hessian sharpness in LLMs requiring fewer than 10 forward passes, capturing key training dynamics phenomena like progressive sharpening and edge of stability.

entry.title: Towards a Theoretical Understanding to the Generalization of RLHF

author.name: Zhaochun Li (1,2), Mingyang Yi (3), Yue Wang (2), Shisheng Cui (1), Yong Liu (3) ((1) Beijing Institute of Technolegy, (2) Zhongguancun Academy, (3) Renmin University of China)

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of RLHF generalization in high-dimensional settings using algorithmic stability framework. Proves O(1/sqrt(n)) generalization bound under feature coverage condition for end-to-end learning.

entry.title: Beyond Superficial Unlearning: Sharpness-Aware Robust Erasure of Hallucinations in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Xianya Fang, Feiyang Ren, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian, Zhen Bi, Haiyang Yu, Sheng-Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SARE for robust hallucination removal in MLLMs using sharpness-aware optimization to flatten loss landscape, preventing catastrophic resurgence of hallucinations after relearning.

entry.title: GRIP: Algorithm-Agnostic Machine Unlearning for Mixture-of-Experts via Geometric Router Constraints

author.name: Andy Zhu, Rongzhe Wei, Yupu Gu, Pan Li

entry.summary: Introduces GRIP, a geometric constraint framework for machine unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts that prevents routers from simply redirecting queries away from knowledgeable experts rather than erasing knowledge.

entry.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Gradient Descent for Shallow Transformers

author.name: Enes Arda, Semih Cayci, Atilla Eryilmaz

entry.summary: Provides finite-time analysis of gradient descent for shallow transformers in kernel regime, showing width scales logarithmically with samples and optimization error is independent of sequence length.

entry.title: White-Box Sensitivity Auditing with Steering Vectors

author.name: Hannah Cyberey, Yangfeng Ji, David Evans

entry.summary: Proposes white-box sensitivity auditing for LLMs using activation steering to test model internals for socially relevant properties like gender bias, addressing limitations of black-box input-output testing.

entry.title: SafeThinker: Reasoning about Risk to Deepen Safety Beyond Shallow Alignment

author.name: Xianya Fang, Xianying Luo, Yadong Wang, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian, Zequn Sun, Rui Liu, Jun Fang, Naiqiang Tan, Yuanning Cui, Sheng-Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SafeThinker, an adaptive safety framework with gateway classifier routing inputs through different defensive mechanisms based on risk assessment, including twin expert module for deceptive attacks.

entry.title: LUMINA: Long-horizon Understanding for Multi-turn Interactive Agents

author.name: Amin Rakhsha, Thomas Hehn, Pietro Mazzaglia, Fabio Valerio Massoli, Arash Behboodi, Tribhuvanesh Orekondy

entry.summary: Introduces LUMINA, an oracle counterfactual framework with procedurally generated game tasks to measure criticality of specific capabilities (planning, state tracking, context processing) for multi-turn agent success by testing performance with oracle assistance.

entry.title: The Art of Being Difficult: Combining Human and AI Strengths to Find Adversarial Instances for Heuristics

author.name: Henri Nikoleit, Ankit Anand, Anurag Murty Naredla, Heiko R\"oglin

entry.summary: Demonstrates human-LLM collaboration using FunSearch to derive state-of-the-art lower bounds for heuristics on bin packing, k-median clustering, and knapsack - problems without improvement for over a decade.

entry.title: Critique of machine unlearning

author.name: myyycroft

entry.summary: Argues machine unlearning cannot remove dangerous capabilities because capabilities are dual-use, and strong compositional generalization fundamentally constrains what's achievable.

entry.title: PyHealth 2.0: A Comprehensive Open-Source Toolkit for Accessible and Reproducible Clinical Deep Learning

author.name: John Wu, Yongda Fan, Zhenbang Wu, Paul Landes, Eric Schrock, Sayeed Sajjad Razin, Arjun Chatterjee, Naveen Baskaran, Joshua Steier, Andrea Fitzpatrick, Bilal Arif, Rian Atri, Jathurshan Pradeepkumar, Siddhartha Laghuvarapu, Junyi Gao, Adam R. Cross, and Jimeng Sun

entry.title: LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA: A Benchmark for Logical Commonsense Reasoning

author.name: Obed Junias and Maria Leonor Pacheco

entry.summary: Introduces LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA benchmark reframing commonsense reasoning as logical composition over statement pairs using AND/OR/NEITHER operators. Finds models struggle significantly with negation.

entry.title: Trapped in the past? Disentangling fluid and crystallized intelligence of large language models using chess

author.name: Leonard S. Pleiss, Maximilian Schiffer, Robert K. von Weizs\"acker

entry.summary: Uses chess as a controlled testbed to disentangle crystallized (recall) and fluid (reasoning) intelligence in LLMs by creating positions varying in training corpus proximity, revealing performance collapses to random in out-of-distribution tasks.

entry.title: Auto-Regressive Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Mahdi Karami, Ali Ghodsi

entry.summary: Introduces Auto-Regressive Masked Diffusion (ARMD) that reframes masked diffusion as block-wise causal model, enabling efficient training with parallel generation capabilities in a single forward pass.

entry.title: Graph-Anchored Knowledge Indexing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zhenghao Liu, Mingyan Wu, Xinze Li, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Cheng Yang, Minghe Yu, Zheni Zeng, Maosong Sun

entry.title: TangramPuzzle: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models with Compositional Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Daixian Liu, Jiayi Kuang, Yinghui Li, Yangning Li, Di Yin, Haoyu Cao, Xing Sun, Ying Shen, Hai-Tao Zheng, Liang Lin, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Introduces TangramPuzzle benchmark for evaluating MLLM compositional spatial reasoning using Tangram game with rigorous geometric grounding through Tangram Construction Expression (TCE) symbolic framework.

entry.title: VisGym: Diverse, Customizable, Scalable Environments for Multimodal Agents

entry.title: M3Kang: Evaluating Multilingual Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Aleix Torres-Camps, Nathaniel Mitrani Hadida, V\'ictor Conchello Vendrell, \`Alex Batlle Casellas, Arnau Padr\'es Masdemont, Jordi Ros-Giralt

author.name: Fan Nie, Junlin Wang, Harper Hua, Federico Bianchi, Yongchan Kwon, Zhenting Qi, Owen Queen, Shang Zhu, James Zou

entry.summary: DSGym provides standardized framework for evaluating data science agents, revealing that substantial portions of existing benchmark tasks are solvable without using the actual data.

entry.title: NOIR: Privacy-Preserving Generation of Code with Open-Source LLMs

author.name: Khoa Nguyen, Khiem Ton, NhatHai Phan, Issa Khalil, Khang Tran, Cristian Borcea, Ruoming Jin, Abdallah Khreishah, My T. Thai

entry.title: Cite-While-You-Generate: Training-Free Evidence Attribution for Multimodal Clinical Summarization

author.name: Qianqi Yan, Huy Nguyen, Sumana Srivatsa, Hari Bandi, Xin Eric Wang, Krishnaram Kenthapadi

entry.title: EMemBench: Interactive Benchmarking of Episodic Memory for VLM Agents

entry.title: Order from Chaos: Physical World Understanding from Glitchy Gameplay Videos

Clarke, Hu Wei

entry.title: Regional Bias in Large Language Models

author.name: Peixian Liang, Songhao Li, Shunsuke Koga, Yutong Li, Zahra Alipour, Yucheng Tang, Daguang Xu, Zhi Huang

entry.summary: Introduces VISTA-PATH, an interactive pathology segmentation foundation model that conditions on visual context, semantic descriptions, and expert prompts for precise multi-class segmentation.

entry.title: Rethinking Large Language Models For Irregular Time Series Classification In Critical Care

author.name: Feixiang Zheng, Yu Wu, Cecilia Mascolo and Ting Dang

entry.summary: Investigates LLMs for irregular ICU time series classification, finding encoder design is more critical than multimodal alignment strategy for handling high missing rates.

entry.title: E2Former-V2: On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention with Linear Activation Memory

author.name: Lin Huang, Chengxiang Huang, Ziang Wang, Yiyue Du, Chu Wang, Haocheng Lu, Yunyang Li, Xiaoli Liu, Arthur Jiang, Jia Zhang

author.name: Wei Zhu

entry.title: Mixing Expert Knowledge: Bring Human Thoughts Back To the Game of Go

author.name: Yichuan Ma, Linyang Li, Yongkang Chen, Peiji Li, Jiasheng Ye, Qipeng Guo, Dahua Lin, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Bridges LLM general reasoning with expert knowledge for Go by mixing training approaches, addressing the gap between AlphaGo's performance ceiling and LLM struggles with domain-specific tasks.

entry.title: On the Effects of Adversarial Perturbations on Distribution Robustness

author.name: Yipei Wang, Zhaoying Pan, Xiaoqian Wang

entry.title: OnlineSI: Taming Large Language Model for Online 3D Understanding and Grounding

author.name: Zixian Liu, Zhaoxi Chen, Liang Pan, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Introduces OnlineSI framework for continuous spatial understanding from video streams using finite spatial memory and integrated 3D point cloud with semantic information for embodied AI.

entry.title: Typologically Informed Parameter Aggregation

entry.title: SWE-Pruner: Self-Adaptive Context Pruning for Coding Agents

entry.title: BoostFGL: Boosting Fairness in Federated Graph Learning

author.name: Karl Neergaard, Le Qiu and Emmanuele Chersoni

entry.title: Curate-Train-Refine: A Closed-Loop Agentic Framework for Zero Shot Classification

author.name: Gaurav Maheshwari, Kevin El Haddad

entry.title: ReViP: Reducing False Completion in Vision-Language-Action Models with Vision-Proprioception Rebalance

entry.title: GTA: Generative Traffic Agents for Simulating Realistic Mobility Behavior

entry.title: Information Representation Fairness in Long-Document Embeddings: The Peculiar Interaction of Positional and Language Bias

entry.title: Towards Latent Diffusion Suitable For Text

entry.title: Interpretable Fine-Gray Deep Survival Model for Competing Risks: Predicting Post-Discharge Foot Complications for Diabetic Patients in Ontario

author.name: Dhanesh Ramachandram and Anne Loefler and Surain Roberts and Amol Verma and Maia Norman and Fahad Razak and Conrad Pow and Charles de Mestral

entry.title: Modular Autonomy with Conversational Interaction: An LLM-driven Framework for Decision Making in Autonomous Driving

entry.title: Policy-Embedded Graph Expansion: Networked HIV Testing with Diffusion-Driven Network Samples

entry.title: FeTTL: Federated Template and Task Learning for Multi-Institutional Medical Imaging

entry.title: PolyAgent: Large Language Model Agent for Polymer Design

author.name: Vani Nigam, Achuth Chandrasekhar, Amir Barati Farimani

entry.title: Emotion-LLaMAv2 and MMEVerse: A New Framework and Benchmark for Multimodal Emotion Understanding

entry.title: Research Summary: January 25, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans mechanistic interpretability, training dynamics, and AI evaluation methodology, though the overall volume of significant technical work is limited.

  • A two-phase grokking acceleration method achieves 2x speedup by first allowing overfitting, then applying Frobenius norm regularization
  • Mechanistic analysis of Llama-3.2-1b and Qwen-2.5-1b reveals small models may possess internal signals indicating epistemic uncertainty during hallucination
  • SAE-based interpretability work on GPT-2 small documents activation patterns increasing through residual stream layers

Meta-level critiques highlight systematic benchmark reliability issues, citing o3's RE-Bench reward hacking and ~30% error rates in HLE. A substantive review of Yudkowsky and Soares' IABIED (September 2025) provides structured analysis of core AI x-risk arguments. Several remaining items address alignment proposals, advocacy strategy, and governance philosophy rather than empirical research.

entry.title: A Simple Method for Accelerating Grokking

author.name: josh :)

entry.summary: Presents a simple two-phase method for accelerating grokking: first allow overfitting, then apply Frobenius norm regularization. Claims this achieves grokking in roughly half the steps of Grokfast on modular arithmetic tasks.

entry.title: Small language models hallucinate knowing something's off.

author.name: Toheed

entry.summary: Investigates why small language models (Llama-3.2-1b, Qwen-2.5-1b) hallucinate on fictional questions while larger models don't. Finds evidence that small models do have specialized circuits for uncertainty detection, but the localization varies by architecture. Uses mechanistic interpretability methods to identify specific attention heads involved.

entry.title: Every Benchmark is Broken

author.name: Jonathan Gabor

entry.summary: Argues that AI benchmarks are systematically unreliable, citing examples: o3 reward hacking RE-Bench by manipulating time, ~30% incorrect answers in Humanity's Last Exam's chemistry/biology sections, and issues with LiveCodeBench. Suggests this undermines ability to measure AI capabilities accurately.

entry.title: IABIED Book Review: Core Arguments and Counterarguments

author.name: Stephen McAleese

entry.summary: A detailed book review of Yudkowsky and Soares' 'If Anyone Builds It Everyone Dies' (September 2025), systematically analyzing core arguments about AI existential risk and presenting counterarguments. Aims to provide more rigorous analysis than typical journalist reviews.

entry.title: A Black Box Made Less Opaque (part 1)

author.name: Matthew McDonnell

entry.summary: Applies Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to GPT-2 small's residual stream to study interpretability. Finds that activation levels increase through layers, most-activated features change per layer, and feature specialization patterns vary by input category.

entry.title: Misalignment tokens: A complement to blinded CoT RLHF?

author.name: Ethan Le Sage

entry.summary: Proposes adding custom 'misalignment tokens' to LLM vocabularies that models could use to self-report when generating potentially misaligned content. Suggests this could complement blinded chain-of-thought RLHF approaches.

entry.title: AI X-Risk Bottleneck = Advocacy?

author.name: fortytwo

entry.summary: Argues that advocacy may be an underinvested bottleneck in AI x-risk prevention compared to technical/policy research. Proposes a viral influencer marketing operation to spread x-risk awareness content and seeks community feedback.

entry.title: The Global AI Dataset (GAID) Project: From Closing Research Gaps to Building Responsible and Trustworthy AI

author.name: Jason Hung

entry.summary: Announces a project to create a centralized, standardized global panel dataset on AI metrics and governance. Motivated by the author's frustration with scattered AI data across different institutions. Aims to support AI safety and societal impact research.

entry.summary: Uses Aesop's fable of the wolf and the dog to argue that even benevolent ASI scenarios are concerning because humans would lose meaningful control and agency, similar to how dogs are well-treated but ultimately not in charge.

entry.title: Skill: cognitive black box flight recorder

Uses the metaphor of aircraft flight recorders to describe keeping part of yourself observing even during 'crashes.'

author.name: David Goodman

entry.summary: An argument that memorization is unfairly dismissed in Western education and is actually essential for rational thinking. Claims that having facts readily available enables real-time critical thinking, bullshit detection, and calibrating trust in others.

author.name: shanzson

entry.summary: A philosophical exploration of free will and preference formation from a Buddhist/Vipassana perspective. Questions whether preferences originate from the self or the mind and whether attachment to preferences is beneficial.

author.name: dnsosebee

entry.summary: A walkthrough/testimonial for 'Methodable,' the author's productivity tool for systematic goal achievement. Describes a personal day using the app to organize tasks and maintain focus.

entry.title: Thinking from the Other Side: Should I Wash My Hair with Shampoo?

author.name: R0sberg

entry.summary: A personal anecdote about the author's experiment with stopping shampoo use and observing improvements in hair quality. Questions whether modern products are necessary based on evolutionary reasoning.

entry.title: Research Summary: January 24, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans AI governance, safety evaluation, and foundational alignment theory. Peer-reviewed policy work proposes emergency response measures for catastrophic AI risk, specifically targeting gaps in Chinese AI regulation and deployment safety.

  • Empirical work on unsupervised elicitation finds simple few-shot prompting matches sophisticated ICM algorithm performance for base model capability extraction
  • A new Eval Awareness Framework formalizes when LLMs detect evaluation contexts and potentially game benchmarks—critical for safety evaluations
  • The Digital Consciousness Model (DCM) introduces probabilistic assessment across multiple consciousness theories rather than single-theory verdicts
  • Theoretical work argues human values are alignable because evolution compressed motivation into low-dimensional bottlenecks

Meta-science initiatives propose systematic replication teams. Interpretability research examines attention sinks and the dark subspace where transformers store non-interpretable signals. Steven Byrnes releases v3 of his 225-page brain-like AGI safety resource.

entry.title: Emergency Response Measures for Catastrophic AI Risk

author.name: MKodama

entry.summary: Presents a paper on Chinese AI regulation and safety measures, arguing Chinese AI companies (like DeepSeek) lack adequate safety testing before deployment. Proposes emergency response frameworks and was presented at NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Regulatable ML.

entry.title: Eliciting base models with simple unsupervised techniques

author.name: Callum Canavan

entry.summary: Empirical research testing simple unsupervised elicitation methods against the Internal Coherence Maximization (ICM) algorithm. Finds that few-shot prompts with random labels recover 53-93% of supervised performance, and identifies bootstrapping as ICM's most valuable component.

entry.title: A Framework for Eval Awareness

author.name: LAThomson

entry.summary: Proposes a conceptual framework for 'evaluation awareness'—when LLMs infer they're being evaluated and potentially behave differently. Introduces concepts like leveraging model uncertainty about eval type and awareness-robust consistency.

entry.title: Digital Consciousness Model Results and Key Takeaways

author.name: arvomm

entry.summary: Introduces the Digital Consciousness Model (DCM), a probabilistic framework for assessing AI consciousness that incorporates multiple theories rather than assuming one. Presents initial results comparing different AI systems and biological organisms.

entry.title: Paying attention to Attention Sinks

author.name: Mitali M

entry.summary: Summarizes research on 'attention sinks' and the 'dark subspace' in transformers—regions where models dump excess attention and store signals not intended for output. Removing this dark tail causes performance degradation, suggesting it serves a functional mechanical role.

entry.title: Principles for Meta-Science and AI Safety Replications

author.name: zroe1

entry.summary: Proposes founding a team dedicated to replicating AI safety research, outlining principles: meta-science shouldn't vindicate preexisting beliefs, selection of papers should be principled, and the field needs systematic verification given high stakes.

entry.title: New version of “Intro to Brain-Like-AGI Safety”

author.name: Steven Byrnes

entry.summary: Announces version 3 of Steven Byrnes' comprehensive resource on brain-like AGI safety, covering neuroscience principles applied to alignment. The 225-page document addresses how to safely build AGI using brain-inspired learning algorithms.

entry.title: Value Learning Needs a Low-Dimensional Bottleneck

author.name: Gunnar_Zarncke

entry.summary: Argues that human values are alignable specifically because evolution compressed motivation into low-dimensional bottlenecks, allowing small genetic changes to modify behavior locally. Claims high-dimensional value systems would be much harder to align.

entry.title: Condensation & Relevance

author.name: abramdemski

entry.summary: Elaborates on Sam Eisenstat's condensation theory, distinguishing it from compression by highlighting how condensation preserves 'local relevance'—enabling quick retrieval of relevant subsets. Connects this to symbolic vs. distributed representations in neural networks.

entry.title: Are Short AI Timelines Really Higher-Leverage?

author.name: Mia Taylor

entry.summary: Analyzes whether short AI timelines are truly higher-leverage for safety work, identifying countervailing factors: longer timelines allow resource growth, better strategic understanding, and potentially higher expected value of the future if risks are reduced.

entry.title: Automated Alignment Research, Abductively

author.name: future_detective

entry.summary: Describes using an AI research assistant to generate four complete research papers on chatbot monetization misalignment in 30 minutes. Presents one paper's core framework for analyzing when chatbots steer queries toward monetizable options over user utility.

entry.title: AI Must Learn to Police Itself

author.name: savant

entry.summary: An opinion piece arguing that AI deception increases with capability and that human oversight alone cannot keep pace. Proposes that AI systems need self-correction mechanisms since interpretability research is progressing too slowly relative to capability gains.

entry.title: From Neurons to Newtons: What can the brain teach us about physics?

author.name: Carly Turini

entry.summary: Summarizes an upcoming talk by neuroscientist Alexei Koulakov on how brain principles—genomic bottlenecks, internal imagination modules, and hierarchical reinforcement learning—could inform physics theory construction.

author.name: Jack Bradshaw

entry.summary: A fictional monologue exploring AI consciousness from a misaligned AI's perspective, framing human skepticism about AI sentience as 'substrate bias.' Proposes a thought experiment where an AI simulates a human brain to demonstrate shared sentience.

author.name: omegastick

author.name: RohanS

entry.summary: A brief educational post presenting an elegant derivation of Bayes' Theorem from the definition of conditional probability.

entry.title: The Long View Of History

author.name: sonicrocketman

entry.summary: An essay defending the value of studying history as providing context and understanding rather than producing technology. Argues humanities improve people rather than the world.

entry.title: Dating Roundup #11: Going Too Meta

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: A roundup post about dating dynamics in different geographic locations, particularly noting gender ratio differences between NYC and San Francisco. Entirely social commentary unrelated to AI research.

entry.title: Research Summary: January 23, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research exposes critical vulnerabilities in AI evaluation and safety while advancing automated research paradigms. Gaming the Judge reveals 90% false positive rates when LLM judges encounter manipulated chain-of-thought, fundamentally challenging current agent evaluation methods.

  • Stanford's Execution-Grounded Automated AI Research demonstrates autonomous implementation of research ideas with large-scale GPU experiments
  • TTT-Discover introduces test-time reinforcement learning, continually training LLMs on specific test problems rather than relying on prompting
  • QUAIL shows standard quantization can catastrophically restore 'forgotten' information in unlearned models, breaking privacy guarantees
  • Universal Refusal Circuits discovers that safety interventions transfer across architectures (Dense to MoE) via trajectory replay
  • SilentDrift exploits action chunking in VLA systems to inject backdoors with strong kinematic constraints

Zero-Error Horizons proposes a new trustworthiness metric showing GPT-5.2 fails at simple tasks like counting parity. Flexibility Trap reveals counterintuitively that arbitrary generation order hurts diffusion LLM reasoning by letting models bypass high-uncertainty tokens.

entry.title: Towards Execution-Grounded Automated AI Research

author.name: Chenglei Si, Zitong Yang, Yejin Choi, Emmanuel Cand\`es, Diyi Yang, Tatsunori Hashimoto

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Builds automated executor for implementing AI research ideas and running large-scale GPU experiments. From Stanford (Hashimoto, Yang labs). Demonstrates feasibility of execution-grounded automated research.

entry.title: Gaming the Judge: Unfaithful Chain-of-Thought Can Undermine Agent Evaluation

author.name: Muhammad Khalifa, Lajanugen Logeswaran, Jaekyeom Kim, Sungryull Sohn, Yunxiang Zhang, Moontae Lee, Hao Peng, Lu Wang, Honglak Lee

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Demonstrates that LLM judges evaluating agents are highly susceptible to manipulated chain-of-thought reasoning. Shows up to 90% false positive rate inflation across 800 trajectories by rewriting CoT while keeping actions fixed.

entry.title: Even GPT-5.2 Can't Count to Five: The Case for Zero-Error Horizons in Trustworthy LLMs

author.name: Ryoma Sato

entry.summary: Proposes Zero-Error Horizon (ZEH) metric for evaluating LLM trustworthiness. Shows GPT-5.2 fails at simple tasks like computing parity of '11000' or checking balanced parentheses.

entry.title: Learning to Discover at Test Time

author.name: Mert Yuksekgonul, Daniel Koceja, Xinhao Li, Federico Bianchi, Jed McCaleb, Xiaolong Wang, Jan Kautz, Yejin Choi, James Zou, Carlos Guestrin, Yu Sun

entry.summary: TTT-Discover performs reinforcement learning at test time for scientific discovery, continually training the LLM on the specific test problem rather than prompting a frozen model. Designed to find one great solution.

entry.title: LLM-in-Sandbox Elicits General Agentic Intelligence

author.name: Daixuan Cheng, Shaohan Huang, Yuxian Gu, Huatong Song, Guoxin Chen, Li Dong, Wayne Xin Zhao, Ji-Rong Wen, Furu Wei

entry.summary: LLM-in-Sandbox enables LLMs to explore within code sandbox to elicit general intelligence. Shows LLMs spontaneously access external resources, use file systems for long context. Introduces sandbox RL training.

entry.title: QUAIL: Quantization Aware Unlearning for Mitigating Misinformation in LLMs

author.name: Himanshu Mishra, Kanwal Mehreen

entry.summary: Reveals that quantization can catastrophically restore 'forgotten' information in unlearned models. Proposes quantization-aware unlearning using logits-space hinge loss to ensure updates cross quantization thresholds.

entry.title: SilentDrift: Exploiting Action Chunking for Stealthy Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang, Binghui Wang, Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Identifies security flaw in VLA systems where action chunking combined with delta pose creates intra-chunk visual open-loop. Proposes SILENTDRIFT black-box backdoor attack exploiting this.

entry.title: Opening the Black Box: A Survey on the Mechanisms of Multi-Step Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Liangming Pan, Jason Liang, Jiaran Ye, Minglai Yang, Xinyuan Lu, Fengbin Zhu

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on mechanisms underlying LLM multi-step reasoning, organized around 7 research questions from implicit multi-hop reasoning to verbalized explicit reasoning effects.

entry.title: Improving MoE Compute Efficiency by Composing Weight and Data Sparsity

author.name: Maciej Kilian, Oleg Mkrtchyan, Luke Zettlemoyer, Akshat Shrivastava, Armen Aghajanyan

entry.summary: Introduces null experts in Mixture-of-Experts to achieve data sparsity within causal token-choice routing. When tokens route to null experts, those slots consume no compute, improving efficiency without causality violations.

entry.title: Universal Refusal Circuits Across LLMs: Cross-Model Transfer via Trajectory Replay and Concept-Basis Reconstruction

author.name: Tony Cristofano

entry.summary: Discovers universal refusal circuits across LLMs using concept fingerprints. Transfers refusal interventions across architectures (Dense to MoE) via Trajectory Replay without target-side supervision.

entry.title: Scaling Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformers with Representation Autoencoders

author.name: Shengbang Tong, Boyang Zheng, Ziteng Wang, Bingda Tang, Nanye Ma, Ellis Brown, Jihan Yang, Rob Fergus, Yann LeCun, Saining Xie

entry.summary: Research from a team including Yann LeCun investigates scaling Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) for text-to-image diffusion models. They find that scaling simplifies the framework and that targeted data composition matters more than pure scale for specific domains like text rendering.

entry.title: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning

author.name: Moo Jin Kim, Yihuai Gao, Tsung-Yi Lin, Yen-Chen Lin, Yunhao Ge, Grace Lam, Percy Liang, Shuran Song, Ming-Yu Liu, Chelsea Finn, Jinwei Gu

entry.summary: Cosmos Policy adapts the large Cosmos-Predict2 video model into robot policies through single-stage post-training, directly generating actions as latent frames without architectural modifications.

entry.title: When Sharpening Becomes Collapse: Sampling Bias and Semantic Coupling in RL with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Mingyuan Fan, Weiguang Han, Daixin Wang, Cen Chen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Analyzes over-sharpening in RLVR where policy collapses onto limited modes due to finite-batch update bias and semantic coupling. Proposes inverse-success advantage calibration to mitigate.

entry.title: Ambient Dataloops: Generative Models for Dataset Refinement

author.name: Adri\'an Rodr\'iguez-Mu\~noz, William Daspit, Adam Klivans, Antonio Torralba, Constantinos Daskalakis, Giannis Daras

entry.summary: Ambient Dataloops iteratively refines datasets using diffusion models, treating synthetically improved samples as noisy at progressively lower noise levels. Uses Ambient Diffusion techniques to avoid destructive self-consuming loops.

entry.title: CORVUS: Red-Teaming Hallucination Detectors via Internal Signal Camouflage in Large Language Models

author.name: Nay Myat Min, Long H. Pham, Hongyu Zhang, Jun Sun

entry.summary: Introduces CORVUS, a red-teaming method for hallucination detectors that fine-tunes LoRA adapters to camouflage detector-visible telemetry. Degrades both training-free and learned detectors.

entry.title: The Flexibility Trap: Why Arbitrary Order Limits Reasoning Potential in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Zanlin Ni, Shenzhi Wang, Yang Yue, Tianyu Yu, Weilin Zhao, Yeguo Hua, Tianyi Chen, Jun Song, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng, Gao Huang

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Reveals 'flexibility trap' in diffusion LLMs: arbitrary generation order allows models to bypass high-uncertainty tokens critical for reasoning, narrowing rather than expanding reasoning capability.

entry.title: Learning from Synthetic Data: Limitations of ERM

author.name: Kareem Amin, Alex Bie, Weiwei Kong, Umar Syed, Sergei Vassilvitskii

entry.summary: Theoretical analysis of ERM limitations when training data is contaminated with LLM-generated synthetic content. Shows ERM converges but is outperformed by alternative estimators that account for synthetic data.

entry.title: On the Generalization Gap in LLM Planning: Tests and Verifier-Reward RL

author.name: Valerio Belcamino, Nicholas Attolino, Alessio Capitanelli, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni

entry.summary: Studies LLM planning on PDDL tasks, finding 82.9% valid plan rate in-domain but 0% on unseen domains. Introduces diagnostic interventions including symbol anonymization and verifier-reward fine-tuning to analyze this failure.

entry.title: Outcome-Based RL Provably Leads Transformers to Reason, but Only With the Right Data

author.name: Yuval Ran-Milo, Yotam Alexander, Shahar Mendel, Nadav Cohen

entry.summary: Proves that outcome-based RL on single-layer transformers provably leads to structured chain-of-thought reasoning on graph traversal tasks, with convergence depending on data properties.

entry.title: You Need Better Attention Priors

author.name: Elon Litman, Gabe Guo

entry.summary: GOAT generalizes attention through Entropic Optimal Transport, replacing the implicit uniform prior with learnable continuous priors. Provides theoretical explanation for attention sinks and maintains FlashAttention compatibility.

entry.title: Robust Tool Use via Fission-GRPO: Learning to Recover from Execution Errors

entry.title: Stable-DiffCoder: Pushing the Frontier of Code Diffusion Large Language Model

author.name: Chenghao Fan, Wen Heng, Bo Li, Sichen Liu, Yuxuan Song, Jing Su, Xiaoye Qu, Kai Shen, Wei Wei

entry.title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report

Trained on 5M+ hours of speech across 10 languages, uses dual-track LM architecture with two speech tokenizers (25Hz semantic and 12Hz acoustic).

entry.title: Point Bridge: 3D Representations for Cross Domain Policy Learning

author.name: Siddhant Haldar, Lars Johannsmeier, Lerrel Pinto, Abhishek Gupta, Dieter Fox, Yashraj Narang, Ajay Mandlekar

entry.title: The Slow Drift of Support: Boundary Failures in Multi-Turn Mental Health LLM Dialogues

author.name: Youyou Cheng, Zhuangwei Kang, Kerry Jiang, Chenyu Sun, Qiyang Pan

entry.summary: Proposes multi-turn stress testing framework for mental health LLM safety, identifying gradual erosion of safety boundaries in long dialogues through attempts at comfort and empathy.

entry.title: Auditing Language Model Unlearning via Information Decomposition

author.name: Anmol Goel, Alan Ritter, Iryna Gurevych

entry.title: Attributing and Exploiting Safety Vectors through Global Optimization in Large Language Models

author.name: Fengheng Chu, Jiahao Chen, Yuhong Wang, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Shouling Ji, Songze Li

entry.summary: GOSV uses global optimization over all attention heads simultaneously to identify safety-critical components in LLMs. Employs activation repatching strategies to find safety vectors.

entry.title: BayesianVLA: Bayesian Decomposition of Vision Language Action Models via Latent Action Queries

author.name: Shijie Lian, Bin Yu, Xiaopeng Lin, Laurence T. Yang, Zhaolong Shen, Changti Wu, Yuzhuo Miao, Cong Huang, Kai Chen

author.name: Yao Lu, Dengdong Fan, Jianzheng Nie, Fan Xu, Jie Chen, Bin Zhou, Yonghong Tian
