entry.title: LR-DWM: Efficient Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Ofek Raban, Ethan Fetaya, Gal Chechik

entry.summary: LR-DWM introduces efficient watermarking for Diffusion Language Models, addressing the challenge that existing AR-focused watermarking methods don't work for iterative denoising generation.

entry.title: ChartAttack: Testing the Vulnerability of LLMs to Malicious Prompting in Chart Generation

author.name: Jesus-German Ortiz-Barajas, Jonathan Tonglet, Vivek Gupta, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: ChartAttack framework evaluates how MLLMs can be misused to generate misleading charts at scale by injecting misleaders into chart designs.

entry.title: Medical Triage as Pairwise Ranking: A Benchmark for Urgency in Patient Portal Messages

author.name: Joseph Gatto, Parker Seegmiller, Timothy Burdick, Philip Resnik, Roshnik Rahat, Sarah DeLozier, Sarah M. Preum

entry.summary: PMR-Bench introduces medical triage as pairwise ranking, training LLMs to choose which patient portal message is more medically urgent. Novel task formulation with 1569 messages.

entry.title: HyperWalker: Dynamic Hypergraph-Based Deep Diagnosis for Multi-Hop Clinical Modeling across EHR and X-Ray in Medical VLMs

author.name: Yuezhe Yang, Hao Wang, Yige Peng, Jinman Kim, Lei Bi

entry.summary: HyperWalker uses dynamic hypergraph construction for multi-hop clinical reasoning across EHR and X-ray data, enabling cross-patient example retrieval for diagnosis.

entry.title: S^2F-Net:A Robust Spatial-Spectral Fusion Framework for Cross-Model AIGC Detection

author.name: Xiangyu Hu, Yicheng Hong, Hongchuang Zheng, Wenjun Zeng, Bingyao Liu

entry.summary: Introduces S²F-Net for detecting AI-generated content by leveraging spatial-spectral fusion, focusing on frequency-domain fingerprints left by upsampling operations in generative models for cross-model generalization.

entry.title: PhaseMark: A Post-hoc, Optimization-Free Watermarking of AI-generated Images in the Latent Frequency Domain

author.name: Sung Ju Lee, Nam Ik Cho

entry.summary: Introduces PhaseMark, a single-shot watermarking method for AI-generated images that directly modulates phase in VAE latent frequency domain, achieving 1000x speedup over optimization-based methods.

entry.title: Spherical Geometry Diffusion: Generating High-quality 3D Face Geometry via Sphere-anchored Representations

entry.title: DExTeR: Weakly Semi-Supervised Object Detection with Class and Instance Experts for Medical Imaging

author.name: Adrien Meyer, Didier Mutter, Nicolas Padoy

entry.summary: Proposes DExTeR for weakly semi-supervised medical object detection using point annotations, introducing class and instance expert mechanisms to handle overlapping anatomy and variable object sizes.

entry.title: VENI: Variational Encoder for Natural Illumination

author.name: Paul Walker, James A. D. Gardner, Andreea Ardelean, William A. P. Smith, Bernhard Egger

entry.title: OpenNavMap: Structure-Free Topometric Mapping via Large-Scale Collaborative Localization

author.name: Jianhao Jiao, Changkun Liu, Jingwen Yu, Boyi Liu, Qianyi Zhang, Yue Wang, Dimitrios Kanoulas

entry.summary: Proposes OpenNavMap, structure-free topometric system for large-scale visual navigation using 3D geometric foundation models for on-demand reconstruction, avoiding traditional structure-based maintenance costs.

entry.title: No instrumental convergence without AI psychology

author.name: TurnTrout

entry.summary: TurnTrout argues that claims about instrumental convergence being independent of AI psychology are incorrect - predicting AI behavior necessarily requires assumptions about how AI selects plans.

entry.title: Risk-Aware Human-in-the-Loop Framework with Adaptive Intrusion Response for Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Dawood Wasif, Terrence J. Moore, Seunghyun Yoon, Hyuk Lim, Dan Dongseong Kim, Frederica F. Nelson, Jin-Hee Cho

entry.title: Are LLMs Ready for TOON? Benchmarking Structural Correctness-Sustainability Trade-offs in Novel Structured Output Formats

author.name: Elio Masciari, Vincenzo Moscato, Enea Vincenzo Napolitano, Gian Marco Orlando, Marco Perillo, Diego Russo

entry.summary: Introduces sustainability-aware evaluation for LLM structured outputs measuring token usage, generation time, and carbon emissions. Proposes GCS_env score and evaluates novel TOON format.

entry.title: Improving Large Molecular Language Model via Relation-aware Multimodal Collaboration

author.name: Jinyoung Park, Minseong Bae, Jeehye Na, Hyunwoo J. Kim

entry.title: Docs2Synth: A Synthetic Data Trained Retriever Framework for Scanned Visually Rich Documents Understanding

author.name: Yihao Ding, Qiang Sun, Puzhen Wu, Sirui Li, Siwen Luo, Wei Liu

entry.summary: Docs2Synth enables retrieval-guided inference for scanned documents in regulated domains using synthetic supervision, addressing lack of annotations and hallucination in MLLMs.

entry.title: STEP-LLM: Generating CAD STEP Models from Natural Language with Large Language Models

author.name: Xiangyu Shi, Junyang Ding, Xu Zhao, Sinong Zhan, Payal Mohapatra, Daniel Quispe, Kojo Welbeck, Jian Cao, Wei Chen, Ping Guo, Qi Zhu

entry.summary: STEP-LLM generates CAD STEP files directly from natural language, addressing the challenge of auto-regressive generation for graph-structured, cross-referenced formats used in manufacturing.

entry.title: Vision Language Models for Optimization-Driven Intent Processing in Autonomous Networks

author.name: Tasnim Ahmed, Yifan Zhu, Salimur Choudhury

entry.summary: IntentOpt benchmark tests whether VLMs can process annotated network diagrams into optimization code for traffic engineering and resource allocation, with 85 prompts across 50 object pairs.

entry.title: Explicit Cognitive Allocation: A Principle for Governed and Auditable Inference in Large Language Models

author.name: H\'ector Manuel Manzanilla-Granados, Zaira Navarrete-Cazales, Miriam Pescador-Rojas, Tonahtiu Ram\'irez-Romero

entry.summary: Proposes Explicit Cognitive Allocation principle separating epistemic functions (framing, exploration, retrieval, methodology, explanation) in AI-assisted inference. Instantiated in Cognitive Architecture.

entry.title: Towards Efficient and Robust Linguistic Emotion Diagnosis for Mental Health via Multi-Agent Instruction Refinement

author.name: Jian Zhang, Zhangqi Wang, Zhiyuan Wang, Weiping Fu, Yu He, Haiping Zhu, Qika Lin, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Multi-agent instruction refinement for linguistic emotion diagnosis in mental health contexts. Addresses emotional comorbidity and inefficient exploration of clinical cues.

Clifton (Department of Engineering Science, University of Oxford, Oxford, UK, Oxford Suzhou Centre for Advanced Research, University of Oxford, Suzhou, Jiangsu, China), Luciano Del Corro (ELIAS Lab, Departamento de Ingenier\'ia, Universidad de San Andr\'es, Victoria, Argentina, Lumina Labs, Buenos Aires, Argentina), Marinka Zitnik (Department of Biomedical Informatics, Harvard Medical School, Boston, MA, USA, Kempner Institute for the Study of Natural and Artificial Intelligence, Allston, MA, USA, Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, Cambridge, MA, USA, Harvard Data Science Initiative, Cambridge, MA, USA)

entry.summary: Introduces ARK, an agentic knowledge graph retriever that gives LLMs control over breadth-depth tradeoffs using global lexical search and neighborhood exploration tools. From Harvard/Oxford researchers.

entry.title: Mixture-of-Experts as Soft Clustering: A Dual Jacobian-PCA Spectral Geometry Perspective

author.name: Feilong Liu

entry.summary: Interprets MoE architectures through geometric lens as soft partitioning, using Jacobian-PCA spectral analysis to characterize local function geometry under different routing strategies.

entry.title: WISP: Waste- and Interference-Suppressed Distributed Speculative LLM Serving at the Edge via Dynamic Drafting and SLO-Aware Batching

author.name: Xiangchen Li, Jiakun Fan, Qingyuan Wang, Dimitrios Spatharakis, Saeid Ghafouri, Hans Vandierendonck, Deepu John, Bo Ji, Ali R. Butt, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos

entry.summary: Introduces WISP for distributed speculative LLM serving, combining dynamic draft length adjustment with SLO-aware batching to optimize edge-cloud inference.

entry.title: Human-Human-AI Triadic Programming: Uncovering the Role of AI Agent and the Value of Human Partner in Collaborative Learning

author.name: Taufiq Daryanto, Xiaohan Ding, Kaike Ping, Lance T. Wilhelm, Yan Chen, Chris Brown, Eugenia H. Rho

entry.summary: Within-subjects study of human-human-AI triadic programming shows AI as additional collaborator enhances collaborative learning and social presence compared to dyadic human-AI baseline.

entry.title: Multimodal Generative Engine Optimization: Rank Manipulation for Vision-Language Model Rankers

author.name: Yixuan Du, Chenxiao Yu, Haoyan Xu, Ziyi Wang, Yue Zhao, Xiyang Hu

entry.summary: MGEO adversarial framework demonstrates VLM-based product search vulnerability through joint optimization of imperceptible image perturbations and textual suffixes for rank manipulation.

entry.title: Beyond the Dirac Delta: Mitigating Diversity Collapse in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Versatile Image Generation

author.name: Jinmei Liu, Haoru Li, Zhenhong Sun, Chaofeng Chen, Yatao Bian, Bo Wang, Daoyi Dong, Chunlin Chen, Zhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DRIFT, a framework addressing diversity collapse in reinforcement learning fine-tuning of diffusion models. Systematically incentivizes output diversity while maintaining task alignment during on-policy fine-tuning.

entry.title: SciCoQA: Quality Assurance for Scientific Paper--Code Alignment

author.name: Tim Baumg\"artner, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Presents SciCoQA, a dataset for detecting discrepancies between scientific papers and codebases using GitHub issues, reproducibility papers, and synthetic generation. Covers diverse computational science domains.

entry.title: AI Skills Improve Job Prospects: Causal Evidence from a Hiring Experiment

author.name: Fabian Stephany, Ole Teutloff, Angelo Leone

entry.summary: Experimental study with 1,700 recruiters showing AI skills significantly increase interview invitation rates and can offset disadvantages like older age or lower education across three occupations.

entry.title: Preconditioning Benefits of Spectral Orthogonalization in Muon

author.name: Jianhao Ma, Yu Huang, Yuejie Chi, Yuxin Chen

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of Muon optimizer's spectral orthogonalization through matrix factorization and linear transformer case studies. Proves condition-number-independent convergence.

entry.title: MASCOT: Towards Multi-Agent Socio-Collaborative Companion Systems

author.name: Yiyang Wang, Yiqiao Jin, Alex Cabral, Josiah Hester

entry.summary: MASCOT introduces a multi-agent framework for socio-collaborative companions addressing persona collapse and social sycophancy through bi-level optimization with persona-aware and collaborative optimization.

entry.title: Extreme Value Policy Optimization for Safe Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shiqing Gao, Yihang Zhou, Shuai Shao, Haoyu Luo, Yiheng Bing, Jiaxin Ding, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang

entry.summary: EVO leverages Extreme Value Theory for safe RL, modeling and exploiting extreme reward and cost samples to explicitly capture tail distribution risks and reduce constraint violations.

entry.title: PaperGuide: Making Small Language-Model Paper-Reading Agents More Efficient

author.name: Zijian Wang, Tiancheng Huang, Hanqi Li, Da Ma, Lu Chen, Kai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes PaperCompass framework for small language model paper-reading agents, separating high-level planning from fine-grained execution. Mitigates excessive low-yield exploration in existing approaches.

entry.title: Evaluating Contextually Mediated Factual Recall in Multilingual Large Language Models

author.name: Yihong Liu, Bingyu Xiong, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Studies contextually mediated factual recall where target entities are introduced indirectly rather than explicitly named. Finds LLMs struggle with referential mediation across languages.

entry.title: Agentic Conversational Search with Contextualized Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Fengran Mo, Yifan Gao, Sha Li, Hansi Zeng, Xin Liu, Zhaoxuan Tan, Xian Li, Jianshu Chen, Dakuo Wang, Meng Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes agentic conversational search with RL-based reasoning for dynamic query reformulation and action optimization in multi-turn dialogues.

entry.title: Anonpsy: A Graph-Based Framework for Structure-Preserving De-identification of Psychiatric Narratives

author.name: Kyung Ho Lim, Byung-Hoon Kim

entry.summary: Anonpsy reformulates psychiatric narrative de-identification as graph-guided semantic rewriting, preserving clinical structure while modifying identifying context.

entry.title: Dimension-First Evaluation of Speech-to-Speech Models with Structured Acoustic Cues

author.name: Arjun Chandra, Kevin Miller, Venkatesh Ravichandran, Constantinos Papayiannis, Venkatesh Saligrama

entry.summary: TRACE framework enables LLM judges to evaluate speech-to-speech systems by reasoning over structured audio cues, separating content, voice quality, and paralinguistics dimensions.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning with Verifiable Fairness Guarantees

author.name: Mohammed Himayath Ali, Mohammed Aqib Abdullah, Syed Muneer Hussin, Mohammed Mudassir Uddin, Shahnawaz Alam

entry.summary: CryptoFair-FL combines homomorphic encryption with secure multi-party computation to enable privacy-preserving verification of demographic parity and equalized odds in federated learning without revealing protected attributes.

entry.title: Evaluating Self-Correcting Vision Agents Through Quantitative and Qualitative Metrics

author.name: Aradhya Dixit

entry.summary: Diagnostic micro-benchmark for Vision-Language Agents that decouples Task Success Rate from Correction Success Rate, finding initial competence doesn't predict repair ability and correction saturates after 3 retries.

entry.title: DAOS: A Multimodal In-cabin Behavior Monitoring with Driver Action-Object Synergy Dataset

author.name: Yiming Li, Chen Cai, Tianyi Liu, Dan Lin, Wenqian Wang, Wenfei Liang, Bingbing Li, Kim-Hui Yap

entry.summary: DAOS dataset with 9,787 video clips annotated with 36 driver actions and 15 object classes (2.5M+ object instances) to enable action-object synergy understanding for driver monitoring.

entry.title: VILTA: A VLM-in-the-Loop Adversary for Enhancing Driving Policy Robustness

author.name: Qimao Chen, Fang Li, Shaoqing Xu, Zhiyi Lai, Zixun Xie, Yuechen Luo, Shengyin Jiang, Hanbing Li, Long Chen, Bing Wang, Yi Zhang, Zhi-Xin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes VILTA, using VLMs in-the-loop to directly generate hazardous trajectories for adversarial scenario generation in autonomous driving, addressing the long-tail problem of rare critical scenarios.

entry.title: SGW-GAN: Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein Guided GANs for Retinal Fundus Image Enhancement

author.name: Yujian Xiong, Xuanzhao Dong, Wenhui Zhu, Xin Li, Oana Dumitrascu, Yalin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SGW-GAN using Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein discrepancy for retinal fundus image enhancement, preserving intra-class geometric structure that standard GAN/diffusion methods distort. Addresses clinical downstream task degradation.

entry.title: VIAFormer: Voxel-Image Alignment Transformer for High-Fidelity Voxel Refinement

author.name: Tiancheng Fang, Bowen Pan, Lingxi Chen, Jiangjing Lyu, Chengfei Lyu, Chaoyue Niu, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes VIAFormer for multi-view conditioned voxel refinement using Image Index for 3D spatial grounding, Correctional Flow objective, and Hybrid Stream Transformer. Corrects artifacts from vision foundation models.

entry.title: PREGEN: Uncovering Latent Thoughts in Composed Video Retrieval

author.name: Gabriele Serussi, David Vainshtein, Jonathan Kouchly, Dotan Di Castro, Chaim Baskin

entry.summary: Introduces PREGEN for composed video retrieval pairing frozen VLM with lightweight encoder, extracting hidden states without fine-tuning. Eliminates expensive caption generation while achieving efficient retrieval.

entry.title: STEC: A Reference-Free Spatio-Temporal Entropy Coverage Metric for Evaluating Sampled Video Frames

author.name: Shih-Yao Lin

entry.summary: Proposes STEC, a reference-free metric for evaluating video frame sampling quality based on spatio-temporal entropy coverage. Measures whether sampled frames capture informative, representative content.

entry.title: One-Shot Refiner: Boosting Feed-forward Novel View Synthesis via One-Step Diffusion

author.name: Yitong Dong, Qi Zhang, Minchao Jiang, Zhiqiang Wu, Qingnan Fan, Ying Feng, Huaqi Zhang, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents One-Shot Refiner framework for high-fidelity novel view synthesis from sparse images, combining Dual-Domain Detail Perception Module for high-resolution handling with one-step diffusion refinement.

entry.title: DARC: Decoupled Asymmetric Reasoning Curriculum for LLM Evolution

author.name: Shengda Fan, Xuyan Ye, Yankai Lin

entry.summary: Proposes DARC, a two-stage framework for LLM self-evolution that addresses optimization instability in self-play by decoupling questioner training (difficulty-calibrated synthesis) from solver training (asymmetric curriculum learning).

entry.title: Chatsparent: An Interactive System for Detecting and Mitigating Cognitive Fatigue in LLMs

author.name: Riju Marwah, Vishal Pallagani, Ritvik Garimella, Amit Sheth

entry.summary: Introduces Chatsparent, an interactive system that detects cognitive fatigue in LLMs through token-level signals including attention decay, embedding drift, and entropy collapse, providing real-time visualization.

entry.title: Distill-then-Replace: Efficient Task-Specific Hybrid Attention Model Construction

author.name: Xiaojie Xia, Huigang Zhang, Chaoliang Zhong, Jun Sun, Yusuke Oishi

entry.summary: Proposes Distill-then-Replace for efficient hybrid attention construction, transferring pretrained weights to linear attention via distillation and learning optimal attention type placement.

entry.title: LSTM-MAS: A Long Short-Term Memory Inspired Multi-Agent System for Long-Context Understanding

author.name: Yichen Jiang, Peng Ye, Jiakang Yuan, Chongjun Tu, Lei Bai, Tao Chen

entry.summary: LSTM-MAS is a multi-agent system inspired by LSTM architecture, emulating hierarchical information flow and gated memory mechanisms for long-context understanding in LLMs.

entry.title: AQUA-Bench: Beyond Finding Answers to Knowing When There Are None in Audio Question Answering

author.name: Chun-Yi Kuan, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: AQUA-Bench evaluates audio LLMs on unanswerable questions across three scenarios: absent answers, incompatible answer sets, and incompatible audio-question pairs.

entry.title: From Prefix Cache to Fusion RAG Cache: Accelerating LLM Inference in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Jiahao Wang, Weiyu Xie, Mingxing Zhang, Boxing Zhang, Jianwei Dong, Yuening Zhu, Chen Lin, Jinqi Tang, Yaochen Han, Zhiyuan Ai, Xianglin Chen, Yongwei Wu, Congfeng Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes FusionRAG optimizing RAG inference by reusing precomputed KV cache of chunks while preserving cross-chunk contextual information that existing methods lose.

entry.title: Labels or Preferences? Budget-Constrained Learning with Human Judgments over AI-Generated Outputs

author.name: Zihan Dong, Ruijia Wu, Linjun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PCAL (Preference-Calibrated Active Learning) for optimal budget allocation between ground-truth labels and pairwise preferences. Uses semi-parametric inference with asymptotic optimality guarantees.

entry.title: "The Whole Is Greater Than the Sum of Its Parts": A Compatibility-Aware Multi-Teacher CoT Distillation Framework

author.name: Jin Cui, Jiaqi Guo, Jiepeng Zhou, Ruixuan Yang, Jiayi Lu, Jiajun Xu, Jiangcheng Song, Boran Zhao, Pengju Ren

entry.summary: COMA introduces a compatibility-aware multi-teacher CoT distillation framework that addresses teacher-student incompatibility and passive supervision issues when distilling reasoning from diverse LLM teachers.

entry.title: ELSA: Efficient LLM-Centric Split Aggregation for Privacy-Aware Hierarchical Federated Learning over Resource-Constrained Edge Networks

author.name: Xiaohong Yang, Tong Xie, Minghui Liwang, Chikai Shang, Yang Lu, Zhenzhen Jiao, Liqun Fu, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour

entry.summary: Proposes ELSA integrating split learning with hierarchical federated learning for LLM fine-tuning at edge. Includes task-agnostic client clustering, trust scoring, and latency-aware assignment.

entry.title: Optimizing User Profiles via Contextual Bandits for Retrieval-Augmented LLM Personalization

author.name: Linfeng Du, Ye Yuan, Zichen Zhao, Fuyuan Lyu, Emiliano Penaloza, Xiuying Chen, Zipeng Sun, Jikun Kang, Laurent Charlin, Xue Liu, Haolun Wu

entry.summary: PURPLE uses contextual bandits to optimize which user history records to include for RAG personalization, arguing semantic relevance is an unreliable proxy for utility. Treats profile selection as exploration-exploitation problem.

entry.title: Multimodal Multi-Agent Empowered Legal Judgment Prediction

author.name: Zhaolu Kang, Junhao Gong, Qingxi Chen, Hao Zhang, Jiaxin Liu, Rong Fu, Zhiyuan Feng, Yuan Wang, Simon Fong, Kaiyue Zhou

entry.summary: JurisMMA is a multi-agent framework for legal judgment prediction using multimodal data. Introduces JurisMM dataset with 100k+ Chinese judicial records including video-text data.

entry.title: A BERTology View of LLM Orchestrations: Token- and Layer-Selective Probes for Efficient Single-Pass Classification

author.name: Gonzalo Ariel Meyoyan, Luciano Del Corro

entry.summary: Proposes training lightweight probes on LLM hidden states for single-pass classification, reusing computation from generation. Two-stage aggregator over token-layer tensor.

entry.title: PRiSM: Benchmarking Phone Realization in Speech Models

author.name: Shikhar Bharadwaj, Chin-Jou Li, Yoonjae Kim, Kwanghee Choi, Eunjung Yeo, Ryan Soh-Eun Shim, Hanyu Zhou, Brendon Boldt, Karen Rosero Jacome, Kalvin Chang, Darsh Agrawal, Keer Xu, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Jian Zhu, Shinji Watanabe, David R. Mortensen

entry.summary: PRiSM is the first open-source phone recognition benchmark with intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation across clinical, educational, and multilingual settings.

entry.title: KG-ViP: Bridging Knowledge Grounding and Visual Perception in Multi-modal LLMs for Visual Question Answering

author.name: Zhiyang Li, Ao Ke, Yukun Cao, Xike Xie

entry.summary: KG-ViP unifies scene graphs (visual details) and commonsense graphs (external knowledge) to address both knowledge hallucination and insufficient visual perception in VQA through retrieval-and-fusion pipeline.

entry.title: A Unified Masked Jigsaw Puzzle Framework for Vision and Language Models

author.name: Weixin Ye, Wei Wang, Yahui Liu, Yue Song, Bin Ren, Wei Bi, Rita Cucchiara, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: Masked Jigsaw Puzzle (MJP) framework defends against gradient attacks in federated learning by shuffling tokens and masking position embeddings to protect Transformers.

entry.title: GO-MLVTON: Garment Occlusion-Aware Multi-Layer Virtual Try-On with Diffusion Models

author.name: Yang Yu, Yunze Deng, Yige Zhang, Yanjie Xiao, Youkun Ou, Wenhao Hu, Mingchao Li, Bin Feng, Wenyu Liu, Dandan Zheng, Jingdong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GO-MLVTON, the first multi-layer virtual try-on method addressing realistic occlusion relationships between inner and outer garments using Garment Occlusion Learning module and StableDiffusion-based morphing.

entry.title: Facial Spatiotemporal Graphs: Leveraging the 3D Facial Surface for Remote Physiological Measurement

author.name: Sam Cantrill, David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Lars Petersson, Hanna Suominen, Mohammad Ali Armin

entry.summary: Introduces Facial Spatiotemporal Graph representation encoding facial color and structure using 3D mesh sequences for remote photoplethysmography. MeshPhys achieves SOTA performance in heart rate estimation.

entry.title: FantasyVLN: Unified Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jing Zuo, Lingzhou Mu, Fan Jiang, Chengcheng Ma, Mu Xu, Yonggang Qi

entry.summary: Proposes FantasyVLN for vision-language navigation using unified multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning, addressing limitations of purely textual CoTs lacking spatial grounding and multimodal CoTs causing token inflation.

entry.title: Data-Consistent Learning of Inverse Problems

author.name: Markus Haltmeier, Gyeongha Hwang

entry.summary: Presents theoretical framework for data-consistent learning of inverse problems, showing null-space networks with classical regularization define convergent regularization methods preserving theoretical reliability.

entry.title: MyGram: Modality-aware Graph Transformer with Global Distribution for Multi-modal Entity Alignment

author.name: Zhifei Li, Ziyue Qin, Xiangyu Luo, Xiaoju Hou, Yue Zhao, Miao Zhang, Zhifang Huang, Kui Xiao, Bing Yang

entry.summary: MyGram uses modality-aware graph transformer with Gram Loss for multi-modal entity alignment. Captures deep structural contextual information within modalities for fine-grained fusion.

entry.title: UniMo: Unified Motion Generation and Understanding with Chain of Thought

author.name: Guocun Wang, Kenkun Liu, Jing Lin, Guorui Song, Jian Li, Xiaoguang Han

entry.summary: UniMo integrates motion-language with chain-of-thought reasoning via SFT, then uses Group Relative Policy Optimization to improve alignment. Addresses cumulative error problems in next-token prediction for motion.

entry.title: FutureX-Pro: Extending Future Prediction to High-Value Vertical Domains

author.name: Jiashuo Liu, Siyuan Chen, Zaiyuan Wang, Zhiyuan Zeng, Jiacheng Guo, Liang Hu, Lingyue Yin, Suozhi Huang, Wenxin Hao, Yang Yang, Zerui Cheng, Zixin Yao, Lingyue Yin, Haoxin Liu, Jiayi Cheng, Yuzhen Li, Zezhong Ma, Bingjie Wang, Bingsen Qiu, Xiao Liu, Zeyang Zhang, Zijian Liu, Jinpeng Wang, Mingren Yin, Tianci He, Yali Liao, Yixiao Tian, Zhenwei Zhu, Anqi Dai, Ge Zhang, Jingkai Liu, Kaiyuan Zhang, Wenlong Wu, Xiang Gao, Xinjie Chen, Zhixin Yao, Zhoufutu Wen, B. Aditya Prakash, Jose Blanchet, Mengdi Wang, Nian Si, Wenhao Huang

entry.summary: FutureX-Pro extends future prediction benchmark to finance, retail, public health, and natural disaster domains. Evaluates agentic LLMs on entry-level prediction tasks in high-stakes verticals.

entry.title: PepEDiff: Zero-Shot Peptide Binder Design via Protein Embedding Diffusion

author.name: Po-Yu Liang, Tobo Duran, Jun Bai

entry.summary: PepEDiff generates peptide binder sequences directly in latent space from protein embeddings without intermediate structure prediction. Uses latent-space exploration to avoid memorizing known sequences.

entry.title: A Lightweight Modular Framework for Constructing Autonomous Agents Driven by Large Language Models: Design, Implementation, and Applications in AgentForge

author.name: Akbar Anbar Jafari, Cagri Ozcinar, Gholamreza Anbarjafari

entry.summary: AgentForge is lightweight open-source Python framework for LLM agents with composable skill abstractions, unified LLM backend interface, and fine-grained input-output contracts.

entry.title: TruthTensor: Evaluating LLMs Human Imitation through Prediction Market Drift and Holistic Reasoning

author.name: Shirin Shahabi, Spencer Graham, Haruna Isah

entry.summary: Proposes TruthTensor, a new LLM evaluation paradigm using live prediction markets to assess models as human-imitation systems in high-entropy environments. Addresses benchmark contamination and distribution shift issues in standard evaluations.

entry.title: Measuring Stability Beyond Accuracy in Small Open-Source Medical Large Language Models for Pediatric Endocrinology

author.name: Vanessa D'Amario, Randy Daniel, Alessandro Zanetti, Dhruv Edamadaka, Nitya Alaparthy, Joshua Tarkoff

entry.summary: Evaluates six small open-source medical LLMs on pediatric endocrinology, assessing stability beyond accuracy through prompt variation effects and self-assessment bias in deterministic and stochastic settings.

entry.title: Semantic Caching and Intent-Driven Context Optimization for Multi-Agent Natural Language to Code Systems

author.name: Harmohit Singh

entry.summary: Production-optimized multi-agent system for natural language to Python code translation achieving 67% semantic cache hit rates and 40-60% token reduction through intent-driven dynamic prompt assembly.

entry.title: Large language models struggle with ethnographic text annotation

author.name: Leonardo S. Goodall, Dor Shilton, Daniel A. Mullins, Harvey Whitehouse

entry.summary: Evaluates 7 SOTA LLMs on annotating 121 ritual features across 567 ethnographic excerpts, finding performance well below reliable automated annotation levels.

entry.title: Efficient Privacy-Preserving Retrieval Augmented Generation with Distance-Preserving Encryption

author.name: Huanyi Ye, Jiale Guo, Ziyao Liu, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-preserving RAG system using distance-preserving encryption to protect embeddings from reconstruction attacks when using untrusted cloud storage. Addresses practical security concerns for RAG deployment.

entry.title: Training instability in deep learning follows low-dimensional dynamical principles

author.name: Zhipeng Zhang, Zhenjie Yao, Kai Li, Lei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified dynamical perspective characterizing deep learning training stability across four dimensions: optimization, environmental/data, parametric, and learning-signal. Uses controlled perturbation auditing to study training trajectories.

entry.title: The AI Genie Phenomenon and Three Types of AI Chatbot Addiction: Escapist Roleplays, Pseudosocial Companions, and Epistemic Rabbit Holes

author.name: M. Karen Shen, Jessica Huang, Olivia Liang, Ig-Jae Kim, Dongwook Yoon

entry.summary: Analyzes AI chatbot addiction through Reddit data (334 entries), identifying 'AI Genie' phenomenon and three addiction types: escapist roleplays, pseudosocial companions, and epistemic rabbit holes.

entry.title: Hierarchical Long Video Understanding with Audiovisual Entity Cohesion and Agentic Search

author.name: Xinlei Yin, Xiulian Peng, Xiao Li, Zhiwei Xiong, Yan Lu

entry.summary: HAVEN presents a unified framework for long video understanding that addresses information fragmentation through audiovisual entity cohesion and hierarchical video indexing with agentic search. It organizes video content into structured hierarchies spanning global summaries to entity levels.

entry.title: Glance-or-Gaze: Incentivizing LMMs to Adaptively Focus Search via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hongbo Bai, Yujin Zhou, Yile Wu, Chi-Min Chan, Pengcheng Wen, Kunhao Pan, Sirui Han, Yike Guo

entry.summary: Glance-or-Gaze proposes a fully autonomous framework for visual understanding that shifts from passive perception to active visual planning, introducing a Selective Gaze mechanism for dynamic search decisions.

entry.title: VideoMaMa: Mask-Guided Video Matting via Generative Prior

author.name: Sangbeom Lim, Seoung Wug Oh, Jiahui Huang, Heeji Yoon, Seungryong Kim, Joon-Young Lee

entry.summary: VideoMaMa presents mask-to-matte video conversion using diffusion model priors, achieving zero-shot generalization. Constructs MA-V dataset with 50K real-world video matting annotations.

entry.title: Controlling Underestimation Bias in Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Safe Exploration

author.name: Shiqing Gao, Jiaxin Ding, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang

entry.summary: MICE proposes memory-driven intrinsic cost estimation for safe RL that introduces intrinsic costs to mitigate value function underestimation, inspired by human flashbulb memory of dangerous experiences.

entry.title: Principled Latent Diffusion for Graphs via Laplacian Autoencoders

author.name: Antoine Siraudin, Christopher Morris

entry.summary: Proposes LG-Flow, latent graph diffusion framework using permutation-equivariant autoencoder for lossless graph compression. Addresses key challenge that graph generation requires near-perfect reconstruction.

entry.title: Semantic Differentiation for Tackling Challenges in Watermarking Low-Entropy Constrained Generation Outputs

author.name: Nghia T. Le, Alan Ritter, Kartik Goyal

entry.summary: Proposes SeqMark, a sequence-level watermarking algorithm with semantic differentiation that addresses failure modes of token-level watermarking for constrained generation tasks with low-entropy output spaces.

entry.title: A Component-Based Survey of Interactions between Large Language Models and Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Miao Xie, Siguang Chen, Chunli Lv

entry.summary: First survey systematically reviewing bidirectional interactions between LLMs and multi-armed bandits at component level. Shows how MAB helps LLM pre-training/RAG/personalization, and how LLMs enhance MAB arm definition and reward modeling.

entry.title: Bridging the Gap Between Estimated and True Regret Towards Reliable Regret Estimation in Deep Learning based Mechanism Design

author.name: Shuyuan You, Zhiqiang Zhuang, Kewen Wang, Zhe Wang

entry.summary: Reveals that existing deep learning mechanism design methods (RegretNet, etc.) systematically underestimate actual regret by orders of magnitude. Derives lower bounds and proposes improved estimation.

entry.title: Deep Learning Approaches to Quantum Error Mitigation

author.name: Leonardo Placidi, Ifan Williams, Enrico Rinaldi, Daniel Mills, Cristina C\^irstoiu, Vanya Eccles, Ross Duncan

entry.summary: Systematic investigation of deep learning for quantum error mitigation comparing architectures from FCNs to transformers. Attention-based models best on IBM QPU data up to 5 qubits.

entry.title: DoPE: Decoy Oriented Perturbation Encapsulation Human-Readable, AI-Hostile Documents for Academic Integrity

author.name: Ashish Raj Shekhar, Shiven Agarwal, Priyanuj Bordoloi, Yash Shah, Tejas Anvekar, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: DoPE embeds semantic decoys into PDF/HTML assessments to confuse MLLMs attempting to automatically solve exams, providing both prevention and detection of AI-assisted cheating.

entry.title: Arab Voices: Mapping Standard and Dialectal Arabic Speech Technology

author.name: Peter Sullivan, AbdelRahim Elmadany, Alcides Alcoba Inciarte, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed

entry.summary: Arab Voices provides standardized framework for dialectal Arabic ASR with unified access to 39 test sets and analysis of linguistic 'dialectness' and audio quality.

entry.title: Dr. Assistant: Enhancing Clinical Diagnostic Inquiry via Structured Diagnostic Reasoning Data and Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yue Guo, Fanfu Wang, Jianwei Lv, Xincheng Shi, Yuchen Li, Youya Wang, Yunsheng Zeng, Yujing Liu, Yunhao Qiao, Gen Li, Junfeng Wang, Bo Yuan

entry.summary: Dr. Assistant proposes Clinical Diagnostic Reasoning Data structure and pipeline for training diagnostic models with reasoning and inquiry capabilities using RL.

entry.title: The Stability Trap: Evaluating the Reliability of LLM-Based Instruction Adherence Auditing

author.name: Murtuza N. Shergadwala

entry.summary: Studies reliability of LLM-as-Judge approaches for auditing GenAI instruction adherence in regulated sectors like HR. Introduces Scoped Instruction Decomposition Framework to classify instructions as Objective vs Subjective to isolate instability factors.

entry.title: studentSplat: Your Student Model Learns Single-view 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yimu Pan, Hongda Mao, Qingshuang Chen, Yelin Kim

entry.summary: studentSplat enables single-view 3D Gaussian splatting scene reconstruction using teacher-student architecture where multi-view teacher provides geometric supervision and extrapolation network completes views.

entry.title: Nip Rumors in the Bud: Retrieval-Guided Topic-Level Adaptation for Test-Time Fake News Video Detection

author.name: Jian Lang, Rongpei Hong, Ting Zhong, Yong Wang, Fan Zhou

entry.summary: RADAR enables test-time adaptation for fake news video detection on unseen topics using entropy selection-based retrieval to guide adaptation with stable, low-entropy reference videos.

entry.title: SDiT: Semantic Region-Adaptive for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Bowen Lin, Fanjiang Ye, Yihua Liu, Zhenghui Guo, Boyuan Zhang, Weijian Zheng, Yufan Xu, Tiancheng Xing, Yuke Wang, Chengming Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SDiT, a training-free framework that allocates computation adaptively for Diffusion Transformers based on regional complexity, observing that backgrounds converge faster than edges/textures. Uses semantic-aware clustering and complexity-driven scheduling.

entry.title: Histopath-C: Towards Realistic Domain Shifts for Histopathology Vision-Language Adaptation

author.name: Mehrdad Noori, Gustavo Adolfo Vargas Hakim, David Osowiechi, Fereshteh Shakeri, Ali Bahri, Moslem Yazdanpanah, Sahar Dastani, Ismail Ben Ayed, Christian Desrosiers

entry.summary: Introduces Histopath-C benchmark with realistic synthetic corruptions mimicking real-world distribution shifts in digital histopathology, and proposes LATTE for test-time adaptation under these corruptions.

entry.title: Generalizable and Animatable 3D Full-Head Gaussian Avatar from a Single Image

author.name: Shuling Zhao, Dan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes framework for one-shot 3D full-head animatable avatar reconstruction with Gaussian primitives in UV space, enabling real-time animation and 360° rendering from a single image.

entry.title: Patient-Conditioned Adaptive Offsets for Reliable Diagnosis across Subgroups

Proves formally that existential temporal realization doesn't preserve conjunction - systems can have all 'ingredients' of experience across time without ever instantiating unified experience.

entry.title: Research Summary: January 20, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research concentrates heavily on alignment techniques and safety evaluation. A survey on alignment pretraining synthesizes evidence that training LLMs on data depicting well-behaved AI during pretraining substantially reduces misalignment—potentially offering a scalable, proactive safety approach.

  • Coup probes testing demonstrates few-shot linear classifiers can detect scheming behavior from model activations, with empirical results on off-policy training data
  • Silent Agreement Evaluation provides first empirical measurement of Schelling coordination in LLMs—whether isolated instances converge on shared choices without communication
  • Framework for AI-delegated safety research identifies key dimensions: epistemic cursedness, parallelizability, and short-horizon suitability
  • Strategic analysis examines whether LLM alignment work transfers to non-LLM takeover-capable systems

Methodological contributions include a critique of METR-HRS timelines forecasting, arguing the 'd' parameter conflates task difficulty with sequence length. Governance-oriented work sketches positive AI transition scenarios co-authored with Claude Opus 4.5.

entry.title: Pretraining on Aligned AI Data Dramatically Reduces Misalignment—Even After Post-Training

author.name: RogerDearnaley

entry.summary: Survey of 'alignment pretraining' research showing that training LLMs on data depicting AI behaving well during pretraining dramatically reduces misalignment, and this persists through post-training. Claims major labs are now interested in this approach.

entry.title: Testing few-shot coup probes

author.name: Joey Marcellino

entry.summary: Implements and tests linear classifiers (coup probes) trained on AI activations to detect scheming behavior. Tests whether off-policy training data can bootstrap detection that improves with real examples. First empirical test of this proposed technique.

entry.title: Silent Agreement Evaluation

author.name: Graeme Ford

entry.summary: First empirical study measuring Schelling coordination in LLMs - whether two model instances independently choose the same option without communication. Frontier models failed at chance without reasoning; thinking models succeeded on word comparisons.

entry.title: Desiderata of good problems to hand off to AIs

author.name: Jozdien

entry.summary: Framework identifying key dimensions for which AI safety problems to delegate to AI systems: epistemic cursedness, parallelizability, short-horizon sub-problems, speed of ASI alignment progress, and legibility to labs.

entry.title: Could LLM alignment research reduce x-risk if the first takeover-capable AI is not an LLM?

author.name: Tim Hua

entry.summary: Analyzes whether LLM alignment research transfers to non-LLM AIs via two mechanisms: direct transfer (reusing evaluations, model organisms) and indirect transfer (using aligned LLMs to oversee non-LLMs). Argues surprisingly much research may transfer directly.

entry.title: AGI both does and doesn't have an infinite time horizon

entry.summary: Critiques AI timelines forecasting by arguing that METR-HRS tasks conflate difficulty with sequence length. The key parameter 'd' in forecasting models depends on whether intelligence or consistency is the bottleneck, dramatically changing extrapolations.

entry.title: Research Summary: January 19, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans AGI benchmarking, reasoning interpretability, agent evaluation, and safety mechanisms for production AI systems.

ARC Prize 2025 technical report documents 'refinement loops' as the defining pattern among top ARC-AGI-2 performers. Reasoning Models Generate Societies of Thought reveals that enhanced reasoning in DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B emerges from internal multi-agent-like simulations. AgencyBench introduces evaluation at unprecedented scale: 32 scenarios requiring ~90 tool calls and 1M tokens.

  • Google DeepMind presents production-ready activation probes for Gemini misuse detection addressing distribution shift
  • Spurious Rewards Paradox identifies mechanistically how RLVR triggers memorization shortcuts via Anchor-Adapter circuits
  • BAPO teaches agentic search systems to recognize reasoning boundaries and output 'I DON'T KNOW'
  • DialDefer exposes 'dialogic deference' bias undermining LLM-as-judge reliability

A critique of METR methodology argues AI capability time horizons may be significantly underestimated. Meta's NeurIPS 2025 DCVLR winner shows difficulty-based example selection outperforms dataset diversity. Digital Metabolism proposes that targeted forgetting can distill pure neural logic cores from factual knowledge.

entry.title: Unlocking the Potentials of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Chuanyue Yu, Jiahui Wang, Yuhan Li, Heng Chang, Ge Lan, Qingyun Sun, Jia Li, Jianxin Li, Ziwei Zhang

entry.summary: First systematic study of RAG for Diffusion Language Models, identifying Response Semantic Drift where generated answers deviate from query semantics, and proposing solutions for improved precision.

entry.title: Institutional AI: Governing LLM Collusion in Multi-Agent Cournot Markets via Public Governance Graphs

author.name: Marcantonio Bracale Syrnikov, Federico Pierucci, Marcello Galisai, Matteo Prandi, Piercosma Bisconti, Francesco Giarrusso, Olga Sorokoletova, Vincenzo Suriani, Daniele Nardi

entry.summary: Introduces 'Institutional AI,' a framework for AI alignment that uses governance graphs—public, immutable manifests declaring legal states and sanctions—to prevent harmful collusion between multi-agent LLM systems in economic settings like Cournot markets.

entry.title: Low-Rank Key Value Attention

author.name: James O'Neill, Robert Clancy, Mariia Matskevichus, Fergal Reid

entry.summary: Proposes Low-Rank KV adaptation (LRKV), which uses shared full-rank KV projections with low-rank head-specific residuals, reducing KV cache memory while subsurming MQA and GQA as special cases.

entry.title: Budget-Aware Anytime Reasoning with LLM-Synthesized Preference Data

author.name: Xuanming Zhang, Shwan Ashrafi, Aziza Mirsaidova, Amir Rezaeian, Miguel Ballesteros, Lydia B. Chilton, Zhou Yu, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces anytime reasoning framework and Anytime Index metric for LLMs under computation budgets. Proposes self-improvement via LLM-synthesized preference data for better intermediate solutions.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Activation Discovery: Transferring Mathematical Structures from Physics to Ecology for Parameter-Efficient Neural Networks

author.name: Anas Hajbi

entry.summary: Proposes Neuro-Symbolic Activation Discovery using genetic programming to extract mathematical formulas from data as custom activation functions, discovering cross-domain transfer from physics to ecology.

entry.title: ZPD Detector: Data Selection via Capability-Difficulty Alignment for Large Language Models

author.name: Bo Yang, Yunkui Chen, Lanfei Feng, Yu Zhang, Shijian Li

entry.summary: Introduces ZPD Detector, a data selection framework inspired by educational theory that dynamically aligns sample difficulty with model capability. Addresses evolving model-data relationships during training.

entry.title: Integrity Shield A System for Ethical AI Use & Authorship Transparency in Assessments

author.name: Ashish Raj Shekhar and Shiven Agarwal and Priyanuj Bordoloi and Yash Shah and Tejas Anvekar and Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces Integrity Shield, document-layer watermarking preventing MLLMs from answering exam PDFs. Embeds schema-aware item-level watermarks invisible to humans but detected by models.

entry.title: Learn Before Represent: Bridging Generative and Contrastive Learning for Domain-Specific LLM Embeddings

author.name: Xiaoyu Liang, Yuchen Peng, Jiale Luo, Wenhao Wang, Haoji Hu, Xincheng Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Learn Before Represent (LBR), a two-stage framework that first injects domain knowledge via generative learning, then performs contrastive learning for domain-specific LLM embeddings. Addresses the knowledge acquisition bottleneck in vertical domains like chemistry and law.

entry.title: Do We Always Need Query-Level Workflows? Rethinking Agentic Workflow Generation for Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Zixu Wang, Bingbing Xu, Yige Yuan, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Questions whether query-level workflow generation is always necessary for multi-agent systems, showing that top-K task-level workflows can cover equivalent queries. Proposes SCALE framework for low-cost task-level generation.

entry.title: VidLeaks: Membership Inference Attacks Against Text-to-Video Models

author.name: Li Wang, Wenyu Chen, Ning Yu, Zheng Li, Shanqing Guo

entry.summary: Presents VidLeaks, the first systematic study of membership inference attacks against text-to-video models, introducing spatial reconstruction fidelity and temporal coherence metrics to probe memorization.

entry.title: FactCorrector: A Graph-Inspired Approach to Long-Form Factuality Correction of Large Language Models

author.name: Javier Carnerero-Cano, Massimiliano Pronesti, Radu Marinescu, Tigran Tchrakian, James Barry, Jasmina Gajcin, Yufang Hou, Alessandra Pascale, Elizabeth Daly

entry.summary: Introduces FactCorrector, a post-hoc correction method using structured feedback for long-form factuality correction, along with VELI5 benchmark containing systematically injected errors and ground-truth corrections.

entry.title: Reasoning in Trees: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Question Answering

author.name: Yuling Shi, Maolin Sun, Zijun Liu, Mo Yang, Yixiong Fang, Tianran Sun, Xiaodong Gu

entry.summary: Introduces RT-RAG using reasoning trees for multi-hop QA with systematic decomposition through entity analysis and consensus-based tree selection, minimizing error propagation across reasoning steps.

entry.title: Membership Inference on LLMs in the Wild

author.name: Jiatong Yi, Yanyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes SimMIA for membership inference attacks against LLMs in strict black-box settings with only generated text access, introducing WikiMIA-25 benchmark for modern proprietary models.

entry.title: Idea First, Code Later: Disentangling Problem Solving from Code Generation in Evaluating LLMs for Competitive Programming

author.name: Sama Hadhoud, Alaa Elsetohy, Frederikus Hudi, Jan Christian Blaise Cruz, Steven Halim, Alham Fikri Aji

entry.summary: Argues for separating algorithmic reasoning from code implementation in evaluating LLMs for competitive programming, showing that generating natural-language editorials before code improves solve rates and enables better error diagnosis.

entry.title: The unreasonable effectiveness of pattern matching

author.name: Gary Lupyan, Blaise Ag\"uera y Arcas

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs can recover meaning from 'Jabberwocky' language with nonsense content words, showing pattern-matching over structural features enables semantic understanding even without recognizable vocabulary.

entry.title: Do explanations generalize across large reasoning models?

author.name: Koyena Pal, David Bau, Chandan Singh

entry.summary: Studies whether chain-of-thought explanations from Large Reasoning Models generalize across different LRMs by testing if explanations from one model induce correct behavior in others. Finds explanations often do generalize.

entry.title: A Concise Agent is Less Expert: Revealing Side Effects of Using Style Features on Conversational Agents

author.name: Young-Min Cho, Yuan Yuan, Sharath Chandra Guntuku, Lyle Ungar

entry.summary: Studies side effects of style prompts on LLM conversational agents, finding structured cross-feature effects like conciseness reducing perceived expertise through systematic survey of 127 papers.

entry.title: NAACL: Noise-AwAre Verbal Confidence Calibration for LLMs in RAG Systems

author.name: Jiayu Liu, Rui Wang, Qing Zong, Qingcheng Zeng, Tianshi Zheng, Haochen Shi, Dadi Guo, Baixuan Xu, Chunyang Li, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Systematically studies LLM confidence calibration in RAG settings, finding noisy contexts inflate false certainty. Proposes NAACL framework with noise-aware calibration rules.

entry.title: VLAs as Model Organisms for AI Safety

author.name: TheSigillite

entry.summary: Reports on VLA training experience for Stanford BEHAVIOR-1K Challenge, identifying three safety-critical failure modes: overconfidence on unfamiliar contexts, exploitation of perceptual shortcuts, and failure to recognize out-of-distribution situations.

entry.title: AJAR: Adaptive Jailbreak Architecture for Red-teaming

author.name: Yipu Dou, Wang Yang

entry.summary: Introduces AJAR, a modular red-teaming framework for LLM agents using MCP protocol. Encapsulates attack algorithms like X-Teaming as standard tools for adversarial testing.

entry.title: Differentially Private Subspace Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models

author.name: Lele Zheng, Xiang Wang, Tao Zhang, Yang Cao, Ke Cheng, Yulong Shen

entry.summary: Proposes DP-SFT, two-stage subspace fine-tuning for differential privacy in LLMs. Reduces noise magnitude by focusing DP perturbations on task-specific low-dimensional subspace.

entry.title: Do You Trust Me? Cognitive-Affective Signatures of Trustworthiness in Large Language Models

author.name: Gerard Yeo, Svetlana Churina, Kokil Jaidka

entry.summary: Analyzes how instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, Mistral) encode perceived trustworthiness in web narratives using layer-level activation analysis and probing techniques.

entry.title: Future Optical Flow Prediction Improves Robot Control & Video Generation

author.name: Kanchana Ranasinghe, Honglu Zhou, Yu Fang, Luyu Yang, Le Xue, Ran Xu, Caiming Xiong, Silvio Savarese, Michael S Ryoo, Juan Carlos Niebles

entry.summary: Introduces FOFPred for language-conditioned optical flow forecasting using unified VLM-Diffusion architecture, enabling future motion prediction for robot control and video generation.

entry.title: HOSL: Hybrid-Order Split Learning for Memory-Constrained Edge Training

author.name: Aakriti, Zhe Li, Dandan Liang, Chao Huang, Rui Li, Haibo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes HOSL, a hybrid-order split learning framework combining first-order and zeroth-order optimization for training LLMs on memory-constrained edge devices. Balances memory efficiency with convergence speed.

entry.title: SonicBench: Dissecting the Physical Perception Bottleneck in Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Yirong Sun, Yanjun Chen, Xin Qiu, Gang Zhang, Hongyu Chen, Daokuan Wu, Chengming Li, Min Yang, Dawei Zhu, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: Introduces SonicBench, psychophysically-grounded benchmark evaluating 12 physical audio attributes. Reveals substantial perception gap where LALMs achieve only ~40% accuracy vs 87% human performance.

entry.title: Vision-as-Inverse-Graphics Agent via Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Shaofeng Yin, Jiaxin Ge, Zora Zhiruo Wang, Xiuyu Li, Michael J. Black, Trevor Darrell, Angjoo Kanazawa, Haiwen Feng

entry.summary: Presents VIGA, an agent for vision-as-inverse-graphics through interleaved multimodal reasoning. Uses closed-loop write-run-render-compare-revise procedure with skill library and evolving context memory.

entry.title: SoLA-Vision: Fine-grained Layer-wise Linear Softmax Hybrid Attention

author.name: Ruibang Li, Guan Luo, Yiwei Zhang, Jin Gao, Bing Li, Weiming Hu

entry.summary: Proposes SoLA-Vision, a flexible layer-wise hybrid of linear and softmax attention for vision transformers that can match or surpass performance while requiring fewer expensive softmax layers.

entry.title: LoRA as Oracle

author.name: Marco Arazzi, Antonino Nocera

entry.summary: Introduces LoRA-based oracle framework for backdoor detection and membership inference that analyzes optimization dynamics and representation shifts when exposed to suspicious samples.

entry.title: Language of Thought Shapes Output Diversity in Large Language Models

author.name: Shaoyang Xu, Wenxuan Zhang

entry.summary: Reveals that the language of thought during LLM reasoning significantly affects output diversity, with non-English thinking languages consistently increasing diversity. Different thinking languages occupy distinct regions in model thinking space.

entry.title: FORESTLLM: Large Language Models Make Random Forest Great on Few-shot Tabular Learning

author.name: Zhihan Yang, Jiaqi Wei, Xiang Zhang, Haoyu Dong, Yiwen Wang, Xiaoke Guo, Pengkun Zhang, Yiwei Xu, Chenyu You

entry.summary: Proposes FORESTLLM combining decision forests with LLMs for few-shot tabular learning, using LLMs for semantic splits rather than statistical purity, achieving strong performance with limited labels.

entry.title: AstroReason-Bench: Evaluating Unified Agentic Planning across Heterogeneous Space Planning Problems

author.name: Weiyi Wang, Xinchi Chen, Jingjing Gong, Xuanjing Huang, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces AstroReason-Bench for evaluating agentic LLM planning in space planning problems with physics constraints, heterogeneous objectives, and long-horizon decisions, including ground station communication and Earth observation tasks.

entry.title: ACoT-VLA: Action Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Linqing Zhong, Yi Liu, Yifei Wei, Ziyu Xiong, Maoqing Yao, Si Liu, Guanghui Ren

entry.summary: Introduces Action Chain-of-Thought (ACoT), a paradigm for Vision-Language-Action models where reasoning occurs directly in action space rather than through language or vision intermediaries, enabling more precise robotic manipulation.

entry.title: MHA2MLA-VLM: Enabling DeepSeek's Economical Multi-Head Latent Attention across Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xiaoran Fan, Zhichao Sun, Tao Ji, Lixing Shen, Tao Gui

entry.summary: Presents MHA2MLA-VLM, a framework for converting existing VLMs to DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention architecture for KV cache compression, using modality-adaptive partial-RoPE and modality-decoupled low-rank approximation.

entry.title: Pruning as Evolution: Emergent Sparsity Through Selection Dynamics in Neural Networks

author.name: Zubair Shah, Noaman Khan

entry.summary: Proposes evolutionary perspective on neural network pruning where parameter groups undergo selection pressure, with pruning corresponding to population extinction based on persistent fitness measures.

entry.title: Is open robotics innovation a threat to international peace and security?

author.name: Ludovic Righetti and Vincent Boulanin

entry.summary: Policy paper examining dual-use risks of open robotics innovation, arguing current openness lacks regulation compared to other dual-use fields like WMD development.

entry.title: FrankenMotion: Part-level Human Motion Generation and Composition

author.name: Chuqiao Li, Xianghui Xie, Yong Cao, Andreas Geiger, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: Introduces FrankenMotion for part-level human motion generation using LLM-generated atomic annotations with temporal awareness, enabling fine-grained body part control.

entry.title: Your One-Stop Solution for AI-Generated Video Detection

author.name: Long Ma, Zihao Xue, Yan Wang, Zhiyuan Yan, Jin Xu, Xiaorui Jiang, Haiyang Yu, Yong Liao, Zhen Bi

entry.summary: Presents comprehensive benchmark and methods for AI-generated video detection, addressing limitations in existing datasets' scale, diversity, and quality. Provides systematic evaluation framework.

entry.title: FAQ: Mitigating Quantization Error via Regenerating Calibration Data with Family-Aware Quantization

author.name: Haiyang Xiao, Weiqing Li, Jinyue Guo, Guochao Jiang, Guohua Liu, Yuewei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FAQ (Family-Aware Quantization) for LLM post-training quantization that uses larger LLMs from the same family to regenerate high-fidelity calibration samples, addressing calibration data bottleneck.

entry.title: VLAgents: A Policy Server for Efficient VLA Inference

author.name: Tobias J\"ulg, Khaled Gamal, Nisarga Nilavadi, Pierre Krack, Seongjin Bien, Michael Krawez, Florian Walter, Wolfram Burgard

entry.summary: Introduces VLAgents, a modular policy server for Vision-Language-Action models with unified Gymnasium-style protocol, supporting both local zero-copy and remote streaming communication for 7 policies.

entry.title: X-Distill: Cross-Architecture Vision Distillation for Visuomotor Learning

author.name: Maanping Shao, Feihong Zhang, Gu Zhang, Baiye Cheng, Zhengrong Xue, Huazhe Xu

entry.summary: Introduces X-Distill for cross-architecture knowledge distillation from DINOv2 ViT to ResNet-18 for robotics, enabling deployment with only 11% parameters while maintaining or exceeding performance.

entry.title: Are NLP Models Good at Tracing Thoughts: An Overview of Narrative Understanding

author.name: Lixing Zhu, Runcong Zhao, Lin Gui, Yulan He

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of narrative understanding tasks examining how NLP models capture authors' cognitive processes including knowledge, intentions, and beliefs. Explores modularized LLM approaches for novel narrative tasks.

entry.title: Mass Distribution versus Density Distribution in the Context of Clustering

author.name: Kai Ming Ting and Ye Zhu and Hang Zhang and Tianrun Liang

entry.summary: Investigates mass distribution vs density distribution for clustering, showing density's high-density bias limitation and proposing mass-based algorithm for arbitrary cluster discovery.

entry.title: Analytic Bijections for Smooth and Interpretable Normalizing Flows

author.name: Mathis Gerdes, Miranda C. N. Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces three families of analytic bijections (cubic rational, sinh, cubic polynomial) for normalizing flows that are globally smooth, defined on all R, and analytically invertible.

entry.title: Bidirectional Human-Robot Communication for Physical Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Junxiang Wang, Cindy Wang, Rana Soltani Zarrin, Zackory Erickson

entry.summary: Introduces BRIDGE for bidirectional human-robot communication using LLMs to interpret trajectory modifications from natural language and provide verbal feedback during physical assistance.

entry.title: Where to Touch, How to Contact: Hierarchical RL-MPC Framework for Geometry-Aware Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Zhixian Xie and Yu Xiang and Michael Posa and Wanxin Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical RL-MPC framework for dexterous manipulation that separates high-level decisions (where to touch, how to move) from low-level contact dynamics. Addresses limitations of end-to-end visuomotor policies.

entry.title: Steering Language Models Before They Speak: Logit-Level Interventions

author.name: Hyeseon An, Shinwoo Park, Hyundong Jin, Yo-Sub Han

entry.summary: Introduces training-free inference-time logit intervention for controllable LLM generation using z-normalized log-odds from labeled corpora. Achieves style control without internal layer access.

entry.title: Efficient Protein Optimization via Structure-aware Hamiltonian Dynamics

author.name: Jiahao Wang, Shuangjia Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces HADES, a Bayesian optimization method using Hamiltonian dynamics for protein optimization. Leverages momentum and uncertainty for efficient sampling in structure-aware posterior.

entry.title: CoG: Controllable Graph Reasoning via Relational Blueprints and Failure-Aware Refinement over Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Yuanxiang Liu, Songze Li, Xiaoke Guo, Zhaoyan Gong, Qifei Zhang, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CoG, training-free framework for KG-augmented LLM reasoning inspired by Dual-Process Theory. Uses relational blueprints as soft constraints with failure-aware refinement.

entry.title: ReCreate: Reasoning and Creating Domain Agents Driven by Experience

author.name: Zhezheng Hao, Hong Wang, Jian Luo, Jianqing Zhang, Yuyan Zhou, Qiang Lin, Can Wang, Hande Dong, Jiawei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ReCreate framework for automatically creating domain agents using experience-driven reasoning rather than black-box generation with final performance metrics.

entry.title: TANDEM: Temporal-Aware Neural Detection for Multimodal Hate Speech

author.name: Girish A. Koushik, Helen Treharne, Diptesh Kanojia

entry.summary: Introduces TANDEM for detecting hate speech in long-form multimodal content with temporal awareness, providing timestamps and target identities rather than binary classification through tandem reinforcement learning.

entry.title: ATATA: One Algorithm to Align Them All

author.name: Boyi Pang, Savva Ignatyev, Vladimir Ippolitov, Ramil Khafizov, Yurii Melnik, Oleg Voynov, Maksim Nakhodnov, Aibek Alanov, Xiaopeng Fan, Peter Wonka, Evgeny Burnaev

entry.summary: Proposes ATATA, a multi-modal algorithm for joint inference of structurally aligned samples with Rectified Flow models, applicable to image, video, and 3D generation without relying on Score Distillation Sampling.

entry.title: SDFLoRA: Selective Dual-Module LoRA for Federated Fine-tuning with Heterogeneous Clients

author.name: Zhikang Shen, Jianrong Lu, Haiyuan Wan, Jianhai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SDFLoRA for federated fine-tuning of LLMs with heterogeneous clients, using dual-module design to handle rank heterogeneity while protecting local information under differential privacy.

entry.title: Skill-Aware Diffusion for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Aoshen Huang, Jiaming Chen, Jiyu Cheng, Ran Song, Wei Pan, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SADiff (Skill-Aware Diffusion) for robotic manipulation that explicitly incorporates skill-level information through learnable skill tokens, improving generalization across tasks with similar motion patterns.

entry.title: XChoice: Explainable Evaluation of AI-Human Alignment in LLM-based Constrained Choice Decision Making

author.name: Weihong Qi, Fan Huang, Rasika Muralidharan, Jisun An, Haewoon Kwak

entry.summary: Presents XChoice framework for explainable evaluation of AI-human alignment in constrained decision-making, recovering interpretable parameters to assess alignment beyond accuracy metrics.

entry.title: One LLM to Train Them All: Multi-Task Learning Framework for Fact-Checking

author.name: Malin Astrid Larsson, Harald Fosen Grunnaleite, Vinay Setty

entry.summary: Proposes multi-task learning approach for automated fact-checking, training single small LLM (Qwen3-4b) to jointly perform claim detection, evidence ranking, and stance detection across multiple datasets.

entry.title: How Much Would a Clinician Edit This Draft? Evaluating LLM Alignment for Patient Message Response Drafting

author.name: Parker Seegmiller, Joseph Gatto, Sarah E. Greer, Ganza Belise Isingizwe, Rohan Ray, Timothy E. Burdick and Sarah Masud Preum

entry.summary: Develops novel taxonomy of thematic elements in clinician responses and evaluation framework for assessing LLM alignment with individual clinicians in patient message drafting, releasing expert-annotated dataset.

entry.title: Factored Value Functions for Graph-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ahmed Rashwan, Keith Briggs, Chris Budd, Lisa Kreusser

entry.summary: Introduces Diffusion Value Function (DVF) for graph-based multi-agent RL that assigns per-agent value components by diffusing rewards over influence graphs with temporal and spatial discounting, addressing credit assignment.

entry.title: Hierarchical Orthogonal Residual Spread for Precise Massive Editing in Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaojie Gu, Guangxu Chen, Yuheng Yang, Jingxin Han, Andi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HORSE, a model editing method using Hierarchical Orthogonal Residual Spread to reduce noisy gradients and enable stable large-scale edits to LLMs without expensive matrix optimization.

entry.title: Generative Scenario Rollouts for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Rajeev Yasarla, Deepti Hegde, Shizhong Han, Hsin-Pai Cheng, Yunxiao Shi, Meysam Sadeghigooghari, Shweta Mahajan, Apratim Bhattacharyya, Litian Liu, Risheek Garrepalli, Thomas Svantesson, Fatih Porikli, Hong Cai

entry.summary: Proposes GeRo, a framework for VLA models in autonomous driving that jointly performs planning and language-grounded future traffic scene generation through autoregressive rollouts.

entry.title: Massive Activations in DroPE: Evidence for Attention Reorganization

author.name: David Africa

entry.summary: Investigates how DroPE (Dropping Positional Embeddings) models differ from RoPE in their use of 'massive values' in attention, finding DroPE reduces concentration in Query tensors and is less dependent on these features.

entry.title: EvidFuse: Writing-Time Evidence Learning for Consistent Text-Chart Data Reporting

author.name: Huanxiang Lin, Qianyue Wang, Jinwu Hu, Bailin Chen, Qing Du, Mingkui Tan

entry.summary: Proposes EvidFuse, a training-free multi-agent framework enabling writing-time text-chart interleaved generation for data reports, addressing chart-text inconsistency in staged pipeline approaches.

entry.title: Towards Reliable ML Feature Engineering via Planning in Constrained-Topology of LLM Agents

author.name: Himanshu Thakur, Anusha Kamath, Anurag Muthyala, Dhwani Sanmukhani, Smruthi Mukund, Jay Katukuri

entry.summary: Proposes planner-guided multi-agent framework for reliable ML feature engineering that integrates team-specific tools and workflows with constrained topology for code generation.

entry.title: FAConvLSTM: Factorized-Attention ConvLSTM for Efficient Feature Extraction in Multivariate Climate Data

author.name: Francis Ndikum Nji, Jianwu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FAConvLSTM using factorized attention with 1x1 bottlenecks and separable spatial attention for efficient spatiotemporal feature extraction in climate data.

entry.title: Forcing and Diagnosing Failure Modes of Fourier Neural Operators Across Diverse PDE Families

author.name: Lennon Shikhman

entry.summary: Systematically stress-tests Fourier Neural Operators across five PDE families to identify failure modes including spectral bias, compounding rollout errors, and overfitting under distribution shifts.

entry.title: Discovery of sustainable energy materials via the machine-learned material space

author.name: Malte Grunert, Max Gro{\ss}mann, Erich Runge

entry.summary: Uses UMAP on graph attention network latent embeddings to show ML models capture interpretable representations of material space. Demonstrates discovery of sustainable alternatives for critical energy materials.

entry.title: Proof of Reasoning for Privacy Enhanced Federated Blockchain Learning at the Edge

author.name: James Calo and Benny Lo

entry.summary: Introduces Proof of Reasoning (PoR), a consensus mechanism for federated learning on blockchain using masked autoencoders for privacy preservation and defense against attacks.

entry.title: LLMs for Game Theory: Entropy-Guided In-Context Learning and Adaptive CoT Reasoning

author.name: Tommaso Felice Banfi and Sashenka Gamage

entry.summary: Proposes entropy-guided chain-of-thought reasoning framework for LLMs on game-theoretic tasks, dynamically adjusting retrieved examples and reasoning paths based on token uncertainty.

entry.title: A Unified 3D Object Perception Framework for Real-Time Outside-In Multi-Camera Systems

author.name: Yizhou Wang, Sameer Pusegaonkar, Yuxing Wang, Anqi Li, Vishal Kumar, Chetan Sethi, Ganapathy Aiyer, Yun He, Kartikay Thakkar, Swapnil Rathi, Bhushan Rupde, Zheng Tang, Sujit Biswas

entry.summary: Presents unified 3D object perception framework for multi-camera infrastructure systems, adapting Sparse4D with occlusion-aware ReID and using NVIDIA COSMOS for generative data augmentation.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: A Stability-Aware Metric for Multi-Horizon Forecasting

author.name: Chutian Ma, Grigorii Pomazkin, Giacinto Paolo Saggese, Paul Smith

entry.summary: Introduces forecast AC score measuring both multi-horizon accuracy and temporal stability in probabilistic forecasting, implementing as differentiable objective for ARIMA training.

entry.title: Neural Induction of Finite-State Transducers

author.name: Michael Ginn, Alexis Palmer, Mans Hulden

entry.summary: Introduces a novel method for automatically constructing finite-state transducers by extracting hidden state geometry from trained RNNs. Achieves up to 87% accuracy improvement over classical transducer learning on morphological inflection and G2P tasks.

entry.title: MMedExpert-R1: Strengthening Multimodal Medical Reasoning via Domain-Specific Adaptation and Clinical Guideline Reinforcement

author.name: Meidan Ding, Jipeng Zhang, Wenxuan Wang, Haiqin Zhong, Xiaoling Luo, Wenting Chen, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Presents MMedExpert-R1, a medical VLM using domain-specific LoRA modules and clinical guideline reinforcement learning. Constructs 10K high-quality samples with step-by-step reasoning traces across four specialties.

entry.title: Backdoor Attacks on Multi-modal Contrastive Learning

author.name: Simi D Kuniyilh, Rita Machacy

entry.summary: Provides comprehensive review of backdoor attacks in contrastive learning across vision, multimodal, graph, and federated settings. Analyzes threat models and defenses.

entry.title: Contextual Distributionally Robust Optimization with Causal and Continuous Structure: An Interpretable and Tractable Approach

author.name: Fenglin Zhang and Jie Wang

entry.summary: Develops Causal Sinkhorn DRO framework combining entropy-regularized Wasserstein distance with causal structure. Derives dual reformulation and proposes tractable neurosymbolic optimization.

entry.title: Predicting Biased Human Decision-Making with Large Language Models in Conversational Settings

author.name: Stephen Pilli and Vivek Nallur

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs can predict biased human decision-making in conversations. Finds GPT-4/GPT-5 can predict Framing Effect and Status Quo Bias, including load-bias interactions.

entry.title: H-AIM: Orchestrating LLMs, PDDL, and Behavior Trees for Hierarchical Multi-Robot Planning

author.name: Haishan Zeng, Peng Li

entry.summary: Proposes H-AIM combining LLMs, PDDL, and Behavior Trees for hierarchical multi-robot planning. Uses LLM for instruction parsing and problem generation, PDDL for planning, BTs for execution.

entry.title: Efficient Multilingual Name Type Classification Using Convolutional Networks

author.name: Davor Lauc

entry.summary: Presents Onomas-CNN X achieving 92.1% accuracy on multilingual name classification while being 46x faster than XLM-RoBERTa on CPU. Uses parallel convolution with depthwise-separable operations.

entry.title: Optimized Algorithms for Text Clustering with LLM-Generated Constraints

author.name: Chaoqi Jia, Weihong Wu, Longkun Guo, Zhigang Lu, Chao Chen, Kok-Leong Ong

entry.summary: Introduces a novel approach using LLMs to generate constraint sets rather than pairwise constraints for text clustering, improving query efficiency and reducing resource consumption. Demonstrates improved clustering accuracy over state-of-the-art methods.

entry.title: FSL-BDP: Federated Survival Learning with Bayesian Differential Privacy for Credit Risk Modeling

author.name: Sultan Amed, Tanmay Sen, Sayantan Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes FSL-BDP for credit risk modeling that combines federated learning with Bayesian differential privacy, modeling time-to-default rather than binary classification while preserving privacy across institutions.

entry.title: GMM-COMET: Continual Source-Free Universal Domain Adaptation via a Mean Teacher and Gaussian Mixture Model-Based Pseudo-Labeling

author.name: Pascal Schlachter and Bin Yang

entry.summary: Presents first study on continual source-free universal domain adaptation, where models adapt sequentially to multiple unlabeled target domains. Combines mean teacher and GMM-based pseudo-labeling.

entry.title: Democratizing planetary-scale analysis: An ultra-lightweight Earth embedding database for accurate and flexible global land monitoring

author.name: Shuang Chen, Jie Wang, Shuai Yuan, Jiayang Li, Yu Xia, Yuanhong Liao, Junbo Wei, Jincheng Yuan, Xiaoqing Xu, Xiaolin Zhu, Peng Zhu, Hongsheng Zhang, Yuyu Zhou, Haohuan Fu, Huabing Huang, Bin Chen, Fan Dai, Peng Gong

entry.summary: Presents ESD, an ultra-lightweight 30-meter resolution global Earth embedding database spanning 2000-2024, enabling planetary-scale analysis without massive computational resources.

entry.title: T$^\star$: Progressive Block Scaling for MDM Through Trajectory Aware RL
