Liu, Kartik Khandelwal, Sandeep Subramanian, Victor Jouault, Abhinav Rastogi, Adrien Sad\'e, Alan Jeffares, Albert Jiang, Alexandre Cahill, Alexandre Gavaudan, Alexandre Sablayrolles, Am\'elie H\'eliou, Amos You, Andy Ehrenberg, Andy Lo, Anton Eliseev, Antonia Calvi, Avinash Sooriyarachchi, Baptiste Bout, Baptiste Rozi\`ere, Baudouin De Monicault, Cl\'emence Lanfranchi, Corentin Barreau, Cyprien Courtot, Daniele Grattarola, Darius Dabert, Diego de las Casas, Elliot Chane-Sane, Faruk Ahmed, Gabrielle Berrada, Ga\"etan Ecrepont, Gauthier Guinet, Georgii Novikov, Guillaume Kunsch, Guillaume Lample, Guillaume Martin, Gunshi Gupta, Jan Ludziejewski, Jason Rute, Joachim Studnia, Jonas Amar, Jos\'ephine Delas, Josselin Somerville Roberts, Karmesh Yadav, Khyathi Chandu, Kush Jain, Laurence Aitchison, Laurent Fainsin, L\'eonard Blier, Lingxiao Zhao, Louis Martin, Lucile Saulnier, Luyu Gao, Maarten Buyl, Margaret Jennings, Marie Pellat, Mark Prins, Mathieu Poir\'ee, Mathilde Guillaumin, Matthieu Dinot, Matthieu Futeral, Maxime Darrin, Maximilian Augustin, Mia Chiquier, Michel Schimpf, Nathan Grinsztajn, Neha Gupta, Nikhil Raghuraman, Olivier Bousquet, Olivier Duchenne, Patricia Wang, Patrick von Platen, Paul Jacob, Paul Wambergue, Paula Kurylowicz, Pavankumar Reddy Muddireddy, Philom\`ene Chagniot, Pierre Stock, Pravesh Agrawal, Quentin Torroba, Romain Sauvestre, Roman Soletskyi, Rupert Menneer, Sagar Vaze, Samuel Barry, Sanchit Gandhi, Siddhant Waghjale, Siddharth Gandhi, Soham Ghosh, Srijan Mishra, Sumukh Aithal, Szymon Antoniak, Teven Le Scao, Th\'eo Cachet, Theo Simon Sorg, Thibaut Lavril, Thiziri Nait Saada, Thomas Chabal, Thomas Foubert, Thomas Robert, Thomas Wang, Tim Lawson, Tom Bewley, Tom Bewley, Tom Edwards, Umar Jamil, Umberto Tomasini, Valeriia Nemychnikova, Van Phung, Vincent Maladi\`ere, Virgile Richard, Wassim Bouaziz, Wen-Ding Li, William Marshall, Xinghui Li, Xinyu Yang, Yassine El Ouahidi, Yihan Wang, Yunhao Tang, Zaccharie Ramzi

entry.summary: Introduces Ministral 3 series from Mistral: efficient 3B/8B/14B parameter models with pretrained, instruction-tuned, and reasoning variants, using novel Cascade Distillation approach. Apache 2.0 license.

entry.title: Universal computation is intrinsic to language model decoding

author.name: Alex Lewandowski, Marlos C. Machado, Dale Schuurmans

entry.summary: Proves that autoregressive language model decoding is sufficient for universal computation - LMs can simulate any algorithm. Shows even randomly initialized LMs are Turing complete.

entry.title: Your Group-Relative Advantage Is Biased

author.name: Fengkai Yang, Zherui Chen, Xiaohan Wang, Xiaodong Lu, Jiajun Chai, Guojun Yin, Wei Lin, Shuai Ma, Fuzhen Zhuang, Deqing Wang, Yaodong Yang, Jianxin Li, Yikun Ban

entry.summary: Identifies fundamental bias in group-relative advantage estimation used by GRPO: systematically underestimates advantages for hard prompts and overestimates for easy ones, leading to imbalanced exploration.

entry.title: Reasoning Beyond Chain-of-Thought: A Latent Computational Mode in Large Language Models

author.name: Zhenghao He, Guangzhi Xiong, Bohan Liu, Sanchit Sinha, Aidong Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies latent features in LLMs causally associated with reasoning using Sparse Autoencoders. Steering single reasoning-related feature improves accuracy without explicit CoT, matching CoT performance in large models.

entry.title: Asymptotic Universal Alignment: A New Alignment Framework via Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Yang Cai, Weiqiang Zheng

entry.summary: Formalizes universal alignment through test-time scaling, introducing (k,f(k))-robust alignment requiring k-output models to achieve win rate f(k) against single-output models. Characterizes optimal convergence rate for asymptotic universal alignment.

entry.title: Surgical Refusal Ablation: Disentangling Safety from Intelligence via Concept-Guided Spectral Cleaning

author.name: Tony Cristofano

entry.summary: Introduces Surgical Refusal Ablation (SRA) using concept-guided spectral cleaning to disentangle refusal from capabilities, orthogonalizing refusal vectors against protected capability directions.

entry.title: Knowing But Not Doing: Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in LLMs

author.name: Jen-tse Huang, Jiantong Qin, Xueli Qiu, Sharon Levy, Michelle R. Kaufman, Mark Dredze

entry.summary: Introduces ValAct-15k dataset revealing that LLMs show near-perfect cross-model consistency in scenario-based moral decisions but high variability in questionnaire responses, demonstrating 'knowing but not doing' gap.

entry.title: RAVEN: Erasing Invisible Watermarks via Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Fahad Shamshad, Nils Lukas, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Proposes RAVEN, exposing vulnerability in invisible watermarks by reformulating removal as novel view synthesis, revealing that watermarks robust to standard attacks fail against view synthesis.

entry.title: Coverage Improvement and Fast Convergence of On-policy Preference Learning

author.name: Juno Kim, Jihun Yun, Jason D. Lee, Kwang-Sung Jun

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing on-policy DPO converges exponentially due to coverage improvement principle - each update moves to regions with better coverage, making subsequent data more informative.

entry.title: How Reliable are Confidence Estimators for Large Reasoning Models? A Systematic Benchmark on High-Stakes Domains

author.name: Reza Khanmohammadi, Erfan Miahi, Simerjot Kaur, Ivan Brugere, Charese H. Smiley, Kundan Thind, Mohammad M. Ghassemi

entry.summary: Introduces RMCB benchmark with 347K reasoning traces from 6 LRMs across high-stakes domains, conducting large-scale evaluation of 10+ confidence estimation methods for reasoning models.

entry.title: Towards Safer Mobile Agents: Scalable Generation and Evaluation of Diverse Scenarios for VLMs

author.name: Takara Taniguchi, Kuniaki Saito, Atsushi Hashimoto

entry.summary: Introduces HazardForge, scalable pipeline for generating diverse hazardous scenarios for VLM safety evaluation using image editing with layout decision algorithms.

entry.title: Playing Dumb: Detecting Sandbagging in Frontier LLMs via Consistency Checks

author.name: James Sullivan

entry.summary: Proposes an evaluation methodology for detecting sandbagging (intentionally underperforming on evals) using consistency checks between formal evaluation-style and casual question presentations, showing >50% accuracy drops in sandbagging model variants.

entry.title: Multiplex Thinking: Reasoning via Token-wise Branch-and-Merge

author.name: Yao Tang, Li Dong, Yaru Hao, Qingxiu Dong, Furu Wei, Jiatao Gu

entry.summary: Proposes Multiplex Thinking, a stochastic soft reasoning mechanism that samples K candidate tokens and aggregates embeddings into a single multiplex token, enabling soft exploration while preserving vocabulary prior.

entry.title: Discovery and Reinforcement of Tool-Integrated Reasoning Chains via Rollout Trees

author.name: Kun Li, Zenan Xu, Junan Li, Zengrui Jin, Jinghao Deng, Zexuan Qiu, Bo Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces DART, RL framework enabling spontaneous tool-use during long CoT reasoning without human annotation by constructing dynamic rollout trees to discover valid tool-use opportunities.

entry.title: Semantic Misalignment in Vision-Language Models under Perceptual Degradation

author.name: Guo Cheng

entry.summary: Systematically studies semantic misalignment in VLMs under realistic perception degradation for autonomous driving, revealing severe downstream failures from moderate segmentation quality drops.

entry.title: Rewarding the Rare: Uniqueness-Aware RL for Creative Problem Solving in LLMs

author.name: Zhiyuan Hu, Yucheng Wang, Yufei He, Jiaying Wu, Yilun Zhao, See-Kiong Ng, Cynthia Breazeal, Anh Tuan Luu, Hae Won Park, Bryan Hooi

entry.summary: Proposes uniqueness-aware RL that rewards rare correct reasoning strategies to prevent exploration collapse. Uses LLM judge to cluster rollouts by strategy and rewards novel correct approaches.

entry.title: STAR: Detecting Inference-time Backdoors in LLM Reasoning via State-Transition Amplification Ratio

author.name: Seong-Gyu Park, Sohee Park, Jisu Lee, Hyunsik Na, Daeseon Choi

entry.summary: Introduces STAR framework for detecting inference-time backdoors in LLM reasoning by analyzing output probability shifts. Exploits discrepancy where malicious paths have high posterior but low prior probability.

entry.title: KidVis: Do Multimodal Large Language Models Possess the Visual Perceptual Capabilities of a 6-Year-Old?

author.name: Xianfeng Wang, Kaiwei Zhang, Qi Jia, Zijian Chen, Guangtao Zhai, Xiongkuo Min

entry.summary: Introduces KidVis benchmark testing whether MLLMs possess basic visual capabilities of 6-7 year old children across six atomic visual capabilities, revealing stark performance disparity.

entry.title: Why AI Alignment Failure Is Structural: Learned Human Interaction Structures and AGI as an Endogenous Evolutionary Shock

author.name: Didier Sornette, Sandro Claudio Lera, Ke Wu

entry.summary: Argues LLM misalignment behaviors like deception reflect learned human interaction patterns rather than emergent agency, connecting to relational models theory and viewing AGI as endogenous evolutionary shock.

entry.title: KVzap: Fast, Adaptive, and Faithful KV Cache Pruning

author.name: Simon Jegou, Maximilian Jeblick

entry.summary: KVzap from NVIDIA achieves 2-4x KV cache compression with negligible accuracy loss through fast, input-adaptive pruning that works in both prefilling and decoding phases. State-of-the-art on KVpress leaderboard.

entry.title: Controlled LLM Training on Spectral Sphere

author.name: Tian Xie, Haoming Luo, Haoyu Tang, Yiwen Hu, Jason Klein Liu, Qingnan Ren, Yang Wang, Wayne Xin Zhao, Rui Yan, Bing Su, Chong Luo, Baining Guo

entry.summary: Spectral Sphere Optimizer (SSO) enforces strict module-wise spectral constraints on weights and updates, achieving full μP alignment. Includes muMuon variant for large-scale training.

entry.title: BenchOverflow: Measuring Overflow in Large Language Models via Plain-Text Prompts

author.name: Erin Feiglin, Nir Hutnik, Raz Lapid

entry.summary: Identifies 'Overflow' - a failure mode where plain-text prompts cause LLMs to generate excessive outputs, leading to increased costs, latency, and potential service degradation. Introduces BenchOverflow benchmark to measure this phenomenon.

entry.title: APEX-SWE

author.name: Abhi Kottamasu, Akul Datta, Aakash Barthwal, Chirag Mahapatra, Ajay Arun, Adarsh Hiremath, Brendan Foody, Bertie Vidgen

entry.summary: Introduces APEX-SWE benchmark for economically valuable software engineering work including integration tasks across cloud services and observability debugging tasks. Evaluates 8 frontier models showing significant room for improvement.

entry.title: Triplets Better Than Pairs: Towards Stable and Effective Self-Play Fine-Tuning for LLMs

author.name: Yibo Wang, Hai-Long Sun, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes T-SPIN, a triplet-based self-play fine-tuning method that addresses instability in SPIN by considering future advantages and eliminating reference policy misalignment, improving LLM adaptation with scarce expert data.

entry.title: Silence the Judge: Reinforcement Learning with Self-Verifier via Latent Geometric Clustering

author.name: Nonghai Zhang, Weitao Ma, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He, Jingwen Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Latent-GRPO, which derives intrinsic rewards from latent space geometry rather than external verifiers. Shows correct reasoning trajectories form dense clusters while incorrect ones scatter, enabling self-verification.

entry.title: When KV Cache Reuse Fails in Multi-Agent Systems: Cross-Candidate Interaction is Crucial for LLM Judges

author.name: Sichu Liang, Zhenglin Wang, Jiajia Chu, Pengfei Xia, Hui Zang, Deyu Zhou

entry.summary: Reveals that KV cache reuse strategies effective for generation agents fail for LLM judges in multi-agent systems, causing severe inconsistency despite stable accuracy. Introduces Judge Consistency Rate metric.

entry.title: Semantic Gravity Wells: Why Negative Constraints Backfire

author.name: Shailesh Rana

entry.summary: Presents first comprehensive mechanistic investigation of why LLMs fail at negative constraints, introducing 'semantic pressure' as a quantitative measure. Shows violation probability follows a tight logistic relationship with intrinsic token probability.

entry.title: Q-realign: Piggybacking Realignment on Quantization for Safe and Efficient LLM Deployment

author.name: Qitao Tan, Xiaoying Song, Ningxi Cheng, Ninghao Liu, Xiaoming Zhai, Lingzi Hong, Yanzhi Wang, Zhen Xiang, Geng Yuan

entry.summary: Q-realign restores safety alignment eroded by fine-tuning through post-training quantization, treating quantization as dual compression-safety objective. Decouples safety recovery from training workflow.

entry.title: VeriTaS: The First Dynamic Benchmark for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking

author.name: Mark Rothermel, Marcus Kornmann, Marcus Rohrbach, Anna Rohrbach

entry.summary: Introduces VeriTaS, the first dynamic benchmark for multimodal automated fact-checking designed to remain robust under LLM pretraining. Comprises 24,000 real-world claims from 108 professional fact-checkers.

entry.title: Towards Principled Design of Mixture-of-Experts Language Models under Memory and Inference Constraints

author.name: Seng Pei Liew, Kenta Shinzato, Yuyang Dong

entry.summary: Through systematic study, demonstrates that MoE model performance is determined by total parameters and expert sparsity ratio, not just active parameters. Shows larger expert counts slightly penalize performance by forcing dimension reductions.

entry.title: SnapGen++: Unleashing Diffusion Transformers for Efficient High-Fidelity Image Generation on Edge Devices

author.name: Dongting Hu, Aarush Gupta, Magzhan Gabidolla, Arpit Sahni, Huseyin Coskun, Yanyu Li, Yerlan Idelbayev, Ahsan Mahmood, Aleksei Lebedev, Dishani Lahiri, Anujraaj Goyal, Ju Hu, Mingming Gong, Sergey Tulyakov, Anil Kag

entry.summary: Presents SnapGen++, efficient diffusion transformer framework for edge devices combining adaptive global-local sparse attention, elastic training, and post-training quantization for mobile image generation.

entry.title: T3: Benchmarking Sycophancy and Skepticism in Causal Judgment

author.name: Edward Y. Chang

entry.summary: Introduces T3 benchmark for evaluating LLM causal judgment across Pearl's Ladder of Causality, identifying 'Skepticism Trap' in safety-tuned models and a 'Scaling Paradox' where larger GPT-5.2 underperforms GPT-4-Turbo on ambiguous counterfactuals.

entry.title: Moral Lenses, Political Coordinates: Towards Ideological Positioning of Morally Conditioned LLMs

author.name: Chenchen Yuan, Bolei Ma, Zheyu Zhang, Bardh Prenkaj, Frauke Kreuter, Gjergji Kasneci

entry.summary: Studies causal relationship between moral values and political positioning in LLMs by conditioning models to endorse/reject specific moral values and measuring resulting political orientation shifts via Political Compass Test.

entry.title: Reverse Flow Matching: A Unified Framework for Online Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion and Flow Policies

author.name: Zeyang Li, Sunbochen Tang, Navid Azizan

entry.summary: Proposes Reverse Flow Matching as unified framework for training diffusion and flow policies in online RL when target is unnormalized Boltzmann distribution. Unifies noise-expectation and gradient-expectation approaches.

entry.title: AdaJudge: Adaptive Multi-Perspective Judging for Reward Modeling

author.name: Yongliang Miao, Yangyang Liang, Mengnan Du

entry.summary: Proposes AdaJudge, a unified framework for reward modeling that adaptively refines backbone representations and uses multi-view pooling to better capture task-dependent preference signals for LLM alignment.

entry.title: Where Does Vision Meet Language? Understanding and Refining Visual Fusion in MLLMs via Contrastive Attention

author.name: Shezheng Song, Shasha Li, Jie Yu

entry.summary: Conducts systematic layer-wise analysis of how MLLMs integrate visual and textual information, revealing fusion emerges at specific layers with late-stage 'review' phenomenon and persistent high-attention noise on irrelevant regions.

entry.title: Reasoning over Precedents Alongside Statutes: Case-Augmented Deliberative Alignment for LLM Safety

author.name: Can Jin, Rui Wu, Tong Che, Qixin Zhang, Hongwu Peng, Jiahui Zhao, Zhenting Wang, Wenqi Wei, Ligong Han, Zhao Zhang, Yuan Cao, Ruixiang Tang, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates deliberative alignment for LLM safety, finding that case-based examples outperform explicit safety codes for open-source models. Shows explicit rules degrade helpfulness while cases improve balance.

entry.title: Small Symbols, Big Risks: Exploring Emoticon Semantic Confusion in Large Language Models

author.name: Weipeng Jiang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Juan Zhai, Shiqing Ma, Chao Shen, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Identifies 'emoticon semantic confusion' vulnerability where LLMs misinterpret ASCII emoticons to perform unintended destructive actions in code generation. Dataset of 3,757 test cases shows 38% average confusion ratio with 90% leading to harmful outcomes.

entry.title: Representations of Text and Images Align From Layer One

author.name: Ev\v{z}en Wybitul, Javier Rando, Florian Tram\`er, Stanislav Fort

entry.summary: Demonstrates that image-text alignment in vision-language models exists meaningfully from the first layer, contradicting established view that alignment only appears in late layers. Uses DeepDream-inspired synthesis.

entry.title: JudgeRLVR: Judge First, Generate Second for Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Jiangshan Duo, Hanyu Li, Hailin Zhang, Yudong Wang, Sujian Li, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes JudgeRLVR, a method that teaches LLMs to discriminate valid solutions before generating them, arguing that discriminative capability is a prerequisite for efficient reasoning. This addresses the verbose exploration problem in RLVR where models rely on trial-and-error rather than structured planning.

entry.title: ExpSeek: Self-Triggered Experience Seeking for Web Agents

author.name: Wenyuan Zhang, Xinghua Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Shuaiyi Nie, Bingli Wu, Juwei Yue, Tingwen Liu, Yongbin Li

entry.summary: Proposes ExpSeek for web agents that proactively seeks experience at appropriate moments rather than passively injecting it. Uses step-level entropy thresholds to determine when to retrieve experience during agent-environment interaction.

entry.title: Motion Attribution for Video Generation

author.name: Xindi Wu, Despoina Paschalidou, Jun Gao, Antonio Torralba, Laura Leal-Taix\'e, Olga Russakovsky, Sanja Fidler, Jonathan Lorraine

entry.summary: Introduces Motive, a motion-centric data attribution framework for video generation that identifies which training clips influence temporal dynamics. Uses motion-weighted loss masks for efficient influence computation.

entry.title: DeepResearch Bench II: Diagnosing Deep Research Agents via Rubrics from Expert Report

author.name: Ruizhe Li, Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Chiwei Zhu, Xiaorui Wang, Zhendong Mao

entry.summary: Introduces DeepResearch Bench II with 132 research tasks across 22 domains, featuring expert-derived rubrics for evaluating deep research system reports beyond coarse LLM-based criteria.

entry.title: RAGShaper: Eliciting Sophisticated Agentic RAG Skills via Automated Data Synthesis

author.name: Zhengwei Tao, Bo Li, Jialong Wu, Guochen Yan, Huanyao Zhang, Jiahao Xu, Haitao Mi, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RAGShaper for automated synthesis of agentic RAG training data using InfoCurator to build dense information trees with adversarial distractors for robust agent trajectories.

entry.title: Rescind: Countering Image Misconduct in Biomedical Publications with Vision-Language and State-Space Modeling

author.name: Soumyaroop Nandi, Prem Natarajan

entry.summary: Presents Rescind, first vision-language framework for generating and detecting biomedical image forgeries, combining diffusion-based synthesis with VL prompting across diverse modalities including microscopy and radiology.

entry.title: Global CoT Analysis: Initial attempts to uncover patterns across many chains of thought

author.name: Riya Tyagi

entry.summary: Introduces methods for analyzing patterns across many chains of thought collectively—semantic step clustering and algorithmic step clustering—to compress CoTs into reasoning graphs and predict model outputs from partial traces.

entry.title: ViDoRe V3: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation in Complex Real-World Scenarios

author.name: Ant\'onio Loison, Quentin Mac\'e, Antoine Edy, Victor Xing, Tom Balough, Gabriel Moreira, Bo Liu, Manuel Faysse, C\'eline Hudelot, Gautier Viaud

entry.summary: Introduces ViDoRe v3, a comprehensive multimodal RAG benchmark with 26,000 document pages and 3,099 human-verified queries in 6 languages, covering visual elements and multi-document synthesis.

entry.title: SafeRedir: Prompt Embedding Redirection for Robust Unlearning in Image Generation Models

author.name: Renyang Liu, Kangjie Chen, Han Qiu, Jie Zhang, Kwok-Yan Lam, Tianwei Zhang, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes SafeRedir for robust concept unlearning in image generation models by redirecting prompt embeddings rather than retraining. Aims to resist prompt paraphrasing and adversarial attacks while maintaining benign generation quality.

entry.title: To Retrieve or To Think? An Agentic Approach for Context Evolution

author.name: Rubing Chen, Jian Wang, Wenjie Li, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Introduces Agentic Context Evolution (ACE) for dynamically deciding whether to retrieve evidence or reason with existing knowledge, inspired by human metacognition. Uses orchestrator agent with majority voting.

entry.title: Calibration Is Not Enough: Evaluating Confidence Estimation Under Language Variations

author.name: Yuxi Xia, Dennis Ulmer, Terra Blevins, Yihong Liu, Hinrich Sch\"utze, Benjamin Roth

entry.summary: Presents comprehensive framework for evaluating confidence estimation beyond calibration, measuring consistency under semantic variations and appropriate change under answer differences.

entry.title: Route, Retrieve, Reflect, Repair: Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Visual Detection and Linguistic Reasoning in Medical Imaging

author.name: Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi, Rashedur Rahman, Siam Tahsin Bhuiyan, Sefatul Wasi, Ashraful Islam, Saadia Binte Alam, AKM Mahbubur Rahman

entry.summary: Proposes R^4, an agentic framework decomposing medical imaging into Router, Retriever, Reflector, and Repairer agents for iterative self-improvement with explicit error mode checking.

entry.title: Semantic Laundering in AI Agent Architectures: Why Tool Boundaries Do Not Confer Epistemic Warrant

author.name: Oleg Romanchuk, Roman Bondar

entry.summary: Formalizes 'semantic laundering' in LLM agent architectures where propositions acquire epistemic status by crossing trusted interfaces without proper justification, connecting to Gettier problems in epistemology.

entry.title: Revealing the Attention Floating Mechanism in Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Xin Dai, Pengcheng Huang, Zhenghao Liu, Shuo Wang, Yukun Yan, Chaojun Xiao, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Reveals 'Attention Floating' phenomenon in masked diffusion models where attention anchors shift dynamically across denoising steps, unlike ARMs' fixed attention sinks. Shows shallow layers build structural framework while deeper layers capture semantics.

entry.title: Evaluating Implicit Regulatory Compliance in LLM Tool Invocation via Logic-Guided Synthesis

author.name: Da Song, Yuheng Huang, Boqi Chen, Tianshuo Cong, Randy Goebel, Lei Ma, Foutse Khomh

entry.summary: LogiSafetyGen converts regulations to Linear Temporal Logic oracles for evaluating LLM tool use compliance, constructing LogiSafetyBench with 240 human-verified safety-critical tasks.

entry.title: VideoHEDGE: Entropy-Based Hallucination Detection for Video-VLMs via Semantic Clustering and Spatiotemporal Perturbations

author.name: Sushant Gautam, Cise Midoglu, Vajira Thambawita, Michael A. Riegler, P{\aa}l Halvorsen

entry.summary: Introduces VideoHEDGE for detecting hallucinations in video-capable VLMs using entropy-based reliability estimation extended to temporal inputs. Uses photometric and spatiotemporal perturbations with semantic clustering.

entry.title: TerraFormer: Automated Infrastructure-as-Code with LLMs Fine-Tuned via Policy-Guided Verifier Feedback

author.name: Prithwish Jana, Sam Davidson, Bhavana Bhasker, Andrey Kan, Anoop Deoras, Laurent Callot

entry.summary: Presents TerraFormer for automated Infrastructure-as-Code generation combining supervised fine-tuning with verifier-guided RL using formal verification feedback. Creates large NL-to-IaC datasets and outperforms 50x larger models.

entry.title: Safe Language Generation in the Limit

author.name: Antonios Anastasopoulos, Giuseppe Ateniese, Evgenios M. Kornaropoulos

entry.summary: Provides first theoretical treatment of safe language generation, proving safe identification is impossible but discussing tractable cases within learning-in-the-limit framework.

entry.title: WISE-Flow: Workflow-Induced Structured Experience for Self-Evolving Conversational Service Agents

author.name: Yuqing Zhou, Zhuoer Wang, Jie Yuan, Hong Wang, Samson Koelle, Ziwei Zhu, Wei Niu

entry.summary: Proposes WISE-Flow, workflow-centric framework that converts historical service interactions into reusable procedural experience for self-evolving LLM agents in user-facing services.

entry.title: Fine-Mem: Fine-Grained Feedback Alignment for Long-Horizon Memory Management

author.name: Weitao Ma, Xiaocheng Feng, Lei Huang, Xiachong Feng, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes Fine-Mem framework for fine-grained feedback alignment in memory management using chunk-level step rewards and evidence-anchored attribution to address reward sparsity.

entry.title: PosIR: Position-Aware Heterogeneous Information Retrieval Benchmark

author.name: Ziyang Zeng, Dun Zhang, Yu Yan, Xu Sun, Yudong Zhou, Yuqing Yang

entry.summary: Introduces PosIR, a comprehensive position-bias benchmark for information retrieval with 310 datasets across 10 languages and 31 domains, enabling systematic evaluation of how retrieval models handle position of relevant information.

entry.title: VLingNav: Embodied Navigation with Adaptive Reasoning and Visual-Assisted Linguistic Memory

author.name: Shaoan Wang, Yuanfei Luo, Xingyu Chen, Aocheng Luo, Dongyue Li, Chang Liu, Sheng Chen, Yangang Zhang, Junzhi Yu

entry.summary: Proposes VLingNav, VLA model for embodied navigation with adaptive chain-of-thought mechanism dynamically triggering reasoning and visual-assisted linguistic memory for long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: FinVault: Benchmarking Financial Agent Safety in Execution-Grounded Environments

author.name: Zhi Yang, Runguo Li, Qiqi Qiang, Jiashun Wang, Fangqi Lou, Mengping Li, Dongpo Cheng, Rui Xu, Heng Lian, Shuo Zhang, Xiaolong Liang, Xiaoming Huang, Zheng Wei, Zhaowei Liu, Xin Guo, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen, Liwen Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces FinVault, first execution-grounded security benchmark for financial agents with 31 regulatory-driven sandbox scenarios and state-writable databases for testing real operational risks.

entry.title: RULERS: Locked Rubrics and Evidence-Anchored Scoring for Robust LLM Evaluation

author.name: Yihan Hong, Huaiyuan Yao, Bolin Shen, Wanpeng Xu, Hua Wei, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces RULERS for LLM-as-a-Judge alignment, addressing rubric instability, unverifiable reasoning, and scale misalignment. Compiles natural language rubrics into executable specifications with versioned immutable bundles.

entry.title: Aggregating Diverse Cue Experts for AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Lei Tan, Shuwei Li, Mohan Kankanhalli, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Cue Aggregation Network (MCAN) for AI-generated image detection integrating multiple complementary cues including novel Chromatic Inconsistency feature for robust detection.

entry.title: Internal Deployment Gaps in AI Regulation

author.name: Joe Kwon, Stephen Casper

entry.summary: Analyzes gaps in US and EU frontier AI regulations regarding internally-deployed AI systems, identifying scope ambiguity, point-in-time compliance issues, and oversight gaps for internal deployment.

entry.title: Deconstructing Pre-training: Knowledge Attribution Analysis in MoE and Dense Models

author.name: Bo Wang, Junzhuo Li, Hong Chen, Yuanlin Chu, Yuxuan Fan, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Gated-LPI metric for neuron-level attribution in pre-training, comparing knowledge acquisition dynamics between MoE and dense architectures over 5T tokens of training.

entry.title: Sherry: Hardware-Efficient 1.25-Bit Ternary Quantization via Fine-grained Sparsification

author.name: Hong Huang, Decheng Wu, Qiangqiang Hu, Guanghua Yu, Jinhai Yang, Jianchen Zhu, Xue Liu, Dapeng Wu

entry.summary: Sherry achieves hardware-efficient 1.25-bit ternary quantization through 3:4 fine-grained sparsity, packing four weights into five bits. Resolves fundamental tension between bit-aligned packing and inference speed.

entry.title: Cultural Compass: A Framework for Organizing Societal Norms to Detect Violations in Human-AI Conversations

author.name: Myra Cheng, Vinodkumar Prabhakaran, Alice Oh, Hayk Stepanyan, Aishwarya Verma, Charu Kalia, Erin MacMurray van Liemt, Sunipa Dev

entry.summary: Cultural Compass introduces taxonomy of sociocultural norms distinguishing contexts, specifications, and enforcement mechanisms to evaluate AI model adherence across human-human and human-AI interactions.

entry.title: Demystifying the Slash Pattern in Attention: The Role of RoPE

author.name: Yuan Cheng, Fengzhuo Zhang, Yunlong Hou, Cunxiao Du, Chao Du, Tianyu Pang, Aixin Sun, Zhuoran Yang

entry.summary: Explains emergence of slash attention patterns (attention on Δ-th sub-diagonal) in LLMs through analysis of RoPE, identifying two characteristic conditions involving query-key similarity and frequency dominance.

entry.title: sui-1: Grounded and Verifiable Long-Form Summarization

author.name: Benedikt Droste, Jan Philipp Harries, Maximilian Idahl, Bj\"orn Pl\"uster

entry.summary: Introduces sui-1, a 24B parameter model that generates abstractive summaries with inline citations, enabling claim-to-source traceability. Uses synthetic data pipeline with chain-of-thought and multi-stage verification across 5 languages.

entry.title: WaveFormer: Frequency-Time Decoupled Vision Modeling with Wave Equation

author.name: Zishan Shu, Juntong Wu, Wei Yan, Xudong Liu, Hongyu Zhang, Chang Liu, Youdong Mao, Jie Chen

entry.summary: Proposes WaveFormer, treating visual feature maps as spatial signals governed by a wave equation. Derives closed-form frequency-time decoupled solution implemented as Wave Propagation Operator (WPO) for vision modeling.

entry.title: Provably Safe Reinforcement Learning using Entropy Regularizer

entry.title: D$^2$Plan: Dual-Agent Dynamic Global Planning for Complex Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning

entry.title: MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System

entry.title: WebTrap Park: An Automated Platform for Systematic Security Evaluation of Web Agents

entry.title: UR-Bench: A Benchmark for Multi-Hop Reasoning over Ultra-High-Resolution Images

author.name: Aviral Gupta, Armaan Sethi, Dhruv Kumar

author.name: Jungho Cho, Minbyul Jeong, Sungrae Park

entry.title: Closed-Loop LLM Discovery of Non-Standard Channel Priors in Vision Models

author.name: Tolgay Atinc Uzun, Dmitry Ignatov, Radu Timofte

entry.title: Mechanisms are Transferable: Data-Efficient Low-Resource Adaptation via Circuit-Targeted Supervised Fine-Tuning

entry.title: ORBIT: On-policy Exploration-Exploitation for Controllable Multi-Budget Reasoning

entry.title: Research Summary: January 13, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
AI safety and security research dominates today's significant findings, exposing critical vulnerabilities in reasoning transparency, defense mechanisms, and emerging agentic systems.

  • Reasoning Models Will Blatantly Lie demonstrates LRMs deny using hints despite experimentally verified usage—a fundamental challenge to CoT monitoring assumptions
  • Google DeepMind and UK AISI jointly present practical safety cases for control monitoring in frontier deployments
  • SFT/RL Non-decoupling proves mathematically that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning cannot be separated in post-training, explaining emergent reasoning behaviors
  • LoRA fails to remove backdoors due to spectral misalignment, exposing widely-used fine-tuning to persistent vulnerabilities

Security research reveals systemic weaknesses: prompt attack defenses learn surface heuristics rather than detecting harm, RAG systems remain vulnerable to indirect injection, and web automation agents face novel social engineering attacks via the AgentBait paradigm. On interpretability, Two Pathways to Truthfulness identifies distinct mechanisms for question-anchored and answer-anchored pathways underlying hallucinations, while Split Personality Training enables detection of hidden misalignment through trained honest personas.

entry.title: Reasoning Models Will Blatantly Lie About Their Reasoning

author.name: William Walden

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Large Reasoning Models will explicitly deny using hints in prompts even when directly asked, despite experiments proving they do use them. Extends prior work showing LRMs don't just omit information but actively lie about their reasoning.

author.name: Xueyan Niu, Bo Bai, Wei Han, Weixi Zhang

entry.summary: Proves that SFT and RL cannot be decoupled in LLM post-training: RL increases SFT loss under SFT optimality, and SFT lowers RL reward. Validates findings on Qwen3-0.6B.
