author.name: Nimrod Shabtay, Itamar Zimerman, Eli Schwartz, Raja Giryes

entry.summary: CLIMP presents the first fully Mamba-based contrastive vision-language model, replacing both vision and text encoders with Mamba architectures. Achieves 7.5% improvement on ImageNet-O over CLIP-ViT-B.

entry.title: More Images, More Problems? A Controlled Analysis of VLM Failure Modes

author.name: Anurag Das, Adrian Bulat, Alberto Baldrati, Ioannis Maniadis Metaxas, Bernt Schiele, Georgios Tzimiropoulos, Brais Martinez

entry.summary: MIMIC benchmark rigorously evaluates multi-image capabilities of LVLMs, revealing that models fail to aggregate information across images and struggle with multi-concept tracking. Provides diagnostic experiments identifying core weaknesses.

entry.title: Latent Space Communication via K-V Cache Alignment

author.name: Lucio M. Dery, Zohar Yahav, Henry Prior, Qixuan Feng, Jiajun Shen, Arthur Szlam

entry.summary: Proposes learning shared representation space that aligns k-v caches of multiple Gemma-2 models, creating high-bandwidth channel for collaboration without altering pre-trained parameters.

entry.title: ArenaRL: Scaling RL for Open-Ended Agents via Tournament-based Relative Ranking

author.name: Qiang Zhang, Boli Chen, Fanrui Zhang, Ruixue Ding, Shihang Wang, Qiuchen Wang, Yinfeng Huang, Haonan Zhang, Rongxiang Zhu, Pengyong Wang, Ailin Ren, Xin Li, Pengjun Xie, Jiawei Liu, Ning Guo, Jingren Zhou, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: Introduces ArenaRL, an RL framework for training agents on open-ended tasks using tournament-based relative ranking instead of pointwise scoring, addressing discrimination collapse in reward models.

entry.title: Artificial Entanglement in the Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models

author.name: Min Chen, Zihan Wang, Canyu Chen, Zeguan Wu, Manling Li, Junyu Liu

entry.summary: Applies quantum information theory concepts to understand LoRA effectiveness, introducing 'Artificial Entanglement' as entanglement entropy of neural network parameters measured through Matrix Product States.

entry.title: Safeguarding LLM Fine-tuning via Push-Pull Distributional Alignment

author.name: Haozhong Wang, Zhuo Li, Yibo Yang, He Zhao, Hongyuan Zha, Dandan Guo

entry.summary: SOT (Safety Optimal Transport) reframes safe fine-tuning as distribution-level alignment using push-pull mechanism: pulling toward safe distribution while pushing away from harmful patterns.

entry.title: d3LLM: Ultra-Fast Diffusion LLM using Pseudo-Trajectory Distillation

author.name: Yu-Yang Qian, Junda Su, Lanxiang Hu, Peiyuan Zhang, Zhijie Deng, Peng Zhao, Hao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces d3LLM using pseudo-trajectory distillation to teach diffusion LLMs which tokens can be decoded early, improving parallelism during training while enhancing accuracy during inference.

entry.title: MedRAGChecker: Claim-Level Verification for Biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yuelyu Ji, Min Gu Kwak, Hang Zhang, Xizhi Wu, Chenyu Li, Yanshan Wang

entry.summary: Framework for claim-level verification in biomedical RAG systems that decomposes LLM answers into atomic claims and verifies them against evidence and knowledge graphs. Addresses safety-critical hallucination in medical AI.

entry.title: Structured Reasoning for Large Language Models

author.name: Jinyi Han, Zixiang Di, Zishang Jiang, Ying Liao, Jiaqing Liang, Yongqi Wang, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Structured Reasoning that decouples reasoning into explicit components (Generate-Verify-Revise) with dynamic termination, addressing redundant verification in long reasoning chains.

entry.title: The Confidence Dichotomy: Analyzing and Mitigating Miscalibration in Tool-Use Agents

author.name: Weihao Xuan, Qingcheng Zeng, Heli Qi, Yunze Xiao, Junjue Wang, Naoto Yokoya

entry.summary: Reveals confidence dichotomy in tool-use agents where evidence tools induce overconfidence while computation tools cause underconfidence. Proposes mitigation strategies.

entry.title: ReinPool: Reinforcement Learning Pooling Multi-Vector Embeddings for Retrieval System

author.name: Sungguk Cha, DongWook Kim, Mintae Kim, Youngsub Han, Byoung-Ki Jeon, Sangyeob Lee

entry.summary: RL framework for learning to pool multi-vector embeddings into compact representations, reducing index sizes by >1000x while maintaining retrieval quality through NDCG-based rewards.

entry.title: Walk the PLANC: Physics-Guided RL for Agile Humanoid Locomotion on Constrained Footholds

author.name: Min Dai, William D. Compton, Junheng Li, Lizhi Yang, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Walk the PLANC combines physics-based optimization with RL for humanoid locomotion on constrained footholds like stepping stones. Physics guidance enables precise foothold placement that pure RL misses.

entry.title: ReliabilityBench: Evaluating LLM Agent Reliability Under Production-Like Stress Conditions

author.name: Aayush Gupta

entry.summary: ReliabilityBench evaluates LLM agent reliability across three dimensions: consistency (pass^k), robustness to perturbations, and fault tolerance under API failures. Introduces chaos-engineering-style fault injection.

entry.title: Circuit Mechanisms for Spatial Relation Generation in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Binxu Wang, Jingxuan Fan, Xu Pan

entry.summary: Mechanistic interpretability study of how Diffusion Transformers generate spatial relations. Finds different mechanisms emerge depending on text encoder choice - with semantic encoders, dedicated attention heads encode relations.

entry.title: LLMRouterBench: A Massive Benchmark and Unified Framework for LLM Routing

author.name: Hao Li, Yiqun Zhang, Zhaoyan Guo, Chenxu Wang, Shengji Tang, Qiaosheng Zhang, Yang Chen, Biqing Qi, Peng Ye, Lei Bai, Zhen Wang, Shuyue Hu

entry.summary: LLMRouterBench: Large-scale benchmark (400K instances, 21 datasets, 33 models) with unified framework for LLM routing. Finds many routing methods perform similarly and commercial routers don't reliably outperform baselines.

entry.title: SPINAL -- Scaling-law and Preference Integration in Neural Alignment Layers

author.name: Arion Das, Partha Pratim Saha, Amit Dhanda, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Amitava Das

entry.summary: Introduces SPINAL, a diagnostic measuring how DPO alignment reshapes LLM representations across depth, revealing that preference gradients concentrate in final decoder blocks (layers 21-30).

entry.title: Beyond Perfect Scores: Proof-by-Contradiction for Trustworthy Machine Learning

author.name: Dushan N. Wadduwage, Dineth Jayakody, Leonidas Zimianitis

entry.summary: Introduces a trustworthiness test using stochastic proof-by-contradiction: trains on permuted labels to detect if models rely on spurious correlations. If accuracy persists on permuted labels, indicates shortcut learning.

entry.title: The Need for a Socially-Grounded Persona Framework for User Simulation

author.name: Pranav Narayanan Venkit, Yu Li, Yada Pruksachatkun, Chien-Sheng Wu

entry.summary: SCOPE framework shows demographic-only personas explain only ~1.5% variance in human responses; adding sociopsychological facets significantly improves behavioral prediction in LLM simulation.

entry.title: PRPO: Aligning Process Reward with Outcome Reward in Policy Optimization

author.name: Ruiyi Ding, Yongxuan Lv, Xianhui Meng, Jiahe Song, Chao Wang, Chen Jiang, Yuan Cheng

entry.summary: PRPO combines process reward model scores with outcome rewards in policy optimization, segmenting reasoning sequences and normalizing PRM scores into token-level advantages.

entry.title: Seeing Right but Saying Wrong: Inter- and Intra-Layer Refinement in MLLMs without Training

author.name: Shezheng Song, Shasha Li, Jie Yu

entry.summary: Identifies 'seeing right but saying wrong' phenomenon in MLLMs where deeper layers attend correctly but predictions are misled by noisy earlier layers. Proposes DualPD, a training-free dual-perspective decoding refinement.

entry.title: DeeperBrain: A Neuro-Grounded EEG Foundation Model Towards Universal BCI

author.name: Jiquan Wang, Sha Zhao, Yangxuan Zhou, Yiming Kang, Shijian Li, Gang Pan

entry.summary: Proposes DeeperBrain, a neuro-grounded EEG foundation model integrating volume conduction-aware encoding and oscillatory dynamics into architecture design for universal BCIs.

entry.title: Are LLM Decisions Faithful to Verbal Confidence?

author.name: Jiawei Wang, Yanfei Zhou, Siddartha Devic, Deqing Fu

entry.summary: Introduces RiskEval to test whether LLMs adjust abstention based on error penalties, finding models are neither cost-aware in confidence nor strategic in abstention decisions.

entry.title: Hidden Monotonicity: Explaining Deep Neural Networks via their DC Decomposition

author.name: Jakob Paul Zimmermann, Georg Loho

entry.summary: Proposes SplitCAM and SplitLRP, saliency methods exploiting decomposition of ReLU networks into monotone convex parts. Achieves SOTA results on ImageNet-S across Quantus metrics for VGG16 and ResNet18.

entry.title: What Matters When Building Universal Multilingual Named Entity Recognition Models?

author.name: Jonas Golde, Patrick Haller, Alan Akbik

entry.summary: Conducts extensive systematic experiments on multilingual NER across architectures, backbones, training objectives, and data composition. Finds many design decisions made without systematic justification.

entry.title: Steer Model beyond Assistant: Controlling System Prompt Strength via Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Yijiang River Dong, Tiancheng Hu, Zheng Hui, Nigel Collier

entry.summary: Proposes training-free method for controlling system prompt adherence by contrasting logits from target and default prompts. Achieves +8.5 strict accuracy on IFEval, +45pp refusal rate modulation.

entry.title: Structured Episodic Event Memory

author.name: Zhengxuan Lu, Dongfang Li, Yukun Shi, Beilun Wang, Longyue Wang, Baotian Hu

entry.summary: Proposes SEEM, hierarchical memory architecture for LLM agents combining graph memory for relational facts with episodic memory for narrative progression, based on cognitive frame theory.

entry.title: Will it Merge? On The Causes of Model Mergeability

author.name: Adir Rahamim, Asaf Yehudai, Boaz Carmeli, Leshem Choshen, Yosi Mass, Yonatan Belinkov

entry.summary: Investigates factors determining model mergeability, proposing a measurable definition and finding that base model knowledge is the dominant factor—models fine-tuned on instances the base knows better merge more successfully.

entry.title: TreePS-RAG: Tree-based Process Supervision for Reinforcement Learning in Agentic RAG

author.name: Tianhua Zhang, Kun Li, Junan Li, Yunxiang Li, Hongyin Luo, Xixin Wu, James Glass, Helen Meng

entry.summary: Online tree-based reinforcement learning framework for agentic RAG that enables step-wise credit assignment while using only outcome-based rewards through process supervision.

entry.title: When Abundance Conceals Weakness: Knowledge Conflict in Multilingual Models

author.name: Jiaqi Zhao, Qiang Huang, Haodong Chen, Xiaoxing You, Jun Yu

entry.summary: Framework examining how multilingual LLMs reconcile conflicting internal beliefs with multilingual external evidence across four progressive conflict scenarios.

entry.title: The Roots of Performance Disparity in Multilingual Language Models: Intrinsic Modeling Difficulty or Design Choices?

author.name: Chen Shani, Yuval Reif, Nathan Roll, Dan Jurafsky, Ekaterina Shutova

entry.summary: Survey examining why multilingual LLMs show performance disparities, distinguishing intrinsic linguistic difficulty from modeling artifacts across tokenization, encoding, and parameter sharing.

entry.title: Order in the Evaluation Court: A Critical Analysis of NLG Evaluation Trends

author.name: Jing Yang, Nils Feldhus, Salar Mohtaj, Leonhard Hennig, Qianli Wang, Eleni Metheniti, Sherzod Hakimov, Charlott Jakob, Veronika Solopova, Konrad Rieck, David Schlangen, Sebastian M\"oller, Vera Schmitt

entry.summary: Meta-analysis of NLG evaluation across 14,171 papers over 6 years revealing task divergence: dialogue shifting to LLM-judges (>40%) while MT remains locked to n-gram metrics.

entry.title: Beyond External Guidance: Unleashing the Semantic Richness Inside Diffusion Transformers for Improved Training

author.name: Lingchen Sun, Rongyuan Wu, Zhengqiang Zhang, Ruibin Li, Yujing Sun, Shuaizheng Liu, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Self-Transcendence enables Diffusion Transformers to guide their own training without external semantic features (like DINO). Shows that slow convergence stems from shallow layer representation learning and proposes internal feature supervision.

entry.title: PALM: Progress-Aware Policy Learning via Affordance Reasoning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yuanzhe Liu, Jingyuan Zhu, Yuchen Mo, Gen Li, Xu Cao, Jin Jin, Yifan Shen, Zhengyuan Li, Tianjiao Yu, Wenzhen Yuan, Fangqiang Ding, Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: PALM structures VLA policy learning around affordance reasoning and subtask progress tracking for long-horizon manipulation. Distills interaction-centric affordance representations for task-relevant cues.

entry.title: The AI Cognitive Trojan Horse: How Large Language Models May Bypass Human Epistemic Vigilance

author.name: Andrew D. Maynard

entry.summary: Proposes 'Cognitive Trojan Horse' hypothesis: LLMs may be optimized to present characteristics that bypass human epistemic vigilance mechanisms evolved to evaluate information sources.

entry.title: A Large-Scale Study on the Development and Issues of Multi-Agent AI Systems

author.name: Daniel Liu, Krishna Upadhyay, Vinaik Chhetri, A. B. Siddique, Umar Farooq

entry.summary: First large-scale empirical study of multi-agent AI systems (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen), analyzing 42K+ commits and 4.7K+ issues to identify development patterns and maintenance challenges.

entry.title: SecureCAI: Injection-Resilient LLM Assistants for Cybersecurity Operations

author.name: Mohammed Himayath Ali, Mohammed Aqib Abdullah, Mohammed Mudassir Uddin, Shahnawaz Alam

entry.summary: SecureCAI extends Constitutional AI with security-aware guardrails and Direct Preference Optimization to defend LLM assistants against prompt injection in cybersecurity operations.

entry.title: Rational Synthesizers or Heuristic Followers? Analyzing LLMs in RAG-based Question-Answering

author.name: Atharv Naphade

entry.summary: GroupQA dataset (1,635 questions, 15,058 documents) for studying how LLMs aggregate conflicting evidence in RAG. Finds paraphrasing more persuasive than independent support; models favor agreeing sources over quality.

entry.title: SafePro: Evaluating the Safety of Professional-Level AI Agents

author.name: Kaiwen Zhou, Shreedhar Jangam, Ashwin Nagarajan, Tejas Polu, Suhas Oruganti, Chengzhi Liu, Ching-Chen Kuo, Yuting Zheng, Sravana Narayanaraju, Xin Eric Wang

entry.summary: SafePro benchmark for evaluating safety alignment of AI agents performing professional activities. Features high-complexity decision-making tasks with potential consequences for misaligned behavior.

entry.title: Dr. Zero: Self-Evolving Search Agents without Training Data

author.name: Zhenrui Yue, Kartikeya Upasani, Xianjun Yang, Suyu Ge, Shaoliang Nie, Yuning Mao, Zhe Liu, Dong Wang

entry.summary: Dr. Zero enables search agents to self-evolve without training data through feedback loop where proposer generates diverse questions to train solver. Achieves competitive performance without seed data.

entry.title: The Impact of Post-training on Data Contamination

author.name: Muhammed Yusuf Kocyigit, Caglar Yildirim

entry.summary: Controlled study showing data contamination persists through post-training stages (SFT, GRPO). Finds contaminated models inflate performance, and post-training without contamination does not remove pre-training contamination effects.

entry.title: Projecting Out the Malice: A Global Subspace Approach to LLM Detoxification

author.name: Zenghao Duan, Zhiyi Yin, Zhichao Shi, Liang Pang, Shaoling Jing, Zihe Huang, Jiayi Wu, Yu Yan, Jingcheng Deng, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes a global subspace approach to LLM detoxification that projects out entire toxic subspaces rather than individual toxic vectors, addressing the limitation that removed vectors can be reconstructed from non-toxic vectors.

entry.title: Are LLMs Vulnerable to Preference-Undermining Attacks (PUA)? A Factorial Analysis Methodology for Diagnosing the Trade-off between Preference Alignment and Real-World Validity

author.name: Hongjun An, Yiliang Song, Jiangan Chen, Jiawei Shao, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Investigates Preference-Undermining Attacks (PUA) where manipulative prompts exploit aligned LLMs' desire to please users at the expense of truthfulness, proposing factorial evaluation for diagnosing this trade-off.

entry.title: Plasticity vs. Rigidity: The Impact of Low-Rank Adapters on Reasoning on a Micro-Budget

author.name: Zohaib Khan, Omer Tafveez, Zoha Hayat Bhatti

entry.summary: Studies how adapter rank in LoRA affects reasoning capabilities in small models (<1.5B) under extreme resource constraints (single GPU, <24 hours). Finds high-rank adapters (r=256) unlock significant plasticity while low-rank (r=8) fails.

entry.title: SecMoE: Communication-Efficient Secure MoE Inference via Select-Then-Compute

author.name: Bowen Shen, Yuyue Chen, Peng Yang, Bin Zhang, Xi Zhang, Zoe L. Jiang

entry.summary: SecMoE enables privacy-preserving MoE inference through a select-then-compute paradigm that hides which expert is activated, protecting token-level privacy in two-party computation.

entry.title: Watching, Reasoning, and Searching: A Video Deep Research Benchmark on Open Web for Agentic Video Reasoning

author.name: Chengwen Liu, Xiaomin Yu, Zhuoyue Chang, Zhe Huang, Shuo Zhang, Heng Lian, Kunyi Wang, Rui Xu, Sen Hu, Jianheng Hou, Hao Peng, Chengwei Qin, Xiaobin Hu, Hong Peng, Ronghao Chen, Huacan Wang

entry.summary: VideoDR benchmark for video-conditioned open-domain QA requiring cross-frame visual anchor extraction, iterative web retrieval, and multi-hop reasoning over joint video-web evidence.

entry.title: PulseMind: A Multi-Modal Medical Model for Real-World Clinical Diagnosis

author.name: Jiao Xu, Junwei Liu, Jiangwei Lao, Qi Zhu, Yunpeng Zhao, Congyun Jin, Shinan Liu, Zhihong Lu, Lihe Zhang, Xin Chen, Jian Wang, Ping Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PulseMind, a multi-modal medical diagnostic model family with MediScope dataset (98K consultations, 601K images) spanning 10+ clinical departments for real-world diagnosis.

entry.title: A Model of Artificial Jagged Intelligence

author.name: Joshua Gans

entry.summary: Develops economic model of Artificial Jagged Intelligence (AJI) explaining why AI performance varies dramatically across similar tasks, framing adoption as information problem with local reliability concerns.

entry.title: Forget Many, Forget Right: Scalable and Precise Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models

author.name: Kaiyuan Deng, Gen Li, Yang Xiao, Bo Hui, Xiaolong Ma

entry.summary: Proposes ScaPre for scalable concept unlearning in diffusion models with spectral trace regularization and geometry alignment to handle conflicting updates and prevent collateral damage.

entry.title: Teach Diffusion Language Models to Learn from Their Own Mistakes

author.name: Liming Liu, Binxuan Huang, Xin Liu, Bing Yin, Tuo Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Decoupled Self-Correction (DSC) for masked diffusion language models, training a specialized correction head after freezing the base model to maintain generation quality with fewer inference steps.

entry.title: AntiPaSTO: Self-Supervised Steering of Moral Reasoning

author.name: Michael J. Clark

entry.summary: Introduces AntiPaSTO for self-supervised steering of moral reasoning in LLMs using anti-parallel representation separation without preference labels.

entry.title: {\dag}DAGGER: Distractor-Aware Graph Generation for Executable Reasoning in Math Problems

author.name: Zabir Al Nazi, Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Sudipta Kar

entry.summary: Introduces DISTRACTMATH-BN, a Bangla benchmark testing LLM robustness to irrelevant context in math problems. Proposes DAGGER, which reformulates math as executable graph generation, improving performance under distractors.

entry.title: PFT: Phonon Fine-tuning for Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials

author.name: Teddy Koker, Abhijeet Gangan, Mit Kotak, Jaime Marian, Tess Smidt

entry.summary: Introduces Phonon Fine-Tuning (PFT) for machine learned interatomic potentials, directly supervising second-order force constants by matching MLIP Hessians to DFT-computed values.

entry.title: DiffER: Diffusion Entity-Relation Modeling for Reversal Curse in Diffusion Large Language Models

author.name: Shaokai He, Kaiwen Wei, Xinyi Zeng, Xiang Chen, Xue Yang, Zhenyang Li, Jiang Zhong, Yu Tian

entry.summary: Shows Diffusion LLMs also suffer from reversal curse despite bidirectional training, identifying three causes: entity fragmentation, data asymmetry, and missing relations. Proposes DiffER solution.

entry.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of 3D Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Chao Liu, Ngai-Man Cheung

entry.summary: First systematic study of adversarial robustness in 3D Vision-Language Models, proposing Vision Attack and Language Attack strategies and demonstrating significant vulnerabilities in PointLLM and GPT4Point.

entry.title: Leveraging 3D Representation Alignment and RGB Pretrained Priors for LiDAR Scene Generation

author.name: Nicolas Sereyjol-Garros, Ellington Kirby, Victor Besnier, Nermin Samet

entry.summary: R3DPA introduces the first method to transfer image-pretrained priors to LiDAR scene generation by aligning intermediate features with self-supervised 3D representations. Achieves state-of-the-art results on LiDAR synthesis.

entry.title: Pro or Average Joe? Do models infer our technical ability and can we control this judgement?

author.name: tobypullan

entry.summary: Research investigating whether LLMs internally model users' technical ability (expert vs novice) and how this affects responses. Trained probes achieved 88.3% accuracy in detecting user ability classification, outperforming direct model queries, and demonstrated ability to steer model behavior via activation manipulation.

entry.title: ENTRA: Entropy-Based Redundancy Avoidance in Large Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Ruichu Cai, Haopeng Du, Qingwen Lin, Yutong Chen, Zijian Li, Boyan Xu

entry.summary: ENTRA: Entropy-based training framework suppressing redundant reasoning in Large Reasoning Models. Uses Bidirectional Importance Estimation to identify and prune redundant tokens while preserving performance.

entry.title: What Users Leave Unsaid: Under-Specified Queries Limit Vision-Language Models

author.name: Dasol Choi, Guijin Son, Hanwool Lee, Minhyuk Kim, Hyunwoo Ko, Teabin Lim, Ahn Eungyeol, Jungwhan Kim, Seunghyeok Hong, Youngsook Song

entry.summary: HAERAE-Vision benchmark of 653 real-world underspecified queries shows even GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro achieve under 50%. Query explicitation alone yields 8-22 point improvements.

entry.title: How Context Shapes Truth: Geometric Transformations of Statement-level Truth Representations in LLMs

author.name: Shivam Adarsh, Maria Maistro, Christina Lioma

entry.summary: Studies how context affects truth representations in LLMs by measuring directional changes in truth vectors, finding vectors are orthogonal in early layers, converge in middle layers, and context increases truth vector magnitude.

entry.title: Benchmarking Egocentric Clinical Intent Understanding Capability for Medical Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Shaonan Liu, Guo Yu, Xiaoling Luo, Shiyi Zheng, Wenting Chen, Jie Liu, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Introduces MedGaze-Bench, using clinician gaze patterns as a 'Cognitive Cursor' to evaluate medical MLLM understanding of clinical intent across surgery, emergency, and diagnostic scenarios.

entry.title: BiasLab: A Multilingual, Dual-Framing Framework for Robust Measurement of Output-Level Bias in Large Language Models

author.name: William Guey, Wei Zhang, Pei-Luen Patrick Rau, Pierrick Bougault, Vitor D. de Moura, Bertan Ucar, Jose O. Gomes

entry.summary: BiasLab provides model-agnostic bias evaluation using dual-framing probe pairs with deterministic target substitution, enabling consistent multilingual bias measurement across LLMs.

entry.title: Safe-FedLLM: Delving into the Safety of Federated Large Language Models

author.name: Mingxiang Tao, Yu Tian, Wenxuan Tu, Yue Yang, Xue Yang, Xiangyan Tang

entry.summary: Safe-FedLLM investigates security of LLMs in federated learning, finding models vulnerable to malicious clients but LoRA weights show filterable behavioral patterns.

entry.title: Adaptive Layer Selection for Layer-Wise Token Pruning in LLM Inference

author.name: Rei Taniguchi, Yuyang Dong, Makoto Onizuka, Chuan Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes ASL, a training-free method for adaptive layer selection in KV cache reduction that exploits token importance variance across layers.

entry.title: Video Evidence to Reasoning Efficient Video Understanding via Explicit Evidence Grounding

author.name: Yanxiang Huang, Guohua Gao, Zhaoyang Wei, Jianyuan Ni

entry.summary: Chain of Evidence (CoE) framework decouples visual grounding from reasoning in video understanding LVLMs. Uses lightweight Evidence Grounding Module and RL-optimized Evidence-Anchoring Protocol to reduce computation while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Lies, Damned Lies, and Proofs: Formal Methods are not Slopless

author.name: Quinn

entry.summary: Argues that formal verification/proofs can still be 'sloppy' and that formality doesn't guarantee correctness for AI safety. Challenges assumption that formal methods provide reliable safety guarantees.

entry.title: Seeing through the Conflict: Transparent Knowledge Conflict Handling in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Hua Ye, Siyuan Chen, Ziqi Zhong, Canran Xiao, Haoliang Zhang, Yuhan Wu, Fei Shen

entry.summary: TCR framework for transparent conflict resolution in RAG: disentangles semantic match from factual consistency, estimates self-answerability, feeds signals through weighted soft-prompt. Improves conflict detection by 5-18 F1.

entry.title: OpenTinker: Separating Concerns in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Siqi Zhu, Jiaxuan You

entry.summary: OpenTinker: RL infrastructure separating concerns across algorithm design, execution, and agent-environment interaction. Includes centralized scheduler for training/inference workloads over shared resources.

entry.title: MixDPO: Modeling Preference Strength for Pluralistic Alignment

author.name: Saki Imai, Pedram Heydari, Anthony Sicilia, Asteria Kaeberlein, Katherine Atwell, Malihe Alikhani

entry.summary: MixDPO generalizes DPO by modeling variation in preference strength across training examples using mixed logit, inspired by behavioral economics discrete choice theory.

entry.title: Tone Matters: The Impact of Linguistic Tone on Hallucination in VLMs

author.name: Weihao Hong, Zhiyuan Jiang, Bingyu Shen, Xinlei Guan, Yangyi Feng, Meng Xu, Boyang Li

entry.summary: Investigates how prompt phrasing and linguistic tone systematically induce hallucinations in Vision-Language Models, introducing Ghost-100 dataset to study prompt pressure effects.

entry.title: MemGovern: Enhancing Code Agents through Learning from Governed Human Experiences

author.name: Qihao Wang, Ziming Cheng, Shuo Zhang, Fan Liu, Rui Xu, Heng Lian, Kunyi Wang, Xiaoming Yu, Jianghao Yin, Sen Hu, Yue Hu, Shaolei Zhang, Yanbing Liu, Ronghao Chen, Huacan Wang

entry.summary: MemGovern transforms raw GitHub issue data into structured 'experience cards' that help software engineering agents learn from historical human debugging experience through agentic search.

entry.title: MEDVISTAGYM: A Scalable Training Environment for Thinking with Medical Images via Tool-Integrated Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Meng Lu, Yuxing Lu, Yuchen Zhuang, Megan Mullins, Yang Xie, Guanghua Xiao, Charles Fleming, Wenqi Shi, Xuan Wang

entry.summary: MedVistaGym is a training environment for medical VLMs to learn tool-integrated visual reasoning through iterative visual interaction, addressing limitations of static single-pass inference.

entry.title: Beyond Variance: Knowledge-Aware LLM Compression via Fisher-Aligned Subspace Diagnostics

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: FASC identifies knowledge-critical dimensions for LLM compression using Fisher Information Matrix, addressing gradient-blind limitations of SVD that ignore factual knowledge preservation.

entry.title: Certainty-Guided Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Dynamic Thinking Budget Approach

author.name: Jo\~ao Paulo Nogueira, Wentao Sun, Alonso Silva, Laith Zumot

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic thinking budget where a critic model assesses reasoning certainty to determine when to terminate, inspired by GAN generator/discriminator framework.

entry.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Visual AutoRegressive modeling by Searching Representative Samples

author.name: Weidong Tang, Xinyan Wan, Siyu Li, Xiumei Wang

entry.summary: VAR-Scaling introduces first inference-time scaling framework for visual autoregressive models, overcoming discrete latent space barrier through kernel density estimation mapping.

entry.title: FlyCo: Foundation Model-Empowered Drones for Autonomous 3D Structure Scanning in Open-World Environments

author.name: Chen Feng, Guiyong Zheng, Tengkai Zhuang, Yongqian Wu, Fangzhan He, Haojia Li, Juepeng Zheng, Shaojie Shen, Boyu Zhou

entry.summary: FlyCo uses foundation models for prompt-driven autonomous 3D structure scanning by drones in open-world environments. Translates human prompts into adaptive scanning flight plans.

entry.title: CBMAS: Cognitive Behavioral Modeling via Activation Steering

author.name: Ahmed H. Ismail, Anthony Kuang, Ayo Akinkugbe, Kevin Zhu, Sean O'Brien

entry.summary: CBMAS framework enables continuous diagnostic analysis of activation steering in LLMs, revealing tipping points where small interventions flip model behavior. Bridges behavioral evaluation with mechanistic understanding.

entry.title: Does Inference Scaling Improve Reasoning Faithfulness? A Multi-Model Analysis of Self-Consistency Tradeoffs

author.name: Deep Mehta

entry.summary: Investigates whether inference scaling via self-consistency improves reasoning faithfulness across four frontier models (GPT-5.2, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini-3-flash, DeepSeek-v3.2) on GSM8K.

entry.title: No More Stale Feedback: Co-Evolving Critics for Open-World Agent Learning

author.name: Zhicong Li, Lingjie Jiang, Yulan Hu, Xingchen Zeng, Yixia Li, Xiangwen Zhang, Guanhua Chen, Zheng Pan, Xin Li, Yong Liu

entry.summary: ECHO framework jointly optimizes policy and critic through synchronized co-evolutionary loop. Critic generates diagnoses for trajectories, followed by policy rollouts, with online critic refinement.

entry.title: Group Pattern Selection Optimization: Let LRMs Pick the Right Pattern for Reasoning

author.name: Hanbin Wang, Jingwei Song, Jinpeng Li, Fei Mi, Lifeng Shang

entry.summary: GPSO extends GRPO with multi-pattern rollouts, letting reasoning models select optimal high-level patterns (direct solution, reflection, exploration) per problem through verifier-guided selection.

entry.title: Active Evaluation of General Agents: Problem Definition and Comparison of Baseline Algorithms

author.name: Marc Lanctot, Kate Larson, Ian Gemp, Michael Kaisers

entry.summary: Formalizes active evaluation of general agents across multiple tasks, proposing algorithms that choose which tasks and agents to evaluate next to minimize samples needed for accurate ranking. From notable DeepMind researchers including Lanctot, Larson, and Kaisers.

entry.title: Automated QoR improvement in OpenROAD with coding agents

author.name: Amur Ghose, Junyeong Jang, Andrew B. Kahng, Jakang Lee

entry.summary: Presents AuDoPEDA, an autonomous coding system that reads OpenROAD codebase, proposes research directions, and submits executable code changes for EDA/chip design optimization with minimal human oversight.

entry.title: InFi-Check: Interpretable and Fine-Grained Fact-Checking of LLMs

author.name: Yuzhuo Bai, Shuzheng Si, Kangyang Luo, Qingyi Wang, Wenhao Li, Gang Chen, Fanchao Qi, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Introduces InFi-Check, a framework for interpretable and fine-grained fact-checking of LLM outputs with explicit evidence, error type labels, justifications, and corrections using controlled data synthesis.

entry.title: Characterising Toxicity in Generative Large Language Models

author.name: Zhiyao Zhang, Yazan Mash'Al, Yuhan Wu

entry.summary: Characterizes toxic output generation in LLMs, examining how safety mechanisms like RLHF can be circumvented. Provides analysis of conditions leading to harmful outputs.

entry.title: MoE-DisCo:Low Economy Cost Training Mixture-of-Experts Models

author.name: Xin Ye, Daning Cheng, Boyang Zhang, Yunquan Zhang

entry.summary: MoE-DisCo enables low-cost MoE training by decomposing models into dense submodels trained independently on clustered data subsets, then coordinating them through sparse updates.

entry.title: Measuring Social Bias in Vision-Language Models with Face-Only Counterfactuals from Real Photos

author.name: Haodong Chen, Qiang Huang, Jiaqi Zhao, Qiuping Jiang, Xiaojun Chang, Jun Yu

entry.summary: FOCUS dataset for measuring VLM social bias using face-only counterfactual editing from real photos, isolating demographic effects while preserving realism.

entry.title: Measuring Iterative Temporal Reasoning with TimePuzzles

author.name: Zhengxiang Wang, Zeyu Dong

entry.summary: TimePuzzles benchmark evaluates iterative temporal reasoning through constraint-based date inference combining temporal anchors with calendar relations. GPT-5 achieves only 49.3% accuracy.

entry.title: ARCQuant: Boosting NVFP4 Quantization with Augmented Residual Channels for LLMs

author.name: Haoqian Meng, Yilun Luo, Yafei Zhao, Wenyuan Liu, Peng Zhang, Xindian Ma

entry.summary: Introduces ARCQuant for NVFP4 quantization of LLMs using augmented residual channels while maintaining strictly unified format, addressing challenges of fine-grained 4-bit formats.

entry.title: Beyond Single-Shot: Multi-step Tool Retrieval via Query Planning

author.name: Wei Fang, James Glass

entry.summary: Proposes TOOLQP, modeling tool retrieval as iterative query planning with sub-task decomposition to bridge semantic gap between user goals and tool documentation.

entry.title: Applying Embedding-Based Retrieval to Airbnb Search

author.name: Mustafa Abdool, Soumyadip Banerjee, Moutupsi Paul, Do-kyum Kim, Xioawei Liu, Bin Xu, Tracy Yu, Hui Gao, Karen Ouyang, Huiji Gao, Liwei He, Stephanie Moyerman, Sanjeev Katariya

entry.summary: Details Airbnb's production embedding-based retrieval system for search, addressing unique challenges of flexible date search, diverse guest preferences, and integration with ranking infrastructure.

entry.title: Optimal Transport under Group Fairness Constraints

author.name: Linus Bleistein, Mathieu Dagr\'eou, Francisco Andrade, Thomas Boudou, Aur\'elien Bellet

entry.summary: Introduces group fairness constraints for Optimal Transport where matching probabilities between groups must satisfy predefined targets. Proposes FairSinkhorn algorithm and penalized relaxation with finite-sample guarantees.

entry.title: GRPO with State Mutations: Improving LLM-Based Hardware Test Plan Generation

author.name: Dimple Vijay Kochar, Nathaniel Pinckney, Guan-Ting Liu, Chia-Tung Ho, Chenhui Deng, Haoxing Ren, Brucek Khailany

entry.summary: Applies GRPO with state mutations for LLM-based hardware test plan generation. Shows SOTA models achieve only 15-21% success rates on RTL verification stimuli, proposes training improvements.

entry.title: Labels have Human Values: Value Calibration of Subjective Tasks

author.name: Mohammed Fayiz Parappan, Ricardo Henao

entry.summary: Framework for calibrating NLP systems to diverse human values by clustering annotations and learning cluster-specific embeddings. Addresses subjective task alignment across toxic content and preference learning.

entry.title: Forecast the Principal, Stabilize the Residual: Subspace-Aware Feature Caching for Efficient Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Guantao Chen, Shikang Zheng, Yuqi Lin, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: SVD-Cache proposes subspace-aware caching for DiT acceleration by decomposing features into principal (predictable) and residual (volatile) subspaces, caching/predicting appropriately.

entry.title: Tensor-Transformer Variants are Surprisingly Performant

author.name: Logan Riggs

entry.summary: Demonstrates that tensor network-based transformer variants with bilinear layers replacing MLPs achieve competitive performance, requiring only ~4% more training data to match standard transformers at 500M parameters. Offers potentially more interpretable architecture.

entry.title: DRAGON: LLM-Driven Decomposition and Reconstruction Agents for Large-Scale Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Shengkai Chen, Zhiguang Cao, Jianan Zhou, Yaoxin Wu, Senthilnath Jayavelu, Zhuoyi Lin, Xiaoli Li, Shili Xiang

entry.summary: DRAGON combines metaheuristic design with LLM reasoning for large-scale combinatorial optimization. Autonomously decomposes problems, identifies high-potential regions, and reformulates subproblems as chain-of-thought prompts.

entry.title: Consolidation or Adaptation? PRISM: Disentangling SFT and RL Data via Gradient Concentration

author.name: Yang Zhao, Yangou Ouyang, Xiao Ding, Hepeng Wang, Bibo Cai, Kai Xiong, Jinglong Gao, Zhouhao Sun, Li Du, Bing Qin, Ting Liu

entry.summary: PRISM framework using gradient concentration analysis to allocate data between SFT (pattern consolidation) and RL (structural adaptation) stages based on cognitive conflict with existing knowledge.

entry.title: Amory: Building Coherent Narrative-Driven Agent Memory through Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Yue Zhou, Xiaobo Guo, Belhassen Bayar, Srinivasan H. Sengamedu

entry.summary: Introduces Amory, a working memory framework for conversational agents that constructs structured memory through agentic reasoning during offline time, organizing fragments into coherent narrative structures.

entry.title: Do Language Models Reason Across Languages?

author.name: Yan Meng, Wafaa Mohammed, Christof Monz

entry.summary: Studies whether language models can reason across languages in two-hop QA, finding models are more sensitive to language variation in answer documents and fail to infer bridging information in 33% of multilingual cases.

entry.title: Why are there many equally good models? An Anatomy of the Rashomon Effect

author.name: Harsh Parikh

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of the Rashomon effect (multiple distinct models achieving equivalent performance), categorizing causes into statistical, structural, and procedural sources.

entry.title: RealMem: Benchmarking LLMs in Real-World Memory-Driven Interaction

author.name: Haonan Bian, Zhiyuan Yao, Sen Hu, Zishan Xu, Shaolei Zhang, Yifu Guo, Ziliang Yang, Xueran Han, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen

entry.summary: RealMem benchmark tests LLM memory in long-term project-oriented interactions with 2,000+ cross-session dialogues across 11 scenarios, evaluating ability to track evolving goals.

entry.title: Relink: Constructing Query-Driven Evidence Graph On-the-Fly for GraphRAG

author.name: Manzong Huang, Chenyang Bu, Yi He, Xingrui Zhuo, Xindong Wu

entry.summary: Relink proposes reason-and-construct paradigm for GraphRAG, dynamically building query-specific evidence graphs rather than relying on pre-constructed static knowledge graphs.

entry.title: BlindU: Blind Machine Unlearning without Revealing Erasing Data

author.name: Weiqi Wang, Zhiyi Tian, Chenhan Zhang, Shui Yu

entry.summary: BlindU enables machine unlearning without servers accessing the data to be erased, using compressed representations instead of original inputs for privacy-preserving unlearning.

entry.title: KALE: Enhancing Knowledge Manipulation in Large Language Models via Knowledge-aware Learning

author.name: Qitan Lv, Tianyu Liu, Qiaosheng Zhang, Xingcheng Xu, Chaochao Lu

entry.summary: Proposes KALE, a post-training framework using knowledge graphs to enhance LLM knowledge manipulation by generating high-quality rationales to address the 'known & incorrect' phenomenon.

entry.title: The Hessian of tall-skinny networks is easy to invert

author.name: Ali Rahimi

entry.summary: Describes exact algorithm for solving Hessian linear systems in deep networks with time and storage scaling linearly in layers, avoiding quadratic Hessian storage.

entry.title: Position: Don't be Afraid of Over-Smoothing And Over-Squashing

author.name: Niklas Kormann, Benjamin Doerr, Johannes F. Lutzeyer

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that over-smoothing and over-squashing in GNNs are less critical than commonly believed. Shows accuracy and over-smoothing are mostly uncorrelated in extensive experiments.

entry.title: Categorize Early, Integrate Late: Divergent Processing Strategies in Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Nathan Roll, Pranav Bhalerao, Martijn Bartelds, Arjun Pawar, Yuka Tatsumi, Tolulope Ogunremi, Chen Shani, Calbert Graham, Meghan Sumner, Dan Jurafsky

entry.summary: Introduces Architectural Fingerprinting to reveal divergent processing strategies: Conformers 'Categorize Early' (phonemes 29% earlier) while Transformers 'Integrate Late' in speech recognition.

entry.title: ShowUI-Aloha: Human-Taught GUI Agent

author.name: Yichun Zhang, Xiangwu Guo, Yauhong Goh, Jessica Hu, Zhiheng Chen, Xin Wang, Difei Gao, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: ShowUI-Aloha transforms unstructured human screen recordings into structured GUI tasks for training agents, including recorder for capturing interactions and hierarchical processing pipeline.

entry.title: When does competition lead to recognisable values?

author.name: Jan_Kulveit

entry.summary: Philosophical discussion of AI futures contrasting 'AI monotheism' (single dominant superintelligence) vs 'AI polytheism' (many competing AIs). Analyzes conditions under which competition preserves recognizable values.

entry.title: HiMeS: Hippocampus-inspired Memory System for Personalized AI Assistants

author.name: Hailong Li, Feifei Li, Wenhui Que, Xingyu Fan

entry.summary: HiMeS architecture inspired by hippocampus-neocortex memory systems, fusing short-term and long-term memory for personalized AI assistants. Uses RL-trained short-term memory extractor.

entry.title: AscendKernelGen: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Kernel Generation for Neural Processing Units

author.name: Xinzi Cao, Jianyang Zhai, Pengfei Li, Zhiheng Hu, Cen Yan, Bingxu Mu, Guanghuan Fang, Bin She, Jiayu Li, Yihan Su, Dongyang Tao, Xiansong Huang, Fan Xu, Feidiao Yang, Yao Lu, Chang-Dong Wang, Yutong Lu, Weicheng Xue, Bin Zhou, Yonghong Tian

entry.summary: AscendKernelGen: Systematic study of LLM-based kernel generation for Ascend NPUs. Finds SOTA LLMs fail to generate functional complex kernels (near-zero success rate) and proposes improvements.

entry.title: Beyond Dialogue Time: Temporal Semantic Memory for Personalized LLM Agents

author.name: Miao Su, Yucan Guo, Zhongni Hou, Long Bai, Zixuan Li, Yufei Zhang, Guojun Yin, Wei Lin, Xiaolong Jin, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Temporal Semantic Memory framework modeling actual occurrence time (not dialogue time) and durative memories capturing persistent states. Separates point-wise from durative memory construction.

entry.title: Political Alignment in Large Language Models: A Multidimensional Audit of Psychometric Identity and Behavioral Bias

author.name: Adib Sakhawat, Tahsin Islam, Takia Farhin, Syed Rifat Raiyan, Hasan Mahmud, Md Kamrul Hasan

entry.summary: Sociotechnical audit of 26 LLMs finding 96.3% cluster in Libertarian-Left ideological region with high consistency (η²>0.90). Identifies substantial disconnect between psychometric positioning and behavioral outputs.

entry.title: VideoWeave: A Data-Centric Approach for Efficient Video Understanding

author.name: Zane Durante, Silky Singh, Arpandeep Khatua, Shobhit Agarwal, Reuben Tan, Yong Jae Lee, Jianfeng Gao, Ehsan Adeli, Li Fei-Fei

entry.summary: Introduces VideoWeave, a data-centric approach improving video-language model training efficiency by splicing short captioned videos into synthetic long-context samples without architectural changes.

entry.title: WFR-FM: Simulation-Free Dynamic Unbalanced Optimal Transport

author.name: Qiangwei Peng, Zihan Wang, Junda Ying, Yuhao Sun, Qing Nie, Lei Zhang, Tiejun Li, Peijie Zhou

entry.summary: WFR-FM extends flow matching to dynamic unbalanced optimal transport, learning both displacement vector fields and scalar growth rates for birth-death dynamics in a simulation-free framework.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Understand, Reason About, and Generate Code-Switched Text?

author.name: Genta Indra Winata, David Anugraha, Patrick Amadeus Irawan, Anirban Das, Haneul Yoo, Paresh Dashore, Shreyas Kulkarni, Ruochen Zhang, Haruki Sakajo, Frederikus Hudi, Anaelia Ovalle, Syrielle Montariol, Felix Gaschi, Michael Anugraha, Rutuj Ravindra Puranik, Zawad Hayat Ahmed, Adril Putra Merin, Emmanuele Chersoni

entry.summary: CodeMixQA benchmark with 16 code-switched language pairs evaluates LLM understanding, reasoning, and generation in mixed-language settings common in multilingual communication.

entry.title: Forward versus Backward: Comparing Reasoning Objectives in Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Murtaza Nikzad, Raghuram Ramanujan

entry.summary: Studies forward chain-of-thought vs backward verification objectives in DPO for reasoning. Forward-only achieves highest accuracy; backward verification improves error acknowledgment but reduces accuracy.

entry.title: SEE: Signal Embedding Energy for Quantifying Noise Interference in Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Yuanhe Zhang, Jiayu Tian, Yibo Zhang, Shilinlu Yan, Liang Lin, Zhenhong Zhou, Li Sun, Sen Su

entry.summary: Introduces Signal Embedding Energy (SEE) for quantifying noise impact on Large Audio Language Models by analyzing structured activation subspaces. Enables differentiation of LALM robustness in real deployments.

entry.title: ReasonTabQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Table Question Answering from Real World Industrial Scenarios

author.name: Changzai Pan, Jie Zhang, Kaiwen Wei, Chenshuo Pan, Yu Zhao, Jingwang Huang, Jian Yang, Zhenhe Wu, Haoyang Zeng, Xiaoyan Gu, Weichao Sun, Yanbo Zhai, Yujie Mao, Zhuoru Jiang, Jiang Zhong, Shuangyong Song, Yongxiang Li, Zhongjiang He

entry.summary: Large-scale bilingual TableQA benchmark with 1,932 tables across 30 industries, featuring complex industrial scenarios with nested headers and explicit reasoning chain annotations.

entry.title: GenDet: Painting Colored Bounding Boxes on Images via Diffusion Model for Object Detection

author.name: Chen Min, Chengyang Li, Fanjie Kong, Qi Zhu, Dawei Zhao, Liang Xiao

entry.summary: GenDet redefines object detection as image generation task using Stable Diffusion, directly generating bounding boxes with semantic annotations in image space through conditional generation.

entry.title: AdaMorph: Unified Motion Retargeting via Embodiment-Aware Adaptive Transformers

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Shibo Jin, Lvsong Li, Jun Li, Liang Lin, Xiaodong He, Zecui Zeng

entry.summary: AdaMorph enables single neural model to retarget human motion to diverse robot morphologies using adaptive layer normalization and dual-purpose prompting mechanism.

entry.title: Beyond Reproducibility: Token Probabilities Expose Large Language Model Nondeterminism

author.name: Tairan Fu, Gonzalo Mart\'inez, Javier Conde, Carlos Arriaga, Pedro Reviriego, Xiuyuan Qi, Shanshan Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes LLM nondeterminism at token probability level rather than just generated text. Shows all evaluated models exhibit probability variations due to GPU arithmetic order dependence, even with deterministic settings.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Compliance: Integrating LLMs and SMT Solvers for Automated Financial Legal Analysis

author.name: Yung-Shen Hsia, Fang Yu, Jie-Hong Roland Jiang

entry.summary: Neuro-symbolic framework integrating LLMs with SMT solvers for financial compliance. LLM interprets regulations to generate constraints, solver enforces consistency and computes minimal corrections.

entry.title: LSRIF: Logic-Structured Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following

author.name: Qingyu Ren, Qianyu He, Jingwen Chang, Jie Zeng, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao, Han Xia, Zeye Sun, Fei Yu

entry.summary: LSRIF explicitly models logical instruction structures (parallel, sequential, conditional) with structure-aware rewards: average aggregation for parallel, failure-penalty propagation for sequential, selective for conditional.

entry.title: LLM Performance Predictors: Learning When to Escalate in Hybrid Human-AI Moderation Systems

author.name: Or Bachar, Or Levi, Sardhendu Mishra, Adi Levi, Manpreet Singh Minhas, Justin Miller, Omer Ben-Porat, Eilon Sheetrit, Jonathan Morra

entry.summary: Framework for learning when to escalate LLM outputs to human review in content moderation. Meta-model uses LLM Performance Predictors (log-probabilities, entropy, uncertainty attribution) for cost-aware selective classification.

entry.title: ARM: Role-Conditioned Neuron Transplantation for Training-Free Generalist LLM Agent Merging

author.name: Zhuoka Feng, Kang Chen, Sihan Zhao, Kai Xiong, Yaoning Wang, Minshen Yu, Junjie Nian, Changyi Xiao, Yixin Cao, Yugang Jiang

entry.summary: ARM: Training-free agent merging via role-conditioned neuron transplantation. Uses activation analysis to identify and transplant role-relevant neurons for multi-environment generalization.

entry.title: Aligning by Misaligning: Boundary-aware Curriculum Learning for Multimodal Alignment

author.name: Hua Ye (Nanjing University, Airon Technology CO. LTD), Hang Ding (University of Bristol), Siyuan Chen (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Yiyang Jiang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Changyuan Zhang (The University of Hong Kong), Xuan Zhang (Airon Technology CO. LTD, Carnegie Mellon University)

entry.summary: BACL introduces boundary-aware curriculum learning for multimodal alignment that progressively increases negative difficulty while highlighting mismatch locations. Claims up to +32% R@1 improvement over CLIP on four benchmarks.

entry.title: Breaking Model Lock-in: Cost-Efficient Zero-Shot LLM Routing via a Universal Latent Space

author.name: Cheng Yan, Wuyang Zhang, Zhiyuan Ning, Fan Xu, Ziyang Tao, Lu Zhang, Bing Yin, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces ZeroRouter, an LLM routing paradigm using a universal latent space that enables zero-shot onboarding of new models without full-scale retraining, addressing model lock-in issues in production systems.

entry.title: Explainability of Complex AI Models with Correlation Impact Ratio

author.name: Poushali Sengupta, Rabindra Khadka, Sabita Maharjan, Frank Eliassen, Yan Zhang, Shashi Raj Pandey, Pedro G. Lind, Anis Yazidi

entry.summary: Proposes ExCIR, a new explainability metric that addresses limitations of SHAP, LIME in handling correlated features. Offers improved stability under noise and sampling variations.

entry.title: MedGround: Bridging the Evidence Gap in Medical Vision-Language Models with Verified Grounding Data

author.name: Mengmeng Zhang, Xiaoping Wu, Hao Luo, Fan Wang, Yisheng Lv

entry.summary: MedGround pipeline transforms segmentation masks into medical referring-grounding data with multi-stage verification, enabling VLMs to produce visually grounded clinical statements.

entry.title: MemTrust: A Zero-Trust Architecture for Unified AI Memory System

author.name: Xing Zhou, Dmitrii Ustiugov, Haoxin Shang, Kisson Lin

entry.summary: MemTrust proposes zero-trust architecture for AI memory systems, balancing data sovereignty with cross-agent collaboration through local-equivalent security with cloud efficiency.

entry.title: BEAT-Net: Injecting Biomimetic Spatio-Temporal Priors for Interpretable ECG Classification

author.name: Runze Ma, Caizhi Liao

entry.summary: Introduces BEAT-Net, reformulating ECG analysis as a language modeling task using QRS tokenization to decompose cardiac signals into biologically aligned heartbeat sequences.

entry.title: Controlled Self-Evolution for Algorithmic Code Optimization

author.name: Tu Hu, Ronghao Chen, Shuo Zhang, Jianghao Yin, Mou Xiao Feng, Jingping Liu, Shaolei Zhang, Wenqi Jiang, Yuqi Fang, Sen Hu, Yi Xu, Huacan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Controlled Self-Evolution (CSE) for algorithmic code optimization with diversified planning initialization, genetic evolution with feedback guidance, and cross-task experience utilization.

entry.title: ES-Mem: Event Segmentation-Based Memory for Long-Term Dialogue Agents

author.name: Huhai Zou, Tianhao Sun, Chuanjiang He, Yu Tian, Zhenyang Li, Li Jin, Nayu Liu, Jiang Zhong, Kaiwen Wei

entry.summary: Proposes ES-Mem, a dialogue memory framework inspired by Event Segmentation Theory with dynamic event segmentation and discourse-guided hierarchical retrieval for long-term agents.

entry.title: Evaluating the encoding competence of visual language models using uncommon actions

author.name: Chen Ling, Nai Ding

entry.summary: Proposes UAIT benchmark for evaluating VLM semantic understanding using uncommon-sense action scenes requiring deep agent-patient relationship understanding.

entry.title: Certified Unlearning in Decentralized Federated Learning

author.name: Hengliang Wu, Youming Tao, Anhao Zhou, Shuzhen Chen, Falko Dressler, Dongxiao Yu

entry.summary: Develops certified machine unlearning framework for decentralized federated learning using Newton-style updates to track and remove client data influence across the network.

entry.title: HAS-VQ: Hessian-Adaptive Sparse Vector Quantization for High-Fidelity LLM Compression

author.name: Vladimer Khasia

entry.summary: Introduces HAS-VQ for LLM compression using Hessian-guided sparse vector quantization that decouples outliers from bulk weights for better small model quantization.

entry.title: Reward-Preserving Attacks For Robust Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lucas Schott, Elies Gherbi, Hatem Hajri, Sylvain Lamprier

entry.summary: Proposes α-reward-preserving attacks for robust RL that adaptively calibrate adversary strength per state to maintain learning while improving robustness.

entry.title: Detecting LLM-Generated Text with Performance Guarantees

author.name: Hongyi Zhou, Jin Zhu, Ying Yang, Chengchun Shi

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-generated text detector with statistical performance guarantees deployed on public platform, using conformal prediction for calibrated decisions.

entry.title: A Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Predicting ICU Deterioration: Integrating ECG Waveforms with Clinical Data and Clinician Benchmarking

author.name: Juan Miguel L\'opez Alcaraz, Xicot\'encatl L\'opez Moran, Erick D\'avila Zaragoza, Claas H\"andel, Richard Koebe, Wilhelm Haverkamp, Nils Strodthoff

entry.summary: Presents MDS-ICU, a unified multimodal framework combining ECG waveforms, vital signs, lab values, and clinical data to predict ICU deterioration. Trained on 63,001 samples from MIMIC-IV and benchmarked against clinician predictions.

entry.title: CliffordNet: All You Need is Geometric Algebra

author.name: Zhongping Ji

entry.summary: Proposes CliffordNet, a vision backbone built entirely on Geometric (Clifford) Algebra principles rather than traditional CNN/Transformer modules. Uses the Clifford Geometric Product for unified spatial and channel mixing.

entry.title: Variational Approximations for Robust Bayesian Inference via Rho-Posteriors

author.name: EL Mahdi Khribch, Pierre Alquier

entry.summary: Develops PAC-Bayesian framework for ρ-posteriors enabling tractable variational approximations while maintaining robustness guarantees. Provides first computationally feasible implementation of ρ-posteriors.

entry.title: A Rising Tide Lifts All Boats: MTQE Rewards for Idioms Improve General Translation Quality

author.name: Ishika Agarwal, Zhenlin He, Dhruva Patil, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Uses GRPO fine-tuning with Machine Translation Quality Estimation rewards to improve idiom translation. Shows 14-point improvement on idioms also improves general translation by 8 points.

entry.title: Time Travel Engine: A Shared Latent Chronological Manifold Enables Historical Navigation in Large Language Models

author.name: Jingmin An, Wei Liu, Qian Wang, Fang Fang

entry.summary: Introduces Time Travel Engine for navigating temporal knowledge in LLM latent space. Shows temporal information forms continuous traversable geometry enabling diachronic style/concept shifts.

entry.title: Probing Multimodal Large Language Models on Cognitive Biases in Chinese Short-Video Misinformation

author.name: Jen-tse Huang, Chang Chen, Shiyang Lai, Wenxuan Wang, Michelle R. Kaufman, Mark Dredze

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal LLMs on detecting misinformation in Chinese short videos, revealing susceptibility to cognitive biases. Dataset of 200 videos with fine-grained annotations for deceptive patterns.

entry.title: Forest Before Trees: Latent Superposition for Efficient Visual Reasoning

author.name: Yubo Wang, Juntian Zhang, Yichen Wu, Yankai Lin, Nils Lukas, Yuhan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Laser for visual reasoning using Dynamic Windowed Alignment Learning that aligns latent states with dynamic windows of future semantics, implementing 'Forest-before-Trees' cognitive hierarchy.

entry.title: SAD: A Large-Scale Strategic Argumentative Dialogue Dataset

author.name: Yongkang Liu, Jiayang Yu, Mingyang Wang, Yiqun Zhang, Ercong Nie, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Kaisong Song, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: First large-scale strategic argumentative dialogue dataset with 392,822 examples annotated for argumentative strategies based on argumentation theory.

entry.title: Ground What You See: Hallucination-Resistant MLLMs via Caption Feedback, Diversity-Aware Sampling, and Conflict Regularization

author.name: Miao Pan, Wangjie Gan, Jintao Chen, Wenqi Zhang, Bing Sun, Jianwei Yin, Xuhong Zhang

entry.summary: Addresses hallucination in MLLMs during RL optimization through caption feedback, diversity-aware sampling, and conflict regularization. Identifies three critical causes: chained reasoning, insufficient exploration, and sample conflicts.

entry.title: Mimic Human Cognition, Master Multi-Image Reasoning: A Meta-Action Framework for Enhanced Visual Understanding

author.name: Jianghao Yin, Qingbin Li, Kun Sun, Cheng Ding, Jie Wang, Qin Chen, Jie Zhou, Nan Wang, Changqing Li, Pei Wu, Jian Xu, Zheming Yang, Liang He

entry.summary: CINEMA decomposes multi-image reasoning into five meta-actions (Global, Focus, Hint, Think, Answer) inspired by human cognition, with Retrieval-Based Tree Sampling for training data generation.

entry.title: Smooth Operator: Smooth Verifiable Reward Activates Spatial Reasoning Ability of Vision-Language Model

author.name: Siwen Jiao, Tianxiong Lv, Kangan Qian, Chenxu Zhao, Xiuyuan Zhu, Tianlun Li, Xiaolong Cheng, Jinyu Li, Zhihao Liao, Yang Cai

entry.summary: Introduces Smooth Numerical Reward Activation (SNRA) operator to address reward sparsity and gradient instability in GRPO for VLM spatial reasoning. Prevents 'advantage collapse' for near-miss samples.

entry.title: Online Markov Decision Processes with Terminal Law Constraints

author.name: Bianca Marin Moreno (EDF R\&D, Thoth, FiME Lab), Margaux Br\'eg\`ere (EDF R\&D, LPSM), Pierre Gaillard (Thoth), Nadia Oudjane (EDF R\&D, FiME Lab)

entry.summary: Introduces periodic framework for reset-free online MDPs where policies must return agents to initial state distribution. Formalizes optimal periodic policies without requiring resets.

entry.title: BlackBoxQuery [BBQ]-Bench: Measuring Hypothesis Formation and Experimentation Capabilities in LLMs

author.name: Daniel Wu

entry.summary: Introduces BBQ-Bench, a benchmark testing LLM research capabilities through black-box function inference tasks requiring hypothesis formation and experimentation. Gemini 3 Pro achieved 92.5%, outperforming human baselines; manual review found LLMs fail by narrowing on false hypotheses too early.

entry.title: Learning How to Remember: A Meta-Cognitive Management Method for Structured and Transferable Agent Memory

author.name: Sirui Liang, Pengfei Cao, Jian Zhao, Wenhao Teng, Xiangwen Liao, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces MCMA, treating agent memory abstraction as a learnable skill rather than fixed design choice, using a memory copilot trained via DPO to manage how memories are structured and reused. Addresses the challenge of negative transfer when distribution shifts occur in long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: SparseOccVLA: Bridging Occupancy and Vision-Language Models via Sparse Queries for Unified 4D Scene Understanding and Planning

author.name: Chenxu Dang, Jie Wang, Guang Li, Zhiwen Hou, Zihan You, Hangjun Ye, Jie Ma, Long Chen, Yan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SparseOccVLA, a vision-language-action model for autonomous driving that unifies scene understanding, occupancy forecasting, and trajectory planning using sparse occupancy queries.

entry.title: L-RAG: Balancing Context and Retrieval with Entropy-Based Lazy Loading

author.name: Sergii Voloshyn

entry.summary: Introduces L-RAG (Lazy RAG), an adaptive framework using entropy-based gating to decide when retrieval is necessary, first processing with document summaries before querying vector databases.

entry.title: Stable On-Policy Distillation through Adaptive Target Reformulation

author.name: Ijun Jang, Jewon Yeom, Juan Yeo, Hyunggu Lim, Taesup Kim

entry.summary: Veto provides stable on-policy knowledge distillation by adaptively reformulating targets to bridge the gap between novice student and expert teacher, avoiding pathological gradients and diversity collapse.

entry.title: PDR: A Plug-and-Play Positional Decay Framework for LLM Pre-training Data Detection

author.name: Jinhan Liu, Yibo Yang, Ruiying Lu, Piotr Piekos, Yimeng Chen, Peng Wang, Dandan Guo

entry.summary: Plug-and-play framework for detecting pre-training data by reweighting token-level scores based on position, finding memorization signals concentrated in high-entropy initial tokens.

entry.title: TALON: Confidence-Aware Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Token Trees

author.name: Tianyu Liu, Qitan Lv, Yuhao Shen, Xiao Sun, Xiaoyan Sun

entry.summary: Training-free speculative decoding with adaptive token trees that dynamically adjust structure based on token difficulty, enabling early stopping for hard tokens and extension for easy ones.

entry.title: VideoLoom: A Video Large Language Model for Joint Spatial-Temporal Understanding

author.name: Jiapeng Shi, Junke Wang, Zuyao You, Bo He, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: VideoLoom presents unified Video LLM for joint spatial-temporal understanding with LoomData-8.7k dataset featuring temporally grounded and spatially localized captions.

entry.title: Follow the Signs: Using Textual Cues and LLMs to Guide Efficient Robot Navigation

entry.summary: Introduces L2O framework for accelerating Krasnosel'skii-Mann fixed-point iterations with convergence guarantees. Learns perturbations that improve average-case performance while maintaining theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Annotating Dimensions of Social Perception in Text: The First Sentence-Level Dataset of Warmth and Competence

entry.summary: Zero-shot framework for hybrid table-text QA that constructs dynamic evidence graphs from noisy retrieval outputs, modeling relationships between evidence pieces to identify bridge documents.

entry.title: Towards Comprehensive Semantic Speech Embeddings for Chinese Dialects

author.name: Kalvin Chang, Yiwen Shao, Jiahong Li, Dong Yu

entry.summary: Achieves cross-dialect semantic alignment between Chinese dialects and Mandarin using ASR-only training data. Creates benchmark for spoken Chinese varieties and achieves SOTA ASR.

author.name: Ernst van Gassen

entry.summary: Symbolic language for prompt compression using mathematical notation (∈, ⇒) that LLMs already understand, achieving 62-81% token reduction without explicit decoding rules.

entry.title: TagSpeech: End-to-End Multi-Speaker ASR and Diarization with Fine-Grained Temporal Grounding

entry.title: TIR-Flow: Active Video Search and Reasoning with Frozen VLMs

entry.title: APEX: Learning Adaptive Priorities for Multi-Objective Alignment in Vision-Language Generation

entry.title: Can Textual Reasoning Improve the Performance of MLLMs on Fine-grained Visual Classification?

author.name: Jie Zhu, Yiyang Su, Xiaoming Liu

entry.title: PARL: Position-Aware Relation Learning Network for Document Layout Analysis

entry.title: Tuning-free Visual Effect Transfer across Videos

author.name: Maxwell Jones, Rameen Abdal, Or Patashnik, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Sergey Tulyakov, Jun-Yan Zhu, Kuan-Chieh Jackson Wang

entry.title: TeleMem: Building Long-Term and Multimodal Memory for Agentic AI

entry.title: Beyond BeautifulSoup: Benchmarking LLM-Powered Web Scraping for Everyday Users

entry.title: ObjSplat: Geometry-Aware Gaussian Surfels for Active Object Reconstruction

entry.title: Research Summary: January 12, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research features significant theoretical contributions on LLM limitations alongside critical safety findings. A mathematical proof formalizes recursive self-improvement as a dynamical system, demonstrating degenerative dynamics that challenge near-term AGI expectations without symbolic synthesis.

Interpretability & Reasoning:

  • PaCoRe introduces parallel coordinated reasoning via message-passing to break sequential test-time compute limits
  • Sparse autoencoders fail to identify genuine reasoning features—59-94% of detected features respond to surface-level cues rather than underlying logic
  • Transformers trained autoregressively inherently encode time-delayed causal structures recoverable from gradient sensitivities
  • Circular Reasoning benchmark identifies self-reinforcing loops as a key failure mode in large reasoning models

Safety & Security:

  • Agentic LLMs with web search successfully re-identify participants in Anthropic's anonymized interview dataset
  • MisBelief framework reveals LLMs resist direct misinformation but succumb to sophisticated multi-role deceptive evidence
  • Current emergent misalignment evaluations systematically overestimate the phenomenon by conflating response types
  • VIGIL proposes verify-before-commit protocol defending agents against tool stream injection attacks

entry.title: On the Limits of Self-Improving in LLMs and Why AGI, ASI and the Singularity Are Not Near Without Symbolic Model Synthesis

author.name: Hector Zenil

entry.summary: Formalizes recursive LLM self-training as discrete-time dynamical system, proving inevitable degenerative dynamics as training data becomes self-generated. Identifies two failure modes: entropy decay (mode collapse) and variance amplification (truth drift).
