entry.title: PRISM: Protocol Refinement through Intelligent Simulation Modeling

author.name: Brian Hsu, Priyanka V Setty, Rory M Butler, Ryan Lewis, Casey Stone, Rebecca Weinberg, Thomas Brettin, Rick Stevens, Ian Foster, and Arvind Ramanathan

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM framework using LLM agents to automate experimental protocol design, validation, and execution on robotic lab platforms. Generates structured experimental steps through planning, critique, and validation loops.

entry.title: GenCtrl -- A Formal Controllability Toolkit for Generative Models

author.name: Emily Cheng, Carmen Amo Alonso, Federico Danieli, Arno Blaas, Luca Zappella, Pau Rodriguez, Xavier Suau

entry.summary: GenCtrl provides theoretical framework for formally assessing controllability of generative models in dialogue settings, with PAC bounds on controllable set estimation that are distribution-free.

entry.title: Lost in Execution: On the Multilingual Robustness of Tool Calling in Large Language Models

author.name: Zheng Luo, T Pranav Kutralingam, Ogochukwu N Okoani, Wanpeng Xu, Hua Wei, Xiyang Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MLCL benchmark for multilingual tool calling, finding LLMs fail on Chinese, Hindi, and Igbo despite correct intent understanding. Identifies parameter value language mismatch as dominant failure mode.

entry.title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models through Iterative Tool-Disguised Attacks via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhaoqi Wang, Zijian Zhang, Daqing He, Pengtao Kou, Xin Li, Jiamou Liu, Jincheng An, and Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes iMIST jailbreak method that disguises malicious queries as tool invocations while using progressive optimization via RL. Exploits vulnerabilities in current defense mechanisms.

entry.title: The Evaluation Gap in Medicine, AI and LLMs: Navigating Elusive Ground Truth & Uncertainty via a Probabilistic Paradigm

author.name: Aparna Elangovan, Lei Xu, Mahsa Elyasi, Ismail Akdulum, Mehmet Aksakal, Enes Gurun, Brian Hur, Saab Mansour, Ravid Shwartz Ziv, Karin Verspoor, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces probabilistic paradigm explaining how ground truth uncertainty affects AI evaluation. Shows that ignoring uncertainty can misleadingly suggest non-experts match expert performance.

entry.title: Over-Searching in Search-Augmented Large Language Models

author.name: Roy Xie, Deepak Gopinath, David Qiu, Dong Lin, Haitian Sun, Saloni Potdar, Bhuwan Dhingra

entry.summary: Systematically studies over-searching in search-augmented LLMs where unnecessary retrieval degrades performance. Finds over-searching is more pronounced in complex reasoning models and compounds in multi-turn.

entry.title: Weights to Code: Extracting Interpretable Algorithms from the Discrete Transformer

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Wei Bi, Kechi Zhang, Dongming Jin, Jie Fu, Zhi Jin

entry.summary: Proposes Discrete Transformer architecture for extracting executable algorithms from trained models by enforcing functional disentanglement between attention (routing) and MLP (arithmetic) components.

entry.title: Goal Force: Teaching Video Models To Accomplish Physics-Conditioned Goals

author.name: Nate Gillman, Yinghua Zhou, Zitian Tang, Evan Luo, Arjan Chakravarthy, Daksh Aggarwal, Michael Freeman, Charles Herrmann, Chen Sun

entry.summary: Goal Force enables video generation conditioned on explicit force vectors and intermediate dynamics. Trained on synthetic causal primitives (collisions, dominos), it generalizes to complex unseen scenarios in a zero-shot manner.

entry.title: Illusions of Confidence? Diagnosing LLM Truthfulness via Neighborhood Consistency

author.name: Haoming Xu, Ningyuan Zhao, Yunzhi Yao, Weihong Xu, Hongru Wang, Xinle Deng, Shumin Deng, Jeff Z. Pan, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Neighbor-Consistency Belief (NCB) to evaluate LLM truthfulness under contextual perturbations, showing that even facts answered with perfect self-consistency can collapse under mild interference.

entry.title: Quantifying Document Impact in RAG-LLMs

author.name: Armin Gerami, Kazem Faghih, Ramani Duraiswami

entry.summary: Introduces Influence Score (IS), a metric based on Partial Information Decomposition to quantify individual document contributions to RAG outputs. Validates through poison attack simulation and faithfulness analysis.

entry.title: Bi-Orthogonal Factor Decomposition for Vision Transformers

author.name: Fenil R. Doshi, Thomas Fel, Talia Konkle, George Alvarez

entry.summary: Introduces Bi-orthogonal Factor Decomposition (BFD) for understanding Vision Transformer attention. Uses ANOVA-based decomposition to disentangle positional and content factors, revealing three distinct communication phenotypes.

entry.title: Dual-Phase LLM Reasoning: Self-Evolved Mathematical Frameworks

author.name: ShaoZhen Liu, Xinting Huang, Houwen Peng, Xin Chen, Xinyang Song, Qi Li, Zhenan Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage training framework enhancing LLM self-correction through self-generated long chain-of-thought data with verification, backtracking, and backward reasoning, using difficulty-aware rejection sampling.

entry.title: Afri-MCQA: Multimodal Cultural Question Answering for African Languages

author.name: Atnafu Lambebo Tonja, Srija Anand, Emilio Villa-Cueva, Israel Abebe Azime, Jesujoba Oluwadara Alabi, Muhidin A. Mohamed, Debela Desalegn Yadeta, Negasi Haile Abadi, Abigail Oppong, Nnaemeka Casmir Obiefuna, Idris Abdulmumin, Naome A Etori, Eric Peter Wairagala, Kanda Patrick Tshinu, Imanigirimbabazi Emmanuel, Gabofetswe Malema, Alham Fikri Aji, David Ifeoluwa Adelani, Thamar Solorio

entry.summary: Introduces Afri-MCQA, first multilingual cultural QA benchmark covering 15 African languages with 7.5k Q&A pairs across text and speech modalities, created entirely by native speakers.

entry.title: GIFT: Games as Informal Training for Generalizable LLMs

author.name: Nuoyan Lyu, Bingbing Xu, Weihao Meng, Yige Yuan, Yang Zhang, Zhiyong Huang, Tat-Seng Chua, Huawei Shen

entry.summary: GIFT uses games as informal training environments for LLMs to develop generalizable skills like strategic creativity and social reasoning. Introduces Nested Training Framework to address multi-task performance degradation.

entry.title: Latent Diffusion Autoencoders: Toward Efficient and Meaningful Unsupervised Representation Learning in Medical Imaging

author.name: Gabriele Lozupone, Alessandro Bria, Francesco Fontanella, Frederick J.A. Meijer, Claudio De Stefano, Henkjan Huisman

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Diffusion Autoencoder (LDAE) for efficient unsupervised representation learning in 3D medical imaging. Applies diffusion process in compressed latent space, making 3D brain MRI analysis tractable for Alzheimer's disease detection.

entry.title: LiveVectorLake: A Real-Time Versioned Knowledge Base Architecture for Streaming Vector Updates and Temporal Retrieval

author.name: Tarun Prajapati

entry.summary: Introduces LiveVectorLake, a dual-tier temporal knowledge base architecture for real-time RAG with version history. Enables semantic search on current knowledge while maintaining complete audit trail for compliance.

entry.title: Same Claim, Different Judgment: Benchmarking Scenario-Induced Bias in Multilingual Financial Misinformation Detection

author.name: Zhiwei Liu, Yupen Cao, Yuechen Jiang, Mohsinul Kabir, Polydoros Giannouris, Chen Xu, Ziyang Xu, Tianlei Zhu, Tariquzzaman Faisal, Triantafillos Papadopoulos, Yan Wang, Lingfei Qian, Xueqing Peng, Zhuohan Xie, Ye Yuan, Saeed Almheiri, Abdulrazzaq Alnajjar, Mingbin Chen, Harry Stuart, Paul Thompson, Prayag Tiwari, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Xue Liu, Jimin Huang, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Creates benchmark for evaluating LLM behavioral biases in multilingual financial misinformation detection across diverse economic scenarios. Tests how scenario context induces different judgments on same claims.

entry.title: Double: Breaking the Acceleration Limit via Double Retrieval Speculative Parallelism

author.name: Yuhao Shen, Tianyu Liu, Junyi Shen, Jinyang Wu, Quan Kong, Li Huan, Cong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Double framework for speculative decoding that breaks theoretical speedup ceiling through double retrieval with synchronous mechanism. Addresses rejection waste and pipeline stalls.

entry.title: Closing the Modality Reasoning Gap for Speech Large Language Models

author.name: Chaoren Wang, Heng Lu, Xueyao Zhang, Shujie Liu, Yan Lu, Jinyu Li, Zhizheng Wu

entry.summary: Introduces TARS, an RL framework aligning speech and text reasoning trajectories in speech LLMs. Uses representation and behavior alignment rewards to close modality reasoning gap.

entry.title: WildSci: Advancing Scientific Reasoning from In-the-Wild Literature

author.name: Tengxiao Liu, Deepak Nathani, Zekun Li, Kevin Yang, William Yang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces WildSci dataset of scientific questions synthesized from peer-reviewed literature across 9 disciplines. Applies RL for scientific reasoning improvement using multiple-choice format.

entry.title: Good Allocations from Bad Estimates

author.name: S\'ilvia Casacuberta, Moritz Hardt

entry.summary: Shows that coarse CATE estimates suffice for near-optimal treatment allocations, reducing sample complexity from O(M/ε²) to O(M/ε). Demonstrates that budget-weighted outcome improvements can be guaranteed even with biased estimates.

entry.title: Multilingual Amnesia: On the Transferability of Unlearning in Multilingual LLMs

author.name: Alireza Dehghanpour Farashah, Aditi Khandelwal, Marylou Fauchard, Zhuan Shi, Negar Rostamzadeh, and Golnoosh Farnadi

entry.summary: Studies multilingual unlearning in LLMs across 10 languages, examining cross-lingual transfer of unlearning for both factual knowledge and stereotypes using the Aya-Expanse 8B model.

entry.title: SceneFoundry: Generating Interactive Infinite 3D Worlds

author.name: ChunTeng Chen, YiChen Hsu, YiWen Liu, WeiFang Sun, TsaiChing Ni, ChunYi Lee, Min Sun, and YuanFu Yang

entry.summary: SceneFoundry is a language-guided diffusion framework generating apartment-scale 3D worlds with articulated furniture for robotic training. Uses LLM for floor layout and diffusion-based sampling for scene population.

entry.title: Context-Aware Decoding for Faithful Vision-Language Generation

author.name: Mehrdad Fazli, Bowen Wei, Ziwei Zhu

entry.summary: Context Embedding Injection (CEI) is a training-free method to reduce hallucinations in VLMs by leveraging the hidden state of the last input token as a grounding signal, based on analysis of commitment-depth gaps between truthful and hallucinatory tokens.

entry.title: LatentVLA: Efficient Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving via Latent Action Prediction

author.name: Chengen Xie, Bin Sun, Tianyu Li, Junjie Wu, Zhihui Hao, XianPeng Lang, Hongyang Li

entry.summary: LatentVLA uses self-supervised latent action prediction to train vision-language-action models for autonomous driving without language annotations, eliminating linguistic bias and enabling real-time deployment.

entry.title: Analysing Differences in Persuasive Language in LLM-Generated Text: Uncovering Stereotypical Gender Patterns

author.name: Amalie Brogaard Pauli, Maria Barrett, Max M\"uller-Eberstein, Isabelle Augenstein, Ira Assent

entry.summary: Analyzes how LLM-generated persuasive language differs based on recipient gender, finding stereotypical gender patterns across 13 models and 16 languages in 19 persuasion categories.

entry.title: FIRE-GNN: Force-informed, Relaxed Equivariance Graph Neural Network for Rapid and Accurate Prediction of Surface Properties

author.name: Circe Hsu, Claire Schlesinger, Karan Mudaliar, Jordan Leung, Robin Walters, Peter Schindler

entry.summary: Introduces FIRE-GNN combining surface-normal symmetry breaking and machine learning interatomic potential force information for predicting work function and cleavage energy. Achieves 2x reduction in MAE over previous SOTA.

entry.title: TagRAG: Tag-guided Hierarchical Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Wenbiao Tao, Yunshi Lan, Weining Qian

entry.summary: Proposes TagRAG, a tag-guided hierarchical knowledge graph RAG framework for efficient global reasoning. Introduces Tag Knowledge Graph Construction for extracting object tags and relationships from documents.

entry.title: TIME: Temporally Intelligent Meta-reasoning Engine for Context Triggered Explicit Reasoning

author.name: Susmit Das

entry.summary: Introduces TIME, a behavioral alignment framework treating explicit LLM reasoning as context-sensitive resource triggered by discourse and temporal cues. Augments dialogue with ISO 8601 timestamps for temporal awareness.

entry.title: MaxCode: A Max-Reward Reinforcement Learning Framework for Automated Code Optimization

author.name: Jiefu Ou, Sapana Chaudhary, Kaj Bostrom, Nathaniel Weir, Shuai Zhang, Huzefa Rangwala, George Karypis

entry.summary: Introduces MaxCode for automated code optimization using max-reward RL framework. Unifies search methods and guides LLMs to discover better solutions through iterative refinement with execution feedback.

entry.title: VIB-Probe: Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models via Variational Information Bottleneck

author.name: Feiran Zhang, Yixin Wu, Zhenghua Wang, Xiaohua Wang, Changze Lv, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes VIB-Probe for hallucination detection in VLMs using Variational Information Bottleneck theory. Probes internal attention heads carrying truthful generation signals.

entry.title: What's Left Unsaid? Detecting and Correcting Misleading Omissions in Multimodal News Previews

author.name: Fanxiao Li, Jiaying Wu, Tingchao Fu, Dayang Li, Herun Wan, Wei Zhou, Min-Yen Kan

entry.summary: Develops OMGuard to detect misleading omissions in multimodal news previews. Proposes pipeline distinguishing preview-based vs context-based understanding and finds LVLMs have blind spots.

entry.title: A Causal Information-Flow Framework for Unbiased Learning-to-Rank

author.name: Haoming Gong, Qingyao Ai, Zhihao Tao, and Yongfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a causal learning framework for unbiased learning-to-rank that combines structural causal models with information theory to jointly handle multiple bias sources (position, selection, trust bias).

entry.title: FLRQ: Faster LLM Quantization with Flexible Low-Rank Matrix Sketching

author.name: Hongyaoxing Gul, Lijuan Hu, Shuzi Niu, Fangfang Liu

entry.summary: FLRQ introduces flexible low-rank quantization for LLMs that automatically identifies accuracy-optimal ranks per layer, avoiding costly manual rank tuning while reducing computational overhead.

entry.title: Left, Right, or Center? Evaluating LLM Framing in News Classification and Generation

author.name: Molly Kennedy, Ali Parker, Yihong Liu, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Studies political framing in LLM text generation across nine state-of-the-art models, finding pervasive ideological center-collapse in both classification and generated text - a systematic tendency toward centrist framing.

entry.title: An Empirical Study on Preference Tuning Generalization and Diversity Under Domain Shift

author.name: Constantinos Karouzos, Xingwei Tan, Nikolaos Aletras

entry.summary: Systematic study of alignment generalization under domain shift, comparing five alignment objectives and various adaptation strategies. Reveals systematic patterns in how preference-tuning degrades across domains.

entry.title: SceneAlign: Aligning Multimodal Reasoning to Scene Graphs in Complex Visual Scenes

author.name: Chuhan Wang, Xintong Li, Jennifer Yuntong Zhang, Junda Wu, Chengkai Huang, Lina Yao, Julian McAuley, Jingbo Shang

entry.summary: SceneAlign framework improves multimodal reasoning by leveraging scene graphs for controllable structural interventions. Addresses hallucination and mis-grounding through four targeted perturbation strategies.

entry.title: Explaining Low Perception Model Competency with High-Competency Counterfactuals

author.name: Sara Pohland and Claire Tomlin

entry.summary: Develops five methods to generate high-competency counterfactual images that explain why a classifier lacks confidence in predictions. Addresses the gap in explaining model uncertainty rather than just classification decisions.

entry.title: Metamorphic Testing of Large Language Models for Natural Language Processing

author.name: Steven Cho, Stefano Ruberto, Valerio Terragni

entry.summary: Applies metamorphic testing to evaluate LLMs on NLP tasks, defining metamorphic relations that establish expected output relationships under input transformations. Addresses the oracle problem in LLM testing.

entry.title: LLM2IR: simple unsupervised contrastive learning makes long-context LLM great retriever

author.name: Xiaocong Yang

entry.summary: Introduces LLM2IR, an efficient unsupervised contrastive learning framework to convert decoder-only LLMs to information retrieval models. Shows that longer context length correlates with stronger IR capacity.

entry.title: Simulation-Free PSRO: Removing Game Simulation from Policy Space Response Oracles

author.name: Yingzhuo Liu, Shuodi Liu, Weijun Luo, Liuyu Xiang, Zhaofeng He

entry.summary: Proposes Simulation-Free PSRO and Dynamic Window-based approach to reduce computational cost of Policy Space Response Oracles for Nash Equilibrium approximation. Addresses game simulation as primary runtime bottleneck.

entry.title: Coding the Visual World: From Image to Simulation Using Vision Language Models

author.name: Sagi Eppel

entry.summary: Explores VLM capacity to recognize and simulate systems depicted in images using Im2Sim methodology. VLM describes system and generates code to simulate it, comparing synthetic output to original image.

entry.title: MOSAIC-GS: Monocular Scene Reconstruction via Advanced Initialization for Complex Dynamic Environments

author.name: Svitlana Morkva, Maximum Wilder-Smith, Michael Oechsle, Alessio Tonioni, Marco Hutter, Vaishakh Patil

entry.summary: Presents MOSAIC-GS for monocular dynamic scene reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting with explicit geometric cues. Leverages depth, optical flow, segmentation, and point tracking for scene dynamics initialization.

entry.title: Efficient Inference for Noisy LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation

author.name: Yiqun T Chen, Sizhu Lu, Sijia Li, Moran Guo, Shengyi Li

entry.summary: Systematically compares measurement error correction and prediction-powered inference approaches for handling noise in LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Provides guidance for accurate benchmark scoring.

entry.title: Thinking with Map: Reinforced Parallel Map-Augmented Agent for Geolocalization

author.name: Yuxiang Ji, Yong Wang, Ziyu Ma, Yiming Hu, Hailang Huang, Xuecai Hu, Guanhua Chen, Liaoni Wu, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Equips vision-language models with map-based reasoning for image geolocalization. Uses two-stage optimization with agentic RL followed by parallel test-time scaling for improved accuracy.

entry.title: PRISMA: Reinforcement Learning Guided Two-Stage Policy Optimization in Multi-Agent Architecture for Open-Domain Multi-Hop Question Answering

author.name: Yu Liu, Wenxiao Zhang, Cong Cao, Wenxuan Lu, Fangfang Yuan, Diandian Guo, Kun Peng, Qiang Sun, Kaiyan Zhang, Yanbing Liu, Jin B.Hong, Bowen Zhou, Zhiyuan Ma

entry.summary: Proposes PRISMA, a two-stage RL-guided multi-agent framework for open-domain multi-hop QA. Addresses retrieval collapse and learning instability through reasoning-guided planning.

entry.title: MemBuilder: Reinforcing LLMs for Long-Term Memory Construction via Attributed Dense Rewards

author.name: Zhiyu Shen, Ziming Wu, Fuming Lai, Shaobing Lian, Yanghui Rao

entry.summary: Introduces MemBuilder, an RL framework for long-term memory construction using attributed dense rewards. Addresses sparse rewards via session-level questions and multi-dimensional memory attribution.

entry.title: FlashMem: Distilling Intrinsic Latent Memory via Computation Reuse

author.name: Yubo Hou, Zhisheng Chen, Tao Wan, Zengchang Qin

entry.summary: Proposes FlashMem for distilling memory from reasoning states via computation reuse. Identifies last hidden state as sufficient statistic for interaction history, enabling efficient latent memory.

entry.title: One Language-Free Foundation Model Is Enough for Universal Vision Anomaly Detection

author.name: Bin-Bin Gao, Chengjie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UniADet, a language-free framework for universal visual anomaly detection. Finds language encoder is not essential and achieves SOTA with vision-only foundation model.

entry.title: Crisis-Bench: Benchmarking Strategic Ambiguity and Reputation Management in Large Language Models

author.name: Cooper Lin, Maohao Ran, Yanting Zhang, Zhenglin Wan, Hongwei Fan, Yibo Xu, Yike Guo, Wei Xue, Jun Song

entry.summary: Introduces Crisis-Bench, a multi-agent POMDP benchmark for evaluating LLMs in corporate crisis management. Tests strategic ambiguity and reputation management across 80 storylines.

entry.title: Generalizable and Adaptive Continual Learning Framework for AI-generated Image Detection

author.name: Hanyi Wang, Jun Lan, Yaoyu Kang, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Zhuosheng Zhang, Shilin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage continual learning framework for detecting AI-generated images that can adapt to new generative models over time. Combines parameter-efficient fine-tuning, pseudo-labeling, and feature replay strategies.

entry.title: ACR: Adaptive Context Refactoring via Context Refactoring Operators for Multi-Turn Dialogue

author.name: Jiawei Shen, Jia Zhu, Hanghui Guo, Weijie Shi, Yue Cui, Qingyu Niu, Guoqing Ma, Yidan Liang, Jingjiang Liu, Yiling Wang, Shimin Di, Jiajie Xu

entry.summary: ACR framework addresses contextual inertia and state drift in multi-turn dialogue by dynamically monitoring and reshaping interaction history through context refactoring operators.

entry.title: Tracing Stereotypes in Pre-trained Transformers: From Biased Neurons to Fairer Models

author.name: Gianmario Voria, Moses Openja, Foutse Khomh, Gemma Catolino, Fabio Palomba

entry.summary: Identifies 'biased neurons' in transformers that encode stereotypical associations, building on knowledge neuron concepts. Creates dataset of biased relations across nine bias types.

entry.title: Boosting Latent Diffusion Models via Disentangled Representation Alignment

author.name: John Page, Xuesong Niu, Kai Wu, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Proposes that VAEs and LDMs should have different alignment targets: LDMs benefit from high-level semantic concepts while VAEs should excel in semantic disentanglement for attribute-level information encoding.

entry.title: CLewR: Curriculum Learning with Restarts for Machine Translation Preference Learning

author.name: Alexandra Dragomir, Florin Brad, Radu Tudor Ionescu

entry.summary: CLewR introduces curriculum learning with restarts for machine translation preference optimization, iterating easy-to-hard curriculum multiple times to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Shows consistent gains across Gemma2, Qwen2.5, and Llama3.1.

entry.title: iReasoner: Trajectory-Aware Intrinsic Reasoning Supervision for Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Meghana Sunil, Manikandarajan Venmathimaran, Muthu Subash Kavitha

entry.summary: iReasoner improves LMM self-evolution by explicitly eliciting chain-of-thought and rewarding internal agreement across reasoning trajectories, providing trajectory-aware intrinsic rewards without ground-truth labels.

entry.title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?

author.name: Jingsheng Zheng, Jintian Zhang, Yujie Luo, Yuren Mao, Yunjun Gao, Lun Du, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang

entry.summary: Formalizes Data-centric Solution Preference for predicting ML agent outcomes without execution, constructing corpus of 18k pairwise comparisons. Shows LLMs achieve 61.5% accuracy when primed with Verified Data Analysis Reports.

entry.title: Should the AI Safety Community Prioritize Safety Cases?

author.name: JanWehner

entry.summary: Synthesizes expert perspectives on whether AI Safety Cases should be a community priority, examining their feasibility, impact, and limitations. Notes that Anthropic and DeepMind have committed to making Safety Cases in their RSPs, and reviews the growing literature on structured safety argumentation.

entry.title: Continual Pretraining on Encrypted Synthetic Data for Privacy-Preserving LLMs

author.name: Honghao Liu, Xuhui Jiang, Chengjin Xu, Cehao Yang, Yiran Cheng, Lionel Ni, Jian Guo

entry.summary: Proposes privacy-preserving continual pretraining using entity-based synthetic data generation with deterministic encryption of PII, enabling knowledge encoding while protecting sensitive information.

entry.title: SketchVL: Policy Optimization via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Chart Understanding and More

author.name: Muye Huang, Lingling Zhang, Yifei Li, Yaqiang Wu, Jun Liu

entry.summary: SketchVL is an MLLM optimized with FinePO algorithm for fine-grained credit assignment in chart understanding, drawing intermediate reasoning steps on images as visual sketches.

entry.title: Automated Generation of MDPs Using Logic Programming and LLMs for Robotic Applications

author.name: Enrico Saccon, Davide De Martini, Matteo Saveriano, Edoardo Lamon, Luigi Palopoli, Marco Roveri

entry.summary: Integrates LLMs with automated planning and formal verification to automatically construct MDPs from natural language descriptions. Uses Prolog knowledge bases and Storm model checker to synthesize optimal robot policies.

entry.title: Intent at a Glance: Gaze-Guided Robotic Manipulation via Foundation Models

author.name: Tracey Yee Hsin Tay, Xu Yan, Jonathan Ouyang, Daniel Wu, William Jiang, Jonathan Kao, Yuchen Cui

entry.summary: Presents GAMMA, a system using ego-centric gaze tracking and vision-language models to infer user intent for robotic manipulation. Maps visual attention to semantic understanding without task-specific training.

entry.title: GlyRAG: Context-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Blood Glucose Forecasting

author.name: Shovito Barua Soumma, Hassan Ghasemzadeh

entry.summary: Proposes GlyRAG, a context-aware RAG framework for blood glucose forecasting using LLMs as semantic extractors from CGM traces. Derives context directly from glucose data without additional sensors.

entry.title: Autoregressive Ranking: Bridging the Gap Between Dual and Cross Encoders

author.name: Benjamin Rozonoyer, Chong You, Michael Boratko, Himanshu Jain, Nilesh Gupta, Srinadh Bhojanapalli, Andrew McCallum and Felix Yu

entry.summary: Proposes autoregressive ranking that bridges dual and cross encoders for information retrieval, proving expressivity bounds and introducing rank-aware loss functions for LLM-based ranking.

entry.title: AGDC: Autoregressive Generation of Variable-Length Sequences with Joint Discrete and Continuous Spaces

author.name: Yeonsang Shin and Insoo Kim and Bongkeun Kim and Keonwoo Bae and Bohyung Han

entry.summary: AGDC framework jointly models discrete and continuous values for variable-length sequences using hybrid categorical prediction and diffusion-based modeling, targeting high-precision domains like semiconductor design.

entry.title: FeatureSLAM: Feature-enriched 3D gaussian splatting SLAM in real time

author.name: Christopher Thirgood, Oscar Mendez, Erin Ling, Jon Storey, Simon Hadfield

entry.summary: FeatureSLAM integrates dense feature rasterization into 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM, aligned with visual foundation models, enabling real-time tracking with open-set segmentation capabilities.

entry.title: Deep learning-enabled virtual multiplexed immunostaining of label-free tissue for vascular invasion assessment

author.name: Yijie Zhang, Cagatay Isil, Xilin Yang, Yuzhu Li, Anna Elia, Karin Atlan, William Dean Wallace, Nir Pillar, Aydogan Ozcan

entry.summary: Presents deep learning framework for virtual multiplexed immunostaining from label-free tissue images. Generates ERG, PanCK, and H&E staining simultaneously for detecting vascular invasion in thyroid cancers.

entry.title: KP-Agent: Keyword Pruning in Sponsored Search Advertising via LLM-Powered Contextual Bandits

author.name: Hou-Wan Long, Yicheng Song, Zidong Wang, Tianshu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes KP-Agent, an LLM agentic system with contextual bandits for keyword pruning in sponsored search advertising. Achieves up to 49.28% profit improvement using reinforcement learning for keyword set refinement.

entry.title: Channel Selected Stratified Nested Cross Validation for Clinically Relevant EEG Based Parkinsons Disease Detection

author.name: Nicholas R. Rasmussen, Rodrigue Rizk, Longwei Wang, Arun Singh, KC Santosh

entry.summary: Proposes unified evaluation framework for EEG-based Parkinson's detection with nested cross-validation and three safeguards: patient-level stratification, multi-layered windowing, and channel selection optimization.

entry.title: The Table of Media Bias Elements: A sentence-level taxonomy of media bias types and propaganda techniques

author.name: Tim Menzner, Jochen L. Leidner

entry.summary: Presents fine-grained, sentence-level taxonomy of media bias comprising 38 elementary bias types arranged in six functional families. Based on 26,464 sentences with definitions, examples, and cognitive foundations.

entry.title: Sketch&Patch++: Efficient Structure-Aware 3D Gaussian Representation

author.name: Yuang Shi and Simone Gasparini and G\'eraldine Morin and Wei Tsang Ooi

entry.summary: Introduces hybrid 3D Gaussian representation separating high-frequency 'Sketch' Gaussians for edges from low-frequency 'Patch' Gaussians for smooth regions. Enables layered progressive streaming with 30-40% memory reduction.

entry.title: Interactive Distillation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Minwoo Cho, Batuhan Altundas, and Matthew Gombolay

entry.summary: Proposes HINT framework for knowledge distillation in multi-agent RL using hierarchical teachers and pseudo off-policy learning. Addresses scalability, out-of-distribution states, and observation space mismatches.

entry.title: What Functions Does XGBoost Learn?

author.name: Dohyeong Ki, Adityanand Guntuboyina

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical foundation for functions learned by XGBoost, introducing infinite-dimensional function class and complexity measure. Shows XGBoost optimizers also optimize penalized regression over broader function class.

entry.title: ART: Adaptive Reasoning Trees for Explainable Claim Verification

author.name: Sahil Wadhwa, Himanshu Kumar, Guanqun Yang, Abbaas Alif Mohamed Nishar, Pranab Mohanty, Swapnil Shinde, Yue Wu

entry.summary: Proposes ART (Adaptive Reasoning Trees) for explainable claim verification using hierarchical argument structure. Determines argument strength via pairwise tournaments adjudicated by LLM judge.

entry.title: STELP: Secure Transpilation and Execution of LLM-Generated Programs

author.name: Swapnil Shinde, Sahil Wadhwa, Andy Luo, Emily Chen

entry.summary: Discusses safety and reliability problems with LLM-generated code in production, proposing STELP for secure transpilation and execution. Addresses vulnerabilities like data poisoning and hallucinations.

entry.title: Efficient Differentiable Causal Discovery via Reliable Super-Structure Learning

author.name: Pingchuan Ma, Qixin Zhang, Shuai Wang, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Proposes ALVGL for efficient differentiable causal discovery using super-structure learning. Addresses challenges of high-dimensional data and latent confounders through reliable super-structure guidance.

entry.title: MMViR: A Multi-Modal and Multi-Granularity Representation for Long-range Video Understanding

author.name: Zizhong Li, Haopeng Zhang, Jiawei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MMViR for long video understanding using multi-modal, multi-granularity structured representation. Identifies turning points for segmentation and constructs three-level descriptions coupling global and local details.

entry.title: Hi-ZFO: Hierarchical Zeroth- and First-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Importance-Guided Tensor Selection

author.name: Feihu Jin and Ying Tan

entry.summary: Proposes Hi-ZFO, hybrid optimization combining zeroth-order exploration with first-order precision for LLM fine-tuning. Adaptively partitions model through importance-guided tensor selection.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Differentiate Harmful from Argumentative Essays? Steps Toward Ethical Essay Scoring

author.name: Hongjin Kim, Jeonghyun Kang, Harksoo Kim

entry.summary: Introduces Harmful Essay Detection benchmark testing LLMs' ability to distinguish harmful from argumentative essays. Finds LLMs need enhancement for accurate harmful content identification in AES.

entry.title: Learn to Evolve: Self-supervised Neural JKO Operator for Wasserstein Gradient Flow

author.name: Xue Feng, Li Wang, Deanna Needell, and Rongjie Lai

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised approach for learning a neural operator that solves JKO subproblems for Wasserstein gradient flows without requiring numerical ground truth solutions. Introduces Learn-to-Evolve algorithm for joint training.

entry.title: SGDrive: Scene-to-Goal Hierarchical World Cognition for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jingyu Li, Junjie Wu, Dongnan Hu, Xiangkai Huang, Bin Sun, Zhihui Hao, Xianpeng Lang, Xiatian Zhu, Li Zhang

entry.summary: SGDrive structures VLM representation learning for autonomous driving around scene-goal hierarchies, decomposing driving understanding into structured spatial-temporal representations.

entry.title: Logic-Parametric Neuro-Symbolic NLI: Controlling Logical Formalisms for Verifiable LLM Reasoning

author.name: Ali Farjami, Luca Redondi, Marco Valentino

entry.summary: Proposes logic-parametric framework for neuro-symbolic NLI treating underlying logic as controllable component, comparing classical and non-classical formalisms embedded in higher-order logic for normative reasoning.

entry.title: TAGRPO: Boosting GRPO on Image-to-Video Generation with Direct Trajectory Alignment

author.name: Jin Wang, Jianxiang Lu, Guangzheng Xu, Comi Chen, Haoyu Yang, Linqing Wang, Peng Chen, Mingtao Chen, Zhichao Hu, Longhuang Wu, Shuai Shao, Qinglin Lu, Ping Luo

entry.summary: TAGRPO improves GRPO for image-to-video models using contrastive learning on rollouts from identical initial noise, applying novel loss to intermediate latents for trajectory alignment.

entry.title: Modular Autonomy with Conversational Interaction: An LLM-driven Framework for Decision Making in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Marvin Seegert, Korbinian Moller, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: Framework integrating LLM-based natural language interface with Autoware autonomous driving software, enabling passengers to issue high-level commands. Includes a domain-specific language for command translation and safety-preserving validation layer.

entry.title: DexterCap: An Affordable and Automated System for Capturing Dexterous Hand-Object Manipulation

author.name: Yutong Liang, Shiyi Xu, Yulong Zhang, Bowen Zhan, He Zhang, Libin Liu

entry.summary: DexterCap is a low-cost optical capture system for dexterous hand-object manipulation using dense character-coded markers and automated reconstruction. Introduces DexterHand dataset of fine-grained hand-object interactions.

entry.title: StackPlanner: A Centralized Hierarchical Multi-Agent System with Task-Experience Memory Management

author.name: Ruizhe Zhang, Xinke Jiang, Zhibang Yang, Zhixin Zhang, Jiaran Gao, Yuzhen Xiao, Hongbin Lai, Xu Chu, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang

entry.summary: StackPlanner is a hierarchical multi-agent framework with explicit memory control, decoupling coordination from execution and learning to retrieve reusable coordination experience for complex tasks.

entry.title: Auditing Fairness under Model Updates: Fundamental Complexity and Property-Preserving Updates

author.name: Ayoub Ajarra, Debabrota Basu

entry.summary: Studies group fairness auditing when models may be adaptively updated while preserving certain properties, characterizing information complexity of allowable updates and identifying what can be reliably audited.

entry.title: Adapting Vision Transformers to Ultra-High Resolution Semantic Segmentation with Relay Tokens

author.name: Yohann Perron, Vladyslav Sydorov, Christophe Pottier, Loic Landrieu

entry.summary: Proposes relay tokens for vision transformers to handle ultra-high resolution segmentation, processing images at local and global scales in parallel and propagating features between branches.

entry.title: CyberGFM: Graph Foundation Models for Lateral Movement Detection in Enterprise Networks

author.name: Isaiah J. King and Bernardo Trindade and Benjamin Bowman and H. Howie Huang

entry.summary: CyberGFM proposes graph foundation models for lateral movement detection in enterprise networks, extending random walk insights to transformer-based language models for link prediction on network graphs.

entry.title: Don't Break the Cache: An Evaluation of Prompt Caching for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks

author.name: Elias Lumer and Faheem Nizar and Akshaya Jangiti and Kevin Frank and Anmol Gulati and Mandar Phadate and Vamse Kumar Subbiah

entry.summary: Comprehensive evaluation of prompt caching across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google for multi-turn agentic tasks, comparing full context, system prompt only, and selective caching strategies.

entry.title: Why AIs aren't power-seeking yet

author.name: Eli Tyre

entry.summary: Explains why current AI systems don't exhibit power-seeking behavior by decomposing the requirements into capability (effectiveness at pursuing instrumental goals) and inclination (having misaligned goals against humans). Argues current AIs lack sufficient capability, but notes they sometimes pursue their own objectives.

entry.title: A Future Capabilities Agent for Tactical Air Traffic Control

author.name: Paul Kent, George De Ath, Martin Layton, Allen Hart, Richard Everson, Ben Carvell

entry.summary: Presents Agent Mallard, a forward-planning, rules-based agent for tactical air traffic control that embeds stochastic digital twins in its conflict-resolution loop. Operates on GPS-guided routes with hierarchical planning.

entry.title: Effects of personality steering on cooperative behavior in Large Language Model agents

author.name: Mizuki Sakai, Mizuki Yokoyama, Wakaba Tateishi, Genki Ichinose

entry.summary: Examines effects of Big Five personality steering on LLM cooperation in repeated Prisoner's Dilemma games. Tests GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4o, and GPT-5 under baseline and personality-informed conditions.

entry.title: When the Server Steps In: Calibrated Updates for Fair Federated Learning

author.name: Tianrun Yu, Kaixiang Zhao, Cheng Zhang, Anjun Gao, Yueyang Quan, Zhuqing Liu, Minghong Fang

entry.summary: Introduces EquFL, a server-side debiasing method for federated learning that generates synthetic bias-aware samples to calibrate model updates without modifying client training protocols.

entry.title: STResNet & STYOLO : A New Family of Compact Classification and Object Detection Models for MCUs

author.name: Sudhakar Sah, Ravish Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces STResNet for classification and STYOLO for detection, optimized for microcontrollers and NPUs. STResNetMilli achieves 70% Top-1 ImageNet accuracy with 3M parameters.

entry.title: HogVul: Black-box Adversarial Code Generation Framework Against LM-based Vulnerability Detectors

author.name: Jingxiao Yang, Ping He, Tianyu Du, Sun Bing, Xuhong Zhang

entry.summary: HogVul is a black-box adversarial framework for attacking LM-based vulnerability detectors using coordinated lexical and syntax perturbations optimized via particle swarm optimization.

entry.title: CHDP: Cooperative Hybrid Diffusion Policies for Reinforcement Learning in Parameterized Action Space

author.name: Bingyi Liu, Jinbo He, Haiyong Shi, Enshu Wang, Weizhen Han, Jingxiang Hao, Peixi Wang, Zhuangzhuang Zhang

entry.summary: CHDP treats hybrid discrete-continuous action space as cooperative game, using two diffusion policies for discrete and continuous actions with conditioning for dependency modeling.

entry.title: Rotate Your Character: Revisiting Video Diffusion Models for High-Quality 3D Character Generation

author.name: Jin Wang, Jianxiang Lu, Comi Chen, Guangzheng Xu, Haoyu Yang, Peng Chen, Na Zhang, Yifan Xu, Longhuang Wu, Shuai Shao, Qinglin Lu, Ping Luo

entry.summary: RCM is an image-to-video diffusion framework for 3D character generation that transfers complex poses to canonical poses, enabling consistent 1024x1024 orbital video generation with controllable camera positions.

entry.title: DynaDebate: Breaking Homogeneity in Multi-Agent Debate with Dynamic Path Generation

author.name: Zhenghao Li, Zhi Zheng, Wei Chen, Jielun Zhao, Yong Chen, Tong Xu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: DynaDebate improves multi-agent debate by addressing homogeneity problem where agents adopt identical reasoning paths. Uses dynamic path generation to enable effective diverse debate.

entry.title: Distilling Feedback into Memory-as-a-Tool

author.name: V\'ictor Gallego

entry.summary: Framework that amortizes inference-time reasoning cost by converting transient critiques into retrievable guidelines through file-based memory and agent-controlled tool calls. Evaluated on Rubric Feedback Bench.

entry.title: EvoQRE: Modeling Bounded Rationality in Safety-Critical Traffic Simulation via Evolutionary Quantal Response Equilibrium

author.name: Phu-Hoa Pham, Chi-Nguyen Tran, Duy-Minh Dao-Sy, Phu-Quy Nguyen-Lam, and Trung-Kiet Huynh

entry.summary: EvoQRE models safety-critical traffic interactions as games solved via Quantal Response Equilibrium with evolutionary dynamics, capturing bounded rationality of human drivers in simulation.

entry.title: Multimodal In-context Learning for ASR of Low-resource Languages

author.name: Zhaolin Li, Jan Niehues

entry.summary: Investigates multimodal in-context learning for ASR of unseen low-resource languages, showing speech LLMs can learn from both speech and text examples to improve recognition.

entry.title: Online Test-Time Adaptation of Spatial-Temporal Traffic Flow Forecasting

author.name: Pengxin Guo, Pengrong Jin, Ziyue Li, Lei Bai, and Yu Zhang

entry.summary: First study applying online test-time adaptation to spatial-temporal traffic flow forecasting, proposing an Adaptive Double Correction method using series decomposition. Addresses temporal drift between training and deployment data.

entry.title: Learning to Reason: Temporal Saliency Distillation for Interpretable Knowledge Transfer

author.name: Nilushika Udayangani Hewa Dehigahawattage, Kishor Nandakishor and Marimuthu Palaniswami

entry.summary: Introduces Temporal Saliency Distillation for interpretable knowledge transfer in time series models. Addresses limitations of standard knowledge distillation methods that ignore temporal dependencies.

entry.title: Online Action-Stacking Improves Reinforcement Learning Performance for Air Traffic Control

author.name: Ben Carvell, George De Ath, Eseoghene Benjamin, Richard Everson

entry.summary: Introduces online action-stacking, an inference-time wrapper that compiles bursts of primitive RL actions into domain-appropriate compound ATC clearances. Enables training on smaller action spaces while producing realistic commands.

entry.title: Naiad: Novel Agentic Intelligent Autonomous System for Inland Water Monitoring

author.name: Eirini Baltzi, Tilemachos Moumouris, Athena Psalta, Vasileios Tsironis, Konstantinos Karantzalos

entry.summary: Introduces NAIAD, an agentic AI assistant using LLMs for holistic inland water monitoring from Earth Observation data. Combines RAG, tool orchestration, and agentic reflection for single-prompt environmental analysis.

entry.title: Transforming User Defined Criteria into Explainable Indicators with an Integrated LLM AHP System

author.name: Geonwoo Bang, Dongho Kim, Moohong Min

entry.summary: Presents interpretable aggregation framework combining LLM scoring with Analytic Hierarchy Process for converting user-defined criteria into quantitative indicators. Uses Jensen-Shannon distance for discriminative power measurement.

entry.title: Mathematical Knowledge Graph-Driven Framework for Equation-Based Predictive and Reliable Additive Manufacturing

author.name: Yeongbin Cha, Namjung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes ontology-guided framework integrating LLMs with additive manufacturing mathematical knowledge graph. Enables reliable knowledge extraction and principled extrapolative modeling for process-property relationships.

entry.title: Improving Enzyme Prediction with Chemical Reaction Equations by Hypergraph-Enhanced Knowledge Graph Embeddings

author.name: Tengwei Song, Long Yin, Zhen Han, Zhiqiang Xu

entry.summary: Uses hypergraph-enhanced knowledge graph embeddings for enzyme-substrate interaction prediction. Addresses sparse database limitations by exploiting chemical reaction equations with multi-compound interactions.

entry.title: A Bayesian Generative Modeling Approach for Arbitrary Conditional Inference

author.name: Qiao Liu and Wing Hung Wong

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian generative modeling approach for flexible conditional inference P(X_B|X_A) without retraining for each new conditioning structure. Uses iterative Bayesian updating until convergence.

entry.title: The Kernel Manifold: A Geometric Approach to Gaussian Process Model Selection

author.name: Md Shafiqul Islam, Shakti Prasad Padhy, Douglas Allaire, Raymundo Arr\'oyave

entry.summary: Presents Bayesian optimization framework for GP kernel selection using kernel-of-kernels geometry. Uses expected divergence-based distances and MDS embedding to map discrete kernel library to continuous manifold.

entry.title: Imitation Learning for Combinatorial Optimisation under Uncertainty

author.name: Prakash Gawas, Antoine Legrain and Louis-Martin Rousseau

entry.summary: Presents a systematic taxonomy of expert constructions for imitation learning in combinatorial optimization under uncertainty. Classifies experts by treatment of uncertainty, computational properties, and impact on learning performance.

entry.title: RingSQL: Generating Synthetic Data with Schema-Independent Templates for Text-to-SQL Reasoning Models

author.name: Marko Sterbentz, Kevin Cushing, Cameron Barrie, Kristian J. Hammond

entry.summary: Introduces RingSQL for synthetic text-to-SQL data generation using schema-independent templates with LLM paraphrasing. Preserves SQL correctness while providing linguistic variety.

entry.title: Towards Valid Student Simulation with Large Language Models

author.name: Zhihao Yuan, Yunze Xiao, Ming Li, Weihao Xuan, Richard Tong, Mona Diab and Tom Mitchell

entry.summary: Introduces framework for LLM-based student simulation addressing the 'competence paradox' where capable LLMs must emulate partial learners. Proposes Epistemic State Specification for constrained generation.

entry.title: GaussianSwap: Animatable Video Face Swapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Xuan Cheng, Jiahao Rao, Chengyang Li, Wenhao Wang, Weilin Chen, Lvqing Yang

entry.summary: Introduces GaussianSwap for video face swapping using 3D Gaussian Splatting to create animatable face avatars. Transfers identity from source image to target video avatar.

entry.title: DeMa: Dual-Path Delay-Aware Mamba for Efficient Multivariate Time Series Analysis

author.name: Rui An, Haohao Qu, Wenqi Fan, Xuequn Shang, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes DeMa, a dual-path Mamba architecture for multivariate time series with explicit cross-variate modeling and delay-aware mechanisms. Addresses limitations of vanilla Mamba for MTS.

entry.title: Learning specifications for reactive synthesis with safety constraints

author.name: Kandai Watanabe, Nicholas Renninger, Sriram Sankaranarayanan, Morteza Lahijanian

entry.summary: Presents approach for learning task specifications as PDFAs from demonstrations with safety constraints. Introduces multi-objective reactive synthesis for balancing robot costs with user preferences.

entry.title: Scalable Heterogeneous Graph Learning via Heterogeneous-aware Orthogonal Prototype Experts

author.name: Wei Zhou, Hong Huang, Ruize Shi, Bang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HOPE framework for heterogeneous graph learning using prototype-based expert routing. Addresses linear projection bottleneck and structural imbalance in HGNNs.

entry.title: Understanding LLM-Driven Test Oracle Generation

author.name: Adam Bodicoat and Gunel Jahangirova and Valerio Terragni

entry.summary: Empirical study on LLMs for test oracle generation examining whether they can distinguish intended from implemented behavior. Evaluates effectiveness in exposing software failures.

entry.title: The ICASSP 2026 HumDial Challenge: Benchmarking Human-like Spoken Dialogue Systems in the LLM Era

author.name: Zhixian Zhao, Shuiyuan Wang, Guojian Li, Hongfei Xue, Chengyou Wang, Shuai Wang, Longshuai Xiao, Zihan Zhang, Hui Bu, Xin Xu, Xinsheng Wang, Hexin Liu, Eng Siong Chng, Hung-yi Lee, Haizhou Li, Lei Xie

entry.summary: Announces ICASSP 2026 HumDial Challenge for benchmarking human-like spoken dialogue systems. Focuses on emotional intelligence and real-time turn-taking with dataset from authentic conversations.

entry.title: Towards Generalized Multi-Image Editing for Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Pengcheng Xu, Peng Tang, Donghao Luo, Xiaobin Hu, Weichu Cui, Qingdong He, Zhennan Chen, Jiangning Zhang, Charles Ling, Boyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes framework for multi-image editing in unified multimodal models using learnable latent separators and sinusoidal index encoding. Enables variable input counts with visual consistency.

entry.title: Orient Anything V2: Unifying Orientation and Rotation Understanding

author.name: Zehan Wang, Ziang Zhang, Jiayang Xu, Jialei Wang, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, HengShuang Zhao, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Orient Anything V2 is an enhanced foundation model for understanding 3D object orientation and rotation from single or paired images, handling objects with diverse rotational symmetries. It introduces scalable synthetic data generation and symmetry-aware training objectives.

entry.title: PiXTime: A Model for Federated Time Series Forecasting with Heterogeneous Data Structures Across Nodes

author.name: Yiming Zhou and Mingyue Cheng and Hao Wang and Enhong Chen

entry.summary: PiXTime enables federated learning for time series forecasting across nodes with heterogeneous data granularities and variable sets through personalized patch embedding and global variable table alignment.

entry.title: AIBoMGen: Generating an AI Bill of Materials for Secure, Transparent, and Compliant Model Training

author.name: Wiebe Vandendriessche, Jordi Thijsman, Laurens D'hooge, Bruno Volckaert, Merlijn Sebrechts

entry.summary: AIBoMGen automates generation of AI Bills of Materials for trained models, capturing datasets, metadata, and environment details with cryptographic verification for compliance and security.

entry.title: mHC-lite: You Don't Need 20 Sinkhorn-Knopp Iterations

author.name: Yongyi Yang, Jianyang Gao

entry.summary: mHC-lite simplifies DeepSeek's manifold-constrained hyper-connections by replacing iterative Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization with more efficient approaches that guarantee doubly stochasticity.

entry.title: Decoding Workload and Agreement From EEG During Spoken Dialogue With Conversational AI

author.name: Lucija Mihi\'c Zidar, Philipp Wicke, Praneel Bhatia, Rosa Lutz, Marius Klug, Thorsten O. Zander

entry.summary: Investigates whether EEG-based mental state classifiers for workload and agreement can transfer to spoken human-AI dialogue, introducing conversational paradigms and alignment pipelines for continuous BCI classification during AI interactions.

entry.title: LayerGS: Decomposition and Inpainting of Layered 3D Human Avatars via 2D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yinghan Xu, John Dingliana

entry.summary: LayerGS decomposes posed humans into animatable multi-layered 3D avatars separating body and garments using 2D Gaussian splatting, inpainting hidden regions with diffusion models via score-distillation sampling.

entry.title: Gender Bias in LLMs: Preliminary Evidence from Shared Parenting Scenario in Czech Family Law

author.name: Jakub Harasta and Matej Vasina and Martin Kornel and Tomas Foltynek

entry.summary: Examines gender bias in LLMs for Czech family law divorce scenarios across GPT-5 nano, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Llama 3.3, introducing legally relevant factors to vary the scenario.

entry.title: HAPS: Hierarchical LLM Routing with Joint Architecture and Parameter Search

author.name: Zihang Tian, Rui Li, Jingsen Zhang, Xiaohe Bo, Wei Huo, Xu Chen

entry.summary: HAPS introduces hierarchical LLM routing jointly searching over model architectures and parameter settings, using high-level router for architecture selection and low-level router for parameter optimization.

entry.title: Pantagruel: Unified Self-Supervised Encoders for French Text and Speech

author.name: Phuong-Hang Le, Valentin Pelloin, Arnault Chatelain, Maryem Bouziane, Mohammed Ghennai, Qianwen Guan, Kirill Milintsevich, Salima Mdhaffar, Aidan Mannion, Nils Defauw, Shuyue Gu, Alexandre Audibert, Marco Dinarelli, Yannick Est\`eve, Lorraine Goeuriot, Steffen Lalande, Nicolas Herv\'e, Maximin Coavoux, Fran\c{c}ois Portet, \'Etienne Ollion, Marie Candito, Maxime Peyrard, Solange Rossato, Benjamin Lecouteux, Aur\'elie Nardy, Gilles S\'erasset, Vincent Segonne, Sol\`ene Evain, Diandra Fabre, Didier Schwab

entry.summary: Pantagruel models are self-supervised encoders for French text and speech learning contextualized representations. Introduces INA-100k, 100k-hour French audio corpus from national broadcast archives.

entry.title: Deepfake detectors are DUMB: A benchmark to assess adversarial training robustness under transferability constraints

author.name: Adrian Serrano, Erwan Umlil, Ronan Thomas

entry.summary: Extends DUMB benchmark methodology to deepfake detection, evaluating detector robustness against adversarial attacks under transferability constraints and cross-dataset configurations across five detectors and three attacks.

entry.title: AdaFuse: Adaptive Ensemble Decoding with Test-Time Scaling for LLMs

author.name: Chengming Cui, Tianxin Wei, Ziyi Chen, Ruizhong Qiu, Zhichen Zeng, Zhining Liu, Xuying Ning, Duo Zhou, Jingrui He

entry.summary: AdaFuse is an adaptive ensemble decoding framework that dynamically selects fusion granularity during LLM generation based on decoding context, combining strengths of multiple models at inference time.

entry.title: Continual Learning of Achieving Forgetting-free and Positive Knowledge Transfer

author.name: Zhi Wang and Zhongbin Wu and Yanni Li and Bing Liu and Guangxi Li and Yuping Wang

entry.summary: Models continual learning as optimization problem explicitly targeting positive forward and backward knowledge transfer while preventing forgetting. Proposes Enhanced Task Continual Learning framework.

entry.title: Tensor-DTI: Enhancing Biomolecular Interaction Prediction with Contrastive Embedding Learning

author.name: Manel Gil-Sorribes, J\'ulia Vilalta-Mor, Isaac Filella-Merc\`e, Robert Soliva, \'Alvaro Ciudad, V\'ictor Guallar, Alexis Molina

entry.summary: Tensor-DTI uses contrastive learning to integrate multimodal embeddings from molecular graphs, protein language models, and binding-site predictions for improved drug-target interaction prediction.

entry.title: Digital Twins in the Cloud: A Modular, Scalable and Interoperable Framework for Accelerating Verification and Validation of Autonomous Driving Solutions

author.name: Tanmay Vilas Samak, Chinmay Vilas Samak, Giovanni Martino, Pranav Nair, Venkat Krovi

entry.summary: Presents a modular framework for scaling digital twins in high-performance computing clusters for autonomous vehicle verification and validation. Enables automated testing across diverse scenarios including rare and hazardous situations.

entry.title: MemKD: Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Time Series Classification

author.name: Nilushika Udayangani, Kishor Nandakishor, and Marimuthu Palaniswami

entry.summary: Proposes MemKD, a memory-discrepancy based knowledge distillation method for efficient time series classification on resource-constrained devices. Addresses temporal dependencies and memory patterns in recurrent networks.

entry.title: SP-Rank: A Dataset for Ranked Preferences with Secondary Information

author.name: Hadi Hosseini and Debmalya Mandal and Amrit Puhan

entry.summary: Introduces SP-Rank, first large-scale dataset for benchmarking algorithms using both first-order preferences and second-order predictions. Contains 12,000+ datapoints across geography, movies, and paintings.

entry.title: Enhancing Foundation Models in Transaction Understanding with LLM-based Sentence Embeddings

author.name: Xiran Fan, Zhimeng Jiang, Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Yuzhong Chen, Yingtong Dou, Menghai Pan, Yan Zheng

entry.summary: Uses LLM-generated embeddings as semantic initializations for lightweight transaction models in payment networks. Balances semantic understanding with operational efficiency for financial applications.

entry.title: Ontology Neural Networks for Topologically Conditioned Constraint Satisfaction

author.name: Jaehong Oh

entry.summary: Presents enhanced Ontology Neural Networks integrating topological conditioning with gradient stabilization. Uses Forman-Ricci curvature, Deep Delta Learning, and CMA-ES optimization achieving 95% constraint satisfaction success.

entry.title: Ensemble of radiomics and ConvNeXt for breast cancer diagnosis

author.name: Jorge Alberto Garza-Abdala, Gerardo Alejandro Fumagal-Gonz\'alez, Beatriz A. Bosques-Palomo, Mario Alexis Monsivais Molina, Daly Avedano, Servando Cardona-Huerta, Jos\'e Gerardo Tamez-Pena

entry.summary: Combines radiomics and ConvNeXt deep learning for breast cancer detection from screening mammograms. Validates across two independent datasets (RSNA and Mexican TecSalud cohort) using ensemble methods.

entry.title: Do LLMs Need Inherent Reasoning Before Reinforcement Learning? A Study in Korean Self-Correction

author.name: Hongjin Kim, Jaewook Lee, Kiyoung Lee, Jong-hun Shin, Soojong Lim, Oh-Woog Kwon

entry.summary: Investigates whether RL can enhance Korean reasoning in LLMs. Finds RL alone yields limited improvements without inherent Korean reasoning; proposes tuning Korean-specific neurons in early layers.

entry.title: TOSC: Task-Oriented Shape Completion for Open-World Dexterous Grasp Generation from Partial Point Clouds

author.name: Weishang Wu, Yifei Shi, Zhiping Cai

entry.summary: Studies task-oriented shape completion for dexterous grasping under partial observation. Uses foundation models for generating completion candidates and discriminative autoencoder for evaluation.

entry.title: MoGen: A Unified Collaborative Framework for Controllable Multi-Object Image Generation

author.name: Yanfeng Li, Yue Sun, Keren Fu, Sio-Kei Im, Xiaoming Liu, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaohong Liu, and Tao Tan

entry.summary: Proposes MoGen for controllable multi-object image generation using Regional Semantic Anchor module. Addresses quantity inconsistency and attribute aliasing without rigid external control signals.

entry.title: GS-DMSR: Dynamic Sensitive Multi-scale Manifold Enhancement for Accelerated High-Quality 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Nengbo Lu, Minghua Pan, Shaohua Sun, and Yizhou Liang

entry.summary: GS-DMSR improves 3D Gaussian splatting for dynamic scenes through adaptive gradient focusing based on motion state analysis. Achieves faster convergence while maintaining rendering quality.

entry.title: HAG: Hierarchical Demographic Tree-based Agent Generation for Topic-Adaptive Simulation

author.name: Rongxin Chen, Tianyu Wu, Bingbing Xu, Xiucheng Xu and Huawei Shen

entry.summary: HAG framework for topic-adaptive agent generation uses hierarchical demographic tree construction to capture macro-level distributions while ensuring micro-level individual rationality in agent-based modeling.

entry.title: One Script Instead of Hundreds? On Pretraining Romanized Encoder Language Models

author.name: Benedikt Ebing, Lennart Keller and Goran Glava\v{s}

entry.summary: Investigates whether script romanization is beneficial for pretraining general-purpose multilingual encoders, finding information loss from romanization can harm performance for high-resource languages.

entry.title: GeoSurDepth: Spatial Geometry-Consistent Self-Supervised Depth Estimation for Surround-View Cameras

author.name: Weimin Liu, Wenjun Wang, Joshua H. Meng

entry.summary: GeoSurDepth leverages geometry consistency using foundation models as pseudo geometry priors for surround-view depth estimation in autonomous driving, enforcing surface normal consistency in 3D space.

entry.title: Continual-learning for Modelling Low-Resource Languages from Large Language Models

author.name: Santosh Srinath K, Mudit Somani, Varun Reddy Padala, Prajna Devi Upadhyay, Abhijit Das

entry.summary: Proposes continual learning strategy using POS-based code-switching and replay adapters to mitigate catastrophic forgetting when adapting LLMs for low-resource languages.

entry.title: TowerMind: A Tower Defence Game Learning Environment and Benchmark for LLM as Agents

author.name: Dawei Wang, Chengming Zhou, Di Zhao, Xinyuan Liu, Marci Chi Ma, Gary Ushaw, Richard Davison

entry.summary: TowerMind is a tower defense game environment for benchmarking LLM planning and decision-making capabilities, offering text-based observations with lower computational demands than existing RTS environments.

entry.title: Distilling Lightweight Domain Experts from Large ML Models by Identifying Relevant Subspaces

author.name: Pattarawat Chormai, Ali Hashemi, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Gr\'egoire Montavon

entry.summary: SubDistill is a knowledge distillation algorithm that identifies and transfers only the relevant components of a teacher model at each layer when only certain classes are needed.

entry.title: Adaptive Conditional Contrast-Agnostic Deformable Image Registration with Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Yinsong Wang, Xinzhe Luo, Siyi Du, Chen Qin

entry.summary: AC-CAR is an adaptive conditional framework for contrast-agnostic deformable image registration using random convolution-based augmentation to generalize across unseen imaging contrasts without retraining.

entry.title: Open World Knowledge Aided Single-Cell Foundation Model with Robust Cross-Modal Cell-Language Pre-training

author.name: Haoran Wang, Xuanyi Zhang, Shuangsang Fang, Longke Ran, Ziqing Deng, Yong Zhang, Yuxiang Li, Shaoshuai Li

entry.summary: OKR-CELL integrates single-cell foundation models with LLMs using RAG-enhanced cell descriptions and robust cross-modal pretraining to handle noise in multi-modal biological data.

entry.title: The Magni Human Motion Dataset: Accurate, Complex, Multi-Modal, Natural, Semantically-Rich and Contextualized

author.name: Tim Schreiter, Tiago Rodrigues de Almeida, Yufei Zhu, Eduardo Gutierrez Maestro, Lucas Morillo-Mendez, Andrey Rudenko, Tomasz P. Kucner, Oscar Martinez Mozos, Martin Magnusson, Luigi Palmieri, Kai O. Arras, Achim J. Lilienthal

entry.summary: Provides a high-quality human motion dataset with motion capture, eye-gaze tracking, and robot sensor data in semantically-rich environments. Uses loosely scripted task assignment to induce natural behavior from participants.

entry.title: Generalizable Blood Pressure Estimation from Multi-Wavelength PPG Using Curriculum-Adversarial Learning

author.name: Zequan Liang, Ruoyu Zhang, Wei Shao, Mahdi Pirayesh Shirazi Nejad, Ehsan Kourkchi, Setareh Rafatirad, Houman Homayoun

entry.summary: Proposes curriculum-adversarial learning for blood pressure estimation from multi-wavelength PPG. Combines curriculum learning transitioning from classification to regression with domain-adversarial training for subject-invariant features.

entry.title: From Events to Trending: A Multi-Stage Hotspots Detection Method Based on Generative Query Indexing

author.name: Kaichun Wang, Yanguang Chen, Ting Zhang, Mengyao Bao, Keyu Chen, Xu Hu, Yongliang Wang, Jingsheng Yang, Jinsong Zhang, Fei Lu

entry.summary: Proposes multi-stage framework for trending query detection in conversational systems, combining offline generation with online identification. Addresses gap between traditional search trending detection and dialogue systems.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-LLM Ensemble for Industrial Part Specification Extraction

author.name: Muzakkiruddin Ahmed Mohammed, John R. Talburt, Leon Claasssens, and Adriaan Marais

entry.summary: Proposes RAGsemble, a multi-LLM ensemble framework orchestrating nine LLMs for industrial part specification extraction. Uses three-phase pipeline with FAISS-based semantic retrieval for grounding.

entry.title: A universal vision transformer for fast calorimeter simulations

author.name: Luigi Favaro, Andrea Giammanco, Claudius Krause

entry.summary: Demonstrates vision transformers can emulate Geant4 calorimeter response with statistical indistinguishability across regular and irregular geometries. Shows pretraining on large datasets enables efficient fine-tuning.

entry.title: DynaSTy: A Framework for SpatioTemporal Node Attribute Prediction in Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Namrata Banerji and Tanya Berger-Wolf

entry.summary: Proposes DynaSTy for spatiotemporal node attribute prediction on dynamic graphs with evolving adjacency matrices. Uses transformer with adaptive attention bias and masked node-time pretraining.

entry.title: ROAP: A Reading-Order and Attention-Prior Pipeline for Optimizing Layout Transformers in Key Information Extraction

author.name: Tingwei Xie, Jinxin He, Yonghong Song

entry.summary: Presents ROAP pipeline for optimizing attention in Layout Transformers without modifying backbones. Uses Adaptive-XY-Gap for reading order extraction and introduces Reading-Order-Aware Position Bias.

entry.title: Prompt-Free SAM-Based Multi-Task Framework for Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation and Classification

author.name: Samuel E. Johnny, Bernes L. Atabonfack, Israel Alagbe, Assane Gueye

entry.summary: Proposes prompt-free SAM-based framework for breast ultrasound lesion segmentation and classification. Uses mask-guided attention to focus on lesion-relevant features.

entry.title: Toward an Integrated Cross-Urban Accident Prevention System: A Multi-Task Spatial-Temporal Learning Framework for Urban Safety Management

author.name: Jiayu Fang, Zhiqi Shao, Haoning Xi, Boris Choy, Junbin Gao

entry.summary: Proposes MLA-STNet for cross-city accident prevention using multi-task learning. Integrates Mamba-attention modules to handle heterogeneous, noisy urban accident data.

entry.title: DNATokenizer: A GPU-First Byte-to-Identifier Tokenizer for High-Throughput DNA Language Models

author.name: Eliatan Niktab and Hardip Patel

entry.summary: Introduces DNATokenizer, a GPU-first tokenizer for genomic DNA sequences. Addresses throughput bottlenecks at tokenization boundary for DNA language models.

entry.title: DIFF-MF: A Difference-Driven Channel-Spatial State Space Model for Multi-Modal Image Fusion

author.name: Yiming Sun, Zifan Ye, Qinghua Hu, Pengfei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes DIFF-MF for multi-modal image fusion using difference-driven state space model. Leverages feature discrepancy maps between modalities for guided extraction and channel-spatial fusion.

entry.title: Generation-Based and Emotion-Reflected Memory Update: Creating the KEEM Dataset for Better Long-Term Conversation

author.name: Jeonghyun Kang, Hongjin Kim, Harksoo Kim

entry.summary: Introduces KEEM dataset for generation-based memory updates incorporating emotional context and causal relationships. Enables dynamic integrative memories for long-term conversational systems.

entry.title: Autonomous Discovery of the Ising Model's Critical Parameters with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hai Man, Chaobo Wang, Jia-Rui Li, Yuping Tian, Shu-Gang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-inspired adaptive RL framework that autonomously discovers critical parameters in the Ising model, identifying both critical temperature and critical exponents without human intervention. The algorithm exhibits search behavior reminiscent of phase transitions.

entry.title: Cumulative Path-Level Semantic Reasoning for Inductive Knowledge Graph Completion

author.name: Jiapu Wang, Xinghe Cheng, Zezheng Wu, Ruiqi Ma, Rui Wang, Zhichao Yan, Haoran Luo, Yuhao Jiang, Kai Sun

entry.summary: CPSR framework for inductive knowledge graph completion captures both structural and semantic information through cumulative path-level reasoning, handling emerging entities and long-range dependencies.

entry.title: Visualising Information Flow in Word Embeddings with Diffusion Tensor Imaging

author.name: Thomas Fabian

entry.summary: Applies diffusion tensor imaging techniques from neuroscience to visualize information flow in word embeddings, revealing how information flows between tokens across LLM layers.

entry.title: Fusion Matters: Length-Aware Analysis of Positional-Encoding Fusion in Transformers

author.name: Mohamed Amine Hallam and Kuo-Kun Tseng

entry.summary: Empirical study examining how positional encoding fusion strategies affect Transformer performance across different sequence lengths. Finds fusion choice has negligible impact on short texts but produces consistent gains on long documents.

entry.title: Semantic NLP Pipelines for Interoperable Patient Digital Twins from Unstructured EHRs

author.name: Rafael Brens, Yuqiao Meng, Luoxi Tang, Zhaohan Xi

entry.summary: Semantic NLP pipeline transforming unstructured EHR notes into FHIR-compliant digital twin representations using NER, concept normalization to SNOMED-CT/ICD-10, and relation extraction. Evaluated on MIMIC-IV.

entry.title: Phase4DFD: Multi-Domain Phase-Aware Attention for Deepfake Detection

author.name: Zhen-Xin Lin and Shang-Kuan Chen

entry.summary: Phase4DFD is a deepfake detection framework explicitly modeling phase-magnitude interactions via learnable attention, combining FFT magnitude and local binary patterns to expose synthesis artifacts.

entry.title: Sequential Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design in Infinite Dimensions via Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Kaichen Shen and Peng Chen

entry.summary: Formulates sequential Bayesian optimal experimental design as a finite-horizon MDP, learning amortized design policies via policy-gradient RL with dual dimension reduction for scalability to infinite-dimensional PDE-governed problems.

entry.title: WaveRNet: Wavelet-Guided Frequency Learning for Multi-Source Domain-Generalized Retinal Vessel Segmentation

author.name: Chanchan Wang, Yuanfang Wang, Qing Xu, Guanxin Chen

entry.summary: WaveRNet uses wavelet-guided frequency learning for multi-source domain-generalized retinal vessel segmentation, addressing domain shift from illumination and contrast variations while preserving fine vessel structures.

entry.title: LookAroundNet: Extending Temporal Context with Transformers for Clinically Viable EEG Seizure Detection

author.name: {\TH}\'or Sverrisson and Steinn Gu{\dh}mundsson

entry.summary: LookAroundNet is a transformer-based seizure detector using wider temporal context before and after target segments, reflecting clinical EEG interpretation practice. Evaluated across multiple diverse datasets.

entry.title: Poisson Hyperplane Processes with Rectified Linear Units

author.name: Shufei Ge, Shijia Wang and Lloyd Elliott

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical connection between Poisson hyperplane processes and two-layer ReLU neural networks, showing PHP with Gaussian prior provides alternative probabilistic representation. Proposes annealed SMC for Bayesian inference.

entry.title: A Framework for Personalized Persuasiveness Prediction via Context-Aware User Profiling

author.name: Sejun Park, Yoonah Park, Jongwon Lim, Yohan Jo

entry.summary: Framework for personalized persuasiveness prediction with trainable query generator and profiler that retrieve and summarize persuasion-relevant history for context-aware assessment.

entry.title: SAFE: Secure and Accurate Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Brain-Computer Interfaces

author.name: Tianwang Jia, Xiaoqing Chen and Dongrui Wu

entry.summary: SAFE proposes federated adversarial training for EEG-based brain-computer interfaces, combining batch-specific normalization with adversarial weight perturbation for privacy-preserving robust BCIs.

entry.title: Kidney Cancer Detection Using 3D-Based Latent Diffusion Models

author.name: Jen Dusseljee, Sarah de Boer, Alessa Hering

entry.summary: 3D latent diffusion pipeline for kidney anomaly detection on CT scans using DDPMs, DDIMs, and VQ-GANs with only case-level pseudo-labels. Demonstrates feasibility of weakly supervised 3D anomaly detection.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Graph Representation of Stiffened Panels with Non-Uniform Boundary Conditions and Loads

author.name: Yuecheng Cai, Jasmin Jelovica

entry.summary: Develops heterogeneous graph representations of stiffened panels for structural analysis using heterogeneous graph neural networks. Accounts for geometry variability, non-uniform boundary conditions, and diverse loading scenarios.

entry.title: Graph energy as a measure of community detectability in networks

author.name: Lucas B\"ottcher, Mason A. Porter, Santo Fortunato

entry.summary: Uses graph energy as a measure of community detectability in networks, analyzing how eigenvalues relevant for community detection can be absorbed by spectral bulk. Proposes bypassing detectability limits using special matrix constructions.

entry.title: Machine learning assisted state prediction of misspecified linear dynamical system via modal reduction

author.name: Rohan Vitthal Thorat, Rajdip Nayek

entry.summary: Introduces framework for model form error estimation in structural dynamics using Gaussian Process Latent Force Models in reduced modal domain. Enables data-driven characterization of unmodeled dynamics for digital twins.

entry.title: Text Detoxification in isiXhosa and Yor\`ub\'a: A Cross-Lingual Machine Learning Approach for Low-Resource African Languages

author.name: Abayomi O. Agbeyangi

entry.summary: Investigates text detoxification for isiXhosa and Yorùbá using lightweight TF-IDF/logistic regression for detection and lexicon-guided rewriting, achieving 61-86% detection accuracy.

entry.title: Computable Gap Assessment of Artificial Intelligence Governance in Children's Centres: Evidence-Mechanism-Governance-Indicator Modelling of UNICEF's Guidance on AI and Children 3.0 Based on the Graph-GAP Framework

author.name: Wei Meng

entry.summary: Proposes Graph-GAP, a methodology for decomposing AI policy requirements into evidence, mechanism, governance, and indicator layers with computable metrics to identify governance gaps. Applied to UNICEF's guidance on AI and children, it provides reproducible frameworks for auditing child-centered AI systems.

entry.title: LMILAtt: A Deep Learning Model for Depression Detection from Social Media Users Enhanced by Multi-Instance Learning Based on Attention Mechanism

author.name: Yukun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes LMILAtt model combining LSTM autoencoders with attention-based multi-instance learning for depression detection from social media. Extracts temporal dynamics of user tweets to identify early depression signals.

entry.title: EdgeLDR: Quaternion Low-Displacement Rank Neural Networks for Edge-Efficient Deep Learning

entry.title: Multi-task Cross-modal Learning for Chest X-ray Image Retrieval

author.name: Zhaohui Liang, Sivaramakrishnan Rajaraman, Niccolo Marini, Zhiyun Xue, Sameer Antani

entry.summary: Fine-tunes BiomedCLIP for chest X-ray retrieval using multi-task learning with binary classification, contrastive, and CLIP losses. Improves cross-modal embeddings for medical image-text retrieval.

entry.title: MMUEChange: A Generalized LLM Agent Framework for Intelligent Multi-Modal Urban Environment Change Analysis

author.name: Zixuan Xiao, Jun Ma, Siwei Zhang

entry.title: Enabling Stroke-Level Structural Analysis of Hieroglyphic Scripts without Language-Specific Priors

author.name: Fuwen Luo, Zihao Wan, Ziyue Wang, Yaluo Liu, Pau Tong Lin Xu, Xuanjia Qiao, Xiaolong Wang, Peng Li, Yang Liu

entry.title: Explainable AI: Learning from the Learners

author.name: Ricardo Vinuesa, Steven L. Brunton, Gianmarco Mengaldo

entry.summary: Perspective arguing that explainable AI combined with causal reasoning enables 'learning from the learners'. Discusses applications in discovery, optimization, and certification.

entry.title: Autonomous Probe Microscopy with Robust Bag-of-Features Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization: Pareto-Front Mapping of Nanoscale Structure-Property Trade-Offs

entry.title: SAS-VPReID: A Scale-Adaptive Framework with Shape Priors for Video-based Person Re-Identification at Extreme Far Distances

author.name: Qiwei Yang and Pingping Zhang and Yuhao Wang and Zijing Gong

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models for Interpretable Credit Card Fraud Detection

entry.title: Stephanie2: Thinking, Waiting, and Making Decisions Like Humans in Step-by-Step AI Social Chat

author.name: Hao Yang, Hongyuan Lu, Dingkang Yang, Wenliang Yang, Peng Sun, Xiaochuan Zhang, Jun Xiao, Kefan He, Wai Lam, Yang Liu, Xinhua Zeng

entry.title: Adaptive Disentangled Representation Learning for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Classification

author.name: Quanjiang Li, Zhiming Liu, Tianxiang Xu, Tingjin Luo, Chenping Hou

entry.summary: ADRL handles incomplete multi-view multi-label classification through adaptive disentangled representation learning with feature-level affinity propagation and label distribution refinement.

entry.title: Detecting Autism Spectrum Disorder with Deep Eye Movement Features

author.name: Zhanpei Huang, Taochen chen, Fangqing Gu and Yiqun Zhang

author.name: Milad Alshomary, Grace Li, Anubhav Jangra, Yufang Hou, Kathleen McKeown, Smaranda Muresan

entry.title: Router-Suggest: Dynamic Routing for Multimodal Auto-Completion in Visually-Grounded Dialogs

author.name: Sandeep Mishra, Devichand Budagam, Anubhab Mandal, Bishal Santra, Pawan Goyal, Manish Gupta

entry.summary: Router-Suggest dynamically routes between text-only and vision-language models for multimodal auto-completion in visually-grounded dialogs, balancing accuracy and efficiency based on dialog context.

entry.title: Bidirectional Channel-selective Semantic Interaction for Semi-Supervised Medical Segmentation

author.name: Kaiwen Huang, Yizhe Zhang, Yi Zhou, Tianyang Xu, Tao Zhou

entry.summary: BCSI framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation using bidirectional channel-selective semantic interaction between labeled and unlabeled data streams, with semantic-spatial perturbation for data augmentation.

entry.title: GlueNN: gluing patchwise analytic solutions with neural networks
