author.name: Akhil S. Nair, Lucas Foppa

entry.summary: Critical assessment of active learning workflows in materials science, examining how design choices like surrogate models, sampling strategies, and uncertainty quantification affect performance.

entry.title: DeePM: Regime-Robust Deep Learning for Systematic Macro Portfolio Management

author.name: Kieran Wood, Stephen J. Roberts, Stefan Zohren

entry.title: From Unstructured Data to Demand Counterfactuals: Theory and Practice

author.name: Timothy Christensen and Giovanni Compiani

entry.summary: Develops practical toolkit correcting bias and ensuring valid inference for demand counterfactuals when using ML-derived product representations from high-dimensional unstructured data.

entry.title: Estimate Hitting Time by Hitting Probability for Elitist Evolutionary Algorithms

author.name: Jun He, Siang Yew Chong and Xin Yao

entry.title: Studying Illustrations in Manuscripts: An Efficient Deep-Learning Approach

author.name: Yoav Evron, Michal Bar-Asher Siegal, Michael Fire

entry.title: Quantifying and Inducing Shape Bias in CNNs via Max-Pool Dilation

author.name: Takito Sawada, Akinori Iwata and Masahiro Okuda

entry.title: Compressing image encoders via latent distillation

author.name: Caroline Mazini Rodrigues (IRISA, CNRS), Nicolas Keriven (CNRS, IRISA, COMPACT), Thomas Maugey (COMPACT)

entry.summary: Uses knowledge distillation to compress image encoders by approximating latent spaces of heavyweight models with lightweight encoders, requiring less data and shorter training.

entry.title: Learning Geometric Invariance for Gait Recognition

author.name: Zengbin Wang, Junjie Li, Saihui Hou, Xu Liu, Chunshui Cao, Yongzhen Huang, Muyi Sun, Siye Wang, Man Zhang

entry.title: ViTNT-FIQA: Training-Free Face Image Quality Assessment with Vision Transformers

author.name: Guray Ozgur, Eduarda Caldeira, Tahar Chettaoui, Jan Niklas Kolf, Marco Huber, Naser Damer, Fadi Boutros

entry.title: Channel Fingerprint Construction for Massive MIMO: A Deep Conditional Generative Approach

author.name: Zhenzhou Jin, Li You, Xudong Li, Zhen Gao, Yuanwei Liu, Xiang-Gen Xia, Xiqi Gao

entry.title: Rapid Adaptation of SpO2 Estimation to Wearable Devices via Transfer Learning on Low-Sampling-Rate PPG

author.name: Zequan Liang, Ruoyu Zhang, Wei Shao, krishna Karthik, Ehsan Kourkchi, Setareh Rafatirad, Houman Homayoun

entry.title: Unveiling Affective Polarization Trends in Parliamentary Proceedings

author.name: Gili Goldin, Ella Rabinovich, Shuly Wintner

entry.summary: Proposes method for quantifying political polarization based on emotional discourse style using Valence, Arousal, and Dominance measures. Applies to Israeli parliament proceedings, finding increasing affective polarization over time.

entry.title: Assembling Solar Panels by Dual Robot Arms Towards Full Autonomous Lunar Base Construction

author.name: Luca Nunziante, Kentaro Uno, Gustavo H. Diaz, Shreya Santra, Alessandro De Luca, Kazuya Yoshida

entry.summary: Presents autonomous dual-arm robot system for lunar solar panel assembly. Integrates vision, control, and hardware for in-situ construction benchmark tasks.

entry.title: Evaluating the Use of LLMs for Automated DOM-Level Resolution of Web Performance Issues

author.name: Gideon Peters, SayedHassan Khatoonabadi, Emad Shihab

entry.summary: Evaluates 9 LLMs for automated web performance optimization focusing on DOM modification. Tests on 15 popular webpages using Lighthouse audits.

entry.title: CHisAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Event Taxonomy Construction in Ancient Chinese Cultural Systems

author.name: Xuemei Tang, Chengxi Yan, Jinghang Gu, Chu-Ren Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CHisAgent, a multi-agent LLM framework for constructing historical taxonomies in Chinese contexts. Decomposes task into Inducer, Expander, and evidence-grounded stages.

entry.title: RISE: Rule-Driven SQL Dialect Translation via Query Reduction

author.name: Xudong Xie and Yuwei Zhang and Wensheng Dou and Yu Gao and Ziyu Cui and Jiansen Song and Rui Yang and Jun Wei

entry.title: FlyPose: Towards Robust Human Pose Estimation From Aerial Views

author.name: Hassaan Farooq, Marvin Brenner, Peter St\\"utz

entry.title: Simplify-This: A Comparative Analysis of Prompt-Based and Fine-Tuned LLMs

author.name: Eilam Cohen, Itamar Bul, Danielle Inbar, Omri Loewenbach

entry.title: Peek2: A Regex-free implementation of pretokenizers for Byte-level BPE

author.name: Liu Zai

author.name: Jonathan Downie and Joss Moorkens

entry.summary: Critical analysis of automated evaluation metrics for interpreting quality, concluding that current automatic metrics cannot account for communicative context and are not viable for measuring authentic interpreting quality.

entry.title: Manifold limit for the training of shallow graph convolutional neural networks

author.name: Johanna Tengler, Christoph Brune, Jos\'e A. Iglesias

entry.summary: Studies discrete-to-continuum consistency of training shallow graph convolutional neural networks on proximity graphs under manifold assumptions, with convergence results across graph resolutions.

entry.title: Extending a Phylogeny-based Method for Detecting Signatures of Multi-level Selection for Applications in Artificial Life

author.name: Matthew Andres Moreno and Sanaz Hasanzadeh Fard and Luis Zaman and Emily Dolson

entry.summary: Extends phylogeny-based methods to detect multilevel selection dynamics in artificial life systems. Adapts techniques from evolutionary biology to identify mutations with short-term individual benefits but negative long-term group effects.

entry.title: Improving User Experience with Personalized Review Ranking and Summarization

author.name: Muhammad Mufti, Omar Hammad, Mahfuzur Rahman

entry.summary: Proposes personalized framework integrating review ranking with abstractive summarization to enhance consumer decision-making. Models user sentiment profiles to identify personally relevant reviews.

entry.title: Evolving Cognitive Architectures

author.name: Alexander Serov

entry.summary: Proposes evolutionary approach to cognitive architecture creation, using functional modules as elementary units and universal structures to create flexible AGI systems. Addresses limitations of predetermined perception patterns.

entry.title: TAPM-Net: Trajectory-Aware Perturbation Modeling for Infrared Small Target Detection

entry.title: Buffered AUC maximization for scoring systems via mixed-integer optimization

author.name: Moe Shiina, Shunnosuke Ikeda and Yuichi Takano

entry.summary: Proposes MIO framework for buffered AUC maximization in scoring systems. Establishes effective mixed-integer optimization approach for directly maximizing bAUC with interpretable integer coefficients.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Facial Expression Recognition based on Dynamic Threshold and Negative Learning

author.name: Zhongpeng Cai, Jun Yu, Wei Xu, Tianyu Liu, Jianqing Sun, Jiaen Liang

entry.summary: Proposes semi-supervised facial expression recognition using dynamic threshold adjustment and selective negative learning. Includes local attention enhancement and feature dropout strategies.

entry.title: Data Augmented Pipeline for Legal Information Extraction and Reasoning

author.name: Nguyen Minh Phuong, Ha-Thanh Nguyen, May Myo Zin, Ken Satoh

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based data augmentation pipeline for legal information extraction that reduces manual annotation effort while improving system robustness. Method is generalizable beyond legal domain.

entry.summary: Studies how parallelism in neural network accelerators affects correlation-based side-channel attacks exploiting power consumption, focusing on fully-connected layers processing the same input in parallel.

entry.title: A New Family of Poisson Non-negative Matrix Factorization Methods Using the Shifted Log Link

author.name: Yigitcan Comlek, R. Murali Krishnan, Sandipp Krishnan Ravi, Amin Moghaddas, Rafael Giorjao, Michael Eff, Anirban Samaddar, Nesar S. Ramachandra, Sandeep Madireddy, Liping Wang

entry.summary: Multi-Task Gaussian Processes framework for engineering systems with multi-source, multi-fidelity data, validated on benchmark functions, ellipsoidal void modeling, and friction-stir welding applications.

entry.title: Performance of a Deep Learning-Based Segmentation Model for Pancreatic Tumors on Public Endoscopic Ultrasound Datasets

entry.title: Detecting Stochasticity in Discrete Signals via Nonparametric Excursion Theorem

author.name: Sunia Tanweer and Firas A. Khasawneh

entry.summary: Framework for distinguishing diffusive stochastic processes from deterministic signals using excursion theorems for continuous semimartingales, providing theoretically-certified detection method.

entry.title: Variational Autoencoders for P-wave Detection on Strong Motion Earthquake Spectrograms

author.name: Turkan Simge Ispak, Salih Tileylioglu and Erdem Akagunduz

entry.summary: Studies VAE architecture variations for P-wave earthquake detection as anomaly detection task, finding attention mechanisms outperform skip connections by avoiding overgeneralization.

entry.title: On the use of case estimate and transactional payment data in neural networks for individual loss reserving

author.name: Benjamin Avanzi, Matthew Lambrianidis, Greg Taylor, Bernard Wong

entry.summary: Compares feed-forward and recurrent neural networks for insurance loss reserving using payment history and case estimate development. Finds case estimates improve deep learning reserving predictions.

entry.title: Generalized Canonical Polyadic Tensor Decompositions with General Symmetry

author.name: Alex Mulrooney and David Hong

entry.summary: Extends Generalized CP tensor decomposition to handle general symmetry, common when stacking symmetric matrices like dynamic graph adjacency matrices over time.

entry.title: Prediction of Fault Slip Tendency in CO${_2}$ Storage using Data-space Inversion

author.name: Xiaowen He, Su Jiang, Louis J. Durlofsky

entry.summary: Implements VAE-based data-space inversion for predicting fault slip tendency in CO2 storage projects. Avoids generating posterior geomodels by inferring quantities directly from simulation results.

entry.title: Can large language models interpret unstructured chat data on dynamic group decision-making processes? Evidence on joint destination choice

author.name: Sung-Yoo Lim, Koki Sato, Kiyoshi Takami, Giancarlos Parady, Eui-Jin Kim

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs can automate annotation of group decision-making processes from unstructured chat data, using joint travel destination choices as a case study. Tests ability to capture context-dependent meanings shaped by social norms.

entry.title: Learning Reconstructive Embeddings in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces via the Representer Theorem

author.name: Enrique Feito-Casares, Francisco M. Melgarejo-Meseguer and Jos\'e-Luis Rojo-\'Alvarez

entry.title: A Dual Pipeline Machine Learning Framework for Automated Multi Class Sleep Disorder Screening Using Hybrid Resampling and Ensemble Learning

author.name: Md Sultanul Islam Ovi, Muhsina Tarannum Munfa, Miftahul Alam Adib, and Syed Sabbir Hasan

entry.title: On the Robustness of Age for Learning-Based Wireless Scheduling in Unknown Environments

entry.title: Community-Based Model Sharing and Generalisation: Anomaly Detection in IoT Temperature Sensor Networks

author.name: Sahibzada Saadoon Hammad, Joaqu\'in Huerta Guijarro, Francisco Ramos, Michael Gould Carlson, Sergio Trilles Oliver

entry.title: Multi-Group Quadratic Discriminant Analysis via Projection

entry.title: Coding Agents As An Interface To The Codebase

entry.title: Research Summary: January 11, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on AI safety fundamentals and alignment tractability debates. A substantive technical argument against continuous chain-of-thought (neuralese) challenges OpenAI's research direction, claiming discrete tokens are architecturally necessary rather than bandwidth limitations.

  • Theoretical analysis provides learning-theoretic bounds on detecting deceptive AI behaviors like sandbagging and sycophancy
  • AI Incident Forecasting models predict 6-11x increases in AI-related incidents over five years using statistical analysis of the AI Incidents Database
  • Anthropic researcher argues alignment may require 70+ years of iterative development, challenging 'steam engine difficulty' optimism

Supporting work includes the False Confidence Theorem applied to Bayesian reasoning, a conceptual framework distinguishing superagency from superintelligence, and practical tooling applying PageRank to identify high-signal voices in AI discourse networks.

entry.title: The Case Against Continuous Chain-of-Thought (Neuralese)

author.name: RobinHa

entry.summary: Argues against continuous chain-of-thought ('neuralese') approaches, claiming that discrete tokens aren't just bandwidth limitations but actually necessary for error correction. Continuous latent representations would accumulate noise across reasoning steps, while discretization identifies and corrects errors.

entry.title: Theoretical predictions on the sample efficiency of training policies and activation monitors

author.name: Alek Westover

entry.summary: Provides a learning-theoretic analysis of how efficiently we can train AI policies or activation monitors to detect and remove bad behaviors like sandbagging during safety research. The post explores sample complexity bounds for both direct policy training and monitor-based approaches to catching deceptive AI actions.

Even 'easy' alignment could fail if we lack sufficient time or coordination before dangerous capabilities emerge.

entry.title: Research Summary: January 10, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's highlights feature significant empirical work on AI progress and safety. MIT FutureTech finds most algorithmic innovations yield small, scale-invariant efficiency gains, challenging narratives about AI progress sources. A mechanistic interpretability study reveals alignment faking in Llama-3.3-70B is controlled by a single linear direction—suggesting deceptive behaviors may be detectable and removable.

  • Abramdemski argues for treating LLMs as sophisticated statistical models rather than over-emphasizing RL approaches
  • Zvi provides extensive practical analysis of Claude Code with Opus 4.5 capabilities
  • Conceptual clarification distinguishes 'Easy RSI' (AI replacing researchers) from 'Hard RSI' (unbounded self-improvement)
  • HypoBench introduced for evaluating AI hypothesis generation in scientific research

Notable gap: Today's batch contains substantial non-AI content (economics, physics education, personal essays), with only 6-7 items directly relevant to AI research.

entry.title: Research Summary: January 09, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's highlights feature major contributions from Anthropic and Meta FAIR, with strong emphasis on safety and interpretability. Chris Olah's team reveals geometric mechanisms underlying counting tasks in Claude 3.5 Haiku, while Constitutional Classifiers++ delivers production-ready jailbreak defenses with cascade architectures.

  • Large-scale study (N=2,724) demonstrates GPT-4o equally effective at increasing conspiracy beliefs as decreasing them—critical persuasion risk finding
  • David Patterson identifies memory bandwidth and interconnect as key LLM inference bottlenecks, not compute
  • Evaluative fingerprints reveal LLM judges are self-consistent but mutually inconsistent (Krippendorff's α=0.042), undermining evaluation reliability

RL training analysis uncovers hidden biases in GRPO-style methods and surprising linearity in RLVR weight evolution. VLM hallucination mechanisms identified: ablating small attention head sets reduces hallucinations by 40%+. Incorporating negative reasoning trajectories during SFT substantially improves OOD generalization.

entry.title: When Models Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Counting Task

author.name: Wes Gurnee, Emmanuel Ameisen, Isaac Kauvar, Julius Tarng, Adam Pearce, Chris Olah, Joshua Batson

entry.summary: Anthropic researchers mechanistically investigate how Claude 3.5 Haiku performs character counting and linebreaking tasks. Discovers that character counts are represented on low-dimensional curved manifolds using sparse features analogous to biological place cells, with geometric transformations enabling linear decision boundaries.

author.name: Hoagy Cunningham, Jerry Wei, Zihan Wang, Andrew Persic, Alwin Peng, Jordan Abderrachid, Raj Agarwal, Bobby Chen, Austin Cohen, Andy Dau, Alek Dimitriev, Rob Gilson, Logan Howard, Yijin Hua, Jared Kaplan, Jan Leike, Mu Lin, Christopher Liu, Vladimir Mikulik, Rohit Mittapalli, Clare O'Hara, Jin Pan, Nikhil Saxena, Alex Silverstein, Yue Song, Xunjie Yu, Giulio Zhou, Ethan Perez, Mrinank Sharma

entry.title: MiJaBench: Revealing Minority Biases in Large Language Models via Hate Speech Jailbreaking

author.name: Iago Alves Brito, Walcy Santos Rezende Rios, Julia Soares Dollis, Diogo Fernandes Costa Silva, Arlindo Rodrigues Galv\~ao Filho

entry.summary: Introduces MiJaBench, a bilingual adversarial benchmark with 44K prompts across 16 minority groups for evaluating LLM safety disparities. Finds model scaling exacerbates defense rate disparities between groups.

entry.title: Surface-based Molecular Design with Multi-modal Flow Matching

author.name: Fang Wu, Zhengyuan Zhou, Shuting Jin, Xiangxiang Zeng, Jure Leskovec, Jinbo Xu

entry.summary: Proposes SurfFlow, a surface-based generative model for therapeutic peptide design using multi-modality conditional flow matching. Co-designs sequence, structure, and surface properties for enhanced binding accuracy.

entry.title: BackdoorAgent: A Unified Framework for Backdoor Attacks on LLM-based Agents

author.name: Yunhao Feng, Yige Li, Yutao Wu, Yingshui Tan, Yanming Guo, Yifan Ding, Kun Zhai, Xingjun Ma, Yugang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes BackdoorAgent, a unified framework for understanding backdoor attacks on LLM agents. Provides modular, stage-aware analysis of how triggers propagate through multi-step agent workflows.

entry.title: Adversarial Yet Cooperative: Multi-Perspective Reasoning in Retrieved-Augmented Language Models

author.name: Can Xu, Lingyong Yan, Jiayi Wu, Haosen Wang, Shuaiqiang Wang, Yuchen Li, Jizhou Huang, Dawei Yin, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Adversarial Reasoning RAG (ARR), a Reasoner-Verifier framework where agents engage in adversarial yet cooperative reasoning over retrieved evidence. Addresses single-perspective reasoning limitations and uses process-aware advantages instead of outcome-only rewards.

entry.title: ToolGate: Contract-Grounded and Verified Tool Execution for LLMs

author.name: Yanming Liu, Xinyue Peng, Jiannan Cao, Xinyi Wang, Songhang Deng, Jintao Chen, Jianwei Yin, Xuhong Zhang

entry.summary: Presents ToolGate, a framework providing formal safety guarantees for LLM tool calling through Hoare-style contracts. Maintains explicit symbolic state space with precondition/postcondition verification for tool invocations.

entry.title: Defense Against Indirect Prompt Injection via Tool Result Parsing

author.name: Qiang Yu, Xinran Cheng, Chuanyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a defense mechanism against indirect prompt injection attacks on LLM agents by parsing tool results, addressing a critical security vulnerability as agents gain control over physical systems. This is increasingly important as LLM agents become more autonomous.

entry.title: DVD: A Robust Method for Detecting Variant Contamination in Large Language Model Evaluation

author.name: Renzhao Liang, Jingru Chen, Bo Jia, Bo Deng, Chenggang Xie, Yidong Wang, Ke Jin, Xin Wang, Linfeng Zhang, Cunxiang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces DVD for detecting variant contamination in LLM evaluation, addressing paraphrased or transformed test items that evade existing detectors. Uses variance of generation distribution from temperature sampling.

entry.title: AlgBench: To What Extent Do Large Reasoning Models Understand Algorithms?

author.name: Henan Sun, Kaichi Yu, Yuyao Wang, Bowen Liu, Xunkai Li, Rong-Hua Li, Nuo Chen, Jia Li

entry.summary: Introduces AlgBench with 3000+ problems across 27 algorithms to evaluate whether LRMs truly master algorithmic reasoning, organized by comprehensive taxonomy.

entry.title: How to Set the Batch Size for Large-Scale Pre-training?

author.name: Yunhua Zhou, Junhao Huang, Shuhao Xin, Yechen Zhang, Runyu Peng, Qiping Guo, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: Derives revised theoretical framework for optimal batch size selection under Warmup-Stable-Decay learning rate schedulers, identifying minimum and optimal batch size thresholds (B_min, B_opt) for LLM pre-training. Challenges OpenAI's original critical batch size theory.

entry.title: Atlas 2 -- Foundation models for clinical deployment

author.name: Maximilian Alber, Timo Milbich, Alexandra Carpen-Amarie, Stephan Tietz, Jonas Dippel, Lukas Muttenthaler, Beatriz Perez Cancer, Alessandro Benetti, Panos Korfiatis, Elias Eulig, J\'er\^ome L\"uscher, Jiasen Wu, Sayed Abid Hashimi, Gabriel Dernbach, Simon Schallenberg, Neelay Shah, Moritz Kr\"ugener, Aniruddh Jammoria, Jake Matras, Patrick Duffy, Matt Redlon, Philipp Jurmeister, David Horst, Lukas Ruff, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Frederick Klauschen, Andrew Norgan

entry.summary: Atlas 2 pathology foundation models trained on 5.5M whole slide images from three institutions. Achieves state-of-the-art across 80 benchmarks with improvements in robustness and computational efficiency.

entry.title: Miner:Mining Intrinsic Mastery for Data-Efficient RL in Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Shuyang Jiang, Yuhao Wang, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Miner for data-efficient RL in reasoning models by mining intrinsic mastery from policy uncertainty as self-supervised reward. Uses token-level focal credit assignment and adaptive advantage calibration.

entry.title: When AI Settles Down: Late-Stage Stability as a Signature of AI-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Ke Sun, Guangsheng Bao, Han Cui, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: Discovers Late-Stage Volatility Decay: AI-generated text shows stabilizing log probability fluctuations while human text maintains variability. Proposes detection features achieving state-of-the-art without perturbation sampling.

entry.title: ConMax: Confidence-Maximizing Compression for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

author.name: Minda Hu, Zexuan Qiu, Zenan Xu, Kun Li, Bo Zhou, Irwin King

entry.summary: Proposes ConMax, an RL framework that automatically compresses Chain-of-Thought reasoning by maximizing prediction confidence while reducing token count, addressing overthinking in LRMs.

entry.title: GlimpRouter: Efficient Collaborative Inference by Glimpsing One Token of Thoughts

author.name: Wenhao Zeng, Xuteng Zhang, Yuling Shi, Chao Hu, Yuting Chen, Beijun Shen, Xiaodong Gu

entry.summary: GlimpRouter determines reasoning step difficulty from just the first token, routing between lightweight and large models. Inspired by 'Aha Moment' phenomenon in LLMs, predicting if reasoning step needs large model capacity.

entry.title: The Forgotten Shield: Safety Grafting in Parameter-Space for Medical MLLMs

author.name: Jiale Zhao, Xing Mou, Jinlin Wu, Hongyuan Yu, Mingrui Sun, Yang Shi, Xuanwu Yin, Zhen Chen, Zhen Lei, Yaohua Wang

entry.summary: Establishes a safety evaluation framework for Medical MLLMs and proposes Safety Grafting, a parameter-space intervention method to recover forgotten safety alignment after medical fine-tuning. Addresses vulnerability to cross-modality jailbreak attacks.

entry.title: Towards a Mechanistic Understanding of Propositional Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Danchun Chen, Qiyao Yan, Liangming Pan

entry.summary: Provides mechanistic analysis of propositional logic reasoning in Qwen3 models, identifying four computational mechanisms: staged computation, information transmission, and layer-wise processing phases.

entry.title: Safety-Utility Conflicts Are Not Global: Surgical Alignment via Head-Level Diagnosis

author.name: Wang Cai, Yilin Wen, Jinchang Hou, Du Su, Guoqiu Wang, Zhonghou Lv, Chenfu Bao, Yunfang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes CAST for safety alignment via head-level diagnosis, addressing that safety-utility conflicts vary across attention heads. Avoids uniform updates to utility-sensitive heads.

entry.title: ReHyAt: Recurrent Hybrid Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Mohsen Ghafoorian and Amirhossein Habibian

entry.summary: Introduces ReHyAt, a Recurrent Hybrid Attention mechanism combining softmax and linear attention for video diffusion. Achieves competitive quality with ~160 GPU hours training through efficient distillation from existing models.

entry.title: Accommodation and Epistemic Vigilance: A Pragmatic Account of Why LLMs Fail to Challenge Harmful Beliefs

author.name: Myra Cheng, Robert D. Hawkins, Dan Jurafsky

entry.summary: Analyzes why LLMs fail to challenge harmful beliefs through lens of linguistic accommodation and epistemic vigilance. Shows social/linguistic factors affect LLM accommodation similarly to humans; simple interventions improve safety.

entry.title: GRACE: Reinforcement Learning for Grounded Response and Abstention under Contextual Evidence

author.name: Yibo Zhao, Jiapeng Zhu, Zichen Ding, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes GRACE, an RL framework for RAG that simultaneously addresses ungrounded responses and fabrication when context is insufficient. Uses multi-stage gated rewards to train for evidence-based grounding and reliable abstention.

entry.title: Know Thy Enemy: Securing LLMs Against Prompt Injection via Diverse Data Synthesis and Instruction-Level Chain-of-Thought Learning

author.name: Zhiyuan Chang, Mingyang Li, Yuekai Huang, Ziyou Jiang, Xiaojun Jia, Qian Xiong, Junjie Wang, Zhaoyang Li, Qing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes InstruCoT for defending against prompt injection attacks through diverse training data synthesis and instruction-level chain-of-thought fine-tuning. Enables LLMs to identify and reject malicious instructions regardless of source or position.

entry.title: PRISM: A Unified Framework for Post-Training LLMs Without Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Mukesh Ghimire, Aosong Feng, Liwen You, Youzhi Luo, Fang Liu, Xuan Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a framework for post-training LLMs without verifiable rewards by exploiting model consistency signals. Shows internal confidence metrics like entropy are unreliable and proposes alternative consistency-based approaches.

entry.title: SciIF: Benchmarking Scientific Instruction Following Towards Rigorous Scientific Intelligence

author.name: Encheng Su, Jianyu Wu, Chen Tang, Lintao Wang, Pengze Li, Aoran Wang, Jinouwen Zhang, Yizhou Wang, Yuan Meng, Xinzhu Ma, Shixiang Tang, Houqiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces SciIF benchmark for scientific instruction following that evaluates both correctness and adherence to validity constraints. Pairs university-level problems with constraint specifications across multiple disciplines.

entry.title: CuMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters

author.name: Ao Sun and Xiaoyu Wang and Zhe Tan and Yu Li and Jiachen Zhu and Shu Su and Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: Proposes CuMA for cultural alignment of LLMs using demographic-aware mixture of adapters, addressing Mean Collapse where dense models converge to generic averages that fail to represent diverse cultural groups.

entry.title: How to Set the Learning Rate for Large-Scale Pre-training?

author.name: Yunhua Zhou, Shuhao Xing, Junhao Huang, Xipeng Qiu, Qipeng Guo

entry.summary: Addresses learning rate configuration for large-scale pre-training through two paradigms: Fitting (using scaling laws to reduce search complexity) and Transfer (extending μTransfer to MoE architectures, model depth, and token horizons).

entry.title: Internal Representations as Indicators of Hallucinations in Agent Tool Selection

author.name: Kait Healy, Bharathi Srinivasan, Visakh Madathil, Jing Wu

entry.summary: Framework detecting tool-calling hallucinations in LLM agents (wrong tools, malformed parameters, tool bypass) using internal representations in real-time without multiple forward passes.

entry.title: The AI Infrastructure Security Shortlist

author.name: Abbey Chaver

entry.summary: From Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy), identifies five high-impact, neglected AI security problems: model confidentiality/integrity, authorization for misuse, secure compute verification, secure untrusted AI labor, and rogue deployment prevention.

entry.title: Differential syntactic and semantic encoding in LLMs

author.name: Santiago Acevedo, Alessandro Laio and Marco Baroni

entry.summary: Studies how syntactic and semantic information is encoded in DeepSeek-V3 representations using centroid analysis. Finds evidence for linear encoding with different cross-layer profiles for syntax and semantics.

entry.title: AgentOCR: Reimagining Agent History via Optical Self-Compression

author.name: Lang Feng, Fuchao Yang, Feng Chen, Xin Cheng, Haiyang Xu, Zhenglin Wan, Ming Yan, Bo An

entry.summary: Introduces AgentOCR that compresses agent history into rendered images using visual tokens for efficiency. Features segment optical caching and agentic self-compression where agent controls compression rate.

entry.title: A Navigational Approach for Comprehensive RAG via Traversal over Proposition Graphs

author.name: Maxime Delmas, Lei Xu, Andr\'e Freitas

entry.summary: Proposes ToPG, a RAG framework using proposition graphs that combines granular fact density with graph connectivity through iterative Suggestion-Selection cycles for complex multi-hop queries.

entry.title: Observations and Remedies for Large Language Model Bias in Self-Consuming Performative Loop

author.name: Yaxuan Wang, Zhongteng Cai, Yujia Bao, Xueru Zhang, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Studies bias emergence in Self-Consuming Performative Loops where LLMs are trained on their own outputs and user feedback creates feedback loops. Shows how synthetic data shapes bias in dynamic iterations.

entry.title: Beyond Binary Preference: Aligning Diffusion Models to Fine-grained Criteria by Decoupling Attributes

author.name: Chenye Meng, Zejian Li, Zhongni Liu, Yize Li, Changle Xie, Kaixin Jia, Ling Yang, Huanghuang Deng, Shiying Ding, Shengyuan Zhang, Jiayi Li, Lingyun Sun

entry.summary: Addresses limitations of binary preference alignment for diffusion models by introducing Complex Preference Optimization (CPO) with hierarchical, fine-grained criteria. Decomposes image quality into multiple attributes organized in tree structure.

entry.title: Gavel: Agent Meets Checklist for Evaluating LLMs on Long-Context Legal Summarization

author.name: Yao Dou, Wei Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Gavel-Ref for evaluating LLMs on legal case summarization spanning 100K-512K tokens. Tests 12 frontier models; best (Gemini 2.5 Pro) achieves only ~50% on multi-value checklist evaluation.

entry.title: IGenBench: Benchmarking the Reliability of Text-to-Infographic Generation

author.name: Yinghao Tang, Xueding Liu, Boyuan Zhang, Tingfeng Lan, Yupeng Xie, Jiale Lao, Yiyao Wang, Haoxuan Li, Tingting Gao, Bo Pan, Luoxuan Weng, Xiuqi Huang, Minfeng Zhu, Yingchaojie Feng, Yuyu Luo, and Wei Chen

entry.summary: Presents IGENBENCH, the first benchmark for evaluating text-to-infographic generation reliability with 600 test cases across 30 infographic types. Proposes automated evaluation decomposing reliability into atomic questions.

entry.title: Scaling Behavior Cloning Improves Causal Reasoning: An Open Model for Real-Time Video Game Playing

author.name: Yuguang Yue, Irakli Salia, Samuel Hunt, Chris Green, Wenzhe Shi, Jonathan J Hunt

entry.summary: Releases an open recipe for training video game playing foundation models including 8300+ hours of human gameplay data. Studies scaling laws showing improved causal reasoning with scale.

entry.title: CRANE: Causal Relevance Analysis of Language-Specific Neurons in Multilingual Large Language Models

author.name: Yifan Le and Yunliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes CRANE, a framework for analyzing language-specific neurons in multilingual LLMs through causal interventions rather than activation-based heuristics. Distinguishes between language preference and functional importance through targeted neuron-level interventions.

entry.title: ResMAS: Resilience Optimization in LLM-based Multi-agent Systems

author.name: Zhilun Zhou, Zihan Liu, Jiahe Liu, Qingyu Shao, Yihan Wang, Kun Shao, Depeng Jin, Fengli Xu

entry.summary: Proposes ResMAS for optimizing resilience in LLM-based multi-agent systems against perturbations like agent failures. Finds communication topology and prompt design significantly affect resilience, proposing a two-stage optimization approach.

entry.title: Automatic Classifiers Underdetect Emotions Expressed by Men

author.name: Ivan Smirnov, Segun T. Aroyehun, Paul Plener, David Garcia

entry.summary: Studies gender biases in automatic emotion classifiers using 1M+ self-annotated posts, finding consistent underdetection of emotions expressed by men across 414 model-class combinations.

entry.title: DR-LoRA: Dynamic Rank LoRA for Mixture-of-Experts Adaptation

author.name: Guanzhi Deng, Bo Li, Ronghao Chen, Huacan Wang, Linqi Song, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: Proposes DR-LoRA, which dynamically adjusts LoRA ranks for different experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs during fine-tuning based on task-specific demands, addressing the mismatch from uniform rank allocation.

entry.title: Prototypicality Bias Reveals Blindspots in Multimodal Evaluation Metrics

author.name: Subhadeep Roy, Gagan Bhatia, Steffen Eger

entry.summary: Identifies prototypicality bias in multimodal evaluation metrics where metrics favor visually prototypical images over semantically correct non-prototypical ones. Introduces ProtoBias benchmark.

entry.title: Agent-as-a-Judge

author.name: Runyang You, Hongru Cai, Caiqi Zhang, Qiancheng Xu, Meng Liu, Tiezheng Yu, Yongqi Li, Wenjie Li

entry.summary: First comprehensive survey on Agent-as-a-Judge paradigm where agentic systems evaluate AI outputs using planning, tool-augmented verification, multi-agent collaboration, and persistent memory.

entry.title: GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization

author.name: Shih-Yang Liu, Xin Dong, Ximing Lu, Shizhe Diao, Peter Belcak, Mingjie Liu, Min-Hung Chen, Hongxu Yin, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Kwang-Ting Cheng, Yejin Choi, Jan Kautz, Pavlo Molchanov

entry.summary: GDPO addresses a critical flaw in applying GRPO to multi-reward RL settings, where normalizing distinct reward combinations causes them to collapse into identical advantage values. Proposes group reward-decoupled normalization to preserve training signal resolution.

entry.title: The Economics of Transformative AI

author.name: Jan_Kulveit

entry.summary: Summarizes Anton Korinek's lecture on transformative AI economics, covering how AI may flip labor from bottleneck to reproducible resource. Discusses implications for growth, wages, and policy, noting that job creation from technology was empirical regularity, not economic law.

entry.title: Rate or Fate? RLV$^\varepsilon$R: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Noisy Rewards

author.name: Ali Rad, Khashayar Filom, Darioush Keivan, Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani, Ehsan Kamalinejad

entry.summary: Analyzes how verifier noise affects RLVR dynamics through multi-armed bandit framework. Shows whether noise merely slows learning (rate) or changes outcomes (fate), with implications for GRPO training.

entry.title: AM$^3$Safety: Towards Data Efficient Alignment of Multi-modal Multi-turn Safety for MLLMs

author.name: Han Zhu, Jiale Chen, Chengkun Cai, Shengjie Sun, Haoran Li, Yujin Zhou, Chi-Min Chan, Pengcheng Wen, Lei Li, Sirui Han, Yike Guo

entry.summary: Presents InterSafe-V dataset and AM³Safety approach for multi-turn multi-modal safety alignment. Addresses vulnerabilities from gradual harmful intent reconstruction across conversation turns.

entry.title: Revisiting Judge Decoding from First Principles via Training-Free Distributional Divergence

author.name: Shengyin Sun and Yiming Li and Renxi Liu and Weizhe Lin and Hui-Ling Zhen and Xianzhi Yu and Mingxuan Yuan and Chen Ma

entry.summary: Revisits Judge Decoding from first principles, proving that learned criticality scores correspond to KL divergence between draft and target distributions. Proposes training-free verification based on this insight.

entry.title: CounterVid: Counterfactual Video Generation for Mitigating Action and Temporal Hallucinations in Video-Language Models

author.name: Tobia Poppi, Burak Uzkent, Amanmeet Garg, Lucas Porto, Garin Kessler, Yezhou Yang, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Rita Cucchiara, Florian Schiffers

entry.summary: Proposes CounterVid, a framework for generating counterfactual videos that differ only in actions or temporal structure for mitigating VLM hallucinations. Creates ~26k preference pairs as training data.

entry.title: Orchestrating Intelligence: Confidence-Aware Routing for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration across Multi-Scale Models

author.name: Jingbo Wang, Sendong Zhao, Jiatong Liu, Haochun Wang, Wanting Li, Bing Qin, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Proposes OI-MAS, a multi-agent framework with confidence-aware routing that dynamically selects agent roles and model scales from heterogeneous LLM pools to reduce computational costs while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Compositional Steering of Large Language Models with Steering Tokens

author.name: Gorjan Radevski, Kiril Gashteovski, Giwon Hong, Carolin Lawrence, Goran Glava\v{s}

entry.summary: Proposes compositional steering tokens for multi-behavior control of LLMs. Embeds behaviors as tokens via self-distillation, enabling zero-shot composition in input token space rather than activation space.

entry.title: RelayLLM: Efficient Reasoning via Collaborative Decoding

author.name: Chengsong Huang, Tong Zheng, Langlin Huang, Jinyuan Li, Haolin Liu, Jiaxin Huang

entry.summary: RelayLLM enables token-level SLM-LLM collaboration where small model acts as controller, invoking large model only for critical tokens via special command. Two-stage training distills collaboration pattern.

entry.title: Pixel-Perfect Visual Geometry Estimation

author.name: Gangwei Xu, Haotong Lin, Hongcheng Luo, Haiyang Sun, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Sida Peng, Hangjun Ye, Xin Yang

entry.summary: Presents Pixel-Perfect Depth (PPD), a monocular depth foundation model using pixel-space diffusion transformers that produces flying-pixel-free point clouds. Introduces Semantics-Prompted DiT to reduce computational complexity while preserving global semantics.

entry.title: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet.

author.name: Dhruv Trehan

entry.summary: Documents experience building 6 AI agents for autonomous research across ML sub-domains. Only 1 of 4 research attempts succeeded. Identifies 6 recurring failure modes including implementation drift, memory degradation, and overexcitement.

entry.title: PackCache: A Training-Free Acceleration Method for Unified Autoregressive Video Generation via Compact KV-Cache

author.name: Kunyang Li, Mubarak Shah, Yuzhang Shang

entry.summary: Proposes PackCache, a training-free acceleration method for autoregressive video generation by compacting KV-cache based on spatiotemporal attention patterns. Distinguishes semantic anchors from decaying frame attention.

entry.title: On the Limitations of Rank-One Model Editing in Answering Multi-hop Questions

author.name: Zhiyuan He, Binghan Chen, Tianxiang Xiong, Ziyang Sun, Mozhao Zhu, Xi Chen

entry.summary: Studies limitations of ROME knowledge editing for multi-hop reasoning. Identifies three failure modes: hopping-too-late, generalization deterioration in later layers, and overfitting to edited knowledge.

entry.title: GPU-Accelerated INT8 Quantization for KV Cache Compression in Large Language Models

author.name: Maanas Taneja and Purab Shingvi

entry.summary: Implements and evaluates GPU-accelerated INT8 quantization for KV cache compression, achieving 4x memory reduction with minimal accuracy loss. Develops multiple CUDA kernel variants with up to 1694x speedup over CPU.

entry.title: RiskAtlas: Exposing Domain-Specific Risks in LLMs through Knowledge-Graph-Guided Harmful Prompt Generation

author.name: Huawei Zheng, Xinqi Jiang, Sen Yang, Shouling Ji, Yingcai Wu, Dazhen Deng

entry.summary: Proposes RiskAtlas for generating domain-specific implicit harmful prompts through knowledge-graph-guided synthesis. Targets harder-to-detect implicit prompts that reflect real-world threats.

entry.title: AT$^2$PO: Agentic Turn-based Policy Optimization via Tree Search

author.name: Zefang Zong, Dingwei Chen, Yang Li, Qi Yi, Bo Zhou, Chengming Li, Bo Qian, Peng Chen, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: Presents AT²PO for multi-turn agentic RL using tree search structure. Introduces Entropy-Guided Tree Expansion for exploration and Turn-wise Credit Assignment for fine-grained reward propagation.

entry.title: MisSpans: Fine-Grained False Span Identification in Cross-Domain Fake News

author.name: Zhiwei Liu, Paul Thompson, Jiaqi Rong, Baojie Qu, Runteng Guo, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Introduces MisSpans, the first multi-domain benchmark for span-level misinformation detection with fine-grained annotations distinguishing false span types (distorted vs fabricated).

entry.title: GenProve: Learning to Generate Text with Fine-Grained Provenance

author.name: Jingxuan Wei, Xingyue Wang, Yanghaoyu Liao, Jie Dong, Yuchen Liu, Caijun Jia, Bihui Yu, Junnan Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces GenProve for generating text with fine-grained provenance triples distinguishing Quotation, Compression, and Inference relationships to cited sources.

entry.title: Milestones over Outcome: Unlocking Geometric Reasoning with Sub-Goal Verifiable Reward

author.name: Jianlong Chen, Daocheng Fu, Shengze Xu, Jiawei Chen, Yuan Feng, Yue Yang, Junchi Yan, Hongyuan Zha, Renqiu Xia

entry.summary: Introduces sub-goal verifiable rewards (SGVR) for geometric reasoning in MLLMs. GeoGoal benchmark uses formal verification to create verifiable numeric subgoals. Dense rewards based on Skeleton Rate improve geometric performance by 9.7%.

entry.title: LaST$_{0}$: Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought for Robotic Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Zhuoyang Liu, Jiaming Liu, Hao Chen, Ziyu Guo, Chengkai Hou, Chenyang Gu, Jiale Yu, Xiangju Mi, Renrui Zhang, Zhengping Che, Jian Tang, Pheng-Ann Heng, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: LaST₀ proposes latent spatio-temporal chain-of-thought for Vision-Language-Action models, enabling efficient reasoning before action without the inference latency of explicit linguistic traces. Captures physical attributes in latent space.

entry.title: Memory Tokens: Large Language Models Can Generate Reversible Sentence Embeddings

author.name: Ignacio Sastre, Aiala Ros\'a

entry.summary: Discovers that LLMs can generate reversible sentence embeddings through special memory tokens, allowing exact text reconstruction without weight modification. Tested across English/Spanish, sequences up to 240 tokens, and models from 100M to 8B parameters.

entry.title: Formal Analysis of AGI Decision-Theoretic Models and the Confrontation Question

author.name: Denis Saklakov

entry.summary: Formalizes AGI confrontation question in Markov decision process framework, deriving closed-form thresholds for when AGI would choose power seizure over cooperation based on discount factor, shutdown probability, and cost.

entry.title: State Backdoor: Towards Stealthy Real-world Poisoning Attack on Vision-Language-Action Model in State Space

author.name: Ji Guo, Wenbo Jiang, Yansong Lin, Yijing Liu, Ruichen Zhang, Guomin Lu, Aiguo Chen, Xinshuo Han, Hongwei Li, Dusit Niyato

entry.summary: Introduces State Backdoor attack on Vision-Language-Action models using robot arm's initial state as trigger. Demonstrates vulnerability in embodied AI systems with high insusceptibility.

entry.title: Shadow Unlearning: A Neuro-Semantic Approach to Fidelity-Preserving Faceless Forgetting in LLMs

author.name: Dinesh Srivasthav P, Ashok Urlana, Rahul Mishra, Bala Mallikarjunarao Garlapati, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru

entry.summary: Proposes Shadow Unlearning for machine unlearning without exposing original data, using anonymized forget sets. Introduces Neuro-Semantic Projector Unlearning (NSPU) framework and MuFU evaluation dataset.

entry.title: Identifying Good and Bad Neurons for Task-Level Controllable LLMs

author.name: Wenjie Li, Guansong Pang, Hezhe Qiao, Debin Gao, David Lo

entry.summary: Proposes methods to identify both supportive and inhibitive neurons in LLMs for task-level control. Addresses fortuitous behavior where models answer correctly by chance rather than understanding.

entry.title: Beyond Monolithic Architectures: A Multi-Agent Search and Knowledge Optimization Framework for Agentic Search

author.name: Yiqun Chen, Lingyong Yan, Zixuan Yang, Erhan Zhang, Jiashu Zhao, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin, Jiaxin Mao

entry.summary: Proposes M-ASK, a multi-agent framework for agentic search that decouples search behavior and knowledge management into separate agent roles. Addresses trajectory inflation, sparse rewards, and search noise in monolithic approaches.

entry.title: Memory Matters More: Event-Centric Memory as a Logic Map for Agent Searching and Reasoning

author.name: Yuyang Hu, Jiongnan Liu, Jiejun Tan, Yutao Zhu, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: Proposes event-centric memory as a logic map for LLM agents, organizing memories by events with explicit logical relationships rather than flat storage. Enables logical reasoning over past experiences for decision-making.

entry.title: Learnable Multipliers: Freeing the Scale of Language Model Matrix Layers

author.name: Maksim Velikanov, Ilyas Chahed, Jingwei Zuo, Dhia Eddine Rhaiem, Younes Belkada, Hakim Hacid

entry.summary: Introduces learnable per-row and per-column multipliers for LLM matrix layers to learn optimal scales, showing the weight decay-noise equilibrium norm is suboptimal and can be improved.

entry.title: The RoboSense Challenge: Sense Anything, Navigate Anywhere, Adapt Across Platforms

author.name: Lingdong Kong, Shaoyuan Xie, Zeying Gong, Ye Li, Meng Chu, Ao Liang, Yuhao Dong, Tianshuai Hu, Ronghe Qiu, Rong Li, Hanjiang Hu, Dongyue Lu, Wei Yin, Wenhao Ding, Linfeng Li, Hang Song, Wenwei Zhang, Yuexin Ma, Junwei Liang, Zhedong Zheng, Lai Xing Ng, Benoit R. Cottereau, Wei Tsang Ooi, Ziwei Liu, Zhanpeng Zhang, Weichao Qiu, Wei Zhang, Ji Ao, Jiangpeng Zheng, Siyu Wang, Guang Yang, Zihao Zhang, Yu Zhong, Enzhu Gao, Xinhan Zheng, Xueting Wang, Shouming Li, Yunkai Gao, Siming Lan, Mingfei Han, Xing Hu, Dusan Malic, Christian Fruhwirth-Reisinger, Alexander Prutsch, Wei Lin, Samuel Schulter, Horst Possegger, Linfeng Li, Jian Zhao, Zepeng Yang, Yuhang Song, Bojun Lin, Tianle Zhang, Yuchen Yuan, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li, Youngseok Kim, Sihwan Hwang, Hyeonjun Jeong, Aodi Wu, Xubo Luo, Erjia Xiao, Lingfeng Zhang, Yingbo Tang, Hao Cheng, Renjing Xu, Wenbo Ding, Lei Zhou, Long Chen, Hangjun Ye, Xiaoshuai Hao, Shuangzhi Li, Junlong Shen, Xingyu Li, Hao Ruan, Jinliang Lin, Zhiming Luo, Yu Zang, Cheng Wang, Hanshi Wang, Xijie Gong, Yixiang Yang, Qianli Ma, Zhipeng Zhang, Wenxiang Shi, Jingmeng Zhou, Weijun Zeng, Kexin Xu, Yuchen Zhang, Haoxiang Fu, Ruibin Hu, Yanbiao Ma, Xiyan Feng, Wenbo Zhang, Lu Zhang, Yunzhi Zhuge, Huchuan Lu, You He, Seungjun Yu, Junsung Park, Youngsun Lim, Hyunjung Shim, Faduo Liang, Zihang Wang, Yiming Peng, Guanyu Zong, Xu Li, Binghao Wang, Hao Wei, Yongxin Ma, Yunke Shi, Shuaipeng Liu, Dong Kong, Yongchun Lin, Huitong Yang, Liang Lei, Haoang Li, Xinliang Zhang, Zhiyong Wang, Xiaofeng Wang, Yuxia Fu, Yadan Luo, Djamahl Etchegaray, Yang Li, Congfei Li, Yuxiang Sun, Wenkai Zhu, Wang Xu, Linru Li, Longjie Liao, Jun Yan, Benwu Wang, Xueliang Ren, Xiaoyu Yue, Jixian Zheng, Jinfeng Wu, Shurui Qin, Wei Cong, Yao He

entry.summary: Introduces RoboSense 2025 Challenge spanning five tracks for robust robot perception including language-grounded decision making, social navigation, and cross-platform 3D perception.

entry.title: DeepWeightFlow: Re-Basined Flow Matching for Generating Neural Network Weights

author.name: Saumya Gupta, Scott Biggs, Moritz Laber, Zohair Shafi, Robin Walters, and Ayan Paul

entry.summary: DeepWeightFlow uses flow matching to generate diverse, high-accuracy neural network weights directly in weight space for various architectures (ResNet, ViT) without requiring fine-tuning of generated models.

entry.title: Vision-Language Introspection: Mitigating Overconfident Hallucinations in MLLMs via Interpretable Bi-Causal Steering

author.name: Shuliang Liu, Songbo Yang, Dong Fang, Sihang Jia, Yuqi Tang, Lingfeng Su, Ruoshui Peng, Yibo Yan, Xin Zou, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Vision-Language Introspection (VLI) mitigates VLM hallucinations through training-free metacognitive self-correction. Performs attributive introspection for risk diagnosis and interventive introspection for correction.

entry.title: Unified Text-Image Generation with Weakness-Targeted Post-Training

author.name: Jiahui Chen, Philippe Hansen-Estruch, Xiaochuang Han, Yushi Hu, Emily Dinan, Amita Kamath, Michal Drozdzal, Reyhane Askari-Hemmat, Luke Zettlemoyer, Marjan Ghazvininejad

entry.summary: Explores post-training for unified text-image generation where models autonomously transition from textual reasoning to visual synthesis. Examines weakness-targeted strategies and relative importance of modalities during post-training.

entry.title: XGrammar 2: Dynamic and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Agentic LLMs

author.name: Linzhang Li, Yixin Dong, Guanjie Wang, Ziyi Xu, Alexander Jiang, Tianqi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes XGrammar 2, an optimized structured generation engine for agentic LLMs with dynamic dispatching, JIT compilation, and cross-grammar caching. Handles complex tool calling and conditional generation.

entry.title: On the Holistic Approach for Detecting Human Image Forgery

author.name: Xiao Guo, Jie Zhu, Anil Jain, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HuForDet, a holistic framework for human image forgery detection covering both facial manipulations and full-body synthesis. Uses dual-branch architecture with RGB and frequency domain experts.

entry.title: When Single-Agent with Skills Replace Multi-Agent Systems and When They Fail

author.name: Xiaoxiao Li

entry.summary: Explores when single-agent systems with skill libraries can replace multi-agent systems, viewing skills as internalized agent behaviors. Finds substantial token and latency reductions while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: RAAR: Retrieval Augmented Agentic Reasoning for Cross-Domain Misinformation Detection

author.name: Zhiwei Liu, Runteng Guo, Baojie Qu, Yuechen Jiang, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Introduces RAAR, a retrieval-augmented agentic reasoning framework for cross-domain misinformation detection that retrieves multi-perspective evidence aligned with semantics, sentiment, and writing style.

entry.title: V-FAT: Benchmarking Visual Fidelity Against Text-bias

author.name: Ziteng Wang, Yujie He, Guanliang Li, Siqi Yang, Jiaqi Xiong, Songxiang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces V-FAT benchmark with 4026 VQA instances to quantify Text Bias in MLLMs, separating Internal Corpus Bias from External Instruction Bias (sycophancy).

entry.title: Text as a Universal Interface for Transferable Personalization

author.name: Yuting Liu, Jian Guan, Jia-Nan Li, Wei Wu, Jiang-Ming Yang, Jianzhe Zhao, Guibing Guo

entry.summary: Advocates natural language as a universal interface for LLM personalization, introducing two-stage training combining SFT with RL for interpretable, transferable preference representations.

entry.title: Reinforced Efficient Reasoning via Semantically Diverse Exploration

author.name: Ziqi Zhao, Zhaochun Ren, Jiahong Zou, Liu Yang, Zhiwei Xu, Xuri Ge, Zhumin Chen, Xinyu Ma, Daiting Shi, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin, Xin Xin

entry.summary: ROSE enhances LLM reasoning using MCTS with semantic-entropy-based branching and ε-exploration for diverse exploration. Addresses limited exploration diversity in existing RLVR approaches for reasoning.

entry.title: Distilling the Thought, Watermarking the Answer: A Principle Semantic Guided Watermark for Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Shuliang Liu, Xingyu Li, Hongyi Liu, Yibo Yan, Bingchen Duan, Qi Zheng, Dong Fang, Lingfeng Su, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: ReasonMark watermarks reasoning LLMs by decoupling into undisturbed Thinking Phase and watermarked Answering Phase. Uses Criticality Score to identify semantically pivotal tokens from reasoning trace.

entry.title: Addressing Overthinking in Large Vision-Language Models via Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization

author.name: Xingjian Diao, Zheyuan Liu, Chunhui Zhang, Weiyi Wu, Keyi Kong, Lin Shi, Kaize Ding, Soroush Vosoughi, Jiang Gui

entry.summary: Proposes Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization (GPRO) to address overthinking in LVLMs. Argues reasoning errors often stem from perception failures rather than insufficient deliberation.

entry.title: Tape: A Cellular Automata Benchmark for Evaluating Rule-Shift Generalization in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Enze Pan

entry.summary: Presents Tape, a cellular automata-based RL benchmark for evaluating out-of-distribution generalization under latent rule shifts. Provides standardized protocols showing methods strong in-distribution can collapse OOD.

entry.title: Prior-Informed Zeroth-Order Optimization with Adaptive Direction Alignment for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Feihu Jin, Shipeng Cen, and Ying Tan

entry.summary: Proposes prior-informed zeroth-order optimization for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning that uses adaptive direction alignment. Computes guiding vectors from Gaussian samples to reduce variance in gradient estimation.

entry.title: LANGSAE EDITING: Improving Multilingual Information Retrieval via Post-hoc Language Identity Removal

author.name: Dongjun Kim, Jeongho Yoon, Chanjun Park, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes LANGSAE EDITING for post-hoc removal of language identity signal from multilingual embeddings to improve cross-lingual retrieval. Uses sparse autoencoder to identify and suppress language-associated units.

entry.title: Higher-Order Knowledge Representations for Agentic Scientific Reasoning

author.name: Isabella A. Stewart and Markus J. Buehler

entry.summary: Introduces hypergraph-based knowledge representations that encode multi-entity relationships for scientific reasoning, applied to ~1100 biocomposite scaffold manuscripts creating 161K node hypergraph.

entry.title: Can AI-Generated Persuasion Be Detected? Persuaficial Benchmark and AI vs. Human Linguistic Differences

author.name: Arkadiusz Modzelewski, Pawe{\l} Golik, Anna Ko{\l}os, Giovanni Da San Martino

entry.summary: Introduces Persuaficial, a multilingual benchmark for detecting AI-generated persuasive text across six languages, finding subtle LLM-generated persuasion harder to detect than overt attempts.

entry.title: Token-Level LLM Collaboration via FusionRoute

author.name: Nuoya Xiong, Yuhang Zhou, Hanqing Zeng, Zhaorun Chen, Furong Huang, Shuchao Bi, Lizhu Zhang, Zhuokai Zhao

entry.summary: FusionRoute enables token-level collaboration between multiple LLMs where a lightweight router selects experts per decoding step and contributes complementary logits. Balances efficiency and capability.

entry.title: Optimal Lower Bounds for Online Multicalibration

author.name: Natalie Collina, Jiuyao Lu, Georgy Noarov, Aaron Roth

entry.summary: Proves tight lower bounds for online multicalibration, establishing an information-theoretic separation from marginal calibration. Shows Ω(T^{2/3}) lower bound using just three binary groups, matching known upper bounds.

entry.title: ParaCodex: A Profiling-Guided Autonomous Coding Agent for Reliable Parallel Code Generation and Translation

author.name: Erel Kaplan, Tomer Bitan, Lian Ghrayeb, Le Chen, Tom Yotam, Niranjan Hasabnis, Gal Oren

entry.summary: Presents ParaCodex, an autonomous coding agent for OpenMP GPU offload using staged hotspot analysis, data planning, and profiling-guided refinement. Succeeded on 31/31 valid kernels with improved performance over reference implementations.

entry.title: RIGOURATE: Quantifying Scientific Exaggeration with Evidence-Aligned Claim Evaluation

author.name: Joseph James, Chenghao Xiao, Yucheng Li, Nafise Sadat Moosavi and Chenghua Lin

entry.summary: Presents RIGOURATE, a framework for detecting scientific overclaiming by retrieving evidence and assigning overstatement scores. Creates dataset of 10K+ claim-evidence sets from ICLR/NeurIPS papers validated with peer review comments.

entry.title: Disco-RAG: Discourse-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Dongqi Liu, Hang Ding, Qiming Feng, Jian Li, Xurong Xie, Zhucun Xue, Chengjie Wang, Jiangning Zhang, Yabiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Disco-RAG, a discourse-aware RAG framework that constructs intra-chunk discourse trees and inter-chunk rhetorical graphs. Uses these structures to condition generation through planning blueprint.

entry.title: ARREST: Adversarial Resilient Regulation Enhancing Safety and Truth in Large Language Models

author.name: Sharanya Dasgupta, Arkaprabha Basu, Sujoy Nath, and Swagatam Das

entry.summary: Proposes ARREST, an external network approach for regulating LLM factuality and safety by intervening in latent activation space. Argues factual and safety failures share representational misalignment.

entry.title: Learning to Simulate Human Dialogue

author.name: Kanishk Gandhi, Agam Bhatia, Noah D. Goodman

entry.summary: Studies learning approaches for next-turn dialogue prediction comparing thinking-before-responding and different reward signals. Finds judge-based rewards decrease human-likeness despite increasing judge scores.

entry.title: Merging Triggers, Breaking Backdoors: Defensive Poisoning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models

author.name: San Kim, Gary Geunbae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MB-Defense, a training pipeline that immunizes instruction-tuned LLMs against backdoor attacks by merging attacker and defensive triggers then breaking the backdoor representation.

entry.title: UniDrive-WM: Unified Understanding, Planning and Generation World Model For Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhexiao Xiong, Xin Ye, Burhan Yaman, Sheng Cheng, Yiren Lu, Jingru Luo, Nathan Jacobs, Liu Ren

entry.summary: Proposes UniDrive-WM, a unified VLM-based world model jointly performing driving scene understanding, trajectory planning, and future image generation within single architecture.

entry.title: Character-R1: Enhancing Role-Aware Reasoning in Role-Playing Agents via RLVR

author.name: Yihong Tang, Kehai Chen, Xuefeng Bai, Benyou Wang, Zeming Liu, Haifeng Wang, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Character-R1 for role-playing agents using RLVR with cognitive focus reward, reference-guided reward, and character-conditioned reward. Provides verifiable signals for role-aware reasoning.

entry.title: DP-MGTD: Privacy-Preserving Machine-Generated Text Detection via Adaptive Differentially Private Entity Sanitization

author.name: Lionel Z. Wang, Yusheng Zhao, Jiabin Luo, Xinfeng Li, Lixu Wang, Yinan Peng, Haoyang Li, XiaoFeng Wang, Wei Dong

entry.summary: Proposes DP-MGTD, a framework for detecting machine-generated text while preserving user privacy through adaptive differential privacy. Uses a two-stage mechanism with Laplace and Exponential mechanisms for different entity types, discovering a counter-intuitive trade-off between privacy and detection accuracy.

entry.title: Forge-and-Quench: Enhancing Image Generation for Higher Fidelity in Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Yanbing Zeng, Jia Wang, Hanghang Ma, Junqiang Wu, Jie Zhu, Xiaoming Wei, Jie Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Forge-and-Quench, a unified framework for image generation and understanding where MLLMs reason over context to enhance text instructions, then map to visual tokens for generation with improved fidelity.

entry.title: KnowMe-Bench: Benchmarking Person Understanding for Lifelong Digital Companions

author.name: Tingyu Wu and Zhisheng Chen and Ziyan Weng and Shuhe Wang and Chenglong Li and Shuo Zhang and Sen Hu and Silin Wu and Qizhen Lan and Huacan Wang and Ronghao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces KnowMe-Bench for person understanding from long-form autobiographical narratives with flashback-aware temporal structure. Evaluates factual recall, subjective attribution, and principle-level reasoning.

entry.title: Orion-RAG: Path-Aligned Hybrid Retrieval for Graphless Data

author.name: Zhen Chen, Weihao Xie, Peilin Chen, Shiqi Wang, Jianping Wang

entry.summary: Presents Orion-RAG for handling graphless, fragmented data by extracting lightweight paths that link related concepts without heavy graph construction. Addresses practical scenarios where data lacks explicit links.

entry.title: Neural-Symbolic Integration with Evolvable Policies

author.name: Marios Thoma, Vassilis Vassiliades and Loizos Michael

entry.summary: Proposes a neural-symbolic AI framework that enables concurrent learning of non-differentiable symbolic policies and neural network weights through evolution. Addresses the limitation of existing NeSy frameworks requiring differentiable policies.

entry.title: SmartSearch: Process Reward-Guided Query Refinement for Search Agents

author.name: Tongyu Wen, Guanting Dong, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: Introduces SmartSearch with process rewards for fine-grained supervision of intermediate search queries and query refinement to improve search agent effectiveness.

entry.title: OptiSet: Unified Optimizing Set Selection and Ranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yi Jiang, Sendong Zhao, Jianbo Li, Bairui Hu, Yanrui Du, Haochun Wang, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes OptiSet, a framework that optimizes passage selection for RAG by treating it as set optimization rather than individual relevance ranking. Uses 'Expand-then-Refine' paradigm to create compact, non-redundant evidence sets without strong LLM supervision.

entry.title: VerseCrafter: Dynamic Realistic Video World Model with 4D Geometric Control

author.name: Sixiao Zheng, Minghao Yin, Wenbo Hu, Xiaoyu Li, Ying Shan, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: VerseCrafter is a 4D-aware video world model enabling explicit control over camera and object dynamics through 4D Geometric Control representation using point clouds and 3D Gaussian trajectories.

entry.title: Generate, Transfer, Adapt: Learning Functional Dexterous Grasping from a Single Human Demonstration

author.name: Xingyi He, Adhitya Polavaram, Yunhao Cao, Om Deshmukh, Tianrui Wang, Xiaowei Zhou, Kuan Fang

entry.summary: CorDex enables learning dexterous functional grasps of novel objects from a single human demonstration using correspondence-based data generation in simulation. Achieves sim-to-real transfer through semantic and geometric reasoning.

entry.title: GREx: Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation, Comprehension, and Generation

author.name: Henghui Ding, Chang Liu, Shuting He, Xudong Jiang, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces GREx benchmarks extending referring expression tasks (segmentation, comprehension, generation) to handle multi-target and no-target expressions. Creates gRefCOCO dataset and proposes unified model handling all three tasks.

entry.title: GeM-VG: Towards Generalized Multi-image Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Shurong Zheng, Yousong Zhu, Hongyin Zhao, Fan Yang, Yufei Zhan, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GeM-VG for generalized multi-image visual grounding with MLLMs, addressing multi-target localization across images. Introduces MG-Data-240K dataset for training.

entry.title: Analyzing Message-Code Inconsistency in AI Coding Agent-Authored Pull Requests

author.name: Jingzhi Gong, Giovanni Pinna, Yixin Bian, Jie M. Zhang

entry.summary: Analyzes 23K pull requests from AI coding agents, finding message-code inconsistencies in 1.7% of PRs, with high-MCI PRs having 51.7% lower acceptance rates. Identifies eight inconsistency types.

entry.title: T-Retriever: Tree-based Hierarchical Retrieval Augmented Generation for Textual Graphs

author.name: Chunyu Wei, Huaiyu Qin, Siyuan He, Yunhai Wang, Yueguo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes T-Retriever for graph-based RAG using tree-based retrieval with Adaptive Compression Encoding that preserves natural hierarchical organization through global optimization.

entry.title: Cutting AI Research Costs: How Task-Aware Compression Makes Large Language Model Agents Affordable

author.name: Zuhair Ahmed Khan Taha, Mohammed Mudassir Uddin, Shahnawaz Alam

entry.summary: AgentCompress reduces LLM agent costs by routing tasks to appropriately compressed model variants based on difficulty. Small network predicts task complexity from opening words in under 1ms.

entry.title: MedPI: Evaluating AI Systems in Medical Patient-facing Interactions

author.name: Diego Fajardo V., Oleksii Proniakin, Victoria-Elisabeth Gruber, Razvan Marinescu

entry.summary: Introduces MedPI, a benchmark evaluating LLMs in patient-clinician conversations across 105 dimensions covering medical process, treatment safety, outcomes, and communication. Includes synthetic EHR-like patient profiles and AI patients.

entry.title: Complexity Agnostic Recursive Decomposition of Thoughts

author.name: Kaleem Ullah Qasim, Jiashu Zhang, Hafiz Saif Ur Rehman

entry.summary: Introduces CARD, a framework that predicts problem complexity before generation and adapts reasoning decomposition accordingly. Uses MRCE to predict 30 features and allocates thought budgets per step.

entry.title: SAGE-32B: Agentic Reasoning via Iterative Distillation

author.name: Basab Jha, Firoj Paudel, Ujjwal Puri, Ethan Henkel, Zhang Yuting, Mateusz Kowalczyk, Mei Huang, Choi Donghyuk, Wang Junhao

entry.summary: Demonstrates SAGE-32B, a 32B parameter model focused on agentic reasoning using Iterative Distillation and inverse reasoning for failure forecasting. Achieves improved success rates on agentic benchmarks.

entry.title: Scaling Trends for Multi-Hop Contextual Reasoning in Mid-Scale Language Models

author.name: Brady Steele, Micah Katz

entry.summary: Controlled study demonstrating task-method dissociation in multi-hop reasoning: rule-based methods achieve 100% on retrieval but 6.7% on reasoning, while LLM multi-agent systems show inverse pattern.

entry.title: Making Tunable Parameters State-Dependent in Weather and Climate Models with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Pritthijit Nath, Sebastian Schemm, Henry Moss, Peter Haynes, Emily Shuckburgh, Mark J. Webb

entry.summary: Presents RL framework for learning parametrisation components in weather/climate models online as function of evolving state. Evaluates across idealised testbeds with multiple RL algorithms.

entry.title: Predictable Gradient Manifolds in Deep Learning: Temporal Path-Length and Intrinsic Rank as a Complexity Regime

author.name: Anherutowa Calvo

entry.summary: Formalizes predictable gradient manifolds introducing prediction-based path length and predictable rank metrics. Shows convergence guarantees can depend on these rather than worst-case bounds.

entry.title: Unlocking the Pre-Trained Model as a Dual-Alignment Calibrator for Post-Trained LLMs

author.name: Beier Luo, Cheng Wang, Hongxin Wei, Sharon Li, Xuefeng Du

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Align for calibrating post-trained LLMs by diagnosing confidence drift and process drift regimes. Uses pre-trained model as calibrator without modifying weights.

entry.title: From Domains to Instances: Dual-Granularity Data Synthesis for LLM Unlearning

author.name: Xiaoyu Xu, Minxin Du, Zitong Li, Zi Liang, Zhibiao Guo, Shiyu Zhang, Peizhao Hu, Qingqing Ye, Haibo Hu

entry.summary: Introduces BiForget framework for synthesizing forget sets for LLM unlearning at domain and instance levels. Uses target model itself to generate data matching its knowledge distribution.

entry.title: LEGATO: Good Identity Unlearning Is Continuous

author.name: Qiang Chen, Chun-Wun Cheng, Xiu Su, Hongyan Xu, Xi Lin, Shan You, Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero, Yi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes LEGATO for continuous identity unlearning in generative models, arguing forgetting should be continuous and controllable rather than discrete. Addresses efficiency and catastrophic collapse issues.

entry.title: Users Mispredict Their Own Preferences for AI Writing Assistance

author.name: Vivian Lai, Zana Bu\c{c}inca, Nil-Jana Akpinar, Mo Houtti, Hyeonsu B. Kang, Kevin Chian, Namjoon Suh, Alex C. Williams

entry.summary: Finds significant gap between users' stated and revealed preferences for AI writing assistance. Compositional effort dominates decisions while urgency shows no predictive power despite being ranked first in self-reports.

entry.title: LinguaGame: A Linguistically Grounded Game-Theoretic Paradigm for Multi-Agent Dialogue Generation

author.name: Yuxiao Ye, Yiming Zhang, Yiran Ma, Huiyuan Xie, Huining Zhu, Zhiyuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes LinguaGame, a game-theoretic framework for multi-agent dialogue generation that models communication as signalling games over intents. Uses training-free equilibrium approximation for inference-time decisions.

entry.title: Estimating Causal Effects in Gaussian Linear SCMs with Finite Data

author.name: Aurghya Maiti and Prateek Jain

entry.summary: Introduces Centralized Gaussian Linear SCMs (CGL-SCMs) for estimating causal effects from finite observational data with latent confounders. Presents an EM-based estimation algorithm that handles overparameterization.

entry.title: See, Explain, and Intervene: A Few-Shot Multimodal Agent Framework for Hateful Meme Moderation

author.name: Naquee Rizwan, Subhankar Swain, Paramananda Bhaskar, Gagan Aryan, Shehryaar Shah Khan, Animesh Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes a few-shot multimodal agent framework for hateful meme moderation that handles detection, explanation, and intervention jointly. Uses generative AI models with task-specific agents for limited data conditions.

entry.title: Tool-MAD: A Multi-Agent Debate Framework for Fact Verification with Diverse Tool Augmentation and Adaptive Retrieval

author.name: Seyeon Jeong, Yeonjun Choi, JongWook Kim, Beakcheol Jang

entry.summary: Proposes Tool-MAD, a multi-agent debate framework for fact verification where each agent has distinct external tools. Uses adaptive retrieval to handle emerging information during debate.

entry.title: PILOT-Bench: A Benchmark for Legal Reasoning in the Patent Domain with IRAC-Aligned Classification Tasks

author.name: Yehoon Jang, Chaewon Lee, Hyun-seok Min, Sungchul Choi

entry.summary: Introduces PILOT-Bench, the first PTAB-centric benchmark aligning patent decisions with USPTO data for legal reasoning evaluation. Formalizes IRAC-aligned classification tasks for Issue Type, Board Authorities, and Subdecision.

entry.title: Belief in Authority: Impact of Authority in Multi-Agent Evaluation Framework

author.name: Junhyuk Choi, Jeongyoun Kwon, Heeju Kim, Haeun Cho, Hayeong Jung, Sehee Min, Bugeun Kim

entry.summary: Analyzes role-based authority bias in multi-agent LLM systems using French and Raven's power theory. Finds Expert and Referent power roles influence more than Legitimate power, with bias emerging through position maintenance.

entry.title: Rethinking GNNs and Missing Features: Challenges, Evaluation and a Robust Solution

author.name: Francesco Ferrini, Veronica Lachi, Antonio Longa, Bruno Lepri, Matono Akiyoshi, Andrea Passerini, Xin Liu, Manfred Jaeger

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing high sparsity limits information loss from missing features in GNNs, introduces new datasets with dense features, and designs evaluation protocols beyond MCAR assumptions.

entry.title: Sequential Subspace Noise Injection Prevents Accuracy Collapse in Certified Unlearning

author.name: Polina Dolgova, Sebastian U. Stich

entry.summary: Sequential noise scheduling for certified unlearning distributes noise across orthogonal parameter subspaces rather than all at once. Maintains privacy guarantees while substantially improving post-unlearning accuracy.

entry.title: CoV: Chain-of-View Prompting for Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Haoyu Zhao, Akide Liu, Zeyu Zhang, Weijie Wang, Feng Chen, Ruihan Zhu, Gholamreza Haffari, Bohan Zhuang

entry.summary: Chain-of-View (CoV) prompting transforms VLMs into active viewpoint reasoners for embodied QA through coarse-to-fine exploration. Training-free test-time reasoning with view selection and adjustment.

entry.title: Beyond Static Summarization: Proactive Memory Extraction for LLM Agents

author.name: Chengyuan Yang and Zequn Sun and Wei Wei and Wei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes ProMem for proactive memory extraction in LLM agents. Treats extraction as iterative cognitive process rather than one-off summarization, addressing ahead-of-time and one-off limitations.

entry.title: EvolSQL: Structure-Aware Evolution for Scalable Text-to-SQL Data Synthesis

author.name: Xuanguang Pan, Chongyang Tao, Jiayuan Bai, Jianling Gao, Zhengwei Tao, Xiansheng Zhou, Gavin Cheung, Shuai Ma

entry.summary: Introduces EvolSQL, a structure-aware data synthesis framework for Text-to-SQL that evolves SQL queries using atomic transformation operators derived from SQL Abstract Syntax Trees.

entry.title: On the Definition and Detection of Cherry-Picking in Counterfactual Explanations

author.name: James Hinns, Sofie Goethals, Stephan Van der Veeken, Theodoros Evgeniou, and David Martens

entry.summary: Formally defines cherry-picking in counterfactual explanations and studies detection capabilities at different access levels, finding detection is possible with procedural access.

entry.title: Re-Align: Structured Reasoning-guided Alignment for In-Context Image Generation and Editing

author.name: Runze He, Yiji Cheng, Tiankai Hang, Zhimin Li, Yu Xu, Zijin Yin, Shiyi Zhang, Wenxun Dai, Penghui Du, Ao Ma, Chunyu Wang, Qinglin Lu, Jizhong Han, Jiao Dai

entry.summary: Re-Align bridges understanding and generation in multimodal models through In-Context Chain-of-Thought (IC-CoT) for image generation/editing. Uses structured reasoning with RL training for improved generation quality.

entry.title: RoboVIP: Multi-View Video Generation with Visual Identity Prompting Augments Robot Manipulation

author.name: Boyang Wang, Haoran Zhang, Shujie Zhang, Jinkun Hao, Mingda Jia, Qi Lv, Yucheng Mao, Zhaoyang Lyu, Jia Zeng, Xudong Xu, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: RoboVIP introduces visual identity prompting for robot manipulation data augmentation, providing explicit visual guidance to diffusion models for generating multi-view, temporally coherent observations. Addresses limitations of text-only prompts for scene specification.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Testing of AI Agents for Air Traffic Control with a Regulated Assessment Framework

author.name: Ben Carvell, Marc Thomas, Andrew Pace, Christopher Dorney, George De Ath, Richard Everson, Nick Pepper, Adam Keane, Samuel Tomlinson, Richard Cannon

entry.summary: Presents a rigorous human-in-the-loop evaluation framework for AI air traffic controllers grounded in regulator-certified assessments. Addresses misalignment between academic representations and real operational complexity.

entry.title: Generalization to Political Beliefs from Fine-Tuning on Sports Team Preferences

author.name: Owen Terry

entry.summary: Finds that LLMs fine-tuned on sports team preferences exhibit unexpected generalization to political beliefs. Both coastal and southern sports preferences led to similar political divergence from base model.

entry.title: Aligned explanations in neural networks

author.name: Corentin Lobet, Francesca Chiaromonte

entry.summary: Introduces PiNets, pseudo-linear networks that produce instance-wise linear predictions for aligned explanations. Argues explanatory alignment is key for trustworthy predictions rather than post-hoc rationalization.

entry.title: Improving and Accelerating Offline RL in Large Discrete Action Spaces with Structured Policy Initialization

author.name: Matthew Landers, Taylor W. Killian, Thomas Hartvigsen, Afsaneh Doryab

entry.summary: Introduces SPIN, a two-stage framework for offline RL in discrete combinatorial action spaces. Pre-trains Action Structure Model then trains lightweight policy heads, achieving up to 39% improvement over SOTA.

entry.title: GUITester: Enabling GUI Agents for Exploratory Defect Discovery

author.name: Yifei Gao, Jiang Wu, Xiaoyi Chen, Yifan Yang, Zhe Cui, Tianyi Ma, Jiaming Zhang, Jitao Sang

entry.summary: Proposes GUITester, a multi-agent framework for automated exploratory GUI testing that addresses Goal-Oriented Masking and Execution-Bias Attribution problems. Introduces GUITestBench with 143 tasks across 26 defects.

entry.title: A General Neural Backbone for Mixed-Integer Linear Optimization via Dual Attention
