entry.summary: Extends Actor-Critic architecture to 3D modeling through multi-agent Planner-Actor-Critic framework with human-in-the-loop supervision for creative tasks.

entry.title: A Future Capabilities Agent for Tactical Air Traffic Control

author.name: Paul Kent, George De Ath, Martin Layton, Allen Hart, Richard Everson, Ben Carvell

entry.summary: Presents Agent Mallard, a forward-planning rules-based agent for tactical air traffic control that embeds a stochastic digital twin for conflict resolution. Addresses the trade-off between safety assurance and interpretability in aviation automation.

entry.title: Convergence Rates for Learning Pseudo-Differential Operators

author.name: Jiaheng Chen, Daniel Sanz-Alonso

entry.summary: Establishes convergence rates for learning elliptic pseudo-differential operators in wavelet-Galerkin framework. Proposes sparse estimator with novel matrix compression for data-efficient learning.

entry.title: Hybrid Federated Learning for Noise-Robust Training

author.name: Yongjun Kim, Hyeongjun Park, Hwanjin Kim, Junil Choi

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid federated learning framework combining gradient-based FL and logit-based federated distillation to improve noise robustness. Uses adaptive UE clustering and weight selection to achieve better accuracy at low SNR.

entry.title: Bridging Distance and Spectral Positional Encodings via Anchor-Based Diffusion Geometry Approximation

author.name: Zimo Yan and Zheng Xie and Runfan Duan and Chang Liu and Wumei Du

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical connections between distance-based and spectral positional encodings in molecular graph learning. Derives explicit reconstruction guarantees using trilateration from anchor distances.

entry.title: Timeliness-Oriented Scheduling and Resource Allocation in Multi-Region Collaborative Perception

author.name: Mengmeng Zhu, Yuxuan Sun, Yukuan Jia, Wei Chen, Bo Ai, and Sheng Zhou

entry.summary: Studies dynamic scheduling in multi-region collaborative perception for autonomous driving. Proposes timeliness-aware prioritization balancing information freshness with communication constraints.

entry.title: GEnSHIN: Graphical Enhanced Spatio-temporal Hierarchical Inference Network for Traffic Flow Prediction

author.name: Zhiyan Zhou and Junjie Liao and Manho Zhang and Yingyi Liao and Ziai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GEnSHIN for traffic flow prediction with attention-enhanced graph convolution, asymmetric dual-embedding graph generation, and dynamic memory banks for long-term pattern capture.

entry.title: 3D Conditional Image Synthesis of Left Atrial LGE MRI from Composite Semantic Masks

author.name: Yusri Al-Sanaani, Rebecca Thornhill, Sreeraman Rajan

entry.summary: Investigates 3D conditional generative models for synthesizing left atrial LGE MRI to augment training data for cardiac segmentation. Compares Pix2Pix GAN, SPADE-GAN, and SPADE-LDM.

entry.title: Vibe Coding an LLM-powered Theorem Prover

author.name: Zhe Hou

entry.summary: Presents Isabellm, an LLM-powered theorem prover for Isabelle/HOL combining stepwise proving with proof planning. Notably, the entire codebase was generated through 'vibe coding' with GPT, Gemini, and Claude.

entry.title: A zone-based training approach for last-mile routing using Graph Neural Networks and Pointer Networks

author.name: \`Angel Ruiz-Fas, Carlos Granell, Jos\'e Francisco Ramos, Joaqu\'in Huerta, Sergio Trilles

entry.summary: Proposes a GNN encoder with Pointer Network decoder for last-mile delivery routing that generates zone-based stop sequences. Handles asymmetric travel times from one-way streets and congestion.

entry.title: Segmentation-Driven Monocular Shape from Polarization based on Physical Model

author.name: Jinyu Zhang, Xu Ma, Weili Chen, and Gonzalo R. Arce

entry.summary: Introduces segmentation-driven monocular shape-from-polarization framework that decomposes global shape recovery into local convex sub-region reconstructions. Uses polarization-aided adaptive region growing.

entry.title: MPM-LLM4DSE: Reaching the Pareto Frontier in HLS with Multimodal Learning and LLM-Driven Exploration

author.name: Lei Xu, Shanshan Wang, Chenglong Xiao

entry.summary: Combines multimodal prediction models with LLM-driven exploration for High-Level Synthesis design space exploration, using GNNs and language models together to predict quality of results metrics.

entry.title: Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Efficient Communication: Improved Algorithm and Lower bounds

author.name: Sifan Yang, Wenhao Yang, Wei Jiang and Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates distributed online convex optimization with compressed communication, providing improved regret bounds with better dependence on compression factor and network topology.

entry.title: Approximate equivariance via projection-based regularisation

author.name: Torben Berndt, Jan St\"uhmer

entry.summary: Introduces projection-based regularization for approximate equivariance in neural networks, avoiding costly data augmentation. Leverages orthogonal decomposition in function spaces for efficient handling of continuous symmetry groups like SO(3).

entry.title: From Rays to Projections: Better Inputs for Feed-Forward View Synthesis

author.name: Zirui Wu, Zeren Jiang, Martin R. Oswald, Jie Song

entry.summary: Proposes projective conditioning for feed-forward view synthesis, replacing Plücker ray maps with target-view projective cues. Transforms brittle geometric regression into stable image-to-image translation.

entry.title: SimuAgent: An LLM-Based Simulink Modeling Assistant Enhanced with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yanchang Liang, Xiaowei Zhao

entry.summary: SimuAgent is LLM-powered Simulink modeling agent using Python representation instead of XML. Proposes Reflection-GRPO (ReGRPO) combining GRPO with self-reflection for sparse reward tasks.

entry.title: Robust Reasoning as a Symmetry-Protected Topological Phase

author.name: Ilmo Sung

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework connecting LLM reasoning robustness to concepts from topological quantum computing, suggesting hallucinations result from 'symmetry breaking' and robust inference requires a topological phase. Introduces a 'Holonomic Network' claimed to show mass gap behavior.

entry.title: Online Action-Stacking Improves Reinforcement Learning Performance for Air Traffic Control

author.name: Ben Carvell, George De Ath, Eseoghene Benjamin, Richard Everson

entry.summary: Introduces online action-stacking, an inference-time wrapper that converts simple RL actions into realistic air traffic control compound clearances. Enables training on smaller action spaces while producing domain-appropriate commands.

entry.title: ArtCognition: A Multimodal AI Framework for Affective State Sensing from Visual and Kinematic Drawing Cues

author.name: Behrad Binaei-Haghighi, Nafiseh Sadat Sajadi, Mehrad Liviyan, Reyhane Akhavan Kharazi, Fatemeh Amirkhani, Behnam Bahrak

entry.summary: Introduces ArtCognition, a multimodal framework for automated psychological assessment from digital drawings. Fuses static visual features with dynamic kinematic cues and uses RAG for interpretation.

entry.title: From Preoperative CT to Postmastoidectomy Mesh Construction:1Mastoidectomy Shape Prediction for Cochlear Implant Surgery

author.name: Yike Zhang, Eduardo Davalos, Dingjie Su, Ange Lou, Jack Noble

entry.summary: Investigates self-supervised and weakly-supervised learning for predicting mastoidectomy shape in cochlear implant surgery without annotations. Proposes hybrid framework for preoperative planning.

entry.title: Data-Driven Terramechanics Approach Towards a Realistic Real-Time Simulator for Lunar Rovers

author.name: Jakob M. Kern, James M. Hurrell, Shreya Santra, Keisuke Takehana, Kentaro Uno, Kazuya Yoshida

entry.summary: Develops data-driven terramechanics models for lunar rover simulation using regression from experimental data. Combines high visual fidelity with realistic terrain interaction for mission planning.

entry.title: Discrete Fourier Transform-based Point Cloud Compression for Efficient SLAM in Featureless Terrain

author.name: Riku Suzuki, Ayumi Umemura, Shreya Santra, Kentaro Uno, Kazuya Yoshida

entry.summary: Proposes DFT-based point cloud compression for SLAM in featureless terrain. Converts elevation maps to frequency domain and removes high-frequency components for compression.

entry.title: SRU-Pix2Pix: A Fusion-Driven Generator Network for Medical Image Translation with Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Xihe Qiu, Yang Dai, Xiaoyu Tan, Sijia Li, Fenghao Sun, Lu Gan, and Liang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes SRU-Pix2Pix for medical image translation integrating SEResNet and U-Net++ in enhanced Pix2Pix framework. Targets MRI synthesis with limited training data.

entry.title: SOVABench: A Vehicle Surveillance Action Retrieval Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Oriol Rabasseda, Zenjie Li, Kamal Nasrollahi, and Sergio Escalera

entry.summary: Presents SOVABench, a surveillance video benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on vehicle action retrieval, testing cross-action discrimination and temporal direction understanding.

entry.title: Conversational AI for Rapid Scientific Prototyping: A Case Study on ESA's ELOPE Competition

author.name: Nils Einecke

entry.summary: Case study using ChatGPT for rapid prototyping in ESA's lunar lander trajectory estimation competition, achieving second place despite late entry. Demonstrates AI contribution to algorithmic reasoning.

entry.title: Stochastic Deep Learning: A Probabilistic Framework for Modeling Uncertainty in Structured Temporal Data

author.name: James Rice

entry.summary: Stochastic Latent Differential Inference (SLDI) framework integrates SDEs with deep generative models for uncertainty quantification. Embeds Itô SDE in VAE latent space for continuous-time temporal modeling.

entry.title: AI #150: While Claude Codes

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's weekly AI newsletter covering Claude Code's impact on workflows, ChatGPT Health, xAI and Anthropic funding rounds, Meta's Llama 4 benchmark concerns, and various AI developments.

entry.title: Survival Dynamics of Neural and Programmatic Policies in Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Anton Roupassov-Ruiz and Yiyang Zuo

entry.summary: Compares neural vs. programmatic policies in evolutionary RL using rigorous survival analysis. Provides first open-source reimplementation of classic 1992 ALife testbed with Kaplan-Meier curves and RMST metrics.

entry.title: Enhanced-FQL($\lambda$), an Efficient and Interpretable RL with novel Fuzzy Eligibility Traces and Segmented Experience Replay

author.name: Mohsen Jalaeian-Farimani

entry.summary: Proposes Enhanced-FQL(λ), a fuzzy reinforcement learning framework with fuzzified eligibility traces and segmented experience replay. Provides interpretable alternative to neural approaches with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Transitive Expert Error and Routing Problems in Complex AI Systems

author.name: Forest Mars

entry.summary: Introduces concept of Transitive Expert Error (TEE), where domain expertise creates systematic vulnerabilities at domain boundaries. Discusses implications for AI system design and routing.

entry.title: Using Large Language Models to Detect Socially Shared Regulation of Collaborative Learning

author.name: Jiayi Zhang, Conrad Borchers, Clayton Cohn, Namrata Srivastava, Caitlin Snyder, Siyuan Guo, Ashwin T S, Naveeduddin Mohammed, Haley Noh, Gautam Biswas

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to detect socially shared regulation of learning (SSRL) in collaborative computational modeling. Leverages LLM summarization for task-aware dialogue representations.

entry.title: SampoNLP: A Self-Referential Toolkit for Morphological Analysis of Subword Tokenizers

author.name: Iaroslav Chelombitko, Ekaterina Chelombitko, Aleksey Komissarov

entry.summary: Introduces SampoNLP, a corpus-free toolkit for morphological lexicon creation using Self-Referential Atomicity Scoring. Evaluates BPE tokenizers for Finnish, Hungarian, and Estonian with proposed IPS metric.

entry.title: Density Matrix RNN (DM-RNN): A Quantum Information Theoretic Framework for Modeling Musical Context and Polyphony

author.name: Joonwon Seo, Mariana Montiel

entry.title: Flexible Manufacturing Systems Intralogistics: Dynamic Optimization of AGVs and Tool Sharing Using Coloured-Timed Petri Nets and Actor-Critic RL with Actions Masking

author.name: Sofiene Lassoued, Laxmikant Shrikant Bahetic, Nathalie Wei{\ss}-Borkowskib, Stefan Lierc, Andreas Schwunga

entry.summary: Combines Colored-Timed Petri Nets with actor-critic RL for flexible manufacturing optimization, integrating AGVs and tool-sharing systems with dynamic action masking.

entry.title: HMVI: Unifying Heterogeneous Attributes with Natural Neighbors for Missing Value Inference

author.name: Xiaopeng Luo, Zexi Tan, Zhuowei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes unified missing value imputation approach that models cross-type feature dependencies between numerical and categorical attributes using natural neighbors.

entry.title: Metasql: A Generate-then-Rank Framework for Natural Language to SQL Translation

author.name: Yuankai Fan, Zhenying He, Tonghui Ren, Can Huang, Yinan Jing, Kai Zhang, X.Sean Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Metasql, a generate-then-rank framework that improves NL-to-SQL translation by generating multiple candidate queries and ranking them, rather than relying on single auto-regressive decoding. This addresses sub-optimal outputs from existing methods.

entry.title: SkeletonX: Data-Efficient Skeleton-based Action Recognition via Cross-sample Feature Aggregation

author.name: Zongye Zhang, Wenrui Cai, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SkeletonX for skeleton-based action recognition in one-shot and limited-data settings by leveraging cross-sample feature aggregation. Addresses the challenge of adapting models to new scenarios with minimal data.

entry.title: Policy to Assist Iteratively Local Segmentation: Optimising Modality and Location Selection for Prostate Cancer Localisation

author.name: Xiangcen Wu, Shaheer U. Saeed, Yipei Wang, Ester Bonmati Coll, Yipeng Hu

entry.summary: Develops a reinforcement learning policy network that recommends optimal imaging modality and region selection to maximize prostate cancer segmentation performance, mimicking how radiologists combine different image types.

entry.title: Control of dynamical systems with neural networks

author.name: Lucas B\"ottcher

entry.summary: Examines using neural networks and automatic differentiation for control problems across discrete/continuous-time and deterministic/stochastic systems. Highlights applications in biology, engineering, physics, and medicine.

entry.title: Listen to Rhythm, Choose Movements: Autoregressive Multimodal Dance Generation via Diffusion and Mamba with Decoupled Dance Dataset

author.name: Oran Duan, Yinghua Shen, Yingzhu Lv, Luyang Jie, Yaxin Liu and Qiong Wu

entry.title: Generative Teaching via Code

author.name: Yuheng Wang, Runde Yang, Lin Wu, Jie Zhang, Jingru Fan, Ruoyu Fu, Tianle Zhou, Huatao Li, Siheng Chen, Weinan E, Chen Qian

entry.title: Leveraging Language Models and RAG for Efficient Knowledge Discovery in Clinical Environments

author.name: Seokhwan Ko, Donghyeon Lee, Jaewoo Chun, Hyungsoo Han, Junghwan Cho

entry.summary: Develops a local RAG system for research collaborator recommendation using PubMedBERT embeddings and locally deployed LLaMA3. Designed for hospital environments with strict privacy requirements.

entry.title: Active Sensing Shapes Real-World Decision-Making through Dynamic Evidence Accumulation

author.name: Hongliang Lu, Yunmeng Liu, Junjie Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a cognitive scheme formalizing real-world evidence affordance and captures active sensing through eye movements in driving scenarios. Generalizes evidence accumulation modeling to real-world decision-making.

entry.title: AgentTutor: Empowering Personalized Learning with Multi-Turn Interactive Teaching in Intelligent Education Systems

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Zeqing Song, Jiong Lou, Chentao Wu, Jie Li

entry.summary: Introduces AgentTutor, a multi-turn interactive intelligent education system with LLM-powered multi-agent system and learner-specific profiles that dynamically optimize teaching strategies.

author.name: Thijs Snelleman, Peter Lundestad Lawrence, Holger H. Hoos, Odd Erik Gundersen

entry.summary: Proposes a generalizable problem statement for automated reproducibility based on extracting hypotheses, experiments, and interpretations from publications. Tests whether scientific method structure can be automatically extracted.

author.name: Yujiao Jiang, Qingmin Liao, Zongqing Lu

entry.title: Integrating Multi-Agent Simulation, Behavioral Forensics, and Trust-Aware Machine Learning for Adaptive Insider Threat Detection

author.name: Firdous Kausar, Asmah Muallem, Naw Safrin Sattar, Mohamed Zakaria Kurdi

entry.summary: Presents hybrid framework for insider threat detection integrating multi-agent simulation, SIEM correlation, behavioral forensics, trust-aware ML, and Theory-of-Mind reasoning.

entry.title: Fuzzy Representation of Norms

author.name: Ziba Assadi and Paola Inverardi

entry.summary: Proposes fuzzy logic representation of SLEEC ethical rules using test-score semantics. Enables embedding ethical requirements in autonomous systems while handling linguistic hedges.

entry.title: Using Grok to Avoid Personal Attacks While Correcting Misinformation on X

author.name: Kevin Matthe Caramancion

entry.summary: Observational study finding Grok-mediated misinformation corrections receive no ad hominem attacks compared to 72% for direct human corrections on X. Suggests AI intermediation reduces hostility.

entry.title: Cross-Language Speaker Attribute Prediction Using MIL and RL

author.name: Sunny Shu, Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari, Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag

entry.summary: Proposes RLMIL-DAT for multilingual speaker attribute prediction combining RL-based instance selection with domain adversarial training. Evaluated on 5-language and 40-language corpora.

author.name: Yongyi Zang, Jiarui Hai, Wanying Ge, Qiuqiang Kong, Zheqi Dai, Helin Wang, Yuki Mitsufuji, Mark D. Plumbley

entry.title: In-SRAM Radiant Foam Rendering on a Graph Processor

author.name: Zulkhuu Tuya, Ignacio Alzugaray, Nicholas Fry, Andrew J. Davison

entry.title: LLM-Guided Lifecycle-Aware Clustering of Multi-Turn Customer Support Conversations

author.name: Priyaranjan Pattnayak, Sanchari Chowdhuri, Amit Agarwal, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel

entry.title: Interpreting Transformers Through Attention Head Intervention

author.name: Mason Kadem, Rong Zheng

entry.summary: Presents work on mechanistic interpretability through attention head intervention in transformers. Brief abstract focusing on understanding decision-making mechanisms.

entry.title: Distribution-Guided and Constrained Quantum Machine Unlearning

author.name: Nausherwan Malik and Zubair Khalid and Muhammad Faryad

entry.summary: Proposes distribution-guided framework for quantum machine unlearning as constrained optimization. Introduces tunable target distributions and anchor-based preservation constraints.

entry.title: SpectraFormer: an Attention-Based Raman Unmixing Tool for Accessing the Graphene Buffer-Layer Signature on SiC

author.name: Dmitriy Poteryayev, Pietro Novelli, Annalisa Coriolano, Riccardo Dettori, Valentina Tozzini, Fabio Beltram, Massimiliano Pontil, Antonio Rossi, Stiven Forti, Camilla Coletti

author.name: Israt Jahan Chowdhury and Md Abu Yousuf Tanvir

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of poorly calibrated ML confidence scores in security alert systems. Proposes aligning model outputs with analyst decision requirements by accounting for asymmetric costs of false alarms vs missed attacks.

author.name: Jingyi Wang and Fanggang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an active learning approach for specific emitter identification combining self-supervised contrastive pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and active sample selection with uncertainty and diversity criteria.

entry.title: FaceRefiner: High-Fidelity Facial Texture Refinement with Differentiable Rendering-based Style Transfer

author.name: Chengyang Li, Baoping Cheng, Yao Cheng, Haocheng Zhang, Renshuai Liu, Yinglin Zheng, Jing Liao, Xuan Cheng

entry.title: Evaluating Human and Machine Confidence in Phishing Email Detection: A Comparative Study

author.name: Paras Jain, Khushi Dhar, Olyemi E. Amujo, Esa M. Rantanen

entry.summary: Compares human and ML model confidence in phishing email detection. Finds ML models show variable confidence while humans use more diverse linguistic signals.

entry.title: Model of Spatial Human-Agent Interaction with Consideration for Others

author.name: Takafumi Sakamoto and Yugo Takeuchi

entry.summary: Constructs a computational model for spatial human-robot interaction that quantifies 'consideration for others' as a parameter adjusting internal states. Validated through VR experiments showing how robot consideration affects human movement behavior.

entry.title: Detector-Augmented SAMURAI for Long-Duration Drone Tracking

author.name: Tamara R. Lenhard, Andreas Weinmann, Hichem Snoussi, Tobias Koch

entry.summary: Evaluates and augments the SAMURAI foundation model for long-term drone tracking in surveillance contexts, combining detector-based approaches with foundation model tracking. First systematic study of SAMURAI for drone-specific scenarios.

entry.title: FibreCastML: An Open Web Platform for Predicting Electrospun Nanofibre Diameter Distributions

entry.summary: Introduces FibreCastML, an ML framework predicting complete nanofiber diameter distributions from electrospinning parameters, trained on 68k measurements from 1778 studies across 16 polymers.

entry.title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Approximate $k$-Coloring with Recursive Warm Starts

author.name: Knut Vanderbush, Melanie Weber

entry.summary: Applies neural algorithmic reasoning with recursive warm starts to approximate k-coloring graph problem. Combines GNN-based prediction with classical combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: EARL: Energy-Aware Optimization of Liquid State Machines for Pervasive AI

author.name: Zain Iqbal, Lorenzo Valerio

entry.summary: EARL optimizes Liquid State Machines for energy-aware pervasive AI using reinforcement learning with Bayesian optimization. Jointly optimizes accuracy and energy consumption.

entry.title: RL-AWB: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Auto White Balance Correction in Low-Light Night-time Scenes

author.name: Yuan-Kang Lee, Kuan-Lin Chen, Chia-Che Chang, Yu-Lun Liu

entry.summary: RL-AWB combines statistical methods with deep reinforcement learning for nighttime auto white balance, mimicking professional AWB tuning by dynamically optimizing parameters. Introduces first multi-sensor nighttime dataset.

entry.title: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent System Driven by LLMs for Meal-Level Personalized Nutrition Management

author.name: Muqing Xu

entry.summary: Presents a mobile nutrition assistant using LLM-driven multi-agent architecture for meal-level dietary guidance. Combines image-based food logging with nutrient estimation and personalized meal planning.

entry.title: Personalized Model-Based Design of Human Centric AI enabled CPS for Long term usage

author.name: Bernard Ngabonziza, Ayan Banerjee, Sandeep K.S. Gupta

entry.summary: Discusses personalized model-based design for AI-enabled human-centric cyber-physical systems addressing long-term operation challenges including corner cases and uncertainty.

entry.title: Improving Semi-Supervised Contrastive Learning via Entropy-Weighted Confidence Integration of Anchor-Positive Pairs

author.name: Shogo Nakayama, Masahiro Okuda

entry.summary: Proposes entropy-weighted confidence integration for semi-supervised contrastive learning. Uses prediction entropy to weight samples including those previously excluded from training.

entry.title: Detection of Deployment Operational Deviations for Safety and Security of AI-Enabled Human-Centric Cyber Physical Systems

author.name: Bernard Ngabonziza, Ayan Banerjee, Sandeep K.S. Gupta

entry.summary: Addresses detection of deployment deviations in AI-enabled human-centric cyber-physical systems. Focuses on identifying uncertain operational conditions that violate system protocols.

entry.title: Breaking Robustness Barriers in Cognitive Diagnosis: A One-Shot Neural Architecture Search Perspective

author.name: Ziwen Wang, Shangshang Yang, Xiaoshan Yu, Haiping Ma, Xingyi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes neural architecture search for cognitive diagnosis models to improve robustness against noise in educational data, addressing deployment challenges from response data contamination.

entry.title: CurricuLLM: Designing Personalized and Workforce-Aligned Cybersecurity Curricula Using Fine-Tuned LLMs

author.name: Arthur Nijdam, Harri K\"ahk\"onen, Valtteri Niemi, Paul Stankovski Wagner, Sara Ramezanian

entry.summary: Presents CurricuLLM, an LLM-based framework for automated cybersecurity curriculum design aligned with industry demands, using fine-tuned models for personalized education.

entry.title: Multi-Disciplinary Dataset Discovery from Citation-Verified Literature Contexts

author.name: Zhiyin Tan and Changxu Duan

entry.summary: Literature-driven framework for dataset discovery using citation contexts rather than metadata. Combines LLM-based dataset recognition with entity resolution, achieving higher recall than Google Dataset Search.

entry.title: What Students Ask, How a Generative AI Assistant Responds: Exploring Higher Education Students' Dialogues on Learning Analytics Feedback

author.name: Yildiz Uzun, Andrea Gauthier and Mutlu Cukurova

entry.summary: Explores how students interact with GenAI assistants for learning analytics feedback, analyzing dialogue patterns across different self-regulated learning levels over 10 weeks.

entry.title: Convenience vs. Control: A Qualitative Study of Youth Privacy with Smart Voice Assistants

author.name: Molly Campbell, Trevor De Clark, Mohamad Sheikho Al Jasem, Sandhya Joshi and Ajay Kumar Shrestha

entry.summary: Qualitative focus group study with 26 young Canadians on smart voice assistant privacy. Finds policy overload and fragmented settings undermine self-efficacy; simple transparency cues improve confidence.

entry.title: Prediction of Cellular Malignancy Using Electrical Impedance Signatures and Supervised Machine Learning

author.name: Shadeeb Hossain

entry.summary: Evaluates machine learning algorithms (Random Forest, SVM, KNN) for classifying malignant vs healthy cells using bioelectrical properties like permittivity and conductivity. Demonstrates the potential of electrical impedance signatures for cancer diagnostics.

entry.title: Integrating Distribution Matching into Semi-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Labeled and Unlabeled Data

author.name: Shogo Nakayama, Masahiro Okuda

entry.summary: Proposes enhancing semi-supervised contrastive learning by incorporating distribution matching between labeled and unlabeled feature embeddings to improve pseudo-label-based classification.

entry.title: Design and Development of Modular Limbs for Reconfigurable Robots on the Moon

author.name: Gustavo H. Diaz, A. Sejal Jain, Matteo Brugnera, Elian Neppel, Shreya Santra, Kentaro Uno, Kazuya Yoshida

entry.summary: Presents modular 4-DOF robot limbs designed for reconfigurable lunar robots. Uses common high torque-to-speed actuators across module types for flexibility in space exploration.

entry.title: Optimizing Path Planning using Deep Reinforcement Learning for UGVs in Precision Agriculture

author.name: Laukik Patade and Rohan Rane and Sandeep Pillai

entry.summary: Applies deep reinforcement learning (DQN, DDPG, TD3) to path planning for agricultural unmanned ground vehicles, comparing against traditional algorithms like A* and Dijkstra in continuous action spaces.

entry.title: APEX: Academic Poster Editing Agentic Expert

author.name: Chengxin Shi, Qinnan Cai, Zeyuan Chen, Long Zeng, Yibo Zhao, Jing Yu, Jianxiang Yu, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces APEX, an agentic framework for interactive academic poster editing with multi-level API-based editing and a review-adjustment mechanism. Also releases APEX-Bench with 514 editing instructions for evaluation.

entry.title: From Stories to Cities to Games: A Qualitative Evaluation of Behaviour Planning

author.name: Mustafa F. Abdelwahed, Joan Espasa, Alice Toniolo, Ian P. Gent

entry.summary: Demonstrates behaviour planning usefulness through three case studies: storytelling, urban planning, and game evaluation, showing practical applications of diverse planning approaches.

entry.title: Exponential capacity scaling of classical GANs compared to hybrid latent style-based quantum GANs

author.name: Milan Liepelt and Julien Baglio

entry.summary: Provides first systematic comparison of quantum GANs vs classical GANs for image generation, examining parameter efficiency claims. Analyzes capacity scaling of latent style-based quantum GANs against classical counterparts.

entry.title: Advanced Multimodal Learning for Seizure Detection and Prediction: Concept, Challenges, and Future Directions

author.name: Ijaz Ahmad, Faizan Ahmad, Sunday Timothy Aboyeji, Yongtao Zhang, Peng Yang, Rab Nawaz, Baiying Lei

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on multimodal learning for epileptic seizure detection and prediction. Covers challenges of EEG-based approaches and evolution across technological eras.

entry.title: QNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields on a Simulated Gate-Based Quantum Computer

author.name: Daniele Lizzio Bosco and Shuteng Wang and Giuseppe Serra and Vladislav Golyanik

entry.title: SeisRDT: Latent Diffusion Model Based On Representation Learning For Seismic Data Interpolation And Reconstruction

entry.title: Research Summary: January 08, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
The OpenAI GPT-5 System Card dominates today's releases, detailing the unified architecture with dynamic routing between fast and deep reasoning modes. A remarkable autoformalization result shows 130k lines of formal topology generated in two weeks for ~$100, suggesting accessible mathematical formalization at scale.

Safety and alignment research features prominently:

  • What Matters For Safety Alignment delivers the field's most comprehensive study: 32 models, 56 jailbreak techniques, 4.6M API calls
  • Jailbreak-Zero shifts red teaming from example-based to policy-based evaluation
  • RAILS demonstrates black-box attacks matching gradient-based effectiveness using only logits

Theoretical and interpretability advances challenge key assumptions:

  • QZero achieves AlphaGo-level Go play without MCTS, using pure model-free RL
  • First unified MoE theory derives Top-k routing and load balancing from variational inference principles
  • Layer-Order Inversion reveals later-hop answers become decodable before bridge entities, contradicting hop-aligned circuit hypotheses
  • Spectral Archaeology discovers 'spectral scars' revealing hidden training behaviors without additional training

Wang, Yushi Wang, Yutian Liu, Zach Stubenvoll, Zehao Dou, Zheng Wu, Zhigang Wang

entry.summary: Official system card for OpenAI GPT-5 launch (August 2025), describing a unified system with fast and deep reasoning models, real-time router for complexity-based model selection, and continuous training on user feedback signals.

entry.title: 130k Lines of Formal Topology in Two Weeks: Simple and Cheap Autoformalization for Everyone?

author.name: Josef Urban

entry.summary: Reports autoformalization of 130k lines of topology from Munkres textbook in two weeks for ~$100 LLM cost, including proofs of Urysohn's lemma and metrization theorem, using LLM-proof checker feedback loop.

entry.title: Jailbreak-Zero: A Path to Pareto Optimal Red Teaming for Large Language Models

author.name: Kai Hu, Abhinav Aggarwal, Mehran Khodabandeh, David Zhang, Eric Hsin, Li Chen, Ankit Jain, Matt Fredrikson, Akash Bharadwaj

entry.summary: Introduces Jailbreak-Zero, a red teaming methodology shifting from example-based to policy-based LLM safety evaluation. Uses attack LLM fine-tuned with preference data to achieve Pareto optimality across coverage, diversity, and fidelity, showing high success rates against GPT-4o and Claude 3.5.

entry.title: Mastering the Game of Go with Self-play Experience Replay

author.name: Jingbin Liu and Xuechun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces QZero, a model-free RL algorithm for Go that learns Nash equilibrium policy through self-play and experience replay without MCTS, achieving AlphaGo-level performance with modest compute (7 GPUs, 5 months).

entry.title: What Matters For Safety Alignment?

author.name: Xing Li, Hui-Ling Zhen, Lihao Yin, Xianzhi Yu, Zhenhua Dong, Mingxuan Yuan

entry.summary: Comprehensive empirical study on safety alignment evaluating 32 LLMs/LRMs across 13 families using 5 safety datasets, 56 jailbreak techniques, and 4 CoT attack strategies totaling 4.6M API calls.

entry.title: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet: Lessons from Four Autonomous Research Attempts

author.name: Dhruv Trehan, Paras Chopra

entry.summary: Documents four attempts at autonomous ML research paper generation using LLM agent pipeline, with one acceptance at Agents4Science 2025. Identifies six failure modes including bias toward defaults, implementation drift, and weak scientific taste.

entry.title: Jailbreaking LLMs Without Gradients or Priors: Effective and Transferable Attacks

author.name: Zhakshylyk Nurlanov, Frank R. Schmidt, Florian Bernard

entry.summary: Introduces RAILS, a black-box jailbreaking framework operating solely on model logits without gradients or handcrafted priors. Matches gradient-based methods through auto-regressive loss for exact prefix matching and history-aware local search.

entry.title: Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization for Efficient LLM Fine-tuning

author.name: Yu Luo, Shuo Han, Yihan Hu, Dong Li, Jianye Hao

entry.summary: Proposes ratio-variance regularization for LLM fine-tuning that constrains policy ratio variance instead of hard clipping, addressing PPO/GRPO's suppression of high-reward divergent actions and improving sample efficiency.

entry.title: GAMBIT: A Gamified Jailbreak Framework for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xiangdong Hu, Yangyang Jiang, Qin Hu, Xiaojun Jia

entry.summary: Introduces GAMBIT, a gamified jailbreak framework for multimodal LLMs that leverages model reasoning incentives through game-like scenarios. Shows improved effectiveness on reasoning models compared to existing attacks.

entry.title: STAR-S: Improving Safety Alignment through Self-Taught Reasoning on Safety Rules

author.name: Di Wu, Yanyan Zhao, Xin Lu, Mingzhe Li, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes STAR-S, a self-taught framework for improving LLM safety by learning to reason over safety rules. The approach creates a synergistic loop where models elicit reasoning guided by safety rules, then fine-tune to enhance safety reasoning.

entry.title: RedBench: A Universal Dataset for Comprehensive Red Teaming of Large Language Models

author.name: Quy-Anh Dang, Chris Ngo, Truong-Son Hy

entry.summary: Introduces RedBench, a universal red teaming dataset aggregating 37 benchmark datasets with 29,362 samples across 22 risk categories and 19 domains for systematic LLM vulnerability assessment. Provides standardized taxonomy and baselines for modern LLMs.

entry.title: Controllable LLM Reasoning via Sparse Autoencoder-Based Steering

author.name: Yi Fang, Wenjie Wang, Mingfeng Xue, Boyi Deng, Fengli Xu, Dayiheng Liu, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Uses Sparse Autoencoders to decompose strategy-entangled hidden states in Large Reasoning Models for controllable reasoning. Enables fine-grained control over cognitive strategies like backtracking and cross-verification.

entry.title: Spectral Archaeology: The Causal Topology of Model Evolution

author.name: Valentin No\"el

entry.summary: Introduces training-free mechanistic probes using attention-graph spectra to analyze model evolution. Discovers 'spectral scars' like Passive-Triggered Connectivity Collapse (PTCC) from curriculum transitions that standard evaluation misses.

entry.title: Variational Inference, Entropy, and Orthogonality: A Unified Theory of Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Ye Su and Yong Liu

entry.summary: Provides the first unified theoretical framework for Mixture-of-Experts, deriving Top-k routing and load balancing from Bayesian and information-theoretic perspectives. Proves routing is NP-hard and establishes existence of representation concentration.

entry.title: GuardEval: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Evaluating Safety, Fairness, and Robustness in LLM Moderators

author.name: Naseem Machlovi, Maryam Saleki, Ruhul Amin, Mohamed Rahouti, Shawqi Al-Maliki, Junaid Qadir, Mohamed M. Abdallah, Ala Al-Fuqaha

entry.summary: Introduces GuardEval, a multi-perspective benchmark with 106 fine-grained categories for evaluating LLM moderators on safety, fairness, and robustness, addressing nuanced cases like implicit offensiveness and jailbreaks.

entry.title: How Real is Your Jailbreak? Fine-grained Jailbreak Evaluation with Anchored Reference

author.name: Songyang Liu and Chaozhuo Li and Rui Pu and Litian Zhang and Chenxu Wang and Zejian Chen and Yuting Zhang and Yiming Hei

entry.summary: Proposes FJAR, a fine-grained jailbreak evaluation framework categorizing responses into five types (Rejective, Irrelevant, Unhelpful, Incorrect, Successful) with novel harmless tree decomposition for anchored references.

entry.title: SIGMA: Scalable Spectral Insights for LLM Collapse

author.name: Yi Gu, Lingyou Pang, Xiangkun Ye, Tianyu Wang, Jianyu Lin, Carey E. Priebe, Alexander Aue

entry.summary: Introduces SIGMA, a framework using spectral analysis of embedding Gram matrices to detect and quantify model collapse in LLMs trained on synthetic data, providing bounds on spectrum contraction.

entry.title: Rendering Data Unlearnable by Exploiting LLM Alignment Mechanisms

author.name: Ruihan Zhang and Jun Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Disclaimer Injection, a data-level defense that makes text unlearnable to LLMs by exploiting alignment mechanisms. Shows that fine-tuning on protected data induces persistent activation of alignment-related layers, causing alignment spillover effects.

entry.title: Layer-Order Inversion: Rethinking Latent Multi-Hop Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Xukai Liu, Ye Liu, Jipeng Zhang, Yanghai Zhang, Kai Zhang, Qi Liu

entry.summary: Challenges the 'hop-aligned circuit hypothesis' in multi-hop reasoning, showing that later-hop answers can become decodable earlier than bridge entities ('layer-order inversion'). Proposes a probabilistic recall-and-extract framework explaining this behavior.

entry.title: PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Wenlong Huang, Yu-Wei Chao, Arsalan Mousavian, Ming-Yu Liu, Dieter Fox, Kaichun Mo, Li Fei-Fei

entry.summary: Introduces PointWorld, a large pre-trained 3D world model representing state and action as 3D point flows. Trained on large-scale dataset spanning real and simulated robotics to forecast per-pixel 3D displacements.

entry.title: TRYLOCK: Defense-in-Depth Against LLM Jailbreaks via Layered Preference and Representation Engineering

author.name: Scott Thornton

entry.summary: Presents TRYLOCK, a defense-in-depth architecture against jailbreaks combining DPO alignment, Representation Engineering steering, adaptive classifier, and input canonicalization, achieving 88% attack success rate reduction on Mistral-7B.

entry.title: The Illusion of Specialization: Unveiling the Domain-Invariant "Standing Committee" in Mixture-of-Experts Models

author.name: Yan Wang, Yitao Xu, Nanhan Shen, Jinyan Su, Jimin Huang, Zining Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces COMMITTEEAUDIT framework analyzing MoE routing at expert group level. Discovers domain-invariant 'Standing Committee' - a compact expert coalition capturing majority of routing mass across domains, challenging specialization assumptions.

entry.title: Understanding Reward Hacking in Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yunqi Hong, Kuei-Chun Kao, Hengguang Zhou, Cho-Jui Hsieh

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes reward hacking in text-to-image RL post-training, examining how aesthetic and consistency rewards contribute to producing unrealistic high-reward images. Shows ensembling only partially mitigates issue.

entry.title: ALERT: Zero-shot LLM Jailbreak Detection via Internal Discrepancy Amplification

author.name: Xiao Lin, Philip Li, Zhichen Zeng, Tingwei Li, Tianxin Wei, Xuying Ning, Gaotang Li, Yuzhong Chen, Hanghang Tong

entry.summary: Proposes ALERT for zero-shot jailbreak detection by amplifying internal feature discrepancies between benign and jailbreak prompts. Uses layer-wise, module-wise, and token-wise amplification without requiring jailbreak templates.

entry.title: Training-Free Adaptation of New-Generation LLMs using Legacy Clinical Models

author.name: Sasha Ronaghi, Chloe Stanwyck, Asad Aali, Amir Ronaghi, Miguel Fuentes, Tina Hernandez-Boussard, Emily Alsentzer

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Architecture Proxy Tuning (CAPT) for training-free clinical domain adaptation by ensembling new general-domain models with older clinical models. Achieves +17.6% average improvement through contrastive decoding.

entry.title: Reasoning Pattern Alignment Merging for Adaptive Reasoning

author.name: Zhaofeng Zhong, Wei Yuan, Tong Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Hongzhi Yin

entry.summary: Proposes RPAM (Reasoning Pattern Alignment Merging), layer-wise model merging combining Long-CoT reasoning models with Short-CoT instruction models for adaptive reasoning without retraining.

entry.title: How Do Large Language Models Learn Concepts During Continual Pre-Training?

author.name: Barry Menglong Yao (1), Sha Li (2), Yunzhi Yao (3), Minqian Liu (2), Zaishuo Xia (1), Qifan Wang (4), Lifu Huang (1) ((1) UC Davis, (2) Virginia Tech, (3) UCLA, (4) Meta AI)

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs acquire, retain, and forget concepts during continual pretraining. Links behavioral dynamics to internal 'Concept Circuits' and finds these circuits provide statistically significant signals of concept learning and forgetting.

entry.title: How Does the Thinking Step Influence Model Safety? An Entropy-based Safety Reminder for LRMs

author.name: Su-Hyeon Kim, Hyundong Jin, Yejin Lee and Yo-Sub Han

entry.summary: Proposes SafeRemind, a decoding-time defense for Large Reasoning Models that injects safe-reminding phrases at entropy-triggered decision points during thinking steps. No parameter updates required.

entry.title: Anti-Length Shift: Dynamic Outlier Truncation for Training Efficient Reasoning Models

author.name: Wei Wu, Liyi Chen, Congxi Xiao, Tianfu Wang, Qimeng Wang, Chengqiang Lu, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, and Hui Xiong

entry.summary: DOT (Dynamic Outlier Truncation) identifies 'length shift' where reasoning models become excessively verbose on simple queries during training. Selectively suppresses redundant tokens to enable efficient reasoning without optimization conflicts.

entry.title: DeepResearch-Slice: Bridging the Retrieval-Utilization Gap via Explicit Text Slicing

author.name: Shuo Lu, Yinuo Xu, Jianjie Cheng, Lingxiao He, Meng Wang, Jian Liang

entry.summary: Proposes DeepResearch-Slice, a neuro-symbolic framework addressing the retrieval-utilization gap where models fail to use retrieved evidence due to context blindness. Uses explicit text slicing to filter noise before reasoning, achieving 73% relative improvement.

entry.title: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think

author.name: NAVER Cloud HyperCLOVA X Team

entry.summary: Presents HyperCLOVA X 32B Think, NAVER's vision-language model emphasizing Korean language/culture reasoning and agentic capabilities. Open-sourced to support broader research.

entry.title: Digital Red Queen: Adversarial Program Evolution in Core War with LLMs

author.name: Akarsh Kumar, Ryan Bahlous-Boldi, Prafull Sharma, Phillip Isola, Sebastian Risi, Yujin Tang, David Ha

entry.summary: Presents Digital Red Queen, a self-play algorithm using LLMs to evolve assembly programs competing in Core War, demonstrating open-ended adversarial dynamics where evolved programs outperform baselines.

entry.title: Metaphors are a Source of Cross-Domain Misalignment of Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Zhibo Hu, Chen Wang, Yanfeng Shu, Hye-young Paik, Liming Zhu

entry.summary: Investigates how metaphors in training data cause LLMs to generalize misaligned patterns from one domain to another. Demonstrates strong causal relationships between metaphorical content and cross-domain misalignment through interventions at pre-training, fine-tuning, and re-alignment phases.

entry.title: Implicit Graph, Explicit Retrieval: Towards Efficient and Interpretable Long-horizon Memory for Large Language Models

author.name: Xin Zhang, Kailai Yang, Hao Li, Chenyue Li, Qiyu Wei, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Proposes LatentGraphMem, combining implicit graph memory in latent space with explicit subgraph retrieval for long-horizon LLM applications. Enables interpretable reasoning while maintaining efficiency for sparse evidence across long contexts.

entry.title: Prompting Underestimates LLM Capability for Time Series Classification

author.name: Dan Schumacher, Erfan Nourbakhsh, Rocky Slavin and Anthony Rios

entry.summary: Demonstrates that prompting underestimates LLM capability for time series classification. Linear probes on internal representations achieve 0.61-0.67 F1 vs 0.15-0.26 for prompting, matching specialized models.

entry.title: A Quantifiable Information-Processing Hierarchy Provides a Necessary Condition for Detecting Agency

author.name: Brett J. Kagan, Valentina Baccetti, Brian D. Earp, J. Lomax Boyd, Julian Savulescu, Adeel Razi

entry.summary: Proposes bottom-up framework for detecting agency based on information-processing order. Identifies three classes: reactive (Class I), stateful (Class II), and adaptive (Class III) systems where transformation rules themselves change.

entry.title: Deploy-Master: Automating the Deployment of 50,000+ Agent-Ready Scientific Tools in One Day

author.name: Yi Wang, Zhenting Huang, Zhaohan Ding, Ruoxue Liao, Yuan Huang, Xinzijian Liu, Jiajun Xie, Siheng Chen, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Deploy-Master, agentic workflow that discovered and deployed 52,550 scientific tools across 90+ domains in one day. Creates build specifications, validates execution, and publishes for AI4S workflows.

entry.title: VeRPO: Verifiable Dense Reward Policy Optimization for Code Generation

author.name: Longwen Wang, Xuan'er Wu, Xiaohui Hu, Yirui Liu, Yuankai Fan, Kaidong Yu, Qizhen Weng, Wei Xi, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces VeRPO for code generation RL using dense rewards from weighted partial success based on execution feedback. Constructs verifiable rewards without external reward models.

entry.title: ReEfBench: Quantifying the Reasoning Efficiency of LLMs

author.name: Zhizhang Fu, Yuancheng Gu, Chenkai Hu, Hanmeng Liu, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ReEfBench for evaluating reasoning efficiency in LLMs using a neuro-symbolic framework. Identifies four behavioral prototypes and reveals that extended token generation is not prerequisite for deep reasoning. Shows critical constraints in mixing long/short CoT data.

entry.title: Reasoning Model Is Superior LLM-Judge, Yet Suffers from Biases

author.name: Hui Huang, Xuanxin Wu, Muyun Yang, Yuki Arase

entry.summary: Presents first systematic comparison showing Large Reasoning Models outperform non-reasoning LLMs as judges, especially on reasoning tasks. However, LRMs still exhibit superficial quality biases. Proposes PlanJudge to mitigate biases.

entry.title: TreeAdv: Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL

author.name: Lang Cao, Hui Ruan, Yongqian Li, Peng Chao, Wu Ning, Haonan Song, Renhong Chen, Yitong Li

entry.summary: Introduces TreeAdv, which addresses GRPO's limitation of treating rollouts as flat sequences by making tree structure explicit for exploration and advantage assignment. Uses entropy-driven sampling where trees branch at high-uncertainty points.

entry.title: HearSay Benchmark: Do Audio LLMs Leak What They Hear?

author.name: Jin Wang, Liang Lin, Kaiwen Luo, Weiliu Wang, Yitian Chen, Moayad Aloqaily, Xuehai Tang, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Li Sun, Qingsong Wen

entry.summary: Introduces HearSay benchmark (22,000+ audio clips) investigating privacy leakage in Audio LLMs through voiceprints. Finds significant privacy leakage including inherent PII extraction from voice alone.

entry.title: Doc-PP: Document Policy Preservation Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haeun Jang, Hwan Chang, Hwanhee Lee

entry.summary: Doc-PP benchmark evaluates Large Vision-Language Models on document policy preservation under non-disclosure constraints. Identifies 'Reasoning-Induced Safety Gap' where models leak sensitive information when answers require inference.

entry.title: Agent Drift: Quantifying Behavioral Degradation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems Over Extended Interactions

author.name: Abhishek Rath

entry.summary: Introduces 'agent drift' concept for behavioral degradation in multi-agent LLM systems over time. Proposes Agent Stability Index (ASI) metric and identifies semantic, coordination, and behavioral drift types.

entry.title: SDCD: Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yuxuan Xia, Siheng Wang, Peng Li

entry.summary: Introduces SDCD (Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding), a training-free method to mitigate LVLM hallucinations. Identifies visual statistical bias from Bag-of-Patches behavior causing spurious visual confidence.

entry.title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents

author.name: Yuanchen Bei, Tianxin Wei, Xuying Ning, Yanjun Zhao, Zhining Liu, Xiao Lin, Yada Zhu, Hendrik Hamann, Jingrui He, Hanghang Tong

entry.summary: Introduces Mem-Gallery benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents. Features multi-session conversations with visual and textual dependencies across long interaction horizons.

entry.title: Locomotion Beyond Feet

author.name: Tae Hoon Yang, Haochen Shi, Jiacheng Hu, Zhicong Zhang, Daniel Jiang, Weizhuo Wang, Yao He, Zhen Wu, Yuming Chen, Yifan Hou, Monroe Kennedy III, Shuran Song, C. Karen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces comprehensive system for whole-body humanoid locomotion across challenging terrains requiring hands, knees, and elbows. Combines physics-grounded keyframe animation with reinforcement learning for locomotion beyond feet.

entry.title: SyncThink: A Training-Free Strategy to Align Inference Termination with Reasoning Saturation

author.name: Gengyang Li, Wang Cai, Yifeng Gao, Yunfang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SyncThink, a training-free decoding method that monitors reasoning-transition signals to terminate CoT early. Achieves 62% accuracy with 656 tokens vs 61% with 2141 tokens for full CoT.

entry.title: Towards Compositional Generalization of LLMs via Skill Taxonomy Guided Data Synthesis

author.name: Yifan Wei, Li Du, Xiaoyan Yu, Yang Feng, Angsheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes STEPS framework for generating compositionally challenging data using skill taxonomy. Uses structural information theory to organize skills hierarchically and information maximization for data synthesis.

entry.title: Benchmark^2: Systematic Evaluation of LLM Benchmarks

author.name: Qi Qian, Chengsong Huang, Jingwen Xu, Changze Lv, Muling Wu, Wenhao Liu, Xiaohua Wang, Zhenghua Wang, Zisu Huang, Muzhao Tian, Jianhan Xu, Kun Hu, He-Da Wang, Yao Hu, Xuanjing Huang, Xiaoqing Zheng

entry.summary: Benchmark² proposes a meta-evaluation framework for LLM benchmarks using three metrics: cross-benchmark ranking consistency, discriminability, and capability alignment deviation. Evaluates 15 benchmarks across 11 models.

entry.title: SearchAttack: Red-Teaming LLMs against Real-World Threats via Framing Unsafe Web Information-Seeking Tasks

author.name: Yu Yan, Sheng Sun, Mingfeng Li, Zheming Yang, Chiwei Zhu, Fei Ma, Benfeng Xu, Min Liu

entry.summary: SearchAttack identifies web search as a critical attack surface for LLMs, outsourcing harmful semantics to search queries while retaining only skeletal structure. Demonstrates how retrieved content can bypass LLM safeguards.

entry.title: Benchmarking and Adapting On-Device Large Language Models for Clinical Decision Support

author.name: Alif Munim, Jun Ma, Omar Ibrahim, Alhusain Abdalla, Shuolin Yin, Leo Chen, and Bo Wang

entry.summary: Benchmarks on-device LLMs (gpt-oss-20b, gpt-oss-120b) against GPT-5 and o4-mini on clinical decision tasks including diagnosis and expert grading simulation, evaluating adaptability for resource-constrained medical settings.

entry.title: MMErroR: A Benchmark for Erroneous Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yang Shi, Yifeng Xie, Minzhe Guo, Liangsi Lu, Mingxuan Huang, Jingchao Wang, Zhihong Zhu, Boyan Xu, Zhiqi Huang

entry.summary: Introduces MMErroR, a benchmark of 2,013 samples for evaluating VLM ability to detect erroneous reasoning and classify error types across 24 subdomains, finding even best models struggle with process-level error detection.

entry.title: Grading Scale Impact on LLM-as-a-Judge: Human-LLM Alignment Is Highest on 0-5 Grading Scale

author.name: Weiyue Li, Minda Zhao, Weixuan Dong, Jiahui Cai, Yuze Wei, Michael Pocress, Yi Li, Wanyan Yuan, Xiaoyue Wang, Ruoyu Hou, Kaiyuan Lou, Wenqi Zeng, Yutong Yang, Yilun Du, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Studies impact of grading scale on LLM-as-judge performance across six benchmarks. Finds 0-5 scale produces highest human-LLM agreement even when within-group reliability is high, identifying optimal scale for evaluation.

entry.title: FROST-Drive: Scalable and Efficient End-to-End Driving with a Frozen Vision Encoder

author.name: Zeyu Dong, Yimin Zhu, Yu Wu, Yu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes FROST-Drive for autonomous driving with frozen VLM vision encoder, challenging the necessity of full fine-tuning. Preserves generalization capabilities from pretrained VLM by direct transfer.

entry.title: Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales

author.name: Francielle Vargas and Jackson Trager and Diego Alves and Surendrabikram Thapa and Matteo Guida and Berk Atil and Daryna Dementieva and Andrew Smart and Ameeta Agrawal

entry.summary: Proposes SMRA (Supervised Moral Rationale Attention), first self-explaining hate speech detection framework using moral rationales from Moral Foundations Theory for attention alignment. Creates supporting dataset.

entry.title: Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks

author.name: Haochen Shi, Xingdi Yuan, Bang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Programmatic Skill Network (PSN) for continual skill acquisition where skills are executable symbolic programs forming compositional networks. Uses LLMs for fault localization, progressive optimization, and structural refactoring.

entry.title: DiffCoT: Diffusion-styled Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Shidong Cao, Hongzhan Lin, Yuxuan Gu, Ziyang Luo, Jing Ma

entry.summary: Proposes DiffCoT, which reformulates Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an iterative denoising process inspired by diffusion models. Uses sliding-window mechanism for unified generation and retrospective correction while maintaining causal consistency.

entry.title: e5-omni: Explicit Cross-modal Alignment for Omni-modal Embeddings

author.name: Haonan Chen, Sicheng Gao, Radu Timofte, Tetsuya Sakai, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: Proposes e5-omni for omni-modal embeddings with explicit cross-modal alignment addressing modality-dependent similarity sharpness and embedding drift. Uses calibrated contrastive learning across modalities.

entry.title: R$^3$L: Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification

author.name: Weijie Shi, Yanxi Chen, Zexi Li, Xuchen Pan, Yuchang Sun, Jiajie Xu, Xiaofang Zhou, Yaliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes R³L (Reflect-then-Retry RL) addressing exploration and exploitation challenges in LLM reasoning. Uses language-guided exploration via reflection, pivotal credit assignment, and positive signal amplification.

entry.title: Step Potential Advantage Estimation: Harnessing Intermediate Confidence and Correctness for Efficient Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Fei Wu, Zhenrong Zhang, Qikai Chang, Jianshu Zhang, Quan Liu, Jun Du

entry.summary: Proposes Step Potential Advantage Estimation for RLVR combining intermediate confidence and correctness signals. Training-free probing mechanism extracts step-level progress to address coarse outcome-based rewards.

entry.title: ResTok: Learning Hierarchical Residuals in 1D Visual Tokenizers for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Xu Zhang, Cheng Da, Huan Yang, Kun Gai, Ming Lu, Zhan Ma

entry.summary: ResTok introduces hierarchical residual learning for 1D visual tokenizers in autoregressive image generation, bringing vision-specific priors (hierarchical, residual design) back to visual tokenization rather than following language model conventions.

entry.title: Analyzing Reasoning Consistency in Large Multimodal Models under Cross-Modal Conflicts

author.name: Zhihao Zhu, Jiafeng Liang, Shixin Jiang, Jinlan Fu, Ming Liu, Guanglu Sun, See-Kiong Ng, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Identifies 'textual inertia' failure mode in LMMs where textual hallucinations in reasoning chains cause models to ignore conflicting visual evidence. LogicGraph Perturbation Protocol shows models self-correct in <10% of cases.

entry.title: Agentic Rubrics as Contextual Verifiers for SWE Agents

author.name: Mohit Raghavendra, Anisha Gunjal, Bing Liu, Yunzhong He

entry.summary: Agentic Rubrics creates context-grounded checklists via expert agent interaction with repositories, then scores patches against rubrics without test execution. Achieves competitive verification for SWE agents.

entry.title: OpenForecaster: How to train language models for open-ended forecasting?

author.name: nikhilchandak

entry.summary: Presents OpenForecaster, an 8B parameter model trained with RL on 52K forecasting questions that achieves competitive performance with 100B+ models on prediction tasks while showing improved calibration and consistency.

entry.title: The Critical Role of Aspects in Measuring Document Similarity

author.name: Eftekhar Hossain, Tarnika Hazra, Ahatesham Bhuiyan, Santu Karmaker

entry.summary: Introduces ASPECTSIM framework requiring explicit aspect specification for document similarity, achieving ~80% higher human-machine agreement than holistic similarity. Evaluates on 26K aspect-document pairs with 16 LLMs and 9 embedding models.

entry.title: Beyond Perplexity: A Lightweight Benchmark for Knowledge Retention in Supervised Fine-Tuning

author.name: Soheil Zibakhsh Shabgahi, Pedram Aghazadeh, Farinaz Koushanfar

entry.summary: Introduces Knowledge Retention (KR) Test, a lightweight evaluation framework for SFT that distinguishes factual learning from stylistic mimicry using contrastive examples. Shows validation perplexity is insufficient.

entry.title: From Chains to Graphs: Self-Structured Reasoning for General-Domain LLMs

author.name: Yingjian Chen, Haoran Liu, Yinhong Liu, Sherry T. Tong, Aosong Feng, Jinghui Lu, Juntao Zhang, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo and Irene Li

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Graph Reasoning (SGR) enabling LLMs to construct and use their own graph-structured reasoning for open-domain QA. Addresses logical inconsistency in linear Chain-of-Thought by allowing parallel subproblem solving.

entry.title: AMIR-GRPO: Inducing Implicit Preference Signals into GRPO

author.name: Amir Hossein Yari, Fajri Koto

entry.summary: Proposes AMIR-GRPO augmenting GRPO with implicit DPO-style contrastive regularizer from intra-group reward rankings. Addresses length bias and underutilized preference information in GRPO.

entry.title: Do LLM Self-Explanations Help Users Predict Model Behavior? Evaluating Counterfactual Simulatability with Pragmatic Perturbations

author.name: Pingjun Hong and Benjamin Roth

entry.summary: Proposes Cue-Resistant Memorization (CRM) framework for evaluating PII leakage under low lexical cue conditions. Large-scale multilingual re-evaluation across 32 languages challenges prior memorization findings.

entry.title: Do LLMs Really Memorize Personally Identifiable Information? Revisiting PII Leakage with a Cue-Controlled Memorization Framework

author.name: Xiaoyu Luo, Yiyi Chen, Qiongxiu Li, Johannes Bjerva

entry.summary: Proposes Cue-Resistant Memorization (CRM) framework evaluating PII leakage under conditions where target cannot be reconstructed from prompt cues. Large-scale multilingual study across 32 languages.

entry.title: HoneyTrap: Deceiving Large Language Model Attackers to Honeypot Traps with Resilient Multi-Agent Defense

author.name: Siyuan Li, Xi Lin, Jun Wu, Zehao Liu, Haoyu Li, Tianjie Ju, Xiang Chen, Jianhua Li

entry.summary: HoneyTrap is a deceptive defense framework using four collaborative agents to counter multi-turn jailbreak attacks on LLMs by luring attackers into honeypot traps. Introduces MTJ-Pro benchmark for progressive jailbreaks.

entry.title: Gen3R: 3D Scene Generation Meets Feed-Forward Reconstruction

author.name: Jiaxin Huang, Yuanbo Yang, Bangbang Yang, Lin Ma, Yuewen Ma, Yiyi Liao

entry.summary: Gen3R bridges reconstruction and video diffusion models for 3D scene generation by training an adapter on VGGT reconstruction tokens aligned with video diffusion latents. Produces RGB videos with camera poses, depth, and point clouds.

entry.title: Verification of Autonomous Neural Car Control with KeYmaera X

author.name: Enguerrand Prebet and Samuel Teuber and Andr\'e Platzer

entry.summary: Provides formal safety proofs for autonomous car control using differential dynamic logic in KeYmaera X, proving collision avoidance on infinite time horizons. Demonstrates formal methods can provide foundation for neural network verification and runtime monitoring.

entry.title: SciNetBench: A Relation-Aware Benchmark for Scientific Literature Retrieval Agents

author.name: Chenyang Shao, Yong Li, Fengli Xu

entry.summary: Introduces SciNetBench, a benchmark for relation-aware scientific literature retrieval that tests agents on understanding relationships like corroborating/conflicting studies and technological lineages, beyond simple content similarity.

entry.title: The Instruction Gap: LLMs get lost in Following Instruction

author.name: Vishesh Tripathi, Uday Allu and Biddwan Ahmed

entry.summary: Studies the 'instruction gap' where LLMs excel at general tasks but struggle with precise custom instructions in enterprise RAG scenarios. Evaluates 13 LLMs, finding Claude-Sonnet-4 and GPT-5 achieve highest compliance.

entry.title: AgentMark: Utility-Preserving Behavioral Watermarking for Agents

author.name: Kaibo Huang, Jin Tan, Yukun Wei, Wanling Li, Zipei Zhang, Hui Tian, Zhongliang Yang, Linna Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes AgentMark, a behavioral watermarking framework embedding multi-bit identifiers into AI agent planning decisions for IP protection and provenance, operating across heterogeneous black-box agents.

entry.title: VLM4VLA: Revisiting Vision-Language-Models in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Jianke Zhang, Xiaoyu Chen, Qiuyue Wang, Mingsheng Li, Yanjiang Guo, Yucheng Hu, Jiajun Zhang, Shuai Bai, Junyang Lin, Jianyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VLM4VLA, a minimal adaptation pipeline for converting VLMs to Vision-Language-Action policies, systematically studying how VLM choice affects downstream robotic control performance across three benchmarks.

entry.title: Breaking the Assistant Mold: Modeling Behavioral Variation in LLM Based Procedural Character Generation

author.name: Maan Qraitem, Kate Saenko, Bryan A. Plummer

entry.summary: Identifies two alignment-induced biases in LLM character generation: positive moral bias and helpful assistant bias. Introduces PersonaWeaver framework that disentangles world-building from behavioral-building to create more diverse, dramatically interesting characters.

entry.title: DeepLeak: Privacy Enhancing Hardening of Model Explanations Against Membership Leakage

author.name: Firas Ben Hmida, Zain Sbeih, Philemon Hailemariam, Birhanu Eshete

entry.summary: Presents DeepLeak system to audit and mitigate privacy risks in post-hoc explanation methods. Develops stronger membership inference attacks for explanations and provides guidance on balancing interpretability with privacy.

entry.title: ThinkRL-Edit: Thinking in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning-Centric Image Editing

author.name: Hengjia Li, Liming Jiang, Qing Yan, Yizhi Song, Hao Kang, Zichuan Liu, Xin Lu, Boxi Wu, Deng Cai

entry.summary: Proposes ThinkRL-Edit, a reasoning-centric RL framework for image editing that decouples visual reasoning from synthesis. Uses Chain-of-Thought sampling with planning and reflection stages.

entry.title: IntroLM: Introspective Language Models via Prefilling-Time Self-Evaluation

author.name: Hossein Hosseini Kasnavieh, Gholamreza Haffari, Chris Leckie, Adel N. Toosi

entry.summary: Proposes IntroLM enabling LLMs to predict output quality during prefilling using introspective tokens and token-conditional LoRA. Avoids external evaluators while preserving generation behavior.

entry.title: SCRIBE: Structured Mid-Level Supervision for Tool-Using Language Models

author.name: Yuxuan Jiang, Francis Ferraro

entry.summary: Introduces SCRIBE, an RL framework for tool-using LLMs that grounds reward modeling in a curated library of skill prototypes. Transforms open-ended LLM evaluation into constrained verification by routing subgoals to skill prototypes.

entry.title: VideoMemory: Toward Consistent Video Generation via Memory Integration

author.name: Jinsong Zhou, Yihua Du, Xinli Xu, Luozhou Wang, Zijie Zhuang, Yehang Zhang, Shuaibo Li, Xiaojun Hu, Bolan Su, Ying-cong Chen

entry.summary: Presents VideoMemory framework for consistent video generation using Dynamic Memory Bank storing entity representations. Multi-agent system decomposes narratives into shots while retrieving and updating entity states.

entry.title: From Implicit to Explicit: Token-Efficient Logical Supervision for Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Shaojie Wang, Liang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FSLR targeting first-step logical relationship understanding in mathematical reasoning. Shows over 90% of errors relate to logical relationship understanding and CoT-SFT fails to reduce them.

entry.title: ADEPT: Adaptive Dynamic Early-Exit Process for Transformers

author.name: Sangmin Yoo and Srikanth Malla and Chiho Choi and Wei D. Lu and Joon Hee Choi

entry.summary: Introduces ADEPT, a novel approach enabling dynamic early exit in both prefill and generation phases of LLM inference by addressing the KV cache bottleneck for skipped layers. Adapts computation dynamically based on input complexity.

entry.title: ETR: Outcome-Guided Elastic Trust Regions for Policy Optimization

author.name: Shijie Zhang, Kevin Zhang, Zheyuan Gu, Xiang Guo, Rujun Guo, Shaoyu Liu, Guanjun Jiang, Xiaozhao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ETR (Elastic Trust Regions) for RLVR, addressing GRPO's limitation of uniform static trust region constraints. Dynamically adjusts constraints based on advantage magnitudes for outcome-driven learning.

entry.title: What Does Loss Optimization Actually Teach, If Anything? Knowledge Dynamics in Continual Pre-training of LLMs

author.name: Seyed Mahed Mousavi, Simone Alghisi, Giuseppe Riccardi

entry.summary: Studies Continual Pre-Training as knowledge learning process rather than optimization. Finds optimization and learning systematically diverge - loss decreases while knowledge may not improve or may degrade.

entry.title: Spectral Manifold Regularization for Stable and Modular Routing in Deep MoE Architectures

author.name: Ibrahim Delibasoglu

entry.summary: SR-MoE proposes spectral regularization for Mixture of Experts architectures to prevent expert collapse, using spectral norm constraints and stable rank penalties to maintain expert diversity. Demonstrates improved one-shot adaptation across scales.

entry.title: CLAP: Contrastive Latent Action Pretraining for Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Human Videos

author.name: Chubin Zhang, Jianan Wang, Zifeng Gao, Yue Su, Tianru Dai, Cai Zhou, Jiwen Lu, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: CLAP uses contrastive learning to align visual latent space from human videos with proprioceptive latent space from robot trajectories, enabling better transfer from abundant video data to robotics.

entry.title: Two Aspects of Situational Awareness: World Modelling & Indexical Information

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: David Krueger distinguishes two components of AI situational awareness: world modeling (knowing facts about the universe) and indexical information (knowing one's position in space-time), with implications for understanding scheming risks.

entry.title: Eye-Q: A Multilingual Benchmark for Visual Word Puzzle Solving and Image-to-Phrase Reasoning

author.name: Ali Najar, Alireza Mirrokni, Arshia Izadyari, Sadegh Mohammadian, Amir Homayoon Sharifizade, Asal Meskin, Mobin Bagherian, Ehsaneddin Asgari

entry.summary: Introduces Eye-Q, a multilingual benchmark of 1,343 visual word puzzles requiring implicit visual reasoning and non-literal concept mapping. Designed to test VLMs beyond surface-level recognition and OCR shortcuts.

entry.title: CALM: Culturally Self-Aware Language Models

author.name: Lingzhi Shen, Xiaohao Cai, Yunfei Long, Imran Razzak, Guanming Chen, Shoaib Jameel

entry.summary: Introduces CALM framework for culturally self-aware language models that disentangles task semantics from cultural concepts. Uses contrastive learning for cultural clusters with Mixture-of-Experts integration.

entry.title: Submodular Evaluation Subset Selection in Automatic Prompt Optimization

author.name: Jinming Nian, Zhiyuan Peng, Hongwei Shang, Dae Hoon Park, Yi Fang

entry.summary: Studies evaluation subset selection for automatic prompt optimization from principled submodular optimization perspective. Shows submodularly selected subsets yield better optimized prompts than random or heuristic baselines.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Code Translation with Weighted Multilanguage Exploration

author.name: Yuhan Wu and Huan Zhang and Wei Cheng and Chen Shen and Jingyue Yang and Wei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes BootTrans for multilingual code translation using bootstrapping with test suite transfer for cross-language verification. Uses dual-pool architecture with language-aware weighting for harder translations.

entry.title: PsychEthicsBench: Evaluating Large Language Models Against Australian Mental Health Ethics

author.name: Yaling Shen, Stephanie Fong, Yiwen Jiang, Zimu Wang, Feilong Tang, Qingyang Xu, Xiangyu Zhao, Zhongxing Xu, Jiahe Liu, Jinpeng Hu, Dominic Dwyer, Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: Introduces PsychEthicsBench, first benchmark based on Australian psychology/psychiatry guidelines for evaluating LLMs' ethical behavior in mental health contexts. Moves beyond refusal-centric metrics to evaluate nuanced clinical responses.

entry.title: O-Researcher: An Open Ended Deep Research Model via Multi-Agent Distillation and Agentic RL

author.name: Yi Yao, He Zhu, Piaohong Wang, Jincheng Ren, Xinlong Yang, Qianben Chen, Xiaowan Li, Dingfeng Shi, Jiaxian Li, Qiexiang Wang, Sinuo Wang, Xinpeng Liu, Jiaqi Wu, Minghao Liu, Wangchunshu Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces O-Researcher for automated synthesis of research-grade instructional data using multi-agent workflow with tool-integrated reasoning. Uses two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning and novel RL method.

entry.title: FOREVER: Forgetting Curve-Inspired Memory Replay for Language Model Continual Learning

author.name: Yujie Feng, Hao Wang, Jian Li, Xu Chu, Zhaolu Kang, Yiran Liu, Yasha Wang, Philip S. Yu, Xiao-Ming Wu

entry.summary: FOREVER introduces forgetting curve-inspired memory replay for LLM continual learning, defining 'model time' via optimizer update magnitudes to better align replay schedules with actual learning progress.

entry.title: Wow, wo, val! A Comprehensive Embodied World Model Evaluation Turing Test

author.name: Chun-Kai Fan, Xiaowei Chi, Xiaozhu Ju, Hao Li, Yong Bao, Yu-Kai Wang, Lizhang Chen, Zhiyuan Jiang, Kuangzhi Ge, Ying Li, Weishi Mi, Qingpo Wuwu, Peidong Jia, Yulin Luo, Kevin Zhang, Zhiyuan Qin, Yong Dai, Sirui Han, Yike Guo, Shanghang Zhang, Jian Tang

entry.summary: WoW-World-Eval benchmark tests video foundation models as embodied world models across five core abilities including perception, physical understanding, and interactive generation using 609 robot manipulation data.

entry.title: CPGPrompt: Translating Clinical Guidelines into LLM-Executable Decision Support

author.name: Ruiqi Deng, Geoffrey Martin, Tony Wang, Gongbo Zhang, Yi Liu, Chunhua Weng, Yanshan Wang, Justin F Rousseau, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Develops CPGPrompt to convert clinical practice guidelines into LLM-executable decision trees. Automatically translates narrative guidelines for patient case evaluation across headache, back pain, and prostate cancer domains.

entry.title: DiVA: Fine-grained Factuality Verification with Agentic-Discriminative Verifier

author.name: Hui Huang, Muyun Yang, Yuki Arase

entry.summary: Proposes DiVA for fine-grained factuality verification beyond binary judgments, combining generative agentic search with discriminative scoring. Creates FGVeriBench benchmark for graded error severity.

entry.title: NeuronScope: A Multi-Agent Framework for Explaining Polysemantic Neurons in Language Models

author.name: Weiqi Liu, Yongliang Miao, Haiyan Zhao, Yanguang Liu, Mengnan Du

entry.summary: Proposes NeuronScope, a multi-agent framework for explaining polysemantic neurons. Iteratively clusters activations into semantic modes and refines explanations using activation feedback.

entry.title: ROI-Reasoning: Rational Optimization for Inference via Pre-Computation Meta-Cognition

author.name: Muyang Zhao, Qi Qi, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes ROI-Reasoning for budget-aware inference with meta-cognition. Two-stage framework with Meta-Cognitive Fine-Tuning predicts reasoning cost and utility before generation for solve-or-skip decisions.

entry.title: SoK: Privacy Risks and Mitigations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Andreea-Elena Bodea, Stephen Meisenbacher, Alexandra Klymenko, and Florian Matthes

entry.summary: Systematization of knowledge (SoK) paper surveying privacy risks and mitigations in RAG systems, addressing concerns about sensitive information in knowledge bases being exposed through model responses.

entry.title: Diffusion-DRF: Differentiable Reward Flow for Video Diffusion Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yifan Wang, Yanyu Li, Sergey Tulyakov, Yun Fu, Anil Kag

entry.summary: Diffusion-DRF enables fine-tuning video diffusion models using differentiable feedback from frozen Vision-Language Models. Converts VLM logits to token-aware gradients through the denoising chain.

entry.title: TracSum: A New Benchmark for Aspect-Based Summarization with Sentence-Level Traceability in Medical Domain

author.name: Bohao Chu, Meijie Li, Sameh Frihat, Chengyu Gu, Georg Lodde, Elisabeth Livingstone, Norbert Fuhr

entry.summary: Introduces TracSum, a benchmark for traceable medical summarization where generated summaries include sentence-level citations, enabling users to verify accuracy. Includes 3.5K annotated summary-citation pairs across seven medical aspects.

entry.title: Mass Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models with Concept Hierarchy

author.name: Jiahang Tu, Ye Li, Yiming Wu, Hanbin Zhao, Chao Zhang, Hui Qian

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical concept organization for mass concept erasure in diffusion models, grouping semantically related concepts under supertype nodes to improve efficiency and maintain generation quality as erased concepts grow.

entry.title: Bare-Metal Tensor Virtualization: Overcoming the Memory Wall in Edge-AI Inference on ARM64

author.name: Bugra Kilictas, Faruk Alpay

entry.summary: Presents 'Virtual Tensor Core' architecture for LLM inference on ARM64 edge devices, using direct memory mapping and NEON SIMD kernels to achieve 100% cache line utilization for weight matrices.

entry.title: RiskCueBench: Benchmarking Anticipatory Reasoning from Early Risk Cues in Video-Language Models

author.name: Sha Luo, Yogesh Prabhu, Tim Ossowski, Kaiping Chen, Junjie Hu

entry.summary: Introduces RiskCueBench for evaluating VLMs on anticipatory reasoning from early risk signals in videos, requiring models to identify safety concerns before accidents occur rather than after.

entry.title: Edit2Restore:Few-Shot Image Restoration via Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pre-trained Editing Models

author.name: M. Ak{\i}n Y{\i}lmaz, Ahmet Bilican, Burak Can Biner, A. Murat Tekalp

entry.summary: Demonstrates that pre-trained text-conditioned image editing models (FLUX.1 Kontext, 12B parameters) can be efficiently adapted for image restoration tasks using only 16-128 paired examples via LoRA fine-tuning. Challenges the paradigm of training specialized models per degradation type.

entry.title: PCoA: A New Benchmark for Medical Aspect-Based Summarization With Phrase-Level Context Attribution

author.name: Bohao Chu, Sameh Frihat, Tabea M. G. Pakull, Hendrik Damm, Meijie Li, Ula Muhabbek, Georg Lodde, Norbert Fuhr

entry.summary: Introduces PCoA, an expert-annotated benchmark for medical aspect-based summarization with phrase-level context attribution. Proposes decoupled evaluation framework for summary quality, citations, and contributory phrases.

entry.title: Enhancing Linguistic Competence of Language Models through Pre-training with Language Learning Tasks

author.name: Atsuki Yamaguchi, Maggie Mi, Nikolaos Aletras

entry.summary: Proposes L2T, a pre-training framework integrating Language Learning Tasks alongside next-token prediction. Transforms raw text into structured input-output pairs inspired by human language acquisition, improving linguistic competence.

entry.title: From Bits to Chips: An LLM-based Hardware-Aware Quantization Agent for Streamlined Deployment of LLMs

author.name: Kaiyuan Deng, Hangyu Zheng, Minghai Qing, Kunxiong Zhu, Gen Li, Yang Xiao, Lan Emily Zhang, Linke Guo, Bo Hui, Yanzhi Wang, Geng Yuan, Gagan Agrawal, Wei Niu, Xiaolong Ma

entry.summary: Introduces HAQA (Hardware-Aware Quantization Agent), an LLM-based framework automating quantization and deployment through hyperparameter tuning and hardware compatibility checks.

entry.title: G2P: Gaussian-to-Point Attribute Alignment for Boundary-Aware 3D Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Hojun Song, Chae-yeong Song, Jeong-hun Hong, Chaewon Moon, Dong-hwi Kim, Gahyeon Kim, Soo Ye Kim, Yiyi Liao, Jaehyup Lee and Sang-hyo Park

entry.summary: Proposes G2P (Gaussian-to-Point) for 3D semantic segmentation by transferring appearance-aware attributes from 3D Gaussian Splatting to point clouds. Uses opacity and scale attributes for geometric disambiguation.
