entry.title: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Visual Prompt for OFF-Road Autonomous Driving

author.name: Liangdong Zhang, Yiming Nie, Haoyang Li, Fanjie Kong, Baobao Zhang, Shunxin Huang, Kai Fu, Chen Min, Liang Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes OFF-EMMA, end-to-end VLA framework for off-road autonomous driving with visual prompt blocks and chain-of-thought with self-consistency reasoning for robust trajectory planning.

entry.title: Interleaved Tool-Call Reasoning for Protein Function Understanding

author.name: Chuanliu Fan, Zicheng Ma, Huanran Meng, Aijia Zhang, Wenjie Du, Jun Zhang, Yi Qin Gao, Ziqiang Cao, Guohong Fu

entry.summary: Shows that CoT reasoning doesn't effectively transfer to protein function understanding - RL mainly amplifies keyword patterns without new biological knowledge. Proposes PFUA, a tool-augmented reasoning agent for proteins.

entry.title: PhysVideoGenerator: Towards Physically Aware Video Generation via Latent Physics Guidance

author.name: Siddarth Nilol Kundur Satish, Devesh Jaiswal, Hongyu Chen, Abhishek Bakshi

entry.summary: Proposes PhysVideoGenerator embedding learnable physics prior into video generation via predictor network trained on V-JEPA 2 features. Injects physics tokens into DiT temporal attention.

entry.title: From Laboratory to Real-World Applications: Benchmarking Agentic Code Reasoning at the Repository Level

author.name: Jia Li, Yuxin Su, Michael R. Lyu

entry.summary: Presents RepoReason, a white-box diagnostic benchmark for repository-level code reasoning using abductive assertion verification. Uses execution-driven mutation and dynamic program slicing for fine-grained diagnostic metrics.

entry.title: Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO: Ensuring Bounded Ratios for Stable and Generalizable Training

author.name: Chi Liu, Xin Chen

entry.summary: ABC-GRPO improves upon Group Relative Policy Optimization for LLM reinforcement learning by introducing asymmetric and adaptive clipping boundaries. Shows superior performance on math reasoning with Qwen3 while maintaining higher entropy to prevent premature convergence.

entry.title: When Helpers Become Hazards: A Benchmark for Analyzing Multimodal LLM-Powered Safety in Daily Life

author.name: Xinyue Lou, Jinan Xu, Jingyi Yin, Xiaolong Wang, Zhaolu Kang, Youwei Liao, Yixuan Wang, Xiangyu Shi, Fengran Mo, Su Yao, Kaiyu Huang

entry.summary: SaLAD benchmark evaluates MLLM safety in daily life scenarios with 2,013 real-world samples across 10 categories, covering both unsafe scenarios and oversensitivity cases. Emphasizes that safety risks require cross-modal reasoning.

entry.title: Towards Zero-Knowledge Task Planning via a Language-based Approach

author.name: Liam Merz Hoffmeister, Brian Scassellati, Daniel Rakita

entry.summary: Formalizes Zero-Knowledge Task Planning (ZKTP) for robotics and proposes LLM-based approach to decompose natural language instructions into behavior trees with on-the-fly refinement. Demonstrates effectiveness in AI2-THOR simulator without task-specific knowledge.

entry.title: Microeconomic Foundations of Multi-Agent Learning

author.name: Nassim Helou

entry.summary: Develops economic foundation for multi-agent learning through principal-agent interaction in MDPs with strategic externalities. Proposes two-phase incentive mechanism achieving sublinear social-welfare regret.

entry.title: EpiQAL: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Epidemiological Question Answering for Enhanced Alignment and Reasoning

author.name: Mingyang Wei, Dehai Min, Zewen Liu, Yuzhang Xie, Guanchen Wu, Carl Yang, Max S. Y. Lau, Qi He, Lu Cheng, Wei Jin

entry.summary: Introduces EpiQAL, first diagnostic benchmark for epidemiological question answering across text-grounded factual recall, multi-step inference, and conclusion reconstruction. Built from open-access literature.

entry.title: Value-Action Alignment in Large Language Models under Privacy-Prosocial Conflict

author.name: Guanyu Chen, Chenxiao Yu, Xiyang Hu

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs' expressed privacy and prosocial values predict their data-sharing actions when these values conflict. Uses multi-group structural equation modeling to evaluate value-action alignment.

entry.title: ELO: Efficient Layer-Specific Optimization for Continual Pretraining of Multilingual LLMs

author.name: HanGyeol Yoo, ChangSu Choi, Minjun Kim, Seohyun Song, SeungWoo Song, Inho Won, Jongyoul Park, Cheoneum Park, KyungTae Lim

entry.summary: Proposes ELO method for efficient continual pretraining of multilingual LLMs by training only first and last layers. Significantly reduces GPU memory and training time while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Learning Shrinks the Hard Tail: Training-Dependent Inference Scaling in a Solvable Linear Model

author.name: Noam Levi

entry.summary: Analyzes neural scaling laws in a solvable fine-tuning model showing pass@k failure rate decay is training-dependent. Reveals that learning 'shrinks the hard tail' of error distributions through instance-level improvements.

entry.title: When Models Decide and When They Bind: A Two-Stage Computation for Multiple-Choice Question-Answering

author.name: Hugh Mee Wong, Rick Nouwen, Albert Gatt

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs internally process multiple-choice questions, finding a two-stage computation: first identifying the winning content position, then mapping to output symbol. Reveals that symbol-binding failures can be mistaken for reasoning errors.

entry.title: Stable Language Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zhihao Zhan, Yuhao Chen, Jiaying Zhou, Qinhan Lv, Hao Liu, Keze Wang, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang

entry.summary: RSS (Residual Semantic Steering) addresses 'modality collapse' in Vision-Language-Action models where visual priors overwhelm linguistic signals. Uses Monte Carlo Syntactic Integration and Residual Affordance Steering.

entry.title: Scanner-Induced Domain Shifts Undermine the Robustness of Pathology Foundation Models

author.name: Erik Thiringer, Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Kajsa Ledesma Eriksson, and Mattias Rantalainen

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates 14 pathology foundation models for robustness to scanner-induced domain shifts. Using 384 breast cancer slides across 5 scanners, finds PFM performance degrades significantly across devices.

entry.title: VNU-Bench: A Benchmarking Dataset for Multi-Source Multimodal News Video Understanding

author.name: Zibo Liu, Muyang Li, Zhe Jiang, Shigang Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VNU-Bench for evaluating MLLMs on multi-source news video understanding, requiring comparison of perspectives across outlets, cross-source evidence alignment, and temporal synthesis.

entry.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization

author.name: Qiang Zhang, Hanchao Yu, Ivan Ji, Chen Yuan, Yi Zhang, Chihuang Liu, Xiaolong Wang, Christopher E. Lambert, Ren Chen, Chen Kovacs, Xinzhu Bei, Renqin Cai, Rui Li, Lizhu Zhang, Xiangjun Fan, Qunshu Zhang, and Benyu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces approach for efficient sequential recommendation by compressing long user histories into learnable tokens combined with recent interactions. Addresses quadratic scaling of transformers.

entry.title: Can LLMs See Without Pixels? Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence from Textual Descriptions

author.name: Zhongbin Guo, Zhen Yang, Yushan Li, Xinyue Zhang, Wenyu Gao, Jiacheng Wang, Chengzhi Li, Xiangrui Liu, Ping Jian

entry.summary: Introduces SiT-Bench to evaluate LLMs' spatial intelligence without pixel-level input, using coordinate-aware textual descriptions. Questions whether spatial understanding comes from visual encoders or reasoning backbone.

entry.title: MobileDreamer: Generative Sketch World Model for GUI Agent

author.name: Yilin Cao, Yufeng Zhong, Zhixiong Zeng, Liming Zheng, Jing Huang, Haibo Qiu, Peng Shi, Wenji Mao, Wan Guanglu

entry.summary: MobileDreamer is a world-model-based framework for mobile GUI agents using textual sketch world models to predict action outcomes and enable lookahead planning for improved decision-making.

entry.title: ContextFocus: Activation Steering for Contextual Faithfulness in Large Language Models

author.name: Nikhil Anand, Shwetha Somasundaram, Anirudh Phukan, Apoorv Saxena, Koyel Mukherjee

entry.summary: ContextFocus uses lightweight activation steering to improve LLM faithfulness to retrieved context when it conflicts with parametric knowledge. No finetuning required, minimal inference overhead.

entry.title: Device-Native Autonomous Agents for Privacy-Preserving Negotiations

author.name: Joyjit Roy

entry.summary: Introduces device-native autonomous AI agents for privacy-preserving negotiations in insurance and B2B commerce, operating entirely on user hardware with zero-knowledge proofs and distilled world models.

entry.title: AI-Guided Discovery of Novel Ionic Liquid Solvents for Industrial CO2 Capture

author.name: Davide Garbelotto, Alexander Lobo, Urvi Awasthi, Oleg Medvedev, Srayanta Mukherjee, Anton Aristov, Konstantin Polunin, Alex De Mur, Leonid Zhukov, Azad Huseynov, Murad Abdullayev

entry.summary: Presents AI-driven approach for discovering ionic liquids for CO2 capture using GNN-based property prediction, Van't Hoff modeling, and Pareto optimization to identify candidates with optimal working capacity, viscosity, and regeneration energy.

entry.title: Aligning Findings with Diagnosis: A Self-Consistent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Trustworthy Radiology Reporting

author.name: Kun Zhao, Siyuan Dai, Pan Wang, Jifeng Song, Hui Ji, Chenghua Lin, Liang Zhan, Haoteng Tang

entry.summary: Proposes framework for self-consistent radiology report generation combining optimal vision encoder/LLM configuration with 'Reason-then-Summarize' architecture optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization.

entry.title: LUT-KAN: Segment-wise LUT Quantization for Fast KAN Inference

author.name: Oleksandr Kuznetsov

entry.summary: Introduces LUT-KAN, a segment-wise lookup-table quantization method for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks enabling fast CPU inference by converting spline functions to int8/uint8 LUTs with linear interpolation.

entry.title: A Novel Unified Approach to Deepfake Detection

author.name: Lord Sen, Shyamapada Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes unified deepfake detection architecture using cross-attention between spatial and frequency features with blood detection module, achieving 99.80% AUC on FaceForensics++ and 99.88% on Celeb-DF.

entry.title: Inferring Clinically Relevant Molecular Subtypes of Pancreatic Cancer from Routine Histopathology Using Deep Learning

author.name: Abdul Rehman Akbar, Alejandro Levya, Ashwini Esnakula, Elshad Hasanov, Anne Noonan, Upender Manne, Vaibhav Sahai, Lingbin Meng, Susan Tsai, Anil Parwani, Wei Chen, Ashish Manne, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Introduces PanSubNet, an interpretable deep learning framework predicting pancreatic cancer molecular subtypes from H&E-stained slides. Trained on 1,055 patients with dual-scale architecture fusing cellular and tissue-level features.

entry.title: FIRE-VLM: A Vision-Language-Driven Reinforcement Learning Framework for UAV Wildfire Tracking in a Physics-Grounded Fire Digital Twin

author.name: Chris Webb, Mobin Habibpour, Mayamin Hamid Raha, Ali Reza Tavakkoli, Janice Coen, Fatemeh Afghah

entry.summary: Introduces FIRE-VLM, first end-to-end VLM-guided RL framework for UAV wildfire tracking trained in physics-grounded digital twin. Integrates terrain, fuel, fire-spread physics with vision-language reasoning.

entry.title: Automated Feedback Generation for Undergraduate Mathematics: Development and Evaluation of an AI Teaching Assistant

author.name: Aron Gohr, Marie-Amelie Lawn, Kevin Gao, Inigo Serjeant and Stephen Heslip

entry.summary: Presents AI tutoring system for free-form mathematical reasoning feedback on undergraduate proofs. Achieves quality comparable to human experts on correctness, style, and presentation assessment.

entry.title: Semantic Belief-State World Model for 3D Human Motion Prediction

author.name: Sarim Chaudhry

entry.summary: Proposes Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) reframing human motion prediction as latent dynamical simulation. Maintains recurrent probabilistic belief state rather than directly predicting poses.

entry.title: PALM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Personalized Audio-Language Models

author.name: Yuwen Wang, Xinyuan Qian, Tian-Hao Zhang, Jiaran Gao, Yuchen Pan, Xin Wang, Zhou Pan, Chen Wei, Yiming Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PALM-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating personalized audio-language models that can recognize personal concepts (like 'my best friend's voice') and reason within personal context. Addresses a significant gap as current LALMs behave generically without user-specific personalization.

entry.title: eTracer: Towards Traceable Text Generation via Claim-Level Grounding

author.name: Bohao Chu, Qianli Wang, Hendrik Damm, Hui Wang, Ula Muhabbek, Elisabeth Livingstone, Christoph M. Friedrich, Norbert Fuhr

entry.summary: Proposes eTracer for traceable text generation by grounding claims against contextual evidence at claim level. Enables tracing responses to sources and quantifying faithfulness in biomedical domain.

entry.title: Whose Facts Win? LLM Source Preferences under Knowledge Conflicts

author.name: Jakob Schuster and Vagrant Gautam and Katja Markert

entry.summary: Investigates how source preferences affect LLM resolution of knowledge conflicts using novel framework motivated by credibility research. Finds LLMs prefer institutional sources over social media but this can be reversed by repetition.

entry.title: Decide Then Retrieve: A Training-Free Framework with Uncertainty-Guided Triggering and Dual-Path Retrieval

author.name: Wang Chen, Guanqiang Qi, Weikang Li, Yang Li, Deguo Xia, Jizhou Huang

entry.summary: DTR is a training-free RAG framework that uses generation uncertainty to decide when retrieval is needed, combined with dual-path retrieval for handling sparse/ambiguous queries. Improves performance across five QA benchmarks.

entry.title: Bridging the Discrete-Continuous Gap: Unified Multimodal Generation via Coupled Manifold Discrete Absorbing Diffusion

author.name: Yuanfeng Xu, Yuhao Chen, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang

entry.summary: CoM-DAD proposes coupled manifold discrete absorbing diffusion for unified text-image generation, decoupling high-level semantic planning from low-level token generation to address alignment challenges.

entry.title: Choreographing a World of Dynamic Objects

author.name: Yanzhe Lyu, Chen Geng, Karthik Dharmarajan, Yunzhi Zhang, Hadi Alzayer, Shangzhe Wu, Jiajun Wu

entry.summary: Introduces CHORD, a universal generative pipeline for synthesizing 4D dynamic object motion by distilling Lagrangian motion information from video generative models without requiring category-specific heuristics or large datasets.

entry.title: Analyzing Reasoning Shifts in Audio Deepfake Detection under Adversarial Attacks: The Reasoning Tax versus Shield Bifurcation

author.name: Binh Nguyen, Thai Le

entry.summary: Analyzes reasoning robustness of Audio Language Models for deepfake detection under adversarial attacks. Introduces forensic auditing framework examining acoustic perception, cognitive coherence, and dissonance dimensions.

entry.title: CoINS: Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-Aware VLM

author.name: Kangjie Zhou, Zhejia Wen, Zhiyong Zhuo, Zike Yan, Pengying Wu, Ieng Hou U, Shuaiyang Li, Han Gao, Kang Ding, Wenhan Cao, Wei Pan and Chang Liu

entry.summary: CoINS enables interactive navigation where robots actively modify cluttered environments to create paths. Uses skill-aware VLM fine-tuning with counterfactual reasoning to determine when/how to interact with objects.

entry.title: Klear: Unified Multi-Task Audio-Video Joint Generation

author.name: Jun Wang, Chunyu Qiang, Yuxin Guo, Yiran Wang, Xijuan Zeng, Chen Zhang, Pengfei Wan

entry.summary: Klear proposes unified architecture for audio-video joint generation using single-tower DiT with Omni-Full Attention. Progressive multitask training regime addresses audio-visual asynchrony and lip-speech alignment.

entry.title: FedSM: Robust Semantics-Guided Feature Mixup for Bias Reduction in Federated Learning with Long-Tail Data

author.name: Jingrui Zhang, Yimeng Xu, Shujie Li, Feng Liang, Haihan Duan, Yanjie Dong, Victor C. M. Leung, Xiping Hu

entry.summary: Proposes FedSM, a federated learning framework that addresses bias from non-IID and long-tail data distributions through semantics-guided feature mixup using pretrained image-text models and lightweight classifier retraining.

entry.title: Less is more: Not all samples are effective for evaluation

author.name: Wentang Song, Jinqiang Li, Kele Huang, Junhui Lin, Shengxiang Wu, Zhongshi Xie

entry.summary: Proposes a history-free test set compression framework for LLM evaluation that works without prior model performance data, using domain-specific fine-tuning to identify semantically redundant samples.

entry.title: Better, But Not Sufficient: Testing Video ANNs Against Macaque IT Dynamics

author.name: Matteo Dunnhofer, Christian Micheloni, Kohitij Kar

entry.summary: Compares macaque inferior temporal cortex responses during naturalistic video viewing against static, recurrent, and video-based ANN models. Finds video models provide only modest improvements, suggesting biological visual processing involves richer dynamic computations.

entry.title: Soft Contextualized Encoder For User Defined Text Classification

author.name: Charu Maheshwari, Vyas Raina

entry.summary: Proposes soft-contextualized encoder for user-defined text classification that contextualizes labels with the full label set and soft prompt of input. Enables zero-shot classification over unseen topic sets.

entry.title: Personalization of Large Foundation Models for Health Interventions

author.name: Stefan Konigorski, Johannes E. Vedder, Babajide Alamu Owoyele, \.Ibrahim \"Ozkan

entry.summary: Reviews challenges of personalizing large foundation models for health interventions, identifying paradoxes including generalizability-personalization tension and automation-empathy conflicts.

entry.title: EvolMem: A Cognitive-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Session Dialogue Memory

author.name: Ye Shen, Dun Pei, Yiqiu Guo, Junying Wang, Yijin Guo, Zicheng Zhang, Qi Jia, Jun Zhou, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes EvolMem, a benchmark for evaluating multi-session memory capabilities in LLMs grounded in cognitive psychology. Covers both declarative and non-declarative memory with fine-grained ability decomposition.

entry.title: Sandwich Reasoning: An Answer-Reasoning-Answer Approach for Low-Latency Query Correction

author.name: Chen Zhang, Kepu Zhang, Jiatong Zhang, Xiao Zhang, Jun Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Sandwich Reasoning outputting answer-reasoning-answer for low-latency query correction. Aligns fast initial answer with post-hoc reasoning for accuracy without latency penalty.

entry.title: Pad\'e Neurons for Efficient Neural Models

author.name: Onur Kele\c{s} and A. Murat Tekalp

entry.summary: Padé neurons (Paons) are a novel neuron model inspired by Padé approximants, offering diverse learned nonlinearities per neuron and stronger nonlinearity per layer than standard McCulloch-Pitts neurons.

entry.title: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Distributional Deviations from Real Images

author.name: Yakun Niu, Yingjian Chen and Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Analyzes frozen CLIP encoders for AI-generated image detection, revealing they cluster real images effectively but don't inherently distinguish AI-generated ones. Proposes detection method based on distributional deviations.

entry.title: Simulated Students in Tutoring Dialogues: Substance or Illusion?

author.name: Alexander Scarlatos, Jaewook Lee, Simon Woodhead, Andrew Lan

entry.summary: Formally defines student simulation task for tutoring dialogues and proposes evaluation metrics spanning linguistic, behavioral, and cognitive aspects. Benchmarks simulation methods showing current approaches have significant quality gaps.

entry.title: Explaining Necessary Truths

author.name: G\"ulce Karde\c{s} and Simon DeDeo

entry.summary: Presents a computational complexity framework for explaining mathematical/logical truths, showing how explanations emerge during search processes and how GPT-4o handles SAT puzzles of varying complexity.

entry.title: Text Anomaly Detection with Simplified Isolation Kernel

author.name: Yang Cao, Sikun Yang, Yujiu Yang, Lianyong Qi, Ming Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Simplified Isolation Kernel (SIK) that maps high-dimensional LLM embeddings to sparse representations for text anomaly detection, achieving linear time complexity and reduced memory requirements while maintaining detection performance.

entry.title: Roles of MLLMs in Visually Rich Document Retrieval for RAG: A Survey

author.name: Xiantao Zhang

entry.summary: Surveys how Multimodal LLMs are used for visually rich document retrieval in RAG systems, organizing approaches into three roles: Modality-Unifying Captioners, Multimodal Embedders, and End-to-End Representers.

entry.title: $\alpha^3$-Bench: A Unified Benchmark of Safety, Robustness, and Efficiency for LLM-Based UAV Agents over 6G Networks

author.name: Mohamed Amine Ferrag, Abderrahmane Lakas, Merouane Debbah

entry.summary: Introduces α³-Bench for evaluating LLM-driven UAV autonomy under 6G network constraints, formulating missions as multi-turn conversational control with safety, protocol compliance, and network adaptation requirements.

entry.title: Feedback Indices to Evaluate LLM Responses to Rebuttals for Multiple Choice Type Questions

author.name: Justin C. Dunlap, Anne-Simone Parent, Ralf Widenhorn

entry.summary: Develops systematic indices for characterizing LLM responses to rebuttals using fictitious-response method, quantifying sycophantic (excessive agreement) and stubborn (rigid adherence) behaviors in multiple-choice settings.

entry.title: MetagenBERT: a Transformer-based Architecture using Foundational genomic Large Language Models for novel Metagenome Representation

author.name: Gaspar Roy, Eugeni Belda, Baptiste Hennecart, Yann Chevaleyre, Edi Prifti and Jean-Daniel Zucker

entry.summary: Introduces MetagenBERT, a transformer framework producing metagenome embeddings directly from raw DNA sequences without taxonomic annotations, using genomic language models and FAISS-accelerated clustering.

entry.title: HEEGNet: Hyperbolic Embeddings for EEG

author.name: Shanglin Li, Shiwen Chu, Okan Ko\c{c}, Yi Ding, Qibin Zhao, Motoaki Kawanabe and Ziheng Chen

entry.summary: Introduces HEEGNet using hyperbolic embeddings for EEG decoding, leveraging hierarchical cognitive structures in brain signals to improve generalization across subjects and domains.

entry.title: RelightAnyone: A Generalized Relightable 3D Gaussian Head Model

author.name: Yingyan Xu, Pramod Rao, Sebastian Weiss, Gaspard Zoss, Markus Gross, Christian Theobalt, Marc Habermann, Derek Bradley

entry.summary: Proposes RelightAnyone, a generalized relightable 3D Gaussian head model that can relight any subject from single/multi-view images without requiring OLAT capture data, learning mapping from flat-lit to relightable Gaussians.

entry.title: A path to natural language through tokenisation and transformers

author.name: David S. Berman, Alexander G. Stapleton

entry.summary: Analyzes how BPE tokenization transforms corpus statistics, deriving closed-form entropy expressions under Zipfian assumptions and showing recursive BPE drives frequencies toward power law.

entry.title: Exploration Through Introspection: A Self-Aware Reward Model

author.name: Michael Petrowski, Milica Ga\v{s}i\'c

entry.summary: Proposes an introspective exploration component for RL agents using hidden Markov models to infer internal 'pain-belief' states. Explores self-awareness mechanisms inspired by biological pain as learning signals for Theory of Mind research.

entry.title: Sensor to Pixels: Decentralized Swarm Gathering via Image-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yigal Koifman, Eran Iceland, Erez Koifman, Ariel Barel, and Alfred M. Bruckstein

entry.summary: Proposes image-based reinforcement learning for decentralized swarm control, encoding observations as structured visual inputs processed by neural networks. Shows advantages over vector-based representations for scalability.

entry.title: MARVEL: A Multi Agent-based Research Validator and Enabler using Large Language Models

author.name: Nikhil Mukund, Yifang Luo, Fan Zhang, Lisa Barsotti, Erik Katsavounidis

entry.summary: Presents MARVEL, a locally deployable framework for domain-aware scientific QA combining RAG with Monte Carlo Tree Search for gravitational-wave research. Uses DeepSearch mode for complex queries with evidence ledger.

entry.title: Measures of classification bias derived from sample size analysis

author.name: Ioannis Ivrissimtzis, Shauna Concannon, Matthew Houliston, Graham Roberts

entry.summary: Proposes using sample size requirements for statistical detection as a measure of classification bias - requiring larger samples to detect bias indicates less biased algorithms.

entry.title: SegNSP: Revisiting Next Sentence Prediction for Linear Text Segmentation

author.name: Jos\'e Isidro, Filipe Cunha, Purifica\c{c}\~ao Silvano, Al\'ipio Jorge, Nuno Guimar\~aes, S\'ergio Nunes, Ricardo Campos

entry.summary: Reframes linear text segmentation as next sentence prediction (NSP) task, leveraging NSP's explicit sentence continuity modeling for topic boundary detection. Proposes SegNSP framework.

entry.title: CroBIM-U: Uncertainty-Driven Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation

author.name: Yuzhe Sun, Zhe Dong, Haochen Jiang, Tianzhu Liu, and Yanfeng Gu

entry.summary: Proposes uncertainty-guided framework for referring remote sensing image segmentation using pixel-wise referring uncertainty maps to adaptively adjust inference across spatially non-uniform regions.

entry.title: GeoDiff-SAR: A Geometric Prior Guided Diffusion Model for SAR Image Generation

author.name: Fan Zhang, Xuanting Wu, Fei Ma, Qiang Yin, Yuxin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes GeoDiff-SAR, a geometric prior guided diffusion model for SAR image generation using point cloud simulation at specific azimuths. Addresses limitation of existing methods operating only in image domain.

entry.title: Physics-Constrained Cross-Resolution Enhancement Network for Optics-Guided Thermal UAV Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Zhicheng Zhao, Fengjiao Peng, Jinquan Yan, Wei Lu, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes PCNet for cross-resolution thermal-optical image enhancement with physical constraints from thermal conduction. Addresses information loss and physically inconsistent artifacts in existing methods.

entry.title: DeepSynth-Eval: Objectively Evaluating Information Consolidation in Deep Survey Writing

author.name: Hongzhi Zhang, Yuanze Hu, Tinghai Zhang, Jia Fu, Tao Wang, Junwei Jing, Zhaoxin Fan, Qi Wang, Ruiming Tang, Han Li, Guorui Zhou, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Introduces DeepSynth-Eval, a benchmark for objectively evaluating LLMs' ability to synthesize information into coherent long-form reports. Uses survey papers as gold standards and proposes fine-grained evaluation using checklists.

entry.title: OLA: Output Language Alignment in Code-Switched LLM Interactions

author.name: Juhyun Oh, Haneul Yoo, Faiz Ghifari Haznitrama, Alice Oh

entry.summary: Introduces OLA benchmark for evaluating LLMs' output language alignment when users code-switch between languages. Shows even frontier models frequently misinterpret implicit language expectations.

entry.title: In Search of Grandmother Cells: Tracing Interpretable Neurons in Tabular Representations

author.name: Ricardo Knauer, Erik Rodner

entry.summary: Investigates grandmother cells in TabPFN using information-theoretic measures for neuronal saliency and selectivity. Finds some neurons show moderate, statistically significant selectivity for high-level concepts.

entry.title: Inference Attacks Against Graph Generative Diffusion Models

author.name: Xiuling Wang, Xin Huang, Guibo Luo, Jianliang Xu

entry.summary: Investigates privacy risks in graph generative diffusion models through three black-box inference attacks: graph reconstruction, property inference, and membership inference. First study exploring privacy leakage in this model class.

entry.title: BREATH-VL: Vision-Language-Guided 6-DoF Bronchoscopy Localization via Semantic-Geometric Fusion

author.name: Qingyao Tian, Bingyu Yang, Huai Liao, Xinyan Huang, Junyong Li, Dong Yi, Hongbin Liu

entry.summary: Introduces BREATH dataset for endoscopic localization (largest in-vivo dataset to date) and BREATH-VL framework combining vision-language models with semantic-geometric fusion for 6-DoF bronchoscopy camera localization.

entry.title: Probabilistic Transformers for Joint Modeling of Global Weather Dynamics and Decision-Centric Variables

author.name: Paulius Rauba, Viktor Cikojevic, Fran Bartolic, Sam Levang, Ty Dickinson, Chase Dwelle

entry.summary: Introduces GEM-2, a probabilistic transformer jointly learning global atmospheric dynamics with decision-centric variables like extrema and threshold exceedances that users directly act upon.

entry.title: When Numbers Start Talking: Implicit Numerical Coordination Among LLM-Based Agents

author.name: Alessio Buscemi, Daniele Proverbio, Alessandro Di Stefano, The Anh Han, German Castignani, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Studies implicit numerical coordination in LLM-based multi-agent systems through game-theoretic analysis. Examines covert communication via indirect signals across different communication regimes.

entry.title: FUSION: Full-Body Unified Motion Prior for Body and Hands via Diffusion

author.name: Enes Duran, Nikos Athanasiou, Muhammed Kocabas, Michael J. Black, and Omid Taheri

entry.summary: FUSION creates a unified diffusion-based motion prior for full-body motion synthesis including detailed hand articulation by curating and unifying existing datasets to overcome data scarcity.

entry.title: Simple summary of AI Safety laws

author.name: Joseph Miller

entry.summary: Concise briefing comparing AI safety legislation across EU AI Act, California SB 53, and NY RAISE Act, covering safety protocol requirements, reporting obligations, penalties, and incident thresholds.

entry.title: Architecting Agentic Communities using Design Patterns

author.name: Zoran Milosevic, Fethi Rabhi

entry.summary: Presents design patterns for architecting agentic AI systems derived from enterprise distributed systems. Classifies patterns into LLM Agents, Agentic AI, and Agentic Communities tiers.

entry.title: Personalized Medication Planning via Direct Domain Modeling and LLM-Generated Heuristics

author.name: Yonatan Vernik, Alexander Tuisov, David Izhaki, Hana Weitman, Gal A. Kaminka, Alexander Shleyfman

entry.summary: Explores using LLM-generated domain-specific heuristics for personalized medication planning. Scales up planning from 7 medications to clinically practical levels using domain-aware search heuristics.

entry.title: Thinking with Frames: Generative Video Distortion Evaluation via Frame Reward Model

author.name: Yuan Wang, Borui Liao, Huijuan Huang, Jinda Lu, Ouxiang Li, Kuien Liu, Meng Wang, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: REACT is a frame-level reward model for evaluating structural distortions in generated videos (abnormal appearances, interactions). Includes taxonomy of distortions and large-scale preference dataset.

entry.title: Causal Data Augmentation for Robust Fine-Tuning of Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Magnus B\"uhler, Lennart Purucker, Frank Hutter

entry.summary: CausalMixFT improves tabular foundation model fine-tuning under data scarcity by augmenting with synthetic samples from Structural Causal Models fitted on target data. Improves median normalized ROC-AUC.

entry.title: Local Gradient Regulation Stabilizes Federated Learning under Client Heterogeneity

author.name: Ping Luo, Jiahuan Wang, Ziqing Wen, Tao Sun and Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: Shows that client heterogeneity destabilizes federated learning by distorting local gradient dynamics. Proposes swarm intelligence-inspired client-side method to regulate local gradients without additional communication.

entry.title: LLM-MC-Affect: LLM-Based Monte Carlo Modeling of Affective Trajectories and Latent Ambiguity for Interpersonal Dynamic Insight

author.name: Yu-Zheng Lin, Bono Po-Jen Shih, John Paul Martin Encinas, Elizabeth Victoria Abraham Achom, Karan Himanshu Patel, Jesus Horacio Pacheco, Sicong Shao, Jyotikrishna Dass, Soheil Salehi, and Pratik Satam

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-MC-Affect for modeling emotion as continuous latent probability distributions using Monte Carlo estimation. Captures uncertainty and sequential coupling in interpersonal exchanges.

entry.title: RadDiff: Describing Differences in Radiology Image Sets with Natural Language

author.name: Xiaoxian Shen, Yuhui Zhang, Sahithi Ankireddy, Xiaohan Wang, Maya Varma, Henry Guo, Curtis Langlotz, Serena Yeung-Levy

entry.summary: Introduces RadDiff, a multimodal agentic system performing radiologist-style comparative reasoning between radiology image sets. Uses proposer-ranker framework with domain adaptation, multimodal reasoning, and iterative refinement.

entry.title: MVP: Enhancing Video Large Language Models via Self-supervised Masked Video Prediction

author.name: Xiaokun Sun, Zezhong Wu, Zewen Ding, Linli Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Masked Video Prediction (MVP) as self-supervised post-training objective for Video LLMs, requiring reconstruction of masked segments from distractors to learn temporal coherence and visual causality.

entry.title: RADAR: Retrieval-Augmented Detector with Adversarial Refinement for Robust Fake News Detection

author.name: Song-Duo Ma, Yi-Hung Liu, Hsin-Yu Lin, Pin-Yu Chen, Hong-Yan Huang, Shau-Yung Hsu, and Yun-Nung Chen

entry.summary: RADAR combines retrieval-augmented detection with adversarial refinement for fake news detection. Uses verbal adversarial feedback (VAF) to co-evolve a generator (creating perturbations) and detector, achieving 86.98% ROC-AUC.

entry.title: KDCM: Reducing Hallucination in LLMs through Explicit Reasoning Structures

author.name: Jinbo Hao, Kai Yang, Qingzhen Su, Yifan Li, Chao Jiang

entry.summary: KDCM reduces LLM hallucinations using chain-style knowledge distillation with programmable modules for knowledge graph exploration. Executable code embedded in reasoning prompts guides structured knowledge use.

entry.title: E-LENS: User Requirements-Oriented AI Ethics Assurance

author.name: Jianlong Zhou and Fang Chen

entry.summary: Introduces E-LENS, an AI ethics assurance framework inspired by aviation safety systems, proposing user requirements, evidence, and validation as key components for ensuring ethical AI deployment.

entry.title: Leveraging Swin Transformer for enhanced diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease using multi-shell diffusion MRI

author.name: Quentin Dessain, Nicolas Delinte, Bernard Hanseeuw, Laurence Dricot, Beno\^it Macq

entry.summary: Applies Swin Transformer to multi-shell diffusion MRI data for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis and amyloid detection, using Low-Rank Adaptation to efficiently adapt to limited neuroimaging data.

entry.title: LLM Agent Framework for Intelligent Change Analysis in Urban Environment using Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Zixuan Xiao, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Presents ChangeGPT, an LLM agent framework for intelligent change analysis in urban environments using remote sensing, achieving 90.71% accuracy on curated 140-question dataset with hierarchical structure to reduce hallucination.

entry.title: MixRx: Predicting Drug Combination Interactions with LLMs

author.name: Risha Surana, Cameron Saidock, Hugo Chacon

entry.summary: MixRx uses LLMs to classify drug combination interactions as additive, synergistic, or antagonistic, with fine-tuned Mistral achieving 81.5% accuracy on standard and perturbed datasets.

entry.title: Automated Post-Incident Policy Gap Analysis via Threat-Informed Evidence Mapping using Large Language Models

author.name: Huan Lin Oh, Jay Yong Jun Jie, Mandy Lee Ling Siu, Jonathan Pan

entry.summary: Presents agentic framework using GPT-4o for automated post-incident cybersecurity review, mapping log evidence to MITRE ATT&CK framework and identifying security policy gaps.

entry.title: Lightweight Transformer Architectures for Edge Devices in Real-Time Applications

author.name: Hema Hariharan Samson

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of lightweight transformer architectures for edge deployment, covering MobileBERT, TinyBERT, DistilBERT, EfficientFormer, and others with benchmarks across GLUE, SQuAD, ImageNet, and COCO.

entry.title: CageDroneRF: A Large-Scale RF Benchmark and Toolkit for Drone Perception

author.name: Mohammad Rostami, Atik Faysal, Hongtao Xia, Hadi Kasasbeh, Ziang Gao, Huaxia Wang

entry.summary: Releases CageDroneRF, a large-scale benchmark for RF-based drone detection with real-world captures and synthetic augmentation pipeline controlling SNR, interference, and frequency shifts across diverse drone models.

entry.title: AI-Driven Cybersecurity Threats: A Survey of Emerging Risks and Defensive Strategies

author.name: Sai Teja Erukude, Viswa Chaitanya Marella, Suhasnadh Reddy Veluru

entry.summary: Survey analyzing AI-driven cybersecurity threats across deepfakes, adversarial AI, automated malware, and AI-powered social engineering, proposing comparative taxonomy and identifying research opportunities.

entry.title: On the Identifiability of Regime-Switching Models with Multi-Lag Dependencies

author.name: Carles Balsells-Rodas, Toshiko Matsui, Pedro A.M. Mediano, Yixin Wang, Yingzhen Li

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework for identifiability of multi-lag regime-switching time series models, proving conditions for identifying number of regimes and transitions in Markov Switching and Switching Dynamical Systems.

entry.title: Enhancing LLM Instruction Following: An Evaluation-Driven Multi-Agentic Workflow for Prompt Instructions Optimization

author.name: Alberto Purpura, Li Wang, Sahil Badyal, Eugenio Beaufrand, Adam Faulkner

entry.summary: Proposes multi-agentic workflow that separately optimizes task descriptions and constraints using quantitative feedback, improving instruction following in Llama 3.1 8B and Mixtral-8x7B.

entry.title: Guardians of the Hair: Rescuing Soft Boundaries in Depth, Stereo, and Novel Views

author.name: Xiang Zhang, Yang Zhang, Lukas Mehl, Markus Gross, Christopher Schroers

entry.summary: Introduces HairGuard framework for recovering soft boundary details (like hair) in depth estimation, stereo, and view synthesis using matting data and gated residual depth fixer network.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Gaussian Process Regression for the Constitutive Modeling of Concrete: A Data-Driven Improvement to Phenomenological Models

author.name: Chenyang Li, Himanshu Sharma, Youcai Wu, Joseph Magallanes, K.T. Ramesh, Michael D. Shields

entry.summary: Develops physics-informed Gaussian Process Regression to replace empirical failure surfaces in concrete constitutive modeling, learning directly from triaxial compression data with uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: PIVONet: A Physically-Informed Variational Neuro ODE Model for Efficient Advection-Diffusion Fluid Simulation

author.name: Hei Shing Cheung, Qicheng Long, Zhiyue Lin

entry.summary: Presents PIVONet, combining Neural ODEs with Continuous Normalizing Flows for stochastic fluid simulation. Uses variational modeling to capture latent stochasticity in fluid trajectories and enables efficient surrogate simulation.

entry.title: Discriminating real and synthetic super-resolved audio samples using embedding-based classifiers

author.name: Mikhail Silaev, Konstantinos Drossos, Tuomas Virtanen

entry.summary: Analyzes separability of real vs. super-resolved audio in embedding spaces using linear classifiers. Provides framework for evaluating GAN and diffusion-based audio super-resolution quality beyond perceptual metrics.

entry.title: An Expectation-Maximization Algorithm for Domain Adaptation in Gaussian Causal Models

author.name: Mohammad Ali Javidian

entry.summary: Studies domain adaptation for missing target variables in shifted deployment using Gaussian causal DAGs. Proposes EM-based framework with gradient updates achieving sublinear convergence under standard conditions.

entry.title: Content vs. Form: What Drives the Writing Score Gap Across Socioeconomic Backgrounds? A Generated Panel Approach

author.name: Nadav Kunievsky and Pedro Pertusi

entry.summary: Uses generated panel approach to study how much of socioeconomic test score gaps in writing comes from content vs. expression. Separates what students say from how they say it using AI rewriting.

entry.title: STELLA: Self-Reflective Terminology-Aware Framework for Building an Aerospace Information Retrieval Benchmark

author.name: Bongmin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes STELLA framework for building aerospace information retrieval benchmarks using terminology-aware query generation from NASA documents. Introduces cross-lingual extension capability.

entry.title: REFA: Real-time Egocentric Facial Animations for Virtual Reality

author.name: Qiang Zhang, Tong Xiao, Haroun Habeeb, Larissa Laich, Sofien Bouaziz, Patrick Snape, Wenjing Zhang, Matthew Cioffi, Peizhao Zhang, Pavel Pidlypenskyi, Winnie Lin, Luming Ma, Mengjiao Wang, Kunpeng Li, Chengjiang Long, Steven Song, Martin Prazak, Alexander Sjoholm, Ajinkya Deogade, Jaebong Lee, Julio Delgado Mangas, Amaury Aubel

entry.title: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Model for Mapping and Goal-Directed Navigation Using Multiscale Place Fields

author.name: Bekarys Dukenbaev, Andrew Gerstenslager, Alexander Johnson, Ali A. Minai

entry.summary: Introduces bio-inspired navigation model with parallel layers of place fields at multiple spatial scales, replay-based reward, and dynamic scale fusion. Shows improved path efficiency over single-scale baselines.

entry.title: CloudMatch: Weak-to-Strong Consistency Learning for Semi-Supervised Cloud Detection

author.name: Jiayi Zhao, Changlu Chen, Jingsheng Li, Tianxiang Xue, and Kun Zhan

author.name: Vladimir Braverman, Sumegha Garg, Chen Wang, David P. Woodruff, Samson Zhou

entry.summary: Addresses the experts problem in the sliding window model where recent data is more valuable. Shows that with just 2 queries and polylog memory, optimal regret can be achieved over any window of the last W days. Proves optimality of the approach.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of Traditional Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Large Language Models for Mental Health Forecasting using Smartphone Sensing Data

author.name: Kaidong Feng, Zhu Sun, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Xun Jiang, Yin-Leng Theng, Yi Ding

entry.title: DisastQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Question Answering in Disaster Management

author.name: Zhitong Chen, Kai Yin, Xiangjue Dong, Chengkai Liu, Xiangpeng Li, Yiming Xiao, Bo Li, Junwei Ma, Ali Mostafavi, James Caverlee

entry.summary: Introduces DisastQA, a 3,000-question benchmark for QA in disaster management with varying evidence conditions. Proposes keypoint-based evaluation for open-ended QA emphasizing factual completeness.

entry.title: AirNav: A Large-Scale Real-World UAV Vision-and-Language Navigation Dataset with Natural and Diverse Instructions

author.name: Hengxing Cai, Yijie Rao, Ligang Huang, Zanyang Zhong, Jinhan Dong, Jingjun Tan, Wenhao Lu, Renxin Zhong

entry.summary: Presents AirNav, a large-scale UAV vision-language navigation benchmark built from real urban aerial data with natural and diverse instructions. Introduces AirVLN-R1 model combining supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning.

entry.title: MIND: From Passive Mimicry to Active Reasoning through Capability-Aware Multi-Perspective CoT Distillation

author.name: Jin Cui, Jiaqi Guo, Jiepeng Zhou, Ruixuan Yang, Jiayi Lu, Jiajun Xu, Jiangcheng Song, Boran Zhao, Pengju Ren

entry.summary: Proposes MIND for multi-perspective Chain-of-Thought distillation that accounts for student model capabilities and evolving preferences during training. Addresses misalignment between teacher's optimal rationale and student's capacity.

entry.title: Scalable Machine Learning Force Fields for Macromolecular Systems Through Long-Range Aware Message Passing

author.name: Chu Wang, Lin Huang, Xinran Wei, Tao Qin, Arthur Jiang, Lixue Cheng, Jia Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MolLR25 benchmark for macromolecular force fields up to 1200 atoms and E2Former-LSR, an equivariant transformer with long-range attention blocks addressing locality constraints in current ML force fields.

entry.title: Membox: Weaving Topic Continuity into Long-Range Memory for LLM Agents

author.name: Dehao Tao, Guoliang Ma, Yongfeng Huang, Minghu Jiang

entry.title: An Event-Based Opto-Tactile Skin

author.name: Mohammadreza Koolani, Simeon Bamford, Petr Trunin, Simon F. M\"uller-Cleve, Matteo Lo Preti, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni, Lucia Beccai, and Chiara Bartolozzi

entry.summary: Novel neuromorphic tactile sensing system combining Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) with flexible silicone optical waveguide skin. Uses triangulation and DBSCAN clustering for press localization over a 4620mm² area.

entry.title: Large-Scale Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Reasoning-Infused LLMs

author.name: Pawe{\l} Liskowski, Krzysztof Jankowski

entry.title: Modular Prompt Optimization: Optimizing Structured Prompts with Section-Local Textual Gradients

author.name: Prith Sharma, Austin Z. Henley

entry.title: Policy-Guided Search on Tree-of-Thoughts for Efficient Problem Solving with Bounded Language Model Queries

author.name: Sumedh Pendurkar, Guni Sharon

entry.summary: Demonstrates how LLM token probabilities can serve as heuristics to guide Tree-of-Thoughts search, reducing thought evaluations under constrained computational budgets.

entry.title: MGPC: Multimodal Network for Generalizable Point Cloud Completion With Modality Dropout and Progressive Decoding

author.name: Jiangyuan Liu, Hongxuan Ma, Yuhao Zhao, Zhe Liu, Jian Wang, and Wei Zou

entry.summary: Proposes MGPC for multimodal point cloud completion integrating point clouds, RGB images, and text. Uses modality dropout and progressive decoding for improved generalization.

entry.title: I2E: From Image Pixels to Actionable Interactive Environments for Text-Guided Image Editing

author.name: Jinghan Yu, Junhao Xiao, Chenyu Zhu, Jiaming Li, Jia Li, HanMing Deng, Xirui Wang, Guoli Jia, Jianjun Li, Zhiyuan Ma, Xiang Bai, Bowen Zhou

entry.title: Detecting Semantic Backdoors in a Mystery Shopping Scenario

author.name: Arpad Berta, Gabor Danner, Istvan Hegedus, Mark Jelasity

entry.summary: Studies semantic backdoor detection in classification models under mystery shopping scenario where training data and recipe are known. Proposes detection methods for natural but out-of-distribution triggers.

entry.title: Logic Tensor Network-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network

author.name: Nijesh Upreti (The University of Edinburgh), Vaishak Belle (The University of Edinburgh)

entry.title: Rethinking Table Pruning in TableQA: From Sequential Revisions to Gold Trajectory-Supervised Parallel Search

entry.title: Atlas: Orchestrating Heterogeneous Models and Tools for Multi-Domain Complex Reasoning

entry.title: FocusUI: Efficient UI Grounding via Position-Preserving Visual Token Selection

entry.title: Layer-wise Positional Bias in Short-Context Language Modeling

author.name: Maryam Rahimi, Mahdi Nouri, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh

entry.summary: Introduces attribution-based framework analyzing layer-wise positional effects in short-context language modeling. Finds architecture-specific positional importance profiles that are stable across inputs.

author.name: Gabriel Benedict, Matthew Butler, Naved Merchant, Eetu Salama-Laine

entry.title: EASLT: Emotion-Aware Sign Language Translation

author.name: Guobin Tu and Di Weng

entry.title: Dual-Attention Heterogeneous GNN for Multi-robot Collaborative Area Search via Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhongtao Miao, Kaiyan Zhao, Masaaki Nagata, Yoshimasa Tsuruoka

entry.title: From Brute Force to Semantic Insight: Performance-Guided Data Transformation Design with LLMs

entry.title: Feature-Aware One-Shot Federated Learning via Hierarchical Token Sequences

author.name: Shudong Liu, Hanwen Zhang, Xiuling Wang, Yuesheng Zhu, Guibo Luo

entry.summary: FALCON introduces a one-shot federated learning framework using hierarchical token sequences and knowledge distillation to handle non-IID image data, particularly for medical imaging. It leverages pretrained visual encoders to compress images efficiently while reducing communication costs and privacy risks.

entry.title: ImLoc: Revisiting Visual Localization with Image-based Representation

author.name: Qianyu Guo, Jingrong Wu, Jieji Ren, Weifeng Ge, Wenqiang Zhang

entry.title: Discontinuous Galerkin finite element operator network for solving non-smooth PDEs

author.name: Lokendra Kumar, Neelesh S. Upadhye, Kannan Piedy

author.name: Guotao Li, Shaoyun Xu, Yuexing Hao, Yang Wang, Yuhui Sun

entry.summary: Proposes PC2P for distributed multi-agent path finding using personalized-enhanced communication based on dynamic graph topology and crowd perception for scaling across diverse environments.

entry.title: Weather-Aware Transformer for Real-Time Route Optimization in Drone-as-a-Service Operations

author.name: Kamal Mohamed, Lillian Wassim, Ali Hamdi, Khaled Shaban

author.name: Qingyun Zou, Jiahao Cui, Nuo Chen, Bingsheng He, Weng-Fai Wong

entry.summary: Presents MHRC-Bench, the first benchmark for multilingual hardware code completion at repository level, covering three hardware design coding styles with semantic labels from syntax tree analysis.

author.name: Dominik Macko

entry.summary: Examines multilingual LLM personalization capabilities across 10 languages covering 1080 prompt combinations and 16+ models. Studies both potential misuse for disinformation and beneficial applications.

entry.summary: ComfySearch is an agentic framework for generating functional ComfyUI pipelines through autonomous exploration and validation-guided workflow construction. Outperforms existing methods on complex creative tasks.

entry.title: Equivariant Neural Networks for Force-Field Models of Lattice Systems

author.name: Yunhao Fan and Gia-Wei Chern

entry.title: Shielded RecRL: Explanation Generation for Recommender Systems without Ranking Degradation

author.name: Ansh Tiwari and Ayush Chauhan

entry.title: Deep Vision-Based Framework for Coastal Flood Prediction Under Climate Change Impacts and Shoreline Adaptations

author.name: Areg Karapetyan, Aaron Chung Hin Chow, Samer Madanat

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning framework for predicting coastal flood hazards under climate change scenarios, addressing data scarcity and high-dimensional output challenges that plague traditional physics-based simulators.

entry.title: CaricatureGS: Exaggerating 3D Gaussian Splatting Faces With Gaussian Curvature

entry.title: Lunar Rover Cargo Transport: Mission Concept and Field Test

entry.title: Latent Geometry of Taste: Scalable Low-Rank Matrix Factorization

entry.title: SpatiaLoc: Leveraging Multi-Level Spatial Enhanced Descriptors for Cross-Modal Localization

entry.title: CSMCIR: CoT-Enhanced Symmetric Alignment with Memory Bank for Composed Image Retrieval

entry.summary: Proposes CSMCIR for composed image retrieval addressing representation space fragmentation where queries and targets use different encoders. Uses CoT-enhanced symmetric alignment with memory bank.

entry.title: Bridging OLAP and RAG: A Multidimensional Approach to the Design of Corpus Partitioning

author.name: Dario Maio and Stefano Rizzi

entry.summary: Proposes combining semantic clustering with multidimensional OLAP-style partitioning for large-scale RAG corpus organization, providing conceptual rationale beyond bottom-up similarity-driven approaches.

entry.title: Quantum vs. Classical Machine Learning: A Benchmark Study for Financial Prediction

author.name: Rehan Ahmad, Muhammad Kashif, Nouhaila Innan, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: Presents reproducible benchmarking framework comparing quantum ML with classical counterparts across financial tasks. Finds quantum approaches show gains when data structure and circuit design align.

entry.title: IDESplat: Iterative Depth Probability Estimation for Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Wei Long, Haifeng Wu, Shiyin Jiang, Jinhua Zhang, Xinchun Ji, Shuhang Gu

entry.summary: Proposes IDESplat for generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting with iterative depth probability estimation. Introduces Depth Probability Boosting Unit for stable depth estimation.

entry.title: Towards Safe Autonomous Driving: A Real-Time Motion Planning Algorithm on Embedded Hardware

author.name: Korbinian Moller, Glenn Johannes Tungka, Lucas J\"urgens, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: Presents a fail-operational motion planning system for autonomous vehicles using a lightweight sampling-based planner on automotive-grade embedded hardware with RTOS. Addresses safety gap when main planners fail.

entry.title: Modeling Behavioral Patterns in News Recommendations Using Fuzzy Neural Networks

author.name: Kevin Innerebner, Stephan Bartl, Markus Reiter-Haas, Elisabeth Lex

entry.summary: Transparent news recommender using fuzzy neural networks to learn human-readable rules from behavioral data. Evaluated on MIND and EB-NeRD datasets, enabling editors to understand consumption patterns.

entry.title: ToTMNet: FFT-Accelerated Toeplitz Temporal Mixing Network for Lightweight Remote Photoplethysmography

entry.title: An interactive toy model for exploring AI's effect on the labour market

author.name: CharlesD

entry.summary: Presents an interactive model for exploring how AI capabilities, adoption speed, compute costs, and induced demand affect human employment in cognitive tasks, examining scenarios from gradual automation to rapid displacement.

entry.title: Deontic Knowledge Graphs for Privacy Compliance in Multimodal Disaster Data Sharing

author.name: Kelvin Uzoma Echenim and Karuna Pande Joshi

entry.title: Investigation into respiratory sound classification for an imbalanced data set using hybrid LSTM-KAN architectures

author.name: Nithinkumar K.V, Anand R

entry.title: Stochastic Voronoi Ensembles for Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yang Cao

entry.summary: Proposes SVEAD for anomaly detection using ensemble random Voronoi diagrams. Addresses varying local densities without expensive neighbor searches or parameter tuning.

entry.title: Prompt Tuning without Labeled Samples for Zero-Shot Node Classification in Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Sethupathy Parameswaran, Suresh Sundaram, Yuan Fang

entry.title: Robust Physics Discovery from Highly Corrupted Data: A PINN Framework Applied to the Nonlinear Schr\"odinger Equation

author.name: Pietro de Oliveira Esteves

entry.title: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality of Ground Motion Data for Early Detection of Complex Catastrophic Slope Failure

author.name: Yuansan Liu, Antoinette Tordesillas, James Bailey

entry.title: MFC-RFNet: A Multi-scale Guided Rectified Flow Network for Radar Sequence Prediction

author.name: Wenjie Luo, Chuanhu Deng, Chaorong Li, Rongyao Deng and Qiang Yang

entry.title: Compact Example-Based Explanations for Language Models

author.name: Loris Schoenegger, Benjamin Roth

entry.title: XAI-LAW: A Logic Programming Tool for Modeling, Explaining, and Learning Legal Decisions

author.name: Agostino Dovier (DMIF - University of Udine), Talissa Dreossi (DMIF - University of Udine), Andrea Formisano (DMIF - University of Udine), Benedetta Strizzolo (DMIF - University of Udine)

entry.title: Bayesian Monocular Depth Refinement via Neural Radiance Fields

author.name: Arun Muthukkumar

entry.title: A Theoretical and Empirical Taxonomy of Imbalance in Binary Classification

entry.title: Experiments in News Bias Detection with Pre-Trained Neural Transformers

author.name: Tim Menzner, Jochen L. Leidner

entry.summary: Compares several pre-trained transformer language models on sentence-level news bias detection and sub-type classification, providing both quantitative and qualitative analysis of their performance.

entry.title: Tigrinya Number Verbalization: Rules, Algorithm, and Implementation

author.name: Fitsum Gaim, Issayas Tesfamariam

author.name: Anna Zavei-Boroda (1), J. Toby Minear (2), Kyle Harlow (1), Dusty Woods (1) and Christoffer Heckman (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science, University of Colorado Boulder, USA, (2) Cooperative Institute for Research in Environmental Science, University of Colorado Boulder, USA)

entry.summary: Evaluates commercial radar sensors for water level monitoring, achieving centimeter-scale precision with minimal calibration. Demonstrates practical low-cost solution for autonomous water monitoring using drones.

entry.title: Experimental Comparison of Light-Weight and Deep CNN Models Across Diverse Datasets

author.name: Md. Hefzul Hossain Papon, Shadman Rabby

entry.title: Investigating Knowledge Distillation Through Neural Networks for Protein Binding Affinity Prediction

entry.title: HyperCOD: The First Challenging Benchmark and Baseline for Hyperspectral Camouflaged Object Detection

entry.title: EvalBlocks: A Modular Pipeline for Rapidly Evaluating Foundation Models in Medical Imaging

author.name: Jan Tagscherer, Sarah de Boer, Lena Philipp, Fennie van der Graaf, Dr\'e Peeters, Joeran Bosma, Lars Leijten, Bogdan Obreja, Ewoud Smit, Alessa Hering

entry.title: Learning from Limited Labels: Transductive Graph Label Propagation for Indian Music Analysis

author.name: Parampreet Singh, Akshay Raina, Sayeedul Islam Sheikh, Vipul Arora

entry.title: Formally Explaining Decision Tree Models with Answer Set Programming

author.name: Akihiro Takemura (National Institute of Informatics, Tokyo, Japan), Masayuki Otani (Tokyo Institute of Technology, Tokyo, Japan), Katsumi Inoue (National Institute of Informatics, Tokyo, Japan)

author.name: Donghwan Lee, Byeongjin Kim, Geunhee Kim, Hyukjin Kwon, Nahyeon Maeng, Wooju Kim

entry.title: VietMed-MCQ: A Consistency-Filtered Data Synthesis Framework for Vietnamese Traditional Medicine Evaluation

author.name: Huynh Trung Kiet, Dao Sy Duy Minh, Nguyen Dinh Ha Duong, Le Hoang Minh Huy, Long Nguyen, and Dien Dinh

author.name: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen

author.name: Veronika Semmelrock, Gerhard Friedrich

entry.title: Bayes-PD: Exploring a Sequence to Binding Bayesian Neural Network model trained on Phage Display data

author.name: Ilann Amiaud-Plachy and Michael Blank and Oliver Bent and Sebastien Boyer

entry.title: Analyzing and Improving Cross-lingual Knowledge Transfer for Machine Translation

author.name: David Stap

entry.title: Quantum Classical Ridgelet Neural Network For Time Series Model

author.name: Bahadur Yadav, Sanjay Kumar Mohanty

entry.title: A Single-Loop Bilevel Deep Learning Method for Optimal Control of Obstacle Problems

author.name: Yongcun Song, Shangzhi Zeng, Jin Zhang, Lvgang Zhang

entry.title: LLM_annotate: A Python package for annotating and analyzing fiction characters

author.name: Hannes Rosenbusch

entry.title: A Comparative Study of 3D Model Acquisition Methods for Synthetic Data Generation of Agricultural Products

author.name: Steven Moonen, Rob Salaets, Kenneth Batstone, Abdellatif Bey-Temsamani, Nick Michiels

entry.summary: Compares 3D model acquisition methods (photogrammetry, NeRF, etc.) for generating synthetic training data in agriculture where CAD models are unavailable. Evaluates performance for training AI systems.

entry.title: Physically Consistent Machine Learning for Melting Temperature Prediction of Refractory High-Entropy Alloys

author.name: Mohd Hasnain

entry.summary: Develops XGBoost model for predicting melting temperature of high-entropy alloys using elemental properties while avoiding data leakage from thermodynamic descriptors.

entry.title: Defeasible Conditionals using Answer Set Programming

author.name: Racquel Dennison, Jesse Heyninck, Thomas Meyer

entry.summary: Presents declarative ASP definition for computing Rational Closure in the KLM framework for defeasible reasoning. Enables automatic minimal ranked model construction and entailment checking.

entry.title: Evaluating Small Decoder-Only Language Models for Grammar Correction and Text Simplification

author.name: Anthony Lamelas

entry.summary: Evaluates small decoder-only LLMs for grammar correction and text simplification on JFLEG and ASSET datasets. Finds SLMs underperform strong baselines and current LLMs.

entry.title: A low-complexity method for efficient depth-guided image deblurring

author.name: Ziyao Yi, Diego Valsesia, Tiziano Bianchi, Enrico Magli

entry.summary: Low-complexity neural network for depth-guided image deblurring using wavelet transform to separate structural details and reduce spatial redundancy. Achieves efficiency gains while maintaining quality.

entry.title: Symbolic Regression for Shared Expressions: Introducing Partial Parameter Sharing

author.name: Viktor Martinek and Roland Herzog

entry.summary: Extends symbolic regression to handle multiple categorical variables with intermediate levels of parameter sharing, enabling description of related phenomena with partially shared expressions.

entry.title: Embedding Autonomous Agents in Resource-Constrained Robotic Platforms

author.name: Negar Halakou, Juan F. Gutierrez, Ye Sun, Han Jiang, Xueming Wu, Yilun Song, and Andres Gomez

entry.summary: Demonstrates integration of AgentSpeak-based autonomous agents on resource-constrained two-wheeled robots, showing real-time decision-making with sub-millisecond reasoning cycles for maze navigation.

author.name: Joe Rogero

entry.summary: Provides recommendations for non-US individuals to contribute to AI safety through public technical governance research and national policy work, highlighting MIRI's remote fellowship opportunity.

entry.title: Clinical Data Goes MEDS? Let's OWL make sense of it

author.name: Alberto Marfoglia, Jong Ho Jhee, Adrien Coulet

entry.title: Unsupervised Modular Adaptive Region Growing and RegionMix Classification for Wind Turbine Segmentation

entry.summary: Examines whether AI chatbots can provide engineering coaching that develops mastery and tacit knowledge rather than just delivering information. Synthesizes perspectives from expertise research and philosophy of AI cognition in the context of AI-driven education.

entry.title: Improving Compactness and Reducing Ambiguity of CFIRE Rule-Based Explanations

author.name: Sebastian M\"uller, Tobias Schneider, Ruben Kemna, Vanessa Toborek

entry.summary: Proposes post-hoc pruning strategy for CFIRE rule-based explanations that removes rules with low contribution or conflicting coverage, reducing ambiguity while preserving fidelity.

entry.title: An Algorithmic Framework for Systematic Literature Reviews: A Case Study for Financial Narratives

author.name: Gabin Taibi and Joerg Osterrieder

entry.summary: Proposes algorithmic framework for systematic literature reviews using NLP, clustering, and interpretability tools. Demonstrates on financial narratives research area.

entry.title: FLNet: Flood-Induced Agriculture Damage Assessment using Super Resolution of Satellite Images

author.name: Sanidhya Ghosal, Anurag Sharma, Sushil Ghildiyal and Mukesh Saini

entry.title: A comprehensive review and analysis of different modeling approaches for financial index tracking problem

author.name: Vrinda Dhingra, Amita Sharma, Anubha Goel

entry.title: LLMberjack: Guided Trimming of Debate Trees for Multi-Party Conversation Creation

author.name: Leonardo Bottona, Nicol\`o Penzo, Bruno Lepri, Marco Guerini, Sara Tonelli

entry.title: Deep Learning-Based Image Recognition for Soft-Shell Shrimp Classification

author.name: Yun-Hao Zhang, I-Hsien Ting, Dario Liberona, Yun-Hsiu Liu, Kazunori Minetaki

entry.title: Shape Classification using Approximately Convex Segment Features

entry.title: Implementing the First-Order Logic of Here and There

entry.title: Research Summary: January 07, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on AI safety vulnerabilities and foundational model capabilities. A systematic study demonstrates extraction of copyrighted books from production LLMs using Best-of-N jailbreaking, raising significant legal implications. Critical stress-testing of Anthropic's SAE features reveals fragility in steering interventions, questioning interpretability claims.

  • NitroGen establishes a vision-action foundation model trained on 40K hours across 1,000+ games, demonstrating cross-game generalization
  • InternVLA-A1 unifies scene understanding, generation, and action via Mixture-of-Transformers for robotic manipulation
  • Logical Phase Transitions discovers abrupt reasoning collapse in LLMs beyond critical complexity thresholds
  • ViT spatial reasoning proven intrinsically limited due to circuit complexity bounds on non-solvable group problems

Practical contributions include agent-permissions.json for web agent governance and a striking one-shot RL finding showing single-sample training produces improvements rivaling full datasets. Jacob Steinhardt's Oversight Assistants framework addresses scalable human oversight of AI systems.
