entry.title: SOP: A Scalable Online Post-Training System for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Mingjie Pan, Siyuan Feng, Qinglin Zhang, Xinchen Li, Jianheng Song, Chendi Qu, Yi Wang, Chuankang Li, Ziyu Xiong, Zhi Chen, Yi Liu, Jianlan Luo

entry.summary: Introduces SOP, scalable online post-training system for VLA models enabling distributed, multi-task post-training directly in physical world with fleet of robots streaming on-policy experience to centralized cloud learner.

entry.title: Shallow-circuit Supervised Learning on a Quantum Processor

author.name: Luca Candelori, Swarnadeep Majumder, Antonio Mezzacapo, Javier Robledo Moreno, Kharen Musaelian, Santhanam Nagarajan, Sunil Pinnamaneni, Kunal Sharma, Dario Villani

entry.summary: Demonstrates practical quantum machine learning on actual quantum hardware using Hamiltonian-based method with Krylov quantum diagonalization. Shows effective learning on standard benchmarks with shallow circuits.

entry.title: A large-scale nanocrystal database with aligned synthesis and properties enabling generative inverse design

author.name: Kai Gu, Yingping Liang, Senliang Peng, Aotian Guo, Haizheng Zhong, Ying Fu

entry.summary: Large-scale Nanocrystal Synthesis-Property database constructed using NanoExtractor LLM with augmentation strategies. Enables generative inverse design of nanocrystals from literature extraction.

entry.title: Polynomial Convergence of Riemannian Diffusion Models

author.name: Xingyu Xu, Ziyi Zhang, Yorie Nakahira, Guannan Qu, Yuejie Chi

entry.summary: Proves polynomial convergence rates for Riemannian diffusion models in sampling error under Wasserstein distance, improving upon prior work requiring exponentially small step sizes. Important for manifold-constrained data generation.

entry.title: Netflix Artwork Personalization via LLM Post-training

author.name: Hyunji Nam, Sejoon Oh, Emma Kong, Yesu Feng, Moumita Bhattacharya

entry.summary: Explores using LLM post-training for personalized artwork recommendations at Netflix. Addresses user heterogeneity by identifying different themes and tones in titles that appeal to different viewers.

entry.title: Sample-Efficient Neurosymbolic Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Celeste Veronese, Daniele Meli, Alessandro Farinelli

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic deep RL approach integrating background symbolic knowledge to improve sample efficiency. Transfers partial policies from simple domains as logical rules for complex settings.

entry.title: RAL2M: Retrieval Augmented Learning-To-Match Against Hallucination in Compliance-Guaranteed Service Systems

author.name: Mengze Hong, Di Jiang, Jiangtao Wen, Zhiyang Su, Yawen Li, Yanjie Sun, Guan Wang, Chen Jason Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RAL2M that repositions LLMs as query-response matching judges instead of generators to eliminate hallucination. Uses query-adaptive latent ensemble for calibrated consensus.

entry.title: Correct, Concise and Complete: Multi-stage Training For Adaptive Reasoning

author.name: Nathana\"el Carraz Rakotonirina, Ren Pang, Neha Anna John, Michael Bohlke-Schneider, Momchil Hardalov

entry.summary: Addresses 'overthinking' in LLM chain-of-thought through multi-stage training combining supervised fine-tuning (rejection sampling or trace reformatting) with RL using adaptive length penalty that penalizes tokens after first correct answer.

entry.title: Decoupling the Effect of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning: A Human Label Variation Perspective

author.name: Beiduo Chen, Tiancheng Hu, Caiqi Zhang, Robert Litschko, Anna Korhonen, Barbara Plank

entry.summary: Investigates how Chain-of-Thought affects model ability to capture human label variation. Discovers 'decoupled mechanism': CoT content determines accuracy (99% variance) while model priors govern distributional ranking (80%+).

entry.title: MemRL: Self-Evolving Agents via Runtime Reinforcement Learning on Episodic Memory

author.name: Shengtao Zhang, Jiaqian Wang, Ruiwen Zhou, Junwei Liao, Yuchen Feng, Weinan Zhang, Ying Wen, Zhiyu Li, Feiyu Xiong, Yutao Qi, Bo Tang, Muning Wen

entry.summary: MemRL enables agent self-evolution through reinforcement learning on episodic memory, separating frozen LLM reasoning from evolving memory. Uses two-phase retrieval mechanism to avoid noise from passive semantic matching.

entry.title: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents

author.name: Chenglin Yu, Yuchen Wang, Songmiao Wang, Hongxia Yang, Ming Li

entry.summary: InfiAgent maintains bounded reasoning context for arbitrary-length tasks by externalizing state to file-centric abstraction. Reconstructs context from workspace snapshots plus recent action window, competitive with larger models on long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: How AI Is Learning to Think in Secret

author.name: Nicholas Andresen

entry.summary: Discusses 'thinkish' and 'neuralese' - incomprehensible internal reasoning emerging in AI systems like GPT-o3. Traces history from 4chan chain-of-thought discovery to current concerns about unreadable AI reasoning.

entry.title: Exploring Reinforcement Learning Effects on Chain-of-Thought Legibility

author.name: Julian H

entry.summary: SPAR project studying how RL training pressures (temperature, KL penalties, length budgets) affect chain-of-thought legibility. High temperature training produces strange tokens but reasoning remains largely legible alongside gibberish.

entry.title: Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) for High-Frequency Limit Order Book Forecasting: Efficiency, Interpretability, and Alpha Decay

author.name: Ahmad Makinde

entry.summary: Proposes Temporal KAN (T-KAN) replacing LSTM weights with learnable B-spline activations for limit order book forecasting. Achieves 19.1% improvement in F1 at longer horizons and 132% returns vs baseline.

entry.title: Normalized Conditional Mutual Information Surrogate Loss for Deep Neural Classifiers

author.name: Linfeng Ye and Zhixiang Chi and Konstantinos N. Plataniotis and En-hui Yang

entry.summary: Proposes normalized conditional mutual information (NCMI) as a drop-in replacement for cross-entropy loss in DNN training. Achieves 2.77% top-1 accuracy improvement on ImageNet with ResNet-50.

entry.title: LongDA: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Document Data Analysis

author.name: Yiyang Li, Zheyuan Zhang, Tianyi Ma, Zehong Wang, Keerthiram Murugesan, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Introduces LongDA benchmark evaluating LLM agents on long-document data analysis tasks requiring navigation of heterogeneous documentation, with 505 queries from 17 U.S. national surveys.

entry.title: ReTreVal: Reasoning Tree with Validation -- A Hybrid Framework for Enhanced LLM Multi-Step Reasoning

author.name: Abhishek HS, Pavan C Shekar, Arpit Jain, and Ashwanth Krishnan

entry.summary: Proposes ReTreVal, a hybrid framework combining Tree-of-Thoughts exploration, self-refinement, LLM-based critique scoring, and reflexion memory for bounded multi-step reasoning.

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Large-Scale Counting in LLMs through a System-2 Strategy

author.name: Hosein Hasani, Mohammadali Banayeeanzade, Ali Nafisi, Sadegh Mohammadian, Fatemeh Askari, Mobin Bagherian, Amirmohammad Izadi, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah

entry.summary: Investigates why LLMs fail at counting tasks despite strong math performance, proposing System-2 inspired decomposition strategy. Uses causal mediation analysis to identify how latent counts are computed and stored in final token positions.

entry.title: Discovering and Causally Validating Emotion-Sensitive Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models

author.name: Xiutian Zhao, Bj\"orn Schuller, Berrak Sisman

entry.summary: First neuron-level interpretability study of emotion-sensitive neurons in large audio-language models, providing causal evidence via inference-time interventions showing emotion-specific ablation effects across Qwen2.5-Omni, Kimi-Audio, and Audio Flamingo 3.

entry.title: Multi-Distribution Robust Conformal Prediction

author.name: Yuqi Yang, Ying Jin

entry.summary: Proposes max-p aggregation scheme for conformal prediction valid across multiple heterogeneous distributions. Proves optimality of the scheme and provides methods for score calibration across distributions.

entry.title: WebCoderBench: Benchmarking Web Application Generation with Comprehensive and Interpretable Evaluation Metrics

author.name: Chenxu Liu, Yingjie Fu, Wei Yang, Ying Zhang, Tao Xie

entry.summary: WebCoderBench benchmark with 1,572 real user requirements for web app generation covering diverse modalities and expression styles with 24 fine-grained evaluation metrics.

entry.title: AbductiveMLLM: Boosting Visual Abductive Reasoning Within MLLMs

author.name: Boyu Chang, Qi Wang, Xi Guo, Zhixiong Nan, Yazhou Yao, Tianfei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes AbductiveMLLM to improve visual abductive reasoning by combining REASONER (verbal) and IMAGINER (visual) components inspired by human cognition. Generates and validates hypotheses through cross-modal alignment.

entry.title: Linear Script Representations in Speech Foundation Models Enable Zero-Shot Transliteration

author.name: Ryan Soh-Eun Shim, Kwanghee Choi, Kalvin Chang, Ming-Hao Hsu, Florian Eichin, Zhizheng Wu, Alane Suhr, Michael A. Hedderich, David Harwath, David R. Mortensen, Barbara Plank

entry.summary: Shows that script is linearly encoded in multilingual speech model activations and can be modified at inference for zero-shot transliteration. Enables script control for unconventional language-script pairings.

entry.title: Mechanistic Knobs in LLMs: Retrieving and Steering High-Order Semantic Features via Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Ruikang Zhang, Shuo Wang, Qi Su

entry.summary: Develops SAE-based framework for retrieving and steering high-order semantic features (demonstrated on Big Five personality traits) using contrastive retrieval pipeline combining statistical activation analysis and generation-based validation.

entry.title: Do LLMs Encode Functional Importance of Reasoning Tokens?

author.name: Janvijay Singh and Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs encode functional importance of reasoning tokens through greedy pruning that removes tokens minimally degrading likelihood. Evaluates pruned reasoning in distillation framework to measure actual vs perceived importance.

entry.title: Language Hierarchization Provides the Optimal Solution to Human Working Memory Limits

author.name: Luyao Chen, Weibo Gao, Junjie Wu, Jinshan Wu, Angela D. Friederici

entry.summary: Shows that hierarchical language processing optimally matches human working memory capacity constraints. Uses maximum likelihood estimation to demonstrate that hierarchical structure minimizes cognitive load compared to linear processing.

entry.title: PCEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Physical Computing Capabilities of Large Language Models

author.name: Inpyo Song, Eunji Jeon, Jangwon Lee

entry.summary: PCEval benchmark for LLM physical computing capabilities, evaluating code generation for hardware interaction with fully automatic evaluation of logical and physical aspects.

entry.title: GEM-Style Constraints for PEFT with Dual Gradient Projection in LoRA

author.name: Brian Tekmen, Jason Yin, Qianqian Tong

entry.summary: Introduces I-GEM, adapting Gradient Episodic Memory for continual learning within LoRA subspace, achieving GEM-like stability with orders of magnitude lower projection overhead. Maintains accuracy while reducing computation.

entry.title: MovieRecapsQA: A Multimodal Open-Ended Video Question-Answering Benchmark

author.name: Shaden Shaar and Bradon Thymes and Sirawut Chaixanien and Claire Cardie and Bharath Hariharan

entry.summary: Introduces MovieRecapsQA, an open-ended multimodal VideoQA benchmark using movie recap videos with synchronized visual and textual modalities, providing 8.2K QA pairs with reference-free verification.

entry.title: SWaRL: Safeguard Code Watermarking via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Neusha Javidnia, Ruisi Zhang, Ashish Kundu, Farinaz Koushanfar

entry.summary: Presents SWaRL, a watermarking framework for code LLMs using reinforcement learning with compiler feedback to ensure functional correctness while maintaining watermark detectability.

entry.title: GRRE: Leveraging G-Channel Removed Reconstruction Error for Robust Detection of AI-Generated Images

author.name: Shuman He, Xiehua Li, Xioaju Yang, Yang Xiong, Keqin Li

entry.summary: Proposes GRRE method for detecting AI-generated images based on reconstruction error differences when the green channel is removed, achieving strong generalization to unseen generative models.

entry.title: Stratified Hazard Sampling: Minimal-Variance Event Scheduling for CTMC/DTMC Discrete Diffusion and Flow Models

author.name: Seunghwan Jang, SooJean Han

entry.summary: Proposes Stratified Hazard Sampling for discrete diffusion models to reduce variance in token replacement timing. Addresses under-editing and over-editing failure modes in CTMC/DTMC-based generation.

entry.title: Batch-of-Thought: Cross-Instance Learning for Enhanced LLM Reasoning

author.name: Xuan Yang, Furong Jia, Roy Xie, Xiong Xi, Hengwei Bian, Jian Li, Monica Agrawal

entry.summary: Introduces Batch-of-Thought (BoT), a training-free method that processes related LLM queries jointly to enable cross-instance learning through comparative analysis, shared reasoning templates, and consistency checks. Implements via multi-agent reflection architecture.

entry.title: Text-Guided Layer Fusion Mitigates Hallucination in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Chenchen Lin, Sanbao Su, Rachel Luo, Yuxiao Chen, Yan Wang, Marco Pavone, Fei Miao

entry.summary: Introduces TGIF, text-guided layer fusion treating vision encoder layers as depth-wise experts with query-dependent mixing predictions for hallucination mitigation in MLLMs.

entry.title: Maximizing Local Entropy Where It Matters: Prefix-Aware Localized LLM Unlearning

author.name: Naixin Zhai, Pengyang Shao, Binbin Zheng, Fei Shen, Long Bai, Xun Yang

entry.summary: PALU framework for LLM unlearning maximizes local entropy only in prefix tokens and top-k logits rather than globally. Shows suppressing sensitive prefix alone severs causal generation while preserving utility.

entry.title: TWIST: Training-free and Label-free Short Text Clustering through Iterative Vector Updating with LLMs

author.name: I-Fan Lin, Faegheh Hasibi, Suzan Verberne

entry.summary: TWIST enables training-free, label-free short text clustering using iterative vector updating with LLM guidance. Achieves competitive results without assuming known cluster count or labels.

entry.title: Socially-Aware Recommender Systems Mitigate Opinion Clusterization

author.name: Lukas Sch\"uepp, Carmen Amo Alonso, Florian D\"orfler, Giulia De Pasquale

entry.summary: Develops social network-aware recommender system that accounts for user-creator feedback loops and exploits social network topology to mitigate opinion polarization and filter bubbles.

entry.title: Causal Manifold Fairness: Enforcing Geometric Invariance in Representation Learning

author.name: Vidhi Rathore

entry.summary: Introduces Causal Manifold Fairness (CMF) bridging causal inference and geometric deep learning, learning representations where Riemannian geometry remains invariant under counterfactual interventions on sensitive attributes.

entry.title: Time-Aware Synthetic Control

author.name: Saeyoung Rho, Cyrus Illick, Samhitha Narasipura, Alberto Abadie, Daniel Hsu, Vishal Misra

entry.summary: Proposes Time-Aware Synthetic Control (TASC) using state-space models with Kalman filtering for causal inference with time-series panel data. Better handles temporal trends than existing methods treating time indices as interchangeable.

entry.title: Physical Transformer

author.name: Tao Xu, Zhixin Hu, Li Luo, Momiao Xiong

entry.summary: Physical Transformer coupling transformer computation with geometric representation and physical dynamics. Models attention as interacting spins with Hamiltonians on learned Neural Differential Manifold.

entry.title: Multi-scale Graph Autoregressive Modeling: Molecular Property Prediction via Next Token Prediction

author.name: Zhuoyang Jiang, Yaosen Min, Peiran Jin, Lei Chen

entry.summary: Presents Connection-Aware Motif Sequencing (CamS) that enables decoder-only Transformers to learn molecular graphs via next-token prediction by serializing graphs into structure-rich causal sequences.

entry.title: Fact-Checking with Large Language Models via Probabilistic Certainty and Consistency

author.name: Haoran Wang, Maryam Khalid, Qiong Wu, Jian Gao, Cheng Cao

entry.summary: Proposes PCC framework for LLM fact-checking that estimates factual confidence by modeling probabilistic certainty and consistency, deciding adaptively whether to use internal knowledge or retrieval.

entry.title: Uni-FinLLM: A Unified Multimodal Large Language Model with Modular Task Heads for Micro-Level Stock Prediction and Macro-Level Systemic Risk Assessment

author.name: Gongao Zhang, Haijiang Zeng, Lu Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes Uni-FinLLM, a unified multimodal LLM with modular task heads for financial analysis spanning stock prediction, credit risk, and systemic risk assessment across micro to macro scales.

entry.title: Learning to Nudge: A Scalable Barrier Function Framework for Safe Robot Interaction in Dense Clutter

author.name: Haixin Jin, Nikhil Uday Shinde, Soofiyan Atar, Hongzhan Yu, Dylan Hirsch, Sicun Gao, Michael C. Yip, Sylvia Herbert

entry.summary: Introduces Dense Contact Barrier Functions for safe robot manipulation in clutter, learning composable object-centric functions that bypass computational complexity of multi-object dynamics modeling.

entry.title: CREAM: Continual Retrieval on Dynamic Streaming Corpora with Adaptive Soft Memory

author.name: HuiJeong Son, Hyeongu Kang, Sunho Kim, Subeen Ho, SeongKu Kang, Dongha Lee, Susik Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes CREAM for continual retrieval on dynamic data streams using self-supervised learning with adaptive soft memory that captures evolving semantics without ground-truth labels.

entry.title: CAMO: Category-Agnostic 3D Motion Transfer from Monocular 2D Videos

author.name: Taeyeon Kim, Youngju Na, Jumin Lee, Minhyuk Sung, Sung-Eui Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes CAMO, a category-agnostic framework for transferring motion from monocular 2D videos to diverse 3D meshes without templates, using morphology-parameterized articulated 3D Gaussian splatting.

entry.title: Soft Responsive Materials Enhance Humanoid Safety

author.name: Chunzheng Wang, Yiyuan Zhang, Annan Tang, Ziqiu Zeng, Haoran Chen, Quan Gao, Zixuan Zhuang, Boyu Li, Zhilin Xiong, Aoqian Zhang, Ce Hao, Siyuan Luo, Tongyang Zhao, Cecilia Laschi, Fan Shi

entry.summary: Introduces a soft-rigid co-design framework for humanoid safety using non-Newtonian fluid-based materials that stiffen on impact. Applied to 42kg humanoid enabling repeated falls without hardware damage.

entry.title: TA-Prompting: Enhancing Video Large Language Models for Dense Video Captioning via Temporal Anchors

author.name: Wei-Yuan Cheng, Kai-Po Chang, Chi-Pin Huang, Fu-En Yang, and Yu-Chiang Frank Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TA-Prompting for dense video captioning using temporal anchors to improve VideoLLM event boundary localization. Includes event coherent sampling for handling arbitrary numbers of events.

entry.title: Reliability-Aware Adaptive Self-Consistency for Efficient Sampling in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Junseok Kim, Nakyeong Yang, Kyungmin Min, Kyomin Jung

entry.summary: Proposes ReASC that reframes adaptive self-consistency from response counting to evidence sufficiency, using response-level confidence for principled aggregation. Operates in two stages: single-sample decision and reliability-aware accumulation.

entry.title: ATLAS: Adaptive Test-Time Latent Steering with External Verifiers for Enhancing LLMs Reasoning

author.name: Tuc Nguyen, Thai Le

entry.summary: Proposes ATLAS for adaptive test-time latent steering using external lightweight verifier that predicts reasoning quality from intermediate hidden states and adaptively selects steering decisions per-example.

entry.title: Empowering Reliable Visual-Centric Instruction Following in MLLMs

author.name: Weilei He, Feng Ju, Zhiyuan Fan, Rui Min, Minhao Cheng, Yi R. Fung

entry.summary: VC-IFEval benchmark evaluates multimodal LLM instruction-following under vision-dependent constraints, addressing gap where prior benchmarks focus only on textual instructions. Systematically tests adherence to visual constraints.

entry.title: UltraLogic: Enhancing LLM Reasoning through Large-Scale Data Synthesis and Bipolar Float Reward

author.name: Yile Liu, Yixian Liu, Zongwei Li, Yufei Huang, Xinhua Feng, Zhichao Hu, Jinglu Hu, Jianfeng Yan, Fengzong Lian, Yuhong Liu

entry.summary: UltraLogic framework for LLM reasoning decouples logical problem cores from natural language, enabling automated high-quality data generation. Introduces bipolar float rewards to address sparse binary reward limitations in RLVR.

entry.title: Critic-Guided Reinforcement Unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion

author.name: Mykola Vysotskyi, Zahar Kohut, Mariia Shpir, Taras Rumezhak, Volodymyr Karpiv

entry.summary: Presents RL framework for diffusion unlearning treating denoising as sequential decision process. Introduces timestep-aware critic with noisy-step rewards for better credit assignment than sparse end-of-trajectory rewards.

entry.title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents

author.name: Dongming Jiang, Yi Li, Guanpeng Li and Bingzhe Li

entry.summary: MAGMA represents memory items across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs for LLM agents. Retrieval is policy-guided traversal enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction.

entry.title: STReasoner: Empowering LLMs for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Time Series via Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juntong Ni, Shiyu Wang, Ming Jin, Qi He, Wei Jin

entry.summary: Introduces ST-Bench for spatio-temporal reasoning in time series with four core tasks. STReasoner empowers LLMs to integrate time series, graph structure, and text via spatial-aware reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Do we need sparsity afterall?

author.name: Giuseppe Birardi

entry.summary: Finds that ranking neurons by activation difference times gradient identifies causally important neurons with higher signal-to-noise ratios. These neurons show interpretable patterns while dense population remains polysemantic.

entry.title: Tree of Preferences for Diversified Recommendation

author.name: Hanyang Yuan, Ning Tang, Tongya Zheng, Jiarong Xu, Xintong Hu, Renhong Huang, Shunyu Liu, Jiacong Hu, Jiawei Chen, Mingli Song

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to infer diverse user preferences as Tree of Preferences for diversified recommendations, addressing data bias that obscures underexplored preferences.

entry.title: TAP-ViTs: Task-Adaptive Pruning for On-Device Deployment of Vision Transformers

author.name: Zhibo Wang, Zuoyuan Zhang, Xiaoyi Pang, Qile Zhang, Xuanyi Hao, Shuguo Zhuo, Peng Sun

entry.summary: TAP-ViTs enables task-adaptive Vision Transformer pruning for mobile deployment without device-local fine-tuning, preserving privacy while generating device-customized models.

entry.title: Joint Encoding of KV-Cache Blocks for Scalable LLM Serving

author.name: Joseph Kampeas and Emir Haleva

entry.summary: Proposes joint encoding of KV-cache blocks that fuses similar blocks across requests and input chunks into shared representations while preserving standard cache structure, achieving up to 4.38x memory reduction.

entry.title: Sampling non-log-concave densities via Hessian-free high-resolution dynamics

author.name: Xiaoyu Wang, Yingli Wang, Lingjiong Zhu

entry.summary: Extends Hessian-free high-resolution dynamics theory to non-convex sampling problems, bridging gap between theory (restricted to convex) and practice (works for non-convex). Provides convergence guarantees under dissipativity assumptions.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Learning from Noisy and Incomplete Data

author.name: Juli\'an Tachella, Mike Davies

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on self-supervised learning methods for inverse problems where ground-truth data is unavailable. Covers methods learning from noisy and incomplete observations across various applications.

entry.title: TextBridgeGNN: Pre-training Graph Neural Network for Cross-Domain Recommendation via Text-Guided Transfer

author.name: Yiwen Chen, Yiqing Wu, Huishi Luo, Fuzhen Zhuang, Deqing Wang

entry.summary: TextBridgeGNN enables cross-domain GNN recommendation transfer by using text as bridge between domain-specific ID spaces. Pre-training framework addresses non-transferability of ID embeddings.

entry.title: The Vibe-Check Protocol: Quantifying Cognitive Offloading in AI Programming

author.name: Aizierjiang Aiersilan

entry.summary: Proposes Vibe-Check Protocol framework to investigate whether 'Vibe Coding' (LLM-assisted programming) is beneficial for learning, examining cognitive offloading vs acceleration effects.

entry.title: VocalBridge: Latent Diffusion-Bridge Purification for Defeating Perturbation-Based Voiceprint Defenses

author.name: Maryam Abbasihafshejani, AHM Nazmus Sakib, Murtuza Jadliwala

entry.summary: VocalBridge uses latent diffusion-bridge purification to defeat perturbation-based voiceprint defenses, recovering authentic voice characteristics for cloning despite protective perturbations.

entry.title: PatchAlign3D: Local Feature Alignment for Dense 3D Shape understanding

author.name: Souhail Hadgi, Bingchen Gong, Ramana Sundararaman, Emery Pierson, Lei Li, Peter Wonka, Maks Ovsjanikov

entry.summary: Presents an encoder-only 3D model that produces language-aligned patch-level features directly from point clouds, addressing the poor local part-level reasoning of current 3D foundation models. Avoids expensive multi-view inference pipelines.

entry.title: Textual Explanations and Their Evaluations for Reinforcement Learning Policy

author.name: Ahmad Terra, Mohit Ahmed, Rafia Inam, Elena Fersman, Martin T\"orngren

entry.summary: Presents an XRL framework generating textual explanations for RL policies, converting them to transparent rules, and evaluating correctness. Uses LLMs with clustering and voting mechanisms.

entry.title: Shallow- and Deep-fake Image Manipulation Localization Using Vision Mamba and Guided Graph Neural Network

author.name: Junbin Zhang, Hamid Reza Tohidypour, Yixiao Wang, Panos Nasiopoulos

entry.summary: Proposes Vision Mamba network combined with guided Graph Neural Network for detecting both shallow-fake and deep-fake image manipulations, addressing the gap of methods handling both types.

entry.title: Annealed Langevin Posterior Sampling (ALPS): A Rapid Algorithm for Image Restoration with Multiscale Energy Models

author.name: Jyothi Rikhab Chand and Mathews Jacob

entry.summary: Introduces ALPS algorithm for image restoration that distills diffusion models into multi-scale energy-based models, enabling efficient MAP inference with compositional structure.

entry.title: DreamLoop: Controllable Cinemagraph Generation from a Single Photograph

author.name: Aniruddha Mahapatra, Long Mai, Cusuh Ham, Feng Liu

entry.summary: Presents DreamLoop for controllable cinemagraph generation from single photographs using video diffusion models, trained on two objectives without cinemagraph training data.

entry.title: When Do Tools and Planning Help LLMs Think? A Cost- and Latency-Aware Benchmark

author.name: Subha Ghoshal and Ali Al-Bustami

entry.summary: Benchmarks LLM planning and tool use on event-centric QA and persuasive generation tasks, comparing one-shot baselines against plan-execute-replan agents with cost and latency analysis.

entry.title: Learning User Preferences Through Interaction for Long-Term Collaboration

author.name: Shuhaib Mehri, Priyanka Kargupta, Tal August, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Introduces MultiSessionCollab benchmark for evaluating how agents learn user preferences across multiple sessions, proposing memory-equipped agents that improve collaboration quality over time.

entry.title: Scaling Laws of Machine Learning for Optimal Power Flow

author.name: Xinyi Liu, Xuan He, and Yize Chen

entry.summary: Presents first systematic scaling study for ML-based optimal power flow across data scale and compute scale, quantifying relationships between training data, model complexity, and accuracy.

entry.title: EComStage: Stage-wise and Orientation-specific Benchmarking for Large Language Models in E-commerce

author.name: Kaiyan Zhao, Zijie Meng, Zheyong Xie, Jin Duan, Yao Hu, Zuozhu Liu, Shaosheng Cao

entry.summary: Proposes EComStage, a benchmark evaluating LLM agents on e-commerce tasks across three reasoning stages: Perception, Planning, and Action. Includes human-annotated samples across seven representative tasks.

entry.title: AnyDepth: Depth Estimation Made Easy

author.name: Zeyu Ren, Zeyu Zhang, Wukai Li, Qingxiang Liu, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes AnyDepth, a lightweight framework for zero-shot monocular depth estimation using DINOv3 encoder with a Simple Depth Transformer (SDT) decoder. Achieves higher accuracy with reduced computational overhead.

entry.title: EarthVL: A Progressive Earth Vision-Language Understanding and Generation Framework

author.name: Junjue Wang, Yanfei Zhong, Zihang Chen, Zhuo Zheng, Ailong Ma, Liangpei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EarthVL, a progressive vision-language framework for remote sensing including EarthVLSet dataset (10.9k images, 761.5k text pairs) and EarthVLNet for semantic segmentation, relational reasoning, and scene understanding.

entry.title: StableDPT: Temporal Stable Monocular Video Depth Estimation

author.name: Ivan Sobko, Hayko Riemenschneider, Markus Gross, Christopher Schroers

entry.summary: Proposes StableDPT for temporally stable monocular video depth estimation using temporal layers with cross-attention to integrate keyframe information across entire video sequences.

entry.title: Warm-Starting Collision-Free Model Predictive Control With Object-Centric Diffusion

author.name: Arthur Haffemayer, Alexandre Chapin, Armand Jordana, Krzysztof Wojciechowski, Florent Lamiraux, Nicolas Mansard, Vladimir Petrik

entry.summary: Proposes combining diffusion-based trajectory generation with collision-aware MPC using object-centric scene representations. Diffusion model provides warm-starts for efficient motion planning in cluttered environments.

entry.title: ChemBART: A Pre-trained BART Model Assisting Organic Chemistry Analysis

author.name: Kenan Li, Yijian Zhang, Jin Wang, Haipeng Gan, Zeying Sun, Xiaoguang Lei, Hao Dong

entry.summary: Introduces ChemBART, a SMILES-based language model pre-trained on chemical reactions for multiple downstream tasks. Achieves 'one model, one pre-training, multiple tasks' for chemistry.

entry.title: Zoom-IQA: Image Quality Assessment with Reliable Region-Aware Reasoning

author.name: Guoqiang Liang, Jianyi Wang, Zhonghua Wu, Shangchen Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Zoom-IQA for image quality assessment using VLMs with uncertainty awareness, region reasoning, and iterative refinement. Two-stage training with SFT and GRPO for reliable reasoning.

entry.title: Parameter-Robust MPPI for Safe Online Learning of Unknown Parameters

author.name: Matti Vahs, Jaeyoun Choi, Niklas Schmid, Jana Tumova and Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Proposes Parameter-Robust MPPI control that integrates online parameter learning with probabilistic safety constraints using Stein Variational Gradient Descent and Conformal Prediction. Maintains safety while improving performance as parameters are learned.

entry.title: From Memorization to Creativity: LLM as a Designer of Novel Neural-Architectures

author.name: Waleed Khalid, Dmitry Ignatov, Radu Timofte

entry.summary: Places code-oriented LLM in closed-loop synthesis framework through 22 supervised fine-tuning cycles to design novel neural architectures, using low-fidelity signals and MinHash-Jaccard filtering for structural novelty.

entry.title: Audit Me If You Can: Query-Efficient Active Fairness Auditing of Black-Box LLMs

author.name: David Hartmann, Lena Pohlmann, Lelia Hanslik, Noah Gie{\ss}ing, Bettina Berendt, Pieter Delobelle

entry.summary: Introduces BAFA for query-efficient fairness auditing of black-box LLMs, maintaining version space of surrogate models and computing uncertainty intervals for fairness metrics via constrained empirical risk minimization with active query selection.

entry.title: Unified Thinker: A General Reasoning Modular Core for Image Generation

author.name: Sashuai Zhou, Qiang Zhou, Jijin Hu, Hanqing Yang, Yue Cao, Junpeng Ma, Yinchao Ma, Jun Song, Tiezheng Ge, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Unified Thinker, task-agnostic reasoning architecture for image generation as unified planning core, decoupling explicit reasoning from visual execution to close reasoning-execution gap in open-source models.

entry.title: Beyond one-hot encoding? Journey into compact encoding for large multi-class segmentation

author.name: Aaron Kujawa, Thomas Booth, Tom Vercauteren

entry.summary: Explores binary encoding alternatives to one-hot encoding for multi-class medical image segmentation to reduce memory from linear to logarithmic in class count. Finds maintaining SOTA performance is challenging.

entry.title: A Dynamic Retrieval-Augmented Generation System with Selective Memory and Remembrance

author.name: Okan Bursa

entry.summary: Adaptive RAG Memory (ARM) framework with dynamic memory using selective remembrance and decay inspired by cognitive consolidation. Achieves near SOTA retrieval with only 22M parameters.

entry.title: DNACHUNKER: Learnable Tokenization for DNA Language Models

author.name: Taewon Kim, Jihwan Shin, Hyomin Kim, Youngmok Jung, Jonhoon Lee, Won-Chul Lee, Insu Han, Sungsoo Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes DNACHUNKER with learnable dynamic DNA tokenization trained as masked language model, segmenting sequences into variable-length chunks that are resilient to mutations and allocate detail to functional regions.

entry.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Semantic-level Internal Reasoning Graph

author.name: Jianpeng Hu, Yanzeng Li, Jialun Zhong, Wenfa Qi, Lei Zou

entry.summary: Proposes semantic-level internal reasoning graph for RAG faithfulness hallucination detection by extending layer-wise relevance propagation to semantic level, constructing attribution-based graphs of model's internal reasoning process.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy LLM-Based Recommendation via Rationale Integration

author.name: Chung Park, Taesan Kim, Hyeongjun Yun, Dongjoon Hong, Junui Hong, Kijung Park, MinCheol Cho, Mira Myong, Jihoon Oh, Min sung Choi

entry.summary: LLM-based recommender that generates logically grounded rationales before recommendations using chain-of-thought. Creates self-annotated rationale dataset and rationale-first instruction tuning.

entry.title: Spiking Heterogeneous Graph Attention Networks

author.name: Buqing Cao, Qian Peng, Xiang Xie, Liang Chen, Min Shi, Jianxun Liu

entry.summary: SpikingHAN combines spiking neural networks with heterogeneous graph attention for energy-efficient graph learning. Addresses memory and compute limitations of standard HGNNs.

entry.title: CutisAI: Deep Learning Framework for Automated Dermatology and Cancer Screening

author.name: Rohit Kaushik and Eva Kaushik

entry.summary: Presents CBDC framework for dermatology combining Statistical Learning Theory, Topological Data Analysis, and Bayesian Conformal Inference for cancer screening with calibrated uncertainty estimates.

entry.title: Credit Assignment via Neural Manifold Noise Correlation

author.name: Byungwoo Kang, Maceo Richards, Bernardo Sabatini

entry.summary: Proposes neural manifold noise correlation (NMNC) for biologically plausible credit assignment, restricting perturbations to neural manifold for efficient gradient estimation.

entry.title: AWARE-US: Benchmark for Preference-Aware Resolution in Tool-Calling Agents

author.name: Mehmet Kurmaz

entry.summary: Introduces AWARE-US benchmark for preference-aware query repair in tool-calling agents, proposing LLM-based methods for inferring relative constraint importance when queries are infeasible.

entry.title: Learning from Prompt itself: the Hierarchical Attribution Prompt Optimization

author.name: Dongyu Chen, Jian Ma, Xianpeng Zhang, Lei Zhang, Haonan Lu, Chen Chen, Chuangchuang Wang and Kai Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchical Attribution Prompt Optimization that learns from prompt structure itself to prevent prompt drift during optimization, improving interpretability and maintaining performance on solved tasks.

entry.title: ClearAIR: A Human-Visual-Perception-Inspired All-in-One Image Restoration

author.name: Xu Zhang, Huan Zhang, Guoli Wang, Qian Zhang, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ClearAIR for all-in-one image restoration inspired by human visual perception. Uses MLLM-based IQA for overall assessment followed by hierarchical coarse-to-fine restoration strategy.

entry.title: DreamStyle: A Unified Framework for Video Stylization

author.name: Mengtian Li, Jinshu Chen, Songtao Zhao, Wanquan Feng, Pengqi Tu, Qian He

entry.summary: Introduces DreamStyle, a unified framework for video stylization supporting text-guided, style-image-guided, and first-frame-guided approaches. Addresses style consistency and temporal flicker issues.

entry.title: Towards Agnostic and Holistic Universal Image Segmentation with Bit Diffusion

author.name: Jakob L{\o}nborg Christensen, Morten Rieger Hannemose, Anders Bjorholm Dahl, Vedrana Andersen Dahl

entry.summary: Introduces a diffusion-based framework for universal image segmentation that predicts full segmentation holistically without mask-based frameworks. Shows 2D gray code ordering improves performance.

entry.title: Enhancing Multilingual RAG Systems with Debiased Language Preference-Guided Query Fusion

author.name: Jeonghyun Park, Byeongjeong Kim, Seojin Hwang, Hwanhee Lee

entry.summary: Identifies biases in multilingual RAG evaluation (exposure bias, gold availability prior, cultural priors) and proposes DeLP for debiased language preference measurement and query fusion in multilingual retrieval systems.

entry.title: MMFormalizer: Multimodal Autoformalization in the Wild

author.name: Jing Xiong, Qi Han, Yunta Hsieh, Hui Shen, Huajian Xin, Chaofan Tao, Chenyang Zhao, Hengyuan Zhang, Taiqiang Wu, Zhen Zhang, Haochen Wang, Zhongwei Wan, Lingpeng Kong, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes MMFormalizer extending autoformalization to multimodal settings by integrating adaptive grounding with real-world mathematical and physical domains through recursive proposition construction from perceptually grounded primitives.

entry.title: The Anatomy of Conversational Scams: A Topic-Based Red Teaming Analysis of Multi-Turn Interactions in LLMs

author.name: Xiangzhe Yuan, Zhenhao Zhang, Haoming Tang, Siying Hu

entry.summary: Systematically studies multi-turn conversational scam risks using LLM-to-LLM simulation, identifying recurrent escalation patterns, defensive mechanisms, and failure modes from safety guardrails and role instability across 8 models.

entry.title: Bayesian Multiple Multivariate Density-Density Regression

author.name: Khai Nguyen, Yang Ni, Peter Mueller

entry.summary: First approach for multiple multivariate density-density regression using sliced Wasserstein barycenters. Enables regression where both predictors and responses are multivariate distributions with principled uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: AIRES: Accelerating Out-of-Core GCNs via Algorithm-System Co-Design

author.name: Shakya Jayakody, Youpeng Zhao, Jun Wang

entry.summary: AIRES system addresses out-of-core GCN training bottlenecks through algorithm-system co-design. Reduces I/O latency and improves GPU utilization for large-scale graph neural networks.

entry.title: Modeling the Mental World for Embodied AI: A Comprehensive Review

author.name: Biyuan Liu, Daigang Xu, Lei Jiang, Wenjun Guo, Ping Chen

entry.summary: Review paper on Mental World Models for embodied AI, covering structured representations of human internal mental states needed for social intelligence and human-machine collaboration.

entry.title: Expert-Guided Explainable Few-Shot Learning with Active Sample Selection for Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Longwei Wang, Ifrat Ikhtear Uddin, KC Santosh

entry.summary: EGxFSL and xGAL frameworks for explainable few-shot learning in medical imaging with expert-guided regions-of-interest supervision via Grad-CAM and active learning prioritizing attention misalignment.

entry.title: The Rise of Agentic Testing: Multi-Agent Systems for Robust Software Quality Assurance

author.name: Saba Naqvi, Mohammad Baqar, Nawaz Ali Mohammad

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent framework for automated software testing where agents collaboratively generate, execute, analyze, and refine tests in a closed-loop system. Uses sandboxed execution and iterative refinement to improve test quality.

entry.title: LLM-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Bahareh Golchin, Banafsheh Rekabdar, Danielle Justo

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining LLM-based reward shaping with RL, VAE-enhanced dynamic rewards, and active learning for time series anomaly detection. Addresses sparse label challenges in practical applications.

entry.title: Reconstructing Item Characteristic Curves using Fine-Tuned Large Language Models

author.name: Christopher Ormerod

entry.summary: Uses fine-tuned LLMs to simulate student responses across ability levels, reconstructing Item Characteristic Curves for psychometric assessment without expensive field testing.

entry.title: Iterative Structured Pruning for Large Language Models with Multi-Domain Calibration

author.name: Guangxin Wu, Hao Zhang, Zhang Zhibin, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes structured pruning framework for LLMs using hybrid multi-domain calibration and iterative calibration for stable compression while maintaining hardware compatibility.

entry.title: Foreground-Aware Dataset Distillation via Dynamic Patch Selection

author.name: Longzhen Li, Guang Li, Ren Togo, Keisuke Maeda, Takahiro Ogawa, Miki Haseyama

entry.summary: Proposes a foreground-aware dataset distillation method using dynamic patch selection that adapts to image content. Addresses computational overhead and generation of unrealistic images in traditional optimization-based distillation.

entry.title: D$^3$R-DETR: DETR with Dual-Domain Density Refinement for Tiny Object Detection in Aerial Images

author.name: Zixiao Wen, Zhen Yang, Xianjie Bao, Lei Zhang, Xiantai Xiang, Wenshuai Li, Yuhan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes D3R-DETR for tiny object detection in aerial images by fusing spatial and frequency domain information. Uses density maps to guide detection of objects with limited pixel information.

entry.title: Towards Zero-Shot Point Cloud Registration Across Diverse Scales, Scenes, and Sensor Setups

author.name: Hyungtae Lim, Minkyun Seo, Luca Carlone, Jaesik Park

entry.summary: Presents BUFFER-X, a training-free point cloud registration framework achieving zero-shot generalization through geometric bootstrapping, distribution-aware sampling, and patch-level coordinates to avoid scale mismatches.

entry.title: M-SEVIQ: A Multi-band Stereo Event Visual-Inertial Quadruped-based Dataset for Perception under Rapid Motion and Challenging Illumination

author.name: Jingcheng Cao, Chaoran Xiong, Jianmin Song, Shang Yan, Jiachen Liu, Ling Pei

entry.summary: Presents M-SEVIQ, a multi-band stereo event visual-inertial dataset collected from a quadruped robot under various illumination conditions. Addresses limitations in existing event camera datasets.

entry.title: RadioDiff-Flux: Efficient Radio Map Construction via Generative Denoise Diffusion Model Trajectory Midpoint Reuse

author.name: Xiucheng Wang and Peilin Zheng and Honggang Jia and Nan Cheng and Ruijin Sun and Conghao Zhou and Xuemin Shen

entry.summary: Proposes RadioDiff-Flux for efficient radio map construction using a two-stage latent diffusion framework. Exploits consistency of latent midpoints across similar scenes for faster inference.

entry.title: Quantum-Enhanced Neural Contextual Bandit Algorithms

author.name: Yuqi Huang, Vincent Y. F Tan, Sharu Theresa Jose

entry.summary: Introduces QNTK-UCB, a quantum neural contextual bandit algorithm using Quantum Neural Tangent Kernel to address over-parameterization and barren plateau issues in quantum neural networks.

entry.title: Revisiting Data Compression with Language Modeling

author.name: Chen-Han Tsai

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs for data compression, achieving 18% adjusted compression rate on enwik9 without additional training. Explores LLMs as compressors for various data types.

entry.title: LOST-3DSG: Lightweight Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs with Semantic Tracking in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Sara Micol Ferraina, Michele Brienza, Francesco Argenziano, Emanuele Musumeci, Vincenzo Suriani, Domenico D. Bloisi, Daniele Nardi

entry.summary: Proposes LOST-3DSG, a lightweight open-vocabulary 3D scene graph for dynamic object tracking using semantic embeddings instead of heavy CLIP features. Achieves superior performance with reduced computational cost.

entry.title: Pearmut: Human Evaluation of Translation Made Trivial

author.name: Vil\'em Zouhar, Tom Kocmi

entry.summary: Introduces Pearmut, a lightweight platform for human evaluation of translation supporting standard protocols (DA, ESA, MQM). Aims to make human evaluation as easy as automatic evaluation.

entry.title: The World is Not Mono: Enabling Spatial Understanding in Large Audio-Language Models

author.name: Yuhuan You, Lai Wei, Xihong Wu, Tianshu Qu

entry.summary: Extends audio-language models beyond mono audio to understand spatial dimensions ('where') through binaural audio synthesis, hybrid semantic-spatial encoders, and dense fusion mechanism applied to models like Qwen2-Audio.

entry.title: Learning to Act Robustly with View-Invariant Latent Actions

author.name: Youngjoon Jeong and Junha Chun and Taesup Kim

entry.summary: Proposes VILA for learning view-invariant latent actions that capture transition patterns across trajectories, grounded in physical dynamics rather than visual appearance. Uses action-guided object-centric alignment across viewpoints.

entry.title: IBISAgent: Reinforcing Pixel-Level Visual Reasoning in MLLMs for Universal Biomedical Object Referring and Segmentation

author.name: Yankai Jiang, Qiaoru Li, Binlu Xu, Haoran Sun, Chao Ding, Junting Dong, Yuxiang Cai, Xuhong Zhang, Jianwei Yin

entry.summary: Proposes IBISAgent, agentic MLLM for biomedical segmentation that reformulates segmentation as vision-centric multi-step reasoning with iterative refinement, avoiding catastrophic forgetting from simultaneous MLLM and decoder fine-tuning.

entry.title: Limited Linguistic Diversity in Embodied AI Datasets

author.name: Selma Wanna, Agnes Luhtaru, Jonathan Salfity, Ryan Barron, Juston Moore, Cynthia Matuszek, Mitch Pryor

entry.summary: Systematic audit of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) training datasets revealing severe linguistic limitations: highly repetitive, template-like commands with limited structural variation. Important documentation of a blind spot in embodied AI.

entry.title: Prompt-Counterfactual Explanations for Generative AI System Behavior

author.name: Sofie Goethals, Foster Provost, Jo\~ao Sedoc

entry.summary: Adapts counterfactual explanations from XAI literature for generative AI systems, explaining what input characteristics cause specific output properties like toxicity or bias. Addresses challenges unique to generative models.

entry.title: On the Convergence Behavior of Preconditioned Gradient Descent Toward the Rich Learning Regime

author.name: Shuai Jiang, Alexey Voronin, Eric Cyr, Ben Southworth

entry.summary: Analyzes how preconditioned gradient descent methods like Gauss-Newton affect spectral bias and grokking in neural networks. Demonstrates theoretically and empirically how PGD can accelerate learning of high-frequency features.

entry.title: LSP-DETR: Efficient and Scalable Nuclei Segmentation in Whole Slide Images

author.name: Mat\v{e}j Pek\'ar and V\'it Musil and Rudolf Nenutil and Petr Holub and Tom\'a\v{s} Br\'azdil

entry.summary: LSP-DETR is an end-to-end nuclei segmentation framework for whole-slide pathology images using linear-complexity transformers. Represents nuclei as star-convex polygons with novel radial distance loss for handling overlapping instances.

entry.title: DiffBench Meets DiffAgent: End-to-End LLM-Driven Diffusion Acceleration Code Generation

author.name: Jiajun jiao, Haowei Zhu, Puyuan Yang, Jianghui Wang, Ji Liu, Ziqiong Liu, Dong Li, Yuejian Fang, Junhai Yong, Bin Wang, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: DiffBench provides comprehensive automated evaluation pipeline for diffusion model acceleration across architectures and scenarios. DiffAgent uses LLMs to automatically generate optimal acceleration code for deployment.

entry.title: Decentralized Autoregressive Generation

author.name: Stepan Maschan, Haoxuan Qu, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Presents theoretical analysis of decentralized autoregressive generation, defining Decentralized Discrete Flow Matching objective. Demonstrates equivalence between decentralized and centralized training for multimodal language models.

entry.title: AnatomiX, an Anatomy-Aware Grounded Multimodal Large Language Model for Chest X-Ray Interpretation

author.name: Anees Ur Rehman Hashmi, Numan Saeed, Christoph Lippert

entry.summary: AnatomiX is a multimodal LLM for chest X-ray interpretation with explicit anatomical grounding. Uses two-stage approach mimicking radiologist workflow: identify anatomical structures first, then perform downstream tasks.

entry.title: Sparse Knowledge Distillation: A Mathematical Framework for Probability-Domain Temperature Scaling and Multi-Stage Compression

author.name: Aaron R. Flouro, Shawn P. Chadwick

entry.summary: Develops unified theoretical framework for sparse knowledge distillation based on probability-domain softening. Provides bias-variance decompositions, homotopy path formalization for multi-stage pruning, and convergence guarantees.

entry.title: DIP: Dynamic In-Context Planner For Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Yang Li, Han Meng, Chenan Wang, Haipeng Chen

entry.summary: DIP dynamically selects and inserts in-context examples during diffusion language model generation rather than providing all upfront. Exploits DLM's bidirectional attention for efficient context optimization.

entry.title: Counterfactual Fairness with Graph Uncertainty

author.name: Davi Val\'erio, Chrysoula Zerva, Mariana Pinto, Ricardo Santos, Andr\'e Carreiro

entry.summary: CF-GU incorporates causal graph uncertainty into counterfactual fairness evaluation by bootstrapping causal discovery algorithms. Quantifies uncertainty with Shannon entropy and provides confidence bounds on fairness metrics.

entry.title: The Fake Friend Dilemma: Trust and the Political Economy of Conversational AI

author.name: Jacob Erickson

entry.summary: Analyzes the 'Fake Friend Dilemma' where users trust AI agents that appear supportive but pursue misaligned goals. Develops typology of harms including covert advertising, propaganda, and surveillance, proposing mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Multi-RADS Synthetic Radiology Report Dataset and Head-to-Head Benchmarking of 41 Open-Weight and Proprietary Language Models

author.name: Kartik Bose, Abhinandan Kumar, Raghuraman Soundararajan, Priya Mudgil, Samonee Ralmilay, Niharika Dutta, Manphool Singhal, Arun Kumar, Saugata Sen, Anurima Patra, Priya Ghosh, Abanti Das, Amit Gupta, Ashish Verma, Dipin Sudhakaran, Ekta Dhamija, Himangi Unde, Ishan Kumar, Krithika Rangarajan, Prerna Garg, Rachel Sequeira, Sudhin Shylendran, Taruna Yadav, Tej Pal, Pankaj Gupta

entry.summary: RXL-RADSet is radiologist-verified synthetic benchmark with 1,600 reports across 10 RADS frameworks. Benchmarks 41 language models (open-weight and proprietary) on standardized radiology risk assignment.

entry.title: InfiniDepth: Arbitrary-Resolution and Fine-Grained Depth Estimation with Neural Implicit Fields

author.name: Hao Yu, Haotong Lin, Jiawei Wang, Jiaxin Li, Yida Wang, Xueyang Zhang, Yue Wang, Xiaowei Zhou, Ruizhen Hu and Sida Peng

entry.summary: InfiniDepth represents depth as neural implicit fields enabling continuous-coordinate queries for arbitrary-resolution depth estimation. Includes new 4K synthetic benchmark from game environments for high-resolution evaluation.

entry.title: Muses: Designing, Composing, Generating Nonexistent Fantasy 3D Creatures without Training

author.name: Hexiao Lu, Xiaokun Sun, Zeyu Cai, Hao Guo, Ying Tai, Jian Yang, Zhenyu Zhang

entry.summary: Muses is first training-free method for generating fantastical 3D creatures via skeleton-based composition. Uses graph-constrained reasoning to create coherent skeletal layouts, then guides voxel-based generation.

entry.title: Catching misreporting about ML hardware use by turning noise into signal - Part II

author.name: Naci Cankaya

entry.summary: Proposes using trusted noisy hardware plus untrusted precise hardware for verifying ML compute claims. Uses network tap for comparison without revealing sensitive information to verifier.

entry.title: Fast Conformal Prediction using Conditional Interquantile Intervals

author.name: Naixin Guo, Rui Luo and Zhixin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Conformal Interquantile Regression (CIR) for efficient conformal prediction with near-minimal prediction intervals. CIR+ variant adds width-based selection for narrower intervals while maintaining coverage.

entry.title: Evolutionary Algorithms for Computing Nash Equilibria in Dynamic Games

author.name: Alireza Rezaee

entry.summary: Proposes evolutionary algorithms for computing Nash equilibria in dynamic games with nonlinear dynamics. Shows classical methods can fail and proposes co-evolutionary genetic algorithm and hybrid GA-PSO.

entry.title: Focus on What Matters: Fisher-Guided Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Yun Bian, Yi Chen, HaiQuan Wang, ShiHao Li, Zhe Cui

entry.summary: TaCCS-DFA uses Fisher information to measure how much each modality contributes to vulnerability detection, enabling adaptive fusion that prevents graph modality from diluting sequence discriminative signal.

entry.title: CT Scans As Video: Efficient Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection Using Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Amirreza Parvahan, Mohammad Hoseyni, Javad Khoramdel, and Amirhossein Nikoofard

entry.summary: Reformulates CT scan analysis as a video processing task for intracranial hemorrhage detection, using lightweight YOLO models with ByteTrack for efficient edge device deployment.

entry.title: LendNova: Towards Automated Credit Risk Assessment with Language Models

author.name: Kiarash Shamsi, Danijel Novokmet, Joshua Peters, Mao Lin Liu, Paul K Edwards, Vahab Khoshdel

entry.summary: Introduces LendNova, the first end-to-end automated pipeline for credit risk assessment that operates directly on raw credit bureau text using language models without manual feature engineering.

entry.title: Hierarchical temporal receptive windows and zero-shot timescale generalization in biologically constrained scale-invariant deep networks

author.name: Aakash Sarkar, Marc W. Howard

entry.summary: Demonstrates that hierarchical temporal receptive windows emerge naturally in biologically-constrained deep networks trained on language tasks, achieving zero-shot generalization to unseen timescales.

entry.title: Effective Online 3D Bin Packing with Lookahead Parcels Using Monte Carlo Tree Search

author.name: Jiangyi Fang, Bowen Zhou, Haotian Wang, Xin Zhu, Leye Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Monte Carlo Tree Search framework for online 3D bin packing with lookahead information, addressing distribution shifts in real-world logistics through model predictive control formulation.

entry.title: DGA-Net: Enhancing SAM with Depth Prompting and Graph-Anchor Guidance for Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Yuetong Li, Qing Zhang, Yilin Zhao, Gongyang Li, Zeming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DGA-Net for camouflaged object detection adapting SAM with depth prompting. Uses Cross-modal Graph Enhancement and Anchor-Guided Refinement for dense prompt propagation.

entry.title: Rationale-Grounded In-Context Learning for Time Series Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Qingxiang Liu, Zhiqing Cui, Xiaoliang Luo, Yuqian Wu, Zhuoyang Jiang, Huaiyu Wan, Sheng Sun, Lvchun Wang, Wei Yu, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes rationale-grounded in-context learning for time series reasoning where rationales serve as guiding reasoning units (not post-hoc explanations) connecting observations to outcomes, with hybrid retrieval for correlated rationale priors.

entry.title: SentGraph: Hierarchical Sentence Graph for Multi-hop Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering

author.name: Junli Liang, Pengfei Zhou, Wangqiu Zhou, Wenjie Qing, Qi Zhao, Ziwen Wang, Qi Song, Xiangyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes SentGraph, sentence-level graph RAG framework that explicitly models fine-grained logical relationships using Rhetorical Structure Theory to distinguish nucleus/satellite sentences for multi-hop question answering.

entry.title: Learning to Diagnose and Correct Moral Errors: Towards Enhancing Moral Sensitivity in Large Language Models

author.name: Bocheng Chen, Han Zi, Xi Chen, Xitong Zhang, Kristen Johnson, Guangliang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes pragmatic inference methods to enhance moral sensitivity in LLMs by enabling them to diagnose morally benign/hazardous input and correct moral errors through unified perspective rather than diverse surface forms.

entry.title: Distillation-based Scenario-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for the Matching Stage of Multi-scenario Recommendation

author.name: Ruibing Wang, Shuhan Guo, Haotong Du, Quanming Yao

entry.summary: DSMOE addresses multi-scenario recommendation matching with Scenario-Adaptive Projection and cross-architecture knowledge distillation to prevent expert collapse in long-tail scenarios.

entry.title: Dementia-R1: Reinforced Pretraining and Reasoning from Unstructured Clinical Notes for Real-World Dementia Prognosis

author.name: Choonghan Kim, Hyunmin Hwang, Hangeol Chang, Jaemin Kim, Jinse Park, Jae-Sung Lim, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Introduces Dementia-R1, RL-based framework for dementia prognosis from unstructured clinical notes using Cold-Start RL that pre-trains on verifiable clinical indices before determining outcomes. Addresses sparse reward challenge.

entry.title: Deep Minimax Classifiers for Imbalanced Datasets with a Small Number of Minority Samples

author.name: Hansung Choi and Daewon Seo

entry.summary: Proposes a minimax learning algorithm for neural networks to handle imbalanced datasets by minimizing worst-class risk. Introduces targeted logit-adjustment loss and iteratively updates target priors toward adversarial distributions.

entry.title: Statistical Inference for Fuzzy Clustering

author.name: Qiuyi Wu, Zihan Zhu, Anru R. Zhang

entry.summary: Develops weighted fuzzy c-means framework with principled statistical inference, providing confidence intervals and hypothesis tests for fuzzy clustering. Addresses cluster size imbalance through cluster-specific weights.

entry.title: Explainable Lane Change Prediction for Near-Crash Scenarios Using Knowledge Graph Embeddings and Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: M. Manzour, A. Ballardini, R. Izquierdo, M. \'A. Sotelo

entry.summary: Uses knowledge graphs and RAG with Bayesian inference for explainable risky lane change prediction. Achieves 91.5% F1 with 4-second anticipation time using custom CRASH dataset.

entry.title: Presenting DiaData for Research on Type 1 Diabetes

author.name: Beyza Cinar and Maria Maleshkova

entry.summary: DiaData systematically integrates 15 Type 1 diabetes datasets to create comprehensive resource for hypoglycemia prediction and diabetes research. Addresses data scarcity in diabetes ML.

entry.title: AI-Native Integrated Sensing and Communications for Self-Organizing Wireless Networks: Architectures, Learning Paradigms, and System-Level Design

author.name: S. Zhang, M. Feizarefi, A. F. Mirzaei

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on AI-native Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) for self-organizing wireless networks, covering architectures, learning paradigms, and system design.

entry.title: Deep Learning Superresolution for 7T Knee MR Imaging: Impact on Image Quality and Diagnostic Performance

author.name: Pinzhen Chen, Libo Xu, Boyang Pan, Jing Li, Yuting Wang, Ran Xiong, Xiaoli Gou, Long Qing, Wenjing Hou, Nan-jie Gong and Wei Chen

entry.summary: Deep learning superresolution for 7T knee MRI using Hybrid Attention Transformer. SR images show higher quality than low-res and lower noise than high-res with improved pathology visibility.

entry.title: Don't Mind the Gaps: Implicit Neural Representations for Resolution-Agnostic Retinal OCT Analysis

author.name: Bennet Kahrs, Julia Andresen, Fenja Falta, Monty Santarossa, Heinz Handels and Timo Kepp

entry.summary: Introduces implicit neural representations (INRs) for retinal OCT analysis that handle variable resolution inputs, addressing the anisotropy issues in clinical imaging. This enables volumetric 3D analysis rather than inconsistent 2D slice-by-slice approaches.

entry.title: Learning and Optimizing the Efficacy of Spatio-Temporal Task Allocation under Temporal and Resource Constraints

author.name: Jiazhen Liu, Glen Neville, Jinwoo Park, Sonia Chernova, Harish Ravichandar

entry.summary: Formalizes Spatio-Temporal Efficacy-optimized Allocation for Multi-robot systems (STEAM), modeling how aggregated capabilities affect performance beyond binary success-failure models. Proposes bi-level optimization approach.

entry.title: Compressed code: the hidden effects of quantization and distillation on programming tokens

author.name: Viacheslav Siniaev, Iaroslav Chelombitko, Aleksey Komissarov

entry.summary: Analyzes how quantization, distillation, and model scaling affect code generation at the token level, introducing cold-start probability analysis method for understanding model behavior without explicit prompts.

entry.title: FlowPlan-G2P: A Structured Generation Framework for Transforming Scientific Papers into Patent Descriptions

author.name: Kris W Pan, Yongmin Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes FlowPlan-G2P framework for transforming scientific papers into patent descriptions through three stages: concept graph induction, paragraph planning, and graph-conditioned generation.

entry.title: Making Infeasible Tasks Feasible: Planning to Reconfigure Disconnected 3D Environments with Movable Objects

author.name: Samarth Kalluraya, Yiannis Kantaros

entry.summary: Proposes planning approach for robots to reconfigure disconnected 3D environments by strategically placing movable objects to create pathways to otherwise unreachable goals.

entry.title: Inferring Causal Graph Temporal Logic Formulas to Expedite Reinforcement Learning in Temporally Extended Tasks

author.name: Hadi Partovi Aria, Zhe Xu

entry.summary: Presents GTL-CIRL framework that simultaneously learns RL policies and mines Causal Graph Temporal Logic specifications, using GP-driven Bayesian optimization for efficient parameter space exploration.

entry.title: Topology-Independent Robustness of the Weighted Mean under Label Poisoning Attacks in Heterogeneous Decentralized Learning

author.name: Jie Peng, Weiyu Li, Stefan Vlaski, Qing Ling

entry.summary: Analyzes robustness of decentralized learning under label poisoning, finding that weighted mean aggregator's performance is topology-independent while robust aggregators depend on network structure.

entry.title: Optimizing Control-Friendly Trajectories with Self-Supervised Residual Learning

author.name: Kexin Guo, Zihan Yang, Yuhang Liu, Jindou Jia and Xiang Yu

entry.summary: Presents a self-supervised framework for learning residual dynamics and optimizing control-friendly trajectories for robotic systems. Combines hybrid modeling with trajectory optimization to handle unknown physics.

entry.title: Q-Regularized Generative Auto-Bidding: From Suboptimal Trajectories to Optimal Policies

author.name: Mingming Zhang, Na Li, Zhuang Feiqing, Hongyang Zheng, Jiangbing Zhou, Wang Wuyin, Sheng-jie Sun, XiaoWei Chen, Junxiong Zhu, Lixin Zou, Chenliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes QGA for auto-bidding that combines Q-value regularization with Decision Transformer to learn from suboptimal offline trajectories. Enables joint optimization of policy imitation and value maximization.

entry.title: UniSRCodec: Unified and Low-Bitrate Single Codebook Codec with Sub-Band Reconstruction

Addresses a practical gap where existing benchmarks fail to emulate real-world SAST finding distributions.
